# Chapter 650: Return to Hu Immortal Blessed Land

Slowly opening his eyes, Fang Yuan woke up.

Seeing bright pink crystal walls, Fang Yuan recalled using the stargate to return to Hu Immortal blessed land.

After returning to Hu Immortal blessed land, he made some arrangements and fell into deep sleep.

"My body is filled with death energy and completely turned into a zombie, knowing no fatigue. But my soul is still my original soul—it has limits and suffers injuries too."

Fang Yuan exhaled turbid air and stretched his limbs, but his body felt rusty, inflexible, and heavy.

This was the backlash of Myriad Self depleting his soul, making moving this zombie body exhausting.

"Where is the land spirit?" Fang Yuan asked, his voice coarse, grating, and chillingly dry.

"Master!" The land spirit Little Hu Immortal's voice immediately resounded in his ears.

Fang Yuan turned to see Little Hu Immortal appearing before his left hand, eyes red.

"How long have I been asleep?" Fang Yuan nodded, asking.

"Master, you have been asleep for two days and three nights." Little Hu Immortal replied.

With the time difference between the blessed land and Northern Plains, less than a day had passed outside the wind veil.

Before sleeping, he had agreed to temporarily cooperate with Hei Lou Lan, meaning he would soon have to return to Northern Plains.

Little Hu Immortal consoled him: "Master, don't be upset. Though your appearance has changed, there must be a way to reverse it. I believe master will return to your original form one day. Master, cheer up!"

Fang Yuan chuckled speechlessly, extending an arm to stroke Little Hu Immortal's small head.

He split a portion of his consciousness and looked inside his body.

The first aperture was in dead silence, devoid of primeval essence and holding only his first vital Gu.

The purple crystal walls had turned stony and cracked under Spring Autumn Cicada's pressure.

"This is the price of becoming a zombie: the aperture is dead and cannot produce primeval essence," Fang Yuan assessed.

"Unlike First Gen Gu Yue, I have ascended, possessing nineteen green grape immortal essence beads and limitless primeval essence!"

With that in mind, Fang Yuan shifted his consciousness to the second aperture.

His strength path immortal aperture was now a dead blessed land of collapsed mountains and foul, rotting ground. The ground was cracked as though struck by an earthquake, the consequence of forcefully containing wisdom Gu.

Inside this immortal aperture were almost all of Fang Yuan's Gu worms.

After inspecting his mortal and immortal aperture, Fang Yuan directed his attention to his body.

Even without a mirror, he knew he had become a monster: six meters tall, green-faced with sharp fangs, blood-red eyes, and rock-hard bulging muscles. Beside his two human arms, six monstrous limbs originated from various rank five flying zombie Gu.

Most critically, the zombie body halted cultivation progress—a massive obstacle to his ambitions.

"How can I shed this zombie body, return from death to life, and regain a living human body?" Fang Yuan asked himself. This was an urgent problem to solve.

Interrogating Mo Yao's will inside his immortal aperture was one method; utilizing wisdom Gu was the second.

As Little Hu Immortal's sobs ceased, Fang Yuan pulled back his hand and asked calmly, "Did anything happen while I was asleep?"

Little Hu Immortal straightened up, wiped her tears, and answered maturely: "Reporting to Master, two matters occurred. The second matter is regarding Immortal Crane Sect, they have stopped engaging in our rockmen transactions."

"Becoming a zombie has degraded my cognition; my thoughts move far too slowly," Fang Yuan frowned deeply.

# Chapter 651: Guilt-ridden Tai Bai Yun Sheng

Stagnant cultivation was only the main drawback; others included the loss of pain and sluggish cognition.

"No wonder zombies like First Gen Gu Yue enter deep sleep. Sleep minimizes thinking and sharply reduces thought consumption, allowing thoughts to accumulate. When they battle, they would think intensely and use up these thoughts." Fang Yuan had a new understanding in his mind.

He turned to Little Hu Immortal: "Bring my senior brother, Tai Bai Yun Sheng, inside. I want to meet him."

Ten breaths later, Little Hu Immortal reappeared, bringing Tai Bai Yun Sheng with her.

"Junior brother, you... sigh!" What shall we do now?" Taking a look at Fang Yuan, Tai Bai Yun Sheng was stunned, his eyes turned red as he spoke in a choking voice."

Fang Yuan laughed heartily: "I advanced to Gu Immortal only to end up like this. Come, take a seat; it's crude here."

His heart was filled with concern, gratitude, and unconditional trust toward Fang Yuan.

Upon waking, Tai Bai Yun Sheng had been deeply relieved that Little Hu Immortal returned his two Immortal Gu.

Sitting on the boulder with a grieving expression, he sighed deeply: "I am ashamed. Not only did you save my life, Junior Brother, but I even need your consolation upon meeting."

Fang Yuan patted Tai Bai Yun Sheng's shoulder and gave a hoarse laugh: "Destiny is unpredictable, and life rarely goes as one wishes. We must be open-minded. Although I became a zombie, it is still halfway between life and death, compared to those dead people and Giant Sun's will, we are much better! Especially when at the final moment, I even obtained wisdom Gu! This is a huge profit; you should be happy, Senior Brother."

"I have deep admiration for you, Junior Brother. But even so, let me try Man as Before on your zombie body!" Deeply emotional, Tai Bai Yun Sheng stood up, ready to give it a try.

But Fang Yuan stopped him.

"Senior Brother, you know full well that Man as Before can only return someone to a state from a moment in the past. Too much time has passed since I transformed; countless moments have gone by. How could it possibly heal me? Why waste your precious green grape immortal essence in vain?"

Tai Bai Yun Sheng turned ashen with turbulent emotions. As Fang Yuan finished speaking, he suddenly slapped himself hard across the face!

"Senior Brother, stop! What are you doing?" Feigning surprise, Fang Yuan quickly stood up and grabbed Tai Bai Yun Sheng's hands with two arms.

Completely overpowered and immobilized, Tai Bai Yun Sheng wept bitterly: "Junior Brother, I let you down—I am so sorry!"

"If only I had lent you Man as Before, you would never have become this!" Tai Bai Yun Sheng wept.

Standing six meters tall, Fang Yuan looked down at the weeping Tai Bai Yun Sheng, an eerie glint flashing in his eyes.

I'm glad you think so, he laughed inwardly, though aloud he sounded utterly sincere: "Senior Brother, you needn't be like this. Although difficult to revert, many methods exist, and we even have wisdom Gu here."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng shook his head weakly: "Wisdom... wisdom Gu is rank nine and only followed you out of survival instinct. Even as a rank six Gu Immortal, you cannot refine or control it!"

"I understand, but even a sliver of the light of wisdom brings immense benefits. In fact, my lifespan-less zombie body is ideally suited to approach wisdom Gu!" Fang Yuan extended a third arm, patting Tai Bai Yun Sheng's back amiably as he explained.

Fang Yuan chuckled: "Most importantly, don't forget we still have Master. I'm certain Master has a solution. I will not hide this from you, after master handed me the mission for Eighty-Eight True Yang Building, he only left me a single consumable Gu, with the specific use of reporting the details to him. I had already used this Gu two days ago, when I first returned to Hu Immortal blessed land."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng's eyes lit up: "So you have a way to contact Master! That's wonderful—with Master's vast knowledge, he is sure to have a way!"

Showing no flaws, Fang Yuan replied calmly: "Don't be hasty, Senior Brother. Master's reply should arrive in a few days; let us wait patiently."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng stepped back, locking eyes with Fang Yuan's bright red gaze. Placing a hand over his chest, he said solemnly: "Junior Brother, I will engrave your kindness in my heart and never forget it. I swear to Longevity Heaven, even if Master cannot cure you, I will spend my entire life seeking your revival!"

"Hahaha! Longevity Heaven is Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's grotto-heaven—swearing by it after we just wrecked his True Yang Building is too ironic!" Fang Yuan laughed aloud. "Senior Brother, I'll be frank! We are Master's disciples, and since I saved you, I expect you to repay me fully!"

"Name it," Tai Bai Yun Sheng responded without hesitation, determined to repay the debt even if asked to do the impossible. Ever since waking, intense guilt had weighed on his conscience; only by sacrificing something for Fang Yuan could his heart find relief.

Fang Yuan grew solemn: "I've thought about this for a long time—our seniority! As Master's legacy disciple, I'm dissatisfied that your ascension allowed you to overtake me! I became a Gu Immortal first, and once I revert my zombie body, seniority dictates that I am the senior brother and you are the junior brother."

"What?" Tai Bai Yun Sheng stared wide-eyed, never expecting the great repayment Fang Yuan demanded would be over such a trifling matter.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng laughed teasingly: "Wishful thinking, Junior Brother! Unless Master rearranges us, I am still your senior brother!"

"Hey!" Fang Yuan voiced his displeasure: "Old Bai, don't be so petty! Did you forget what I said? I will never call you senior brother!"

"Hahaha, I understand completely, Junior Brother—this senior brother doesn't mind." Tai Bai Yun Sheng laughed heartily, tears overflowing from deep emotion.

# Chapter 652: Seeing Wisdom Gu Again

With Tai Bai Yun Sheng gone, Fang Yuan was left alone in the cave.

Killing Tai Bai Yun Sheng would yield Man as Before, Landscape as Before, and a rank six time path immortal aperture, but that would not maximize his benefits.

First, his utility was immense: a rank six time path Gu Immortal with a high-grade blessed land, exceptional healing, and master-level flying attainment.

Second, he was easy to control. Having searched his soul, Fang Yuan knew his entire past; Tai Bai Yun Sheng was kind-hearted, conscientious, and devoted to repaying favors. Indebted after being helped repeatedly in True Yang Building, rescued from the wind veil of assimilation, and returned his two Immortal Gu, Tai Bai Yun Sheng now placed absolute trust in Fang Yuan.

"Feeding so many Immortal Gu is too costly; leaving Man as Before and Landscape as Before with Tai Bai Yun Sheng is undoubtedly better. Meanwhile, my dead immortal aperture cannot produce immortal essence. I only have nineteen beads of green grape immortal essence. Rather than exhausting my limited reserves, it is far better to utilize Tai Bai Yun Sheng's instead."

He summoned Little Hu Immortal: "How is wisdom Gu? Where is it now?"

"Master, wisdom Gu burrowed deep underground after you brought it here. It found a rockman cave and is slumbering inside," Little Hu Immortal reported after sensing its location with closed eyes.

Fang Yuan nodded, ordering: "Bring me there."

Sensing that Fang Yuan had arrived, wisdom Gu shone with a five colored light.

"Wisdom Gu, I saved your life and helped you escape. By our earlier agreement, it is time to uphold your end of the deal," Fang Yuan's voice echoed in the dark cave.

The multicolored sphere of wisdom light expanded, engulfing Fang Yuan and Little Hu Immortal.

Thoughts collided instantly in Fang Yuan's mind as his cognition accelerated to lightning speed.

But after a few breaths' time, her body started fading.

"Little Hu Immortal, you are formed from obsession and restricted by wisdom Gu. You cannot stay here—quickly return." Fang Yuan tapped her forehead.

Not daring to disobey Fang Yuan, she vanished in a flash.

As a zombie, his thought production and cognition had slowed. But the light of wisdom accelerated thought collisions, expending vast amounts of thoughts in a short time.

But there were wills in Fang Yuan's mind.

To counter Mo Yao, Fang Yuan had acquired wisdom path Gu like special will, deliberate will, and sharp intent, which could think on his behalf.

Powered by limitless primeval essence, his wills were near infinite, rapidly melting like snow under wisdom's light.

Flashes of inspiration followed, and old memories grew clearer. Whenever Fang Yuan concentrated, vast amounts of memories vividly replayed in his mind.

# Chapter 653: Bankruptcy and Zombie Alliance

In the underground cave, Fang Yuan bathed in the light of wisdom and pondered deeply.

"This trip to northern plains far exceeded my expectations. Without Mo Yao's interference, I could have stayed in True Yang Building, exploring it gradually under different identities every ten years. But now the die is cast, and northern plains will be in an uproar; countless experts and powerful forces will seek trouble with me!"

"Eighty-Eight True Yang Building is northern plains' spiritual symbol, and I am the culprit who toppled it. If captured now, the consequences will be unimaginable. Although I can hide in Hu Immortal blessed land right now, it is not truly safe. Immortal Crane Sect covets Dang Hun Mountain, and Northern Plains' Gu Immortals might track me down through wisdom path deductions!"

"Dark Limit Immortal Gu was known even in my previous life for concealing aura and obstructing calculations. Obtaining it should help me avert this danger."

Fang Yuan thought of Hei Lou Lan.

Both Dark Limit and Fixed Immortal Travel were treasures he desired.

The wills in his mind were nearly expended.

Dazed for a moment, Fang Yuan retreated from wisdom's light to activate Gu worms and create new wills.

"Mortal Gu produce so few wills that burn away instantly. An Immortal Gu would provide immense, long-lasting wills to think freely!"

He possessed a rank six wisdom path Immortal Gu, Delight in Water and Mountain, which produced joyful will.

Yet with only nineteen beads of green grape immortal essence and an unreplenishing dead aperture, every bead was irreplaceable.

This time, he focused inward on himself rather than external situations.

"As a zombie, my cultivation is stagnant; reviving my human body is essential. The second issue is that I am completely bankrupt!"

He lacked even a single immortal essence stone, and Hu Immortal blessed land had become extremely barren.

The rockman slave trade had been Fang Yuan's economic pillar, but it collapsed after Immortal Crane Sect halted transactions. With treasure yellow heaven's rockman market already carved up, he could hardly squeeze in, worsening his predicament.

Three days later.

Within Dang Hun Palace.

Seated to Fang Yuan's left, Tai Bai Yun Sheng furrowed his brows as he held a delicate white dove.

Withdrawing his consciousness from the messenger dove Gu, Tai Bai Yun Sheng sighed worriedly: "Master does not plan to help, treating this as a test for junior brother."

Fang Yuan nodded: "Master criticized my greed for rashly opening Di Qiu inheritance, which brought Mo Yao's will and these consequences. So he wants me to resolve this myself. Sigh, master has always been like this; I have no choice but to work hard!"

Tai Bai Yun Sheng asked quietly: "Junior brother, you said master has six legacy disciples. You rank fifth, grasping strength and enslavement paths. Why not ask the other five disciples for help?"

The messenger dove's contents were fabricated by Fang Yuan, Purple Mountain True Monarch was a made-up alias, and the six legacy disciples were pure fiction—how could they seek help from nonexistent people?

"That is impossible," Fang Yuan smiled bitterly. "I have never met them, nor do I know their identities or whereabouts. More importantly, this is master's task! In the letter, he acknowledged your status as the fifth disciple and instructed you to assist me in solving this issue. After all, this is his test for me."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng said anxiously: "Even without master's words, I would stand by your side with all my strength! What are your plans now?"

"Old Bai, you read the letter. Master suggested I join Zombie Alliance."

"What kind of organization is Zombie Alliance?" asked Tai Bai Yun Sheng, who had newly ascended to Gu Immortal and was still unfamiliar with many things.

"Zombie Alliance is an ancient organization spanning all five regions, established during Medieval Antiquity. Headquartered in Eastern Sea, it has branches across the other four regions," Fang Yuan explained.

Fang Yuan shook his head: "Not quite. Nearly all members are zombies, and their higher-ups are immortal zombies like me. For the most part, these immortal zombies are Gu Immortals who became zombies to prolong their lives after exhausting their lifespan. With dead immortal apertures unable to produce essence or absorb heaven and earth qi, their blessed lands gradually shrink and crumble. Thus, their battle strength usually pales compared to normal Gu Immortals. Naturally, certain immortal zombies are exceptions."

"I see." Having broadened his knowledge, Tai Bai Yun Sheng asked doubtfully, "Then why does master want you to join Zombie Alliance?"

Fang Yuan thought for a moment: "If a Gu Immortal forced to become an immortal zombie later obtains lifespan Gu, they will naturally want to resurrect. Zombie Alliance was established to research methods of regaining a living body. Master likely intends for me to obtain those results."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng was both pleased and concerned: "A good idea, but how will you join Zombie Alliance?"

Fang Yuan laughed: "No need to worry, Old Bai. Joining is simple—I only need to prove my immortal zombie status."

"Suppressed by super forces, Zombie Alliance eagerly welcomes new members. An immortal zombie's identity cannot be faked. Zombie Alliance has researched deeply and has many methods to verify immortal zombies. I intend to join the northern plains branch, but first, we must wait for someone."

"Hei Lou Lan." Tai Bai Yun Sheng blurted out.

Fang Yuan nodded.

# Chapter 654: Asking Mo Yao’s will

"Sigh, it has been so many years since I last saw a mirror willow." Mo Yao's will sighed, touching the solitary tree with deep emotion as past memories resurfaced.

This dark, decaying world was Fang Yuan's dead immortal aperture.

Mo Yao's will had proved remarkably cooperative, elaborating on all his refinement path questions and providing immense insights.

Yet when Fang Yuan asked about Spirit Affinity House, Mo Yao's will made a request: "I have been away from central continent for so long, and I deeply miss the people and things there. Please find me a mirror willow tree to soothe my longing for my homeland."

Beneath the mirror willow, Mo Yao's will shared much inside information about Spirit Affinity House.

"Next time you come, could you bring a cup of qingpu tea? It is Spirit Affinity House's specialty tea. Though I cannot taste it, I would like to see it," Mo Yao requested.

Fang Yuan's will snorted: "You seem to lack awareness of your captive status. Asking for this and that—are you scheming again?"

Mo Yao's will laughed charmingly: "Oh Fang Yuan, you are too vigilant. How could I possibly create or execute any schemes?"

Mo Yao's will smiled: "Force will only yield fragmented results. Soul searching is easy, but will searching is tough. A wisdom path grandmaster could manage it, but you have almost no wisdom path foundation, merely buying random Gu from the market. Wisdom path is uniquely mysterious and complex; you have not even reached the entry level."

Fang Yuan's will laughed: "Thanks for your cooperation; I will bring the qingpu tea next time."

The immortal aperture opened a tiny slit, and his will flew back into Fang Yuan's mind.

She cooperated and answered his questions to display her value and buy herself time.

"Finding a wisdom path inheritance would make everything easier. Unfortunately, wisdom path is profound and its practitioners rare; I know of no such inheritances from my memories."

"Master, Immortal Crane Sect's reply is here." Little Hu Immortal appeared holding a rank five letter Gu.

Fang Yuan took the letter Gu and his consciousness went into it.

The letter demanded Fang Yuan initiate the guts Gu trade, threatening to declare him a traitor and attack the blessed land!

Immortal Crane Sect had capitalized on Fang Yuan and Fang Zheng's resemblance to claim Fang Yuan as their secretly nurtured disciple, forcing the other nine sects to recognize their victory.

"Branding me a sect traitor gives them a perfect pretext to attack Tian Ti Mountain without provoking outrage," Fang Yuan contemplated solemnly.

Fang Yuan laughed, saying to Little Hu Immortal: "Bring Tai Bai Yun Sheng here."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng's face darkened at the news: "What shall we do? Immortal Crane Sect is one of central continent's ten ancient sects, far surpassing northern plains' super tribes. If they attack, the two of us cannot stop them!"

Tai Bai Yun Sheng gasped, showing embarrassment as he pondered before suggesting: "Didn't we ally with Hei Lou Lan? We can ask her for help!"

Suddenly, Tai Bai Yun Sheng patted his head: "I've got it! Didn't master tell you to join Zombie Alliance? We can use their strength to threaten Immortal Crane Sect!"

Fang Yuan shook his head: "Zombie Alliance's Central Continent branch is far inferior to Immortal Crane Sect. Rather than deterring them, seeking their help would only invite Zombie Alliance to exploit us."

Noticing Fang Yuan's calm smile, Tai Bai Yun Sheng chuckled: "You clearly already have a plan!"

"What method do you have, aren't you going to tell me?"

"Immortal Crane Sect's claim of my discipleship is their weakness, and my breakthrough point."

Fang Yuan revealed: "I plan to send a letter to Spirit Affinity House to establish contact."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng asked: "What if Spirit Affinity House hands your letter to Immortal Crane Sect?"

"Of course not, because this letter... is very special." Fang Yuan was extremely confident.

# Chapter 655: Deducing a Gu recipe

Thoughts in his mind burned away rapidly, the intense expenditure far exceeding his normal thinking speed.

"The power of rank nine Gu is terrifying," Fang Yuan marveled as he stepped from the halo.

He was perfecting the refinement recipe of gruel mud Immortal Gu.

Days of accumulated wills were expended in a dozen breaths.

The result was less than a 0.1% advancement in deducing the gruel mud Gu recipe.

Fang Yuan originally planned to deduce Immortal Gu recipes and sell them in treasure yellow heaven for profit, but he ran into a problem.

"Deducing an Immortal Gu recipe requires immense will, but mortal Gu produce far too little. Running these mortal Gu at full capacity has pushed them to their limits; exceeding this will damage them. Unless I use the rank six Delight in Water and Mountain Gu..."

He consumed one bead of green grape immortal essence, activating delight in water and mountain Gu.

Joyful will surged like a rushing river compared to the puddle from mortal Gu.

Fang Yuan re-entered the halo of wisdom, falling into deep thought.

Deduction progress on the gruel mud Immortal Gu recipe advanced by one percent.

He silently left the underground cave for Dang Hun Palace.

"Junior brother, how did it go?" asked Tai Bai Yun Sheng, who had been waiting anxiously inside the palace.

Having limited lifespan, Tai Bai Yun Sheng dared not approach the legendary Gu that consumed longevity.

Fang Yuan sighed: "I used Delight in Water and Mountain; its joyful will advanced the deduction by one percent."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng stood up in excitement: "One percent? That means a hundred uses will deduce a complete Immortal Gu recipe! that after becoming a zombie, junior brother could receive such benefits!"

Seeing Tai Bai Yun Sheng's excitement, Fang Yuan nodded: "Having you inspect Hu Immortal blessed land and learn Gu Immortal cultivation was effective. You've finally realized the importance of cultivation resources. Unfortunately, though selling Immortal Gu recipes is highly profitable, we cannot do so yet."

"Ah, why is that?" Tai Bai Yun Sheng was confused.

"Deducing an Immortal Gu recipe from scratch requires over a hundred beads of green grape immortal essence."

"Junior brother, didn't you deduce one percent of this Immortal Gu recipe?"

"I was deducing gruel mud Gu, which I had already collated to sixty percent completion," Fang Yuan explained.

A sixty percent remnant recipe already had a general direction, allowing Fang Yuan to rule out many refinement elements and advance the deduction by one percent.

Fang Yuan continued: "I only have eighteen immortal essence beads left, and you and the land spirit cannot enter the wisdom halo. Even if I lend you delight in water and mountain Immortal Gu, I cannot use the joyful will you create. The gruel mud remnant recipe is our most promising option, but it still requires about forty beads of immortal essence. Moreover, we aren't safe. Northern Plains' Gu Immortals and Immortal Crane Sect will target us. If wisdom Gu is exposed, every Gu Immortal across the five regions will come hunting us!"

"Yes, the cost is too great, and we must preserve green grape immortal essence for emergencies." Tai Bai Yun Sheng nodded, sighing as he looked down in disappointment.

Suddenly he looked up, eyes shining: "I have an idea! Junior brother, remember what you told me regarding Lang Ya land spirit? Master taught you Eighty-Eight True Yang Building's secrets, so when seeking Lang Ya land spirit's help, you claimed you deduced them yourself. Lang Ya land spirit assumed you were a wisdom path Gu Master and wanted to collaborate on perfecting Gu recipes!"

"Right!" Fang Yuan feigned sudden realization. "Lang Ya land spirit holds many highly completed remnant recipes! Old Bai, you're right! My best remnant recipe is sixty percent gruel mud, but Lang Ya land spirit must hold many remnant recipes with far higher completion rates!"

"You know Lang Ya land spirit and how to enter Lang Ya blessed land—we can certainly cooperate!" Tai Bai Yun Sheng laughed heartily at the plan.

# Chapter 656: I will take down my brother in the name of justice

"Old Bai, that is true, but I have no direct way to contact Lang Ya land spirit. I used two requests to take two Immortal Gu from that old man, nearly getting chased out. Hehehe, I doubt he'll welcome me," Fang Yuan smiled bitterly.

Connecting Hu Immortal blessed land in Central Continent to Northern Plains' Lang Ya blessed land required stargate Gu.

Stargate Gu worked in pairs, but Fang Yuan had only one left, the other destroyed in the wind veil of assimilation.

"There is another way, though it relies on luck," Fang Yuan mused. "That old land spirit loves refining Gu, but cannot leave to gather materials. Lang Ya blessed land produces limited material varieties, so he frequently visits treasure yellow heaven. We can watch treasure yellow heaven patiently until his divine sense appears."

"Count on me! I'll activate connecting heaven Gu right away!" Tai Bai Yun Sheng patted his chest eagerly, and the land spirit teleported him back to his quarters.

After sending Tai Bai Yun Sheng away, Fang Yuan fell into deep thought.

After their chaotic journey through Northern Plains, Fang Yuan had closely observed Tai Bai Yun Sheng in Hu Immortal blessed land, gaining deep insight into his character.

"Tai Bai Yun Sheng is indeed a good person, capable but unambitious. With only average intelligence, his strength lies in a lifetime of accumulated worldly experience. Lacking vision for the big picture, it is no surprise that despite being a former young tribe leader with ample strength and fame, he never built his own force."

Such a person served best as a follower; left on his own, his moral principles could ruin plans.

In their late-night talks, Fang Yuan had shared his rebirth experiences, merely inventing the non-existent "Purple Mountain True Monarch."

Even when Fang Yuan already had a plan, he repeatedly summoned Tai Bai Yun Sheng for discussion.

First, it tested Tai Bai Yun Sheng's abilities and probed the sincerity of his heart.

Second, sharing the full situation openly fostered his sense of belonging and responsibility.

Third, dismissing Tai Bai Yun Sheng's ideas conditioned him to subconsciously defer to Fang Yuan's judgment.

Above all, Fang Yuan was confident that even without slavery Immortal Gu, he could tame Tai Bai Yun Sheng into an optimal, fully exploited tool.

Central Continent, Fei He mountain.

Atop Fei He Mountain, Fang Zheng skillfully directed thousands of iron beak flying cranes through intricate formations.

Adversity breeds growth; the setback in Hu Immortal blessed land a year ago had matured Fang Zheng significantly.

A voice echoed from his aperture: "Good. Your command over the iron beak flying cranes has reached effortless mastery; they respond to your every thought. Now you can take the sect's crane manipulation test. Achieving a B grade will reward you with the rank five, five hole jade flute Gu. With it, your crane manipulation will reach quasi-enslavement master level."

The voice came from a spirit incubating flea in his aperture.

Inside resided the soul of Fang Zheng's master, Lord Sky Crane.

"Rank five, five hole jade flute Gu?" Fang Zheng's eyes shone with excitement. "Yes, Master, I'll go at once!"

"Senior Brother Fang Zheng is strong, but his brother is extraordinary—he managed to seize Hu Immortal blessed land."

"Indeed, word is his brother Fang Yuan is secretly a supreme elder's legacy disciple. When Spirit Affinity House nearly claimed Hu Immortal blessed land, the elder dispatched Fang Yuan, who stunned everyone and secured it!"

"Brother!" Fang Zheng's eyes shone with a trace of darkness.

"Calm yourself, disciple," Lord Sky Crane's voice came from the flea.

"You are a rank five Gu Master and quasi-enslavement master; he is no match for you now. The sect mobilized three supreme elders to reclaim Hu Immortal blessed land—your brother cannot survive."

Sensing his thoughts, Lord Sky Crane laughed: "Do not feel guilty, Fang Zheng. Your brother took the wrong path and walks the demonic path. How many more innocents will suffer if he lives?"

"Right. His hands are soaked in blood—he's a murderer! I will avenge my clan, my uncle and aunt, and Shen Cui Er!" Fang Zheng resolved internally.

"Good!" Lord Sky Crane approved. "Remember your perilous training in Fu Hu blessed land, where one year outside was eight years within! All your suffering to reach rank five was for reclaiming Hu Immortal blessed land. Do not falter at this crucial moment or disappoint us."

"Don't worry, Master! I will exterminate evil and take down my brother for justice!" Fang Zheng declared.

# Chapter 657: Dong Fang Chang Fan, Miniscule Mountain

Fang Yuan stood quietly before opening his eyes and stepping out of the wisdom light halo.

The wills in his mind were nearly depleted; mortal Gu produced limited wills, incomparable to wisdom path Immortal Gu.

"My deduction of Immortal Crane Sect's plan failed not from a lack of wills, but a lack of clues," Fang Yuan reflected.

"Yet wisdom path contains an Immortal Gu that grants direct answers: heavenly secret Gu. Historically, Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable created rank eight heavenly secret Immortal Gu, but after his death, it vanished without a trace."

"Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable was supposedly the rank nine most attuned to heavenly fate, creating heavenly secret Immortal Gu to commune with heaven and earth and re-experience natural inspiration. Pairing heavenly secret Immortal Gu with wisdom Gu would be exquisite. Conversely, if an enemy used it to investigate me, all my secrets would be exposed..."

Against other wisdom path methods, Fang Yuan was safe for now; the wind veil of assimilation had wiped away all evidence of his actions in Imperial Court blessed land.

Northern Plains, Jade Pool blessed land.

Led by Chanyu tribe's Tong Zu, about ten Northern Plains righteous path Gu Immortals descended slowly.

An old man sat fishing beside the pool in front of a house.

"Sir Dong Fang, it has been over a decade since we fought side by side at Snowy Mountain. Time flies..." As the group halted, Tong Zu, the highest in cultivation, offered greetings.

"Lord Tong Zu remains graceful, while I have one foot in the grave," the fisherman replied, slowly standing. He was Dong Fang Chang Fan, Northern Plains' number one wisdom path Gu Immortal.

Dong Fang Chang Fan seated the guests in the administration hall—Northern Plains righteous path Gu Immortals from various forces gathered under one roof.

Taking the main seat, Dong Fang Chang Fan smiled: "I invited you all today to propose a transaction."

As Guan Shen Zhao and the others exchanged silent glances, Tong Zu spoke: "Sir Dong Fang stopped making deductions for outsiders decades ago. But in the letter, you said you were making an exception for us, and will deduce the true culprit of the destruction of True Yang Building or perhaps other aspects. But I wonder how we can pay for this transaction?"

Dong Fang Chang Fan coughed and sighed: "My lifespan is ending with no hope of extension, yet lingering concerns remain before I depart. One is the tribe's growth and the other is my tribe's descendants, I hope I can make this transaction with everyone. This old man shall make deductions for each of your tribes once, and after I die, I hope everyone can ally with my Dong Fang tribe."

"I have prepared the alliance contracts; examine them, and we can adjust any terms." Dong Fang Chang Fan passed two east window Gu to the Gu Immortals.

The Gu Immortals reviewed the contracts, finding the terms remarkably lenient. Dong Fang Chang Fan did not ask for mutual defense, only that they guarantee Dong Fang tribe's peace for fifty years after his death.

"Great, Sir Dong Fang, Chanyu tribe accepts your terms."

Tong Zu spoke first, then Hei tribe, Murong tribe, every tribe's representatives also accepted.

Expecting this, Dong Fang Chang Fan's smile broadened: "In that case, Fairy Li Shan, please assist us."

To everyone's surprise, a rank six female Gu Immortal emerged from behind the hall.

Another Gu Immortal laughed: "Sir Dong Fang prepared thoroughly by inviting Fairy Li Shan. But without mountains or rivers in Jade Pool blessed land, how will we swear the oath?"

Dong Fang Yi Kong, standing beside Dong Fang Chang Fan, spoke: "Everyone, watch closely."

He opened his palm, releasing vibrant multicolored light that revealed a miniature mountain peak.

"Could this be—Miniscule Mountain?!" Murong Qing Si exclaimed in disbelief, her eyes widening.

"Indeed," Dong Fang Yi Kong smiled modestly, though pride shone through.

# Chapter 658: Difficulty in resolving the issues, Hei Lou Lan appears

Fang Yuan stood quietly inside, stepping out of the wisdom light halo only after his mind's wills were fully depleted.

Though his deduction succeeded, Fang Yuan's mood turned somber.

"Sealing Spring Autumn Cicada requires over six thousand mortal Gu—nearly half rank five, two thousand rare types, and eight hundred ancient Gu. These ancient Gu are nearly extinct. I estimate this method will cost twenty-three immortal essence stones."

With Spring Autumn Cicada recovering at an accelerating pace, his first aperture's condition grew increasingly critical.

Fortunately, turning into a zombie converted his first aperture into a dead aperture, allowing it to endure until now; otherwise, it would have already burst.

"At this rate, I have roughly two months to prepare. Beyond that, even a dead aperture will collapse."

As a living dead, destroying his first aperture would not kill him, but losing it would permanently cripple his future cultivation potential—an intolerable loss.

Faced with this crisis, only one method could earn twenty-three immortal essence stones quickly: selling Immortal Gu recipes.

"I have watched treasure yellow heaven almost non-stop, but Lang Ya land spirit's divine sense hasn't appeared once."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng's answer made Fang Yuan feel disappointment.

"Back in northern plains, the second wave of experts had already attacked Lang Ya blessed land. Has the third wave struck, leaving the land spirit no time to refine Gu?"

Fang Yuan handed over a letter Gu: "This is from Immortal Crane Sect, please read it."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng sent his consciousness inside, his brows soon furrowing deeply.

Immortal Crane Sect's second letter was even harsher, making their intent to attack Hu Immortal blessed land clear and adopting a victor's tone to demand Fang Yuan's surrender.

"They've gone crazy over Dang Hun mountain. I would have placated you first before launching sneak attacks. Aren't they afraid of putting us on guard?" Tai Bai Yun Sheng said displeasedly.

"This is Immortal Crane Sect's confidence. As one of central continent's ten great ancient sects, their foundation is immense, having stood tall at Fei He mountain for hundreds of thousands of years. Besides, they are pressuring me to probe my backers' intentions," Fang Yuan analyzed.

"Yes, Immortal Crane Sect is stronger than any northern plains super force. We are too weak against such an overbearing colossus; protecting Hu Immortal blessed land will be very difficult..." Tai Bai Yun Sheng spoke cautiously, glancing repeatedly at Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan consoled him: "Immortal Crane Sect is one of central continent's ten great ancient sects, but even this behemoth has worries. How many methods can they spare against us? I guarantee it is not as dire as you imagine, especially since they greatly underestimate our true battle strength."

Fang Yuan nodded: "Rest assured, Old Bai, I am not stubborn. If the situation becomes truly hopeless, I will definitely take the initiative to retreat. Repelling Immortal Crane Sect's first wave won't be difficult, but as a massive sect, if we repel them, another wave will immediately follow. After a few rounds, their offense will intensify as they take us seriously. We must ally with another ancient sect to resolve this."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng nodded in full agreement: "But junior brother, Spirit Affinity House hasn't replied to your letter. Was it intercepted by Immortal Crane Sect? Should we send more?"

Fang Yuan had been confident, but with Spirit Affinity House silent for so long, he grew uncertain.

Accepting Tai Bai Yun Sheng's suggestion, Fang Yuan nodded: "We'll wait seven days. If there's still no reply, we'll send another letter."

A powerful enemy loomed outside, while cultivation resources were lacking within. Though Fang Yuan could use his zombie body and wisdom Gu to deduce and sell top-grade Immortal Gu recipes, he lacked the capital to start and had to shelve the plan.

Amidst these circumstances, Hei Lou Lan suddenly arrived at Dang Hun mountain.

Though agreed upon, Fang Yuan was still surprised: "If I am not mistaken, there is still half a month before our agreed deadline, right?"

"The situation has changed, my friend," Hei Lou Lan said gravely, revealing a trace of worry.

Realizing her slip, Hei Lou Lan concealed her emotions with a cold smile: "Naturally, arriving early also catches you off guard. In case you set traps in your headquarters, I've disrupted your plans!"

Fang Yuan chuckled unperturbed: "After northern plains, we are tied together for better or worse. But for full cooperation, your previous conditions remain insufficient!"

# Chapter 659: The dirtiness of humans

Hearing him say "insufficient", Hei Lou Lan snorted displeasedly: "Fang Yuan, let me enlighten you on the situation in northern plains. Recently, northern plains' number one wisdom path Gu Immortal, Dong Fang Chang Fan, invited all super tribes and made deductions for them. His condition was that they ally with Dong Fang tribe and refrain from targeting or suppressing them for fifty years after his death."

"Oh?" Fang Yuan's gaze focused: "There's such a thing? Then, what did he deduce?"

"Reportedly, Dong Fang Chang Fan gave each tribe one deduction regarding Gu recipes, Immortal Gu sightings, or killing desolate beasts. He has deduced much about you, though I lack the deeper details. Now everyone knows you aren't a northern plains Gu Master, and that a local Gu Master colluded with you."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng's pupils shrank, saying with some fear: "He deduced so much? As expected of Dong Fang Chang Fan..."

Hei Lou Lan snickered: "Fang Yuan, our lives are tied together! If I die, I might expose you and Tai Bai Yun Sheng. Besides, is wisdom Gu in your hands?"

Fang Yuan laughed calmly: "Impossible! Wisdom Gu perished in the wind veil of assimilation, how could I bring it here?"

Finding no flaw in his act, Hei Lou Lan squinted, saying ruthlessly: "Whether you lost it or not, wisdom Gu could have willingly followed you under survival pressure. No need to deny it. You know full well that hiding in central continent isn't safe. Even if you don't have it, once I spread word that wisdom Gu is with you, Gu Immortals worldwide will hunt you like lunatics until the truth comes out!"

"Are you threatening me?" Fang Yuan's expression turned cold, he slowly stood up.

"Hei Lou Lan, what audacity! You are on Dang Hun mountain—one instruction and the land spirit will kill you right here!" Tai Bai Yun Sheng shouted.

Hei Lou Lan laughed with her head held high, fearless: "Hahaha, even if this is a dragon's nest or a tiger's den, what can you do to me? I made arrangements beforehand: if I do not return in three days, all of northern plains will know you two toppled True Yang Building, and the entire world will know wisdom Gu is with you!"

Fang Yuan's eerie words stopped her laughter: "Hei Lou Lan, I know you aren't afraid of death, but have you forgotten your hatred?"

Hei Lou Lan's expression changed, her aura diminishing as her lightning-like gaze fixed on Fang Yuan: "State your conditions."

"First, return Fixed Immortal Travel to its owner, me." Fang Yuan raised four fingers: "Second, during your revenge, loot will be split four to six between you and us. After all, Tai Bai Yun Sheng and I make up two Gu Immortals."

Seeing her sincerity, Fang Yuan smiled faintly: "Lastly, I need the full story, and why you must kill your father personally."

Hei Lou Lan was silent briefly before agreeing: "You are overly suspicious, but I can satisfy all three conditions. There is nothing I can't speak of anyway."

Next, in their conversation, Fang Yuan finally understood the secret behind Hei Lou Lan's thirst for revenge.

The root of all this was actually Eighty-Eight True Yang Building.

In True Yang Building, there was a true inheritance called the "yin-yang life extension method", taken by Hei Cheng long ago.

Giant Sun Immortal Venerable created this true inheritance while researching Ren Zu for life extension methods.

Using this method required a male and female Gu Immortal to copulate, extending the lifespan of one of them.

Once, while Su tribe's leader attended Hei Cheng, Su Xian Er poured wine and fell in love with him at first sight.

Learning of a plot, Su Xian Er fled her campsite at midnight to save Hei Cheng.

He had asked Su Xian Er: "Your tribe leader plotted against me; as a Su tribesman, why save your tribe's enemy?"

Su Xian Er answered: "Lord possesses a noble spirit, and this humble girl fell in love at first sight. Our short-sighted leader plotted against Lord under petty influence, ignoring the consequences of offending Hei tribe. It is proper for Lord to take revenge, but I hope Lord will be merciful and leave behind a trace of Su tribe's bloodline."

Overwhelmed, Hei Cheng grasped Su Xian Er's hand and swore: "Your love is deep as the sea, and I am not cruel; how could I not repay you? From today on, you will be my only wife! I will care for no other beauties, no matter how fair. In this life, I will never betray you!"

Yet few knew that Su tribe faced extermination soon after.

Hei Cheng had many wives and children, Su Xian Er was neither the first, nor the last.

Hei Cheng and Su Xian Er had a daughter, taking her father's surname and given the name Lou Lan. Years later, Su Xian Er died. A deeply aggrieved Hei Cheng announced that childbirth had ruined her health and strength, causing her to perish in her blessed land's earthly calamity.

"He secretly obtained the yin-yang life extension method in the true inheritance secluded domain. For his selfish desires, he maliciously deceived my mother, who trusted him, mercilessly taking almost all her lifespan."

"Before dying, mother saw his true colors and warned me. A flaw in his cultivation rapidly consumed that stolen lifespan; facing another lifespan crisis, his target is now me."

"With my Great Strength True Martial Physique, my foundation will be extremely firm upon becoming a Gu Immortal. Using the yin-yang life extension method on me will waste less lifespan and grant him far more!"

Hei Lou Lan spilled these dark secrets, her calm tone brimming with utter hatred.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng shook his head: "To think Lord Hei Cheng is such a person, how disappointing..."

"Hmph, such is the righteous path—countless dirty deeds beneath a glorious surface. In contrast, the demonic path is far more straightforward!" Hei Lou Lan scoffed.

"No wonder you ignored Hei Cheng's call when the wind veil of assimilation opened." Fang Yuan nodded, looking at Hei Lou Lan with new perspective.

This was likely what forged her formidable personality.

Legend says when Ren Zu started walking the road of life, his vision plunged into pure darkness.

He took the first step.

PIop.

At the next moment, he stepped into the mud.

He raised his foot and wiped it; it was caked in foul-smelling, mushy mud.

He was hesitant to move forward.

Self Gu spoke: "Do not hesitate, human. To walk your own road, rely on your own legs. When stepping forward, do not fear dirtiness."

# Chapter 660: Snowy Mountain Alliance

Teleporting into a quiet room, Tai Bai Yun Sheng appeared. The woman brewing tea stood upon seeing him and smiled with interest: "You are Tai Bai Yun Sheng."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng quickly looked around before greeting her: "Junior greets senior Fairy Li Shan."

The woman nodded with a smile; she was the prominent northern plains rank seven Gu Immortal, Fairy Li Shan.

Confirming their surroundings were safe, Tai Bai Yun Sheng opened his immortal aperture, and two figures leaped out.

One became Hei Lou Lan, while the other was a fierce, six-meter-tall eight-armed immortal zombie—Gu Yue Fang Yuan.

"Little aunt, I am back." Hei Lou Lan walked toward Fairy Li Shan, her cold expression softening with affection.

Fairy Li Shan glanced warmly at Hei Lou Lan with a sigh, then looked at Fang Yuan and Tai Bai Yun Sheng: "My relationship with Little Lan has always been a secret, unknown even to outsiders. Revealing this secret shows her sincerity in cooperating with you two. Little Lan has mentioned you often lately, Fang Yuan. You accomplished a massive feat, bringing down even Eighty-Eight True Yang Building."

Fang Yuan chuckled heartily in a zombie's hoarse voice: "Fairy exaggerates; all this commotion was not my intention. Fairy Li Shan explained: "This rank six information path Immortal Gu is as renowned as sea oath Gu. As long as the chosen mountain exists, the oath cannot be broken. Which mountain do you choose, Virtuous junior Fang?"

Fang Yuan raised his brows, pointing outside with a hoarse laugh: "What place could be better than this mountain?"

Tai Bai Yun Sheng asked, not understanding the situation: "What mountain is this?"

"This mountain is called Snowy Mountain." Fairy Li Shan smiled and introduced.

"Snowy Mountain... wait, could this be the nest of northern plains' demonic path Gu Immortals—Snowy Mountain blessed land?!" Tai Bai Yun Sheng cried out in shock.

Fang Yuan explained: "Old Bai, having recently advanced, you have only heard me mention northern plains' Gu Immortal world in passing. Fairy Li Shan owns Snowy Mountain blessed land's third branch peak; you can also call her the third leader."

"Cough cough cough." Lying on a sickbed, Dong Fang Chang Fan coughed incessantly, his pale face withering with every cough.

Wearing a white robe with jade-white skin and deep eyes revealing calm maturity, it was Dong Fang Yu Liang.

"No need to grieve, Liang Er, cough cough, birth, aging, sickness, and death are the way of nature." Dong Fang Chang Fan gasped for breath, recovering slightly before continuing: "Your talent surpasses mine; in the entire tribe, you are my greatest hope. Only you can shoulder Dong Fang tribe's growth. I, Dong Fang Chang Fan, would not misjudge this."

Dong Fang Yu Liang reached out and took the old man's right hand.

"Thi... this Gu... take it." Dong Fang Chang Fan's face reddened from strain, squeezing out energy with his dying breath.

Staring intently at Dong Fang Yu Liang, he warned: "Though Dong Fang tribe allied with the other righteous path tribes, worldly affairs are fickle and hard to predict. My death will cause Dong Fang tribe to decline from its peak; as my successor, you must be careful. Activating this Gu will take you to a secluded place with cultivation resources I prepared for you, immortal ascension insights, our tribe's secret history, and all my wisdom path comprehensions. Remember, prioritize safety; don't be impatient. The tribe has... has demonic path spies."

Dong Fang Chang Fan's expression froze, the flush on his face fading as the final radiance in his eyes died.

"Lord!!" Covered in tears, Dong Fang Yu Liang could no longer hold them back, weeping in sorrow.

Northern plains' number one wisdom path Gu Immortal, Dong Fang Chang Fan, had passed away.

As news spread, Dong Fang tribe wept for three days and three nights, while Northern Plains' righteous and demonic Gu Immortals breathed sighs of relief.

He searched for the passage to Lang Ya blessed land—Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's purple stone tree.

Three days had passed since the alliance with Hei Lou Lan.

Fang Yuan retrieved Fixed Immortal Travel and used it to travel to Crescent Lake.

Finding the cave intact, Fang Yuan lent Fixed Immortal Travel to Tai Bai Yun Sheng and entered his immortal aperture to reach the location.

# Chapter 661: Seeing Swamp Crab again

"Found it." Fang Yuan's eyes shone before the purple stone pillar.

After sending Tai Bai Yun Sheng into his immortal aperture, Fang Yuan sat on the bench, cut his arm with a Gu worm, and dripped blood onto the purple stone pillar.

Unlike normal blood, his was an ice-cold, jade-green liquid devoid of warmth.

Modified long ago by Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's mysterious Gu, the purple stone pillar quickly absorbed the jade-green zombie blood.

Re-entering Lang Ya blessed land, Fang Yuan did not land in a cloud building room this time.

Lang Ya blessed land's unique terrain consisted of vast white cloud soil.

Twelve equidistant structures stood atop the cloud soil: the twelve cloud buildings.

The fertile cloud soil was pocked with craters—some freezing with ice, others billowing black smoke.

Emerging from Fang Yuan's immortal aperture, Tai Bai Yun Sheng observed, "A battle occurred here recently. Lang Ya land spirit truly was in trouble."

Without speaking, Fang Yuan merely gazed toward the distant twelve cloud buildings.

"We are inside Lang Ya blessed land, yet why hasn't the land spirit appeared?" Tai Bai Yun Sheng frowned, growing vigilant.

"Let's go in and see first." Fang Yuan pondered.

After traveling aways, Tai Bai Yun Sheng pointed ahead: "Look, a desolate beast corpse!"

"This is the desolate beast, spinefin star dragonfish." Fang Yuan said.

"Oh? Intruders." Inside a dark secret room, Lang Ya land spirit opened his eyes, sensing Fang Yuan and Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

Before him sat a middle-aged inkman Gu Immortal with an imposing demeanor, black skin, and white hair.

"Another strong foe?" The inkman Gu Immortal asked nervously.

Focusing his senses, Lang Ya land spirit exhaled in relief. "Pfft, that rascal scared me! Don't worry, I know him—he visited half a year ago."

The inkman Gu Immortal raised his brows, surprised that anyone besides himself could visit Lang Ya blessed land.

"If they are friends, all is well. We've spent three days and nights here and will soon undo a seal layer—we cannot be disturbed," the inkman Gu Immortal said, relieved.

"We still cannot let them approach. That crafty kid duped me before—I'll send a desolate beast to stall him," Lang Ya land spirit gritted his teeth.

As Tai Bai Yun Sheng spoke, a massive metallic golden boulder suddenly breached the cloud soil.

The cubic boulder moved swiftly, blocking their path.

"Desolate beast!" Tai Bai Yun Sheng readied himself to face this enemy.

The eyeless desolate beast brandished a pair of massive pincers of undeniable lethality.

Recognizing the desolate beast, Tai Bai Yun Sheng exclaimed, "This is the swamp crab, lord of swamps!"

Halting before the swamp crab, Tai Bai Yun Sheng asked Fang Yuan, "What do we do now?"

Gazing at the desolate beast, Fang Yuan uttered one word: "Fight."

"Be careful." Tai Bai Yun Sheng nodded and retreated swiftly. As a healing Gu Immortal, risking direct combat went against his nature.

Fang Yuan launched forward like a meteor crashing toward the swamp crab.

As a flying master, Fang Yuan swerved midair to crash directly onto the swamp crab's back.

With a thunderous boom, Fang Yuan's impact slammed the swamp crab into the ground.

"Tough enough!" Fang Yuan grinned, retracting four right arms.

Every fist was torn open, exposing the white bone beneath.

Devoid of pain, Fang Yuan watched his injured fists regenerate completely within a few breaths.

Two waves of fierce winds approached to assault him.

Unfurling his wings, Fang Yuan darted through the air like lightning to evade the fierce winds.

Behind him, the swamp crab's pincers bent at an impossible angle, snapping together with sharp cracks.

Matching a rank six Gu Immortal in strength, the desolate beast's strike was not something even Fang Yuan's sturdy heavenly zombie body wished to endure.

"The swamp crab's armor is nearly flawless—brute force is my only option," Fang Yuan thought rapidly.

The swamp crab possessed the unique ability to spawn and command a crab army at will anywhere.

"Very good." With a cold gaze, Fang Yuan took a deep breath and activated the killer move, Myriad Self!

Expending a bead of green grape immortal essence, he activated the core Immortal Gu.

Fang Yuan's eight fists pounded at the swamp crab below him.

Each fist unleashed formless fist qi, raining punches down like a torrential storm!

Thousands of fist qi struck the swamp crab's shell, deforming its carapace before condensing into Fang Yuan's strength path phantoms.

Within ten breaths, a strength path phantom army formed atop the swamp crab.

"This is..." Shocked, Tai Bai Yun Sheng witnessed this killer move for the first time.

The strength path phantoms routed the crab army and overwhelmed the desolate beast, leaving it shrieking helplessly in defeat.

Watching from the secret room, Lang Ya land spirit cried in panic, "Ahhhh, my desolate beast! What killer move did that rascal use? It is so powerful—it must be an immortal killer move!"

# Chapter 662: Inkman King

Fang Yuan had unleashed over ten thousand strength path phantoms, calmly recalling the remaining three thousand into his immortal aperture.

"You rascal, barging in unannounced and injuring my desolate beast—how will you compensate me?!" Lang Ya land spirit raged.

Familiar with the land spirit, Fang Yuan noted his shackles and frowned. "You've been sealed; no wonder your divine sense was absent from treasure yellow heaven. It has barely been half a year by Northern Plains' time—how did you end up like this?"

Lang Ya land spirit snapped, "Look at yourself—neither human nor ghost! Becoming a Gu Immortal only to degenerate into a zombie! Well, at least you have plenty of lifespan left."

"Hmph, after living so long, do you still not understand the simple logic of give and take? One must sacrifice to gain; without becoming a zombie, how could I stand before you with such power? Yet the longer you live, the further you regress, unable even to refine Gu. You are truly disgracing your main body," Fang Yuan sneered, intentionally provoking him.

Lang Ya land spirit cursed, "You brat, you dare mock me? True Yang Building's collapse was definitely your doing, right?! Two super forces lost their leaders, countless died, and all of Northern Plains' Gu Immortals hunt you as the culprit. Being a public target can't be easy!"

"Lang Ya land spirit, aren't you going to introduce your guest?" Fang Yuan chuckled in an uncomfortably hoarse voice.

The inkman Gu Immortal stood up and greeted them, "I am Mo Tan Sang of Inkman City, king of Northern Plains' inkmen."

Fang Yuan praised, "So you are the Inkman King. Indeed, your majestic aura is extraordinary."

Mo Tan Sang explained, "Inkman City has always maintained close ties with Lang Ya blessed land. Our city has attainment in qi path, and since the land spirit was sealed by a qi path method, I hurried here to assist. Sir is a dragon stirring up storms across Northern Plains. I truly admire such grandeur, especially as our Inkman City has long been suppressed by the Huang Jin tribes. As the land spirit's friends, you are my friends too. Feel free to visit Inkman City in the future."

Fang Yuan nodded meaningfully to the Inkman King. "If given the chance, I will certainly visit Inkman City."

Turning back to the land spirit, Fang Yuan provoked him: "Friend or not, you must still refine Gu for me. Did you forget I have one refinement chance left? If I demand it, you must comply whether you want to or not!"

The land spirit grinned gloatingly. "Hahaha, this qi path seal has eighteen layers, and Inkman King has only broken the first! I cannot refine Gu for you—this is wonderful!"

Fang Yuan cleared his throat and spoke solemnly: "Then let's discuss business. Since you can't refine Gu, forget it. I came today to make a transaction."

"Transaction, what transaction?" Lang Ya land spirit asked.

"It's simple. You know I cultivate wisdom path: I will deduce Immortal Gu recipes for you in exchange for immortal essence stones. It is a win-win deal," Fang Yuan replied.

Lang Ya land spirit mocked, "Fang Yuan, as a zombie, you think you can deduce Gu recipes, let alone Immortal Gu recipes? Drop that delusion!"

Inkman King added, "Immortal Gu recipes—even remnant ones—are immensely valuable. If you fail to deduce it, wouldn't we be giving you the recipe for nothing?"

Anticipating this, Fang Yuan laughed and opened his monstrous palm to reveal an Immortal Gu: "Look, what is this?"

# Chapter 663: Recognising Immortal Gu

Radiating worldly laws, the Gu worm's immortal aura proved it was an Immortal Gu, though neither recognized which one.

"This Gu..." Lang Ya land spirit's eyes shone. "I've never seen it before; it must be a new Gu."

He gasped, "A luck path aura—this is a luck path Gu! Good lad, destroying True Yang Building certainly brought you massive gains!"

Fang Yuan mocked, "To think the grand Lang Ya land spirit is so ignorant. This isn't new—it was created ten thousand years ago. It is Calamity Beckoning, created by Fairy Mo Yao of Central Continent's Spirit Affinity House."

After teasing them mystifyingly, Fang Yuan retrieved Calamity Beckoning Immortal Gu and produced another Immortal Gu.

"Lang Ya land spirit, didn't you say you were well learnt and knowledgeable? I will give you another chance, see what Gu worm this is?"

"Indeed," the land spirit said proudly. "This ancient movement-type Immortal Gu allows Gu Immortals to effortlessly traverse mountains and waters. Most valuably, its ascending and descending speed far exceeds most Gu of the same rank."

"What Gu is this?" Tai Bai Yun Sheng chimed in on cue, having grasped Fang Yuan's intent.

Without suspicion, Lang Ya land spirit flaunted his knowledge: "This peculiar, vicious Immortal Gu is a single-use consumable. I remember it from historical records: this is Woman's Heart. Unlike normal Immortal Gu, its refinement and nurturing occur simultaneously."

Lang Ya land spirit glanced at Tai Bai Yun Sheng. "Lad, you're still young. Gu varieties are endless, and the aspects of nurturing, use, and refinement are infinitely profound. As the saying goes, 'a woman's heart is the deadliest poison." Woman's Heart is a lethal poison path Immortal Gu nurtured with women's hearts. Feeding it continually refines and strengthens the Gu—the more hearts consumed, the more potent its venom.""

Expressionless, Fang Yuan put away Woman's Heart and took out another Immortal Gu: "Lang Ya land spirit, I admit you have some skill, but you're still inferior to me. Hahaha, you'll never guess this Immortal Gu!"

Exhaling deeply, the land spirit laughed: "I know this Gu! My main body saw it while discussing cultivation with Giant Sun Immortal Venerable."

To prove himself, he revealed all he knew: "This Immortal Gu is Connect Luck. It allows a Gu Master's luck to connect with others. If one has good luck, it is shared with the other. Similarly, bad luck will also affect the other party."

"With luck inspection Gu, you can inspect others' formless luck. If you find someone with good luck, you can use Connect Luck. But this isn't optimal, as luck rises and falls like a tide. In that case, you'd want to use another Immortal Gu, Break Luck, in tandem."

Fang Yuan nodded to the Inkman King, then turned to Lang Ya land spirit: "Back to our deal—I have full sincerity and never intended to keep your Immortal Gu recipes for myself. Land spirit, when deducing recipes, I will leave an Immortal Gu as collateral. If I fail after seeing a recipe, you can keep the Gu. You will feel assured in this case, right?"

Lang Ya land spirit exchanged glances with the Inkman King, then shouted: "Rascal, you seem very confident. Fine, this deal carries no risk for me; in fact, I profit. First, I will only give you three Immortal Gu recipes. Whichever it is, you must completely deduce it to count as a success. If you succeed, hand it over and I'll pay you the immortal essence stones plus another remnant recipe."

"Okay." Fang Yuan did not hesitate, he immediately agreed.

At the same time, in Lang Ya blessed land.

# Chapter 665: Three 100% Immortal Gu recipes!

Lang Ya land spirit said smugly: "That brat was disrespectful, so I gave him difficult recipes on purpose! Hmph, little Tai Bai has blind faith in him. If he deduces that Immortal Gu recipe, I'll crush my medicine grinder and eat it!"

Tai Bai Yun Sheng looked at the laughing land spirit with pity, knowing Fang Yuan possessed Wisdom Gu.

Fang Yuan quietly stood within the wisdom light halo.

"Wisdom Gu provides unlimited inspiration—with my refinement foundation, solving these recipes is effortless." Fang Yuan marveled.

He concentrated and began deducing another Gu recipe.

He had to expend three beads of green grape immortal essence in a row to perfect it.

Fang Yuan connected to treasure yellow heaven and contacted Lang Ya land spirit using divine sense Gu.

Expecting Fang Yuan to admit defeat, Lang Ya land spirit laughed wildly—only to be stunned when presented with a fully completed Immortal Gu recipe.

"Amazing! To think the barrier could be broken like this! Why didn't I think of that?" he shouted, wishing his hands weren't trapped in the qi path seal so he could slap his thigh.

Embarrassed, Lang Ya land spirit muttered: "Brat, you actually hit the mark blindfolded and deduced this recipe! Consider yourself lucky. Per our contract, perfecting a rank six remnant recipe at ninety percent or above pays ten immortal essence stones! Should I deliver them through treasure yellow heaven, or will you come collect them in person?"

Treasure yellow heaven required a service fee, but collecting in person would require using Fixed Immortal Travel.

Treasure yellow heaven was cheaper, but risked leaving traces for hostile wisdom path Gu Immortals to deduce.

Crossing between Northern Plains and Central Continent made hole earth Gu unusable, leaving only stargate Gu.

"Land spirit, knowing you, you should have stargate Gu there, right?" Fang Yuan asked.

"Hehe, brat, you know me well," Lang Ya land spirit admitted.

Fang Yuan transmitted: "Treasure yellow heaven draws scrutiny, and Fixed Immortal Travel is too costly. We should link our blessed lands and establish a stargate."

"Build a stargate?" Lang Ya land spirit refused. "Any calamity on your side could spread straight here. If Lang Ya blessed land is discovered, I'm finished!"

Fang Yuan laughed and offered no argument, simply handing over the second Immortal Gu recipe.

"You completed another one?!" Lang Ya land spirit was shocked.

"Hahaha, old man, the new generation surpasses the old! You stay cooped up in Lang Ya blessed land, ignorant of the outside world. Even your friend the Inkman King is just an inkman—how could he know the core of human cultivation? Besides, who am I? A peerless wisdom path genius! One day, I will surpass Star Constellation Immortal Venerable!"

Unable to listen further, Lang Ya land spirit stamped his foot: "Brat, don't get cocky! What's so great about deducing two recipes? If you're truly a genius, deduce the last one—then I'll admire you!"

"Hmph, kid, even my main body was stumped by that final recipe. Ponder it properly for seven or eight years; maybe then you'll realize how vast the world is and learn humility, ahahaha..."

"You mean this recipe?" Smirking, Fang Yuan tossed out the third Immortal Gu recipe.

Lang Ya land spirit's laughter stopped abruptly, and he shouted in shock: "What is this? What in the world is this?!"

"You actually deduced it?! Incredible! To think this recipe could be solved from an entirely different angle—no wonder even my main body failed... The old saying is true: the mountain road twists around every peak; a glimmer of hope shines at the darkest hour!"

# Chapter 666: Huge profit!

"Is this kid truly a wisdom path genius rarely seen in a century? No, such talent is heaven-defying—not just once in a hundred years, but once in ten thousand years!"

In Hu Immortal blessed land, Fang Yuan remained calm. Even as a zombie with slowed thoughts, he could still easily outwit a land spirit.

He had to quickly amass immortal essence stones to break his predicament and grow stronger.

With the land spirit's mind thoroughly shaken by the three recipes, Fang Yuan seized the chance to negotiate.

He spoke: "Lang Ya land spirit, frankly speaking, I need immortal essence stones and you need recipes; we'll collaborate often in the future. A stargate benefits us both."

Fang Yuan urged: "Lang Ya blessed land has already suffered three waves of attacks, each stronger than the last. Undoubtedly, your location is exposed and monitored by a great force. With a stargate, our collaboration can advance; in crises, I can come through to protect you."

Fang Yuan asked, "You haven't sold stargate Gu in treasure yellow heaven yet, right?"

"Not yet, I have plenty of immortal essence stones," Lang Ya land spirit replied.

Fang Yuan laughed: "Even better. Stargate Gu is innovative, unlike hole earth Gu which must be planted in the ground and easily discovered. There is simply no threat in building a stargate."

Moved by the reasoning, Lang Ya land spirit agreed: "Alright, we'll build a stargate. Let us settle the recipe deduction first."

The land spirit added: "I'll refine the stargate Gu and lend it to you."

Connecting to Lang Ya blessed land would make future transactions vastly cheaper while securing an escape route.

Additionally, Fang Yuan kept stargate Gu off treasure yellow heaven's market, preventing other Gu Immortals from gaining its advantages.

"Trading with Lang Ya land spirit is safe and lucrative. As long as I cultivate and deepen this bond, he might even lend me Immortal Gu one day," Fang Yuan calculated.

Fang Yuan expended green grape immortal essence to visit Lang Ya blessed land and retrieve the stargate Gu.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng remained behind to restore several more rivers across the blessed land.

From this trip, he brought back one stargate Gu, three new remnant recipes, and thirty immortal essence stones.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng offered Fang Yuan his three earned immortal essence stones, but Fang Yuan declined, letting his ally keep resources to grow stronger.

The stargate couldn't be built immediately—Fang Yuan had run out of starlight firefly Gu.

And his gains were a whole thirty immortal essence stones.

Fang Yuan had only nine beads of green grape immortal essence left after his repeated round trips.

Though his dead aperture could not produce essence, he could extract green grape immortal essence from immortal essence stones.

"Yet immortal essence stones are currency—I shouldn't refine them into essence unless necessary. Now, let's connect to treasure yellow heaven and check."

Fang Yuan sat with closed eyes, sending his consciousness into his immortal aperture.

The immortal aperture was deathly still—grey skies over black ground, the air thick with a putrid odor.

With a thought, a new connecting heaven Gu fluttered up, opening a passage to treasure yellow heaven.

Fang Yuan activated divine sense Gu, sending a continuous stream through the passage into treasure yellow heaven.

As an immortal zombie, he could conduct transactions in treasure yellow heaven directly.

Fang Yuan wanted to buy starlight firefly Gu first.

His divine sense searched around and soon found over a thousand starlight firefly Gu.

Fang Yuan recognized the seller: Star Lord Wan Xiang.

# Chapter 667: Eight Arm Immortal, Spring Star Rain

"How much are you selling this group of starlight firefly Gu for?" Fang Yuan's divine sense inquired.

"How may I address you, sir, and how many starlight firefly Gu do you need?" Though absent, Star Lord Wan Xiang had left a will beside his goods.

"Call me Eight Arm Immortal. I want to buy this entire group," Fang Yuan transmitted.

Connecting with a new divine sense, Fang Yuan went unrecognized as 'Fox Immortal', appearing to Star Lord Wan Xiang as a stranger.

Sensing a big spender, Star Lord Wan Xiang's will grew enthusiastic: "Starlight firefly Gu is an ancient Gu worm, nearly extinct today. Mine are in prime condition, over twelve hundred in total. I will sell them to you for four immortal essence stones."

Fang Yuan laughed: "I know the going rate, and you aren't the only seller. I can buy from Fairy Yao Guang or Di Yuan as well."

Fang Yuan cut in: "I will pay two immortal essence stones for fifteen hundred starlight firefly Gu."

After bargaining, both compromised: Fang Yuan paid three immortal essence stones for twelve hundred starlight firefly Gu.

He then asked: "Do you sell any star path killer moves?"

"Of course I sell them. Look, I have three star path killer moves here."

The first, 'dazzling star armor', was a defensive killer move requiring starlight Gu, bane star Gu, and star shield Gu to form full-body armor.

The second, 'spring star rain', required star rain Gu, spring wind Gu, and star shoot Gu to create a three-day jade drizzle. The rich rain nourished crops and boosted productivity to manage blessed lands.

The third, 'spiral drill star spear', was an offensive killer move requiring spiral bone spear Gu, star river Gu, countless star dart Gu, and numerous shooting star Gu.

Star Lord Wan Xiang chimed in: "Dazzling star armor sells for half an immortal essence stone. Spring star rain was created by my main body and only sold to a few, so it costs one and a half immortal essence stones. Spiral drill star spear is one stone."

Fang Yuan knew dazzling star armor was extremely common; half an immortal essence stone was overpriced.

For an offensive move, Fang Yuan recalled the mortal killer move icy stardust—wide-ranged, cheap, and highly effective. It pierced defenses and clung to enemies with chilling frost that slowed them down.

Star fragment grass nourished starlight fireflies to produce starlight firefly Gu—a resource Fang Yuan needed long-term.

Among the Gu required for spring star rain was the consumable star path star shoot Gu.

Anyone using spring star rain would expend star shoot Gu every time—and only Star Lord Wan Xiang sold them.

Fang Yuan probed: "I'll offer two immortal essence stones for spring star rain and the recipe for star shoot Gu."

Though this was an extremely high offer for a rank three recipe, Star Lord Wan Xiang refused, claiming the Gu formed naturally without a recipe.

Fang Yuan knew this was likely an excuse, but he could hardly demand to inspect Wan Xiang's blessed land.

Fang Yuan suggested: "I'll pay two immortal essence stones for spring star rain, dazzling star armor, and star shoot Gu for ten activations."

Realizing this, Fang Yuan yielded, spending two immortal essence stones on spring star rain and enough star shoot Gu for ten activations.

With the transaction complete, Fang Yuan continued browsing treasure yellow heaven.

"The regional walls isolate the five regions, keeping their events largely independent. Since rebirth, I have affected Southern Border, Northern Plains, and Central Continent. Northern Plains felt the greatest impact and is now a mess, followed by Central Continent and Southern Border—where I only altered mortal matters. Western Desert and Eastern Sea remain unchanged."

# Chapter 668: Little Immortal Xing Luo

Central Continent, Immortal Crane Sect, Fu Hu blessed land.
