# Chapter 669: He Feng Yang’s scheme

The cave was large as a plaza, filled with bloody light and metallic stench, surrounding a pool bubbling with scalding blood.

Fang Zheng stripped and entered the pool, gasping at the scalding blood.

"Begin. Step by step, don't rush. First is iron blood Gu," Lord Sky Crane instructed.

Fang Zheng closed his eyes and activated iron blood Gu.

"Maintain iron blood Gu, activate blood blade Gu." Lord Sky Crane said again.

Fang Zheng shuddered as his skin ruptured into over a hundred wounds, releasing pitch-black iron-blood blades!

Intense pleasure flooded his mind—the effect of iron blood Gu converting excruciating pain into battle ecstasy.

"Now the crucial step—use blood merge Gu," Lord Sky Crane reminded.

Fang Zheng gritted his teeth and activated blood merge Gu.

Instantly, powerful suction erupted from his hundred-plus wounds, ceaselessly absorbing the surrounding blood.

"Resist the pleasure! Fang Zheng, activate failed blood demon flower Gu!" Lord Sky Crane urged while monitoring him closely.

"Urghh—! Fang Zheng tightly gritted his teeth, groaning softly in pain. His face was pale, his whole body was like soil with many demonic flowers growing forcibly on him. This intense pain was ten times more terrifying than a woman giving birth!"

"Your blood is boiling and will incinerate your organs! Use cold blood Gu quickly!" Lord Sky Crane warned anxiously.

Fang Zheng activated cold blood Gu with great difficulty.

"Good! The demon flowers boost your blood path Gu worms. One step left—use blood sense Gu!" Lord Sky Crane urged.

Breaths later, Fang Zheng gasped: "I... I sense it... underground, southeast, five to six thousand steps away."

"Great, you did it again! Final step—use blood scar Gu to mark the position."

However, blood scar Gu demanded massive primeval essence; Fang Zheng held out for eight breaths before collapsing unconscious into the blood pool.

He Feng Yang sat in white robes atop a meditation mat.

Floating in the spirit incubating flea, Lord Sky Crane's soul reported Fang Zheng's training results.

He Feng Yang frowned: "Even after eight years and abundant relic Gu raising him to rank five, he still cannot activate six or seven Gu simultaneously."

Lord Sky Crane replied: "Multitasking amid such extreme pain and ecstasy is daunting. Fang Zheng lasted eight breaths—success is near. He only needs ten breaths to activate blood scar Gu successfully. With just two more breaths and a few more sessions, we can..."

"Enough! Years have been wasted on your plan, and Dang Hun Mountain remains beyond our grasp. Do you know how many dissatisfied voices are in the sect, how many disciples demand the exchange of guts Gu?"

He Feng Yang waved his sleeve: "Leave. The sect convention is in one month. Before then, I expect success so we can launch our assault on Hu Immortal blessed land!"

"Lord, the violent clash of pleasure and pain will shatter his soul!" Lord Sky Crane protested.

He Feng Yang sneered: "Isn't a shattered soul exactly what you want to seize his body and revive?"

He Feng Yang faced mounting pressure, especially from his rival Lei Tan, who openly mocked his failure to reclaim Hu Immortal blessed land.

"Not much longer... Once this succeeds, I'll silence detractors like Lei Tan and claim the sect's greatest contribution in years! I will lead the attack alongside Fairy Cang Yu and Old Lord Can Yang. Fairy Cang Yu matches my strength, while Old Lord Can Yang is a rank seven Gu Immortal with an offensive Immortal Gu!"

"The land spirit can suppress mortal Gu, so our strategy relies on depleting its green grape immortal essence. Hu Immortal blessed land was barren and poorly managed—how much green grape immortal essence could it hold? Fang Yuan cannot possibly outlast the three of us! Once its immortal essence is exhausted, the land spirit cannot restrict mortal Gu. At that time, hmph!"

Meanwhile, in an underground cave within Hu Immortal blessed land, Fang Yuan stepped from the light of wisdom halo, a satisfied smile on his face.

He had just successfully deduced the killer move icy stardust.

# Chapter 670: Icy Drill Stardust

Tai Bai Yun Sheng had returned from Lang Ya blessed land—white-haired and deeply wrinkled, his tired eyes shining bright.

"I'm back..." Covered in dust, Tai Bai Yun Sheng gazed at Hu Immortal blessed land and sighed.

Fang Yuan flew over, laughing: "Hahaha, Old Bai, perfect timing! Come see the killer move I just deduced."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng laughed heartily: "Is that so? I bought a cloud path defensive killer move from Inkman King—let's test them in a friendly spar!"

Saying this, he flew into the air.

Hearing this, Fang Yuan raised his eyebrows and stretched out a right arm, palm facing the sky with fingers straight.

A lump of starlight soon formed in his palm.

He flew into the sky, as a ring of white clouds appeared around him.

"Old Bai, get ready to take this." He growled, flicking a finger to shoot out a speck of starlight like lightning.

As the starlight neared Tai Bai Yun Sheng, the white cloud ring suddenly spun at high speed!

Examining his cloud ring, Tai Bai Yun Sheng saw where it blocked the starlight had turned blue, oozing frost energy.

He laughed: "Your killer move isn't so amazing. Mine hasn't even been fully activated yet."

Fang Yuan snickered: "Old Bai, it's still too early to say that."

Saying so, he flicked his wrist, and threw the entire starlight lump towards Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng quickly activated five concentric cloud rings expanding outward to shield him.

As the starlight lump attacked, the five cloud rings spun rapidly, their afterimages producing an illusory white sphere.

But right at this moment, the starlight lump exploded.

Countless specks of starlight collided and exploded across Tai Bai Yun Sheng's body as frost energy burst forth.

"Again!" Fang Yuan raised his eight monstrous arms, simultaneously clutching at the air like claws.

The next moment, lumps of starlight formed in his palms.

Standing in place, Fang Yuan fired consecutively from all eight arms, raining starlight lumps down like meteors upon Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

Explosions roared as a disheveled Tai Bai Yun Sheng dodged frantically until his five cloud rings detonated one by one.

"Enough." Fang Yuan suddenly stopped.

Breathing heavily, Tai Bai Yun Sheng flew toward Fang Yuan: "What is the name of this killer move? What percent of its full power did you use?"

Fang Yuan replied unabashedly: "I named it icy drill stardust, my unique creation. At full power, I can unleash a vat-sized starlight lump up to six times, though larger lumps move slower. More stardust inside causes greater collisions, expending energy and reducing speed."

"You didn't even use fifty percent? It cannot match an immortal killer move, but its power far exceeds most mortal killer moves," Tai Bai Yun Sheng gasped.

Fang Yuan laughed: "In Imperial Court blessed land, I found the inheritance of Dou Min Jun, who devised a brand-new star Gu. This star Gu boosts the attack power of star path Gu worms like a weakened amplify effect Gu. Fusing it into this killer move gave it such great power."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng realized: "So that's why. My nine cloud ring can sustain nine rings at full force. It is instantly replenishable and reflects enemy attacks—costing me two whole immortal essence stones!"

Tai Bai Yun Sheng laughed: "Inkman King gave a discount considering my Landscape as Before Gu. As an Immortal facing tribulations, he needs me to repair blessed land damage!"

"Junior brother, you are incredible. This icy drill stardust is worth at least four immortal essence stones in treasure yellow heaven," Tai Bai Yun Sheng sighed.

"Without wisdom Gu, how could I have endless inspiration?" Fang Yuan replied plainly.

Fang Yuan shook his head: "Becoming a zombie has many flaws. I reached this point through coincidences, lucky opportunities, and thanks to Red Lotus Demon Venerable. If not for the peculiar situation back then, allowing me to reach an arrangement with wisdom Gu, how could I utilize the light of wisdom?"

# Chapter 671: Sealing Spring Autumn Cicada

Lang Ya land spirit remained bound by qi path seals, with fifteen of the original eighteen layers remaining.

"The seal will last four years, preventing Spring Autumn Cicada from bursting my first aperture." Fang Yuan sighed in relief.

Exhausted from the sealing, Fang Yuan fell asleep for three days.

# Chapter 672: Difficult problem of feeding Immortal Gu

Three days later, Fang Yuan slowly woke up.

After dealing with Lang Ya land spirit twice, he earned sixty immortal essence stones. But he also spent a lot.

Currently, Fang Yuan had thirty and a half immortal essence stones left.

Deducing recipes had left him with nine green grape immortal essence beads after his first trade. The second deduction cost six beads and sealing Spring Autumn Cicada took another, leaving only two beads.

Having only two beads left was perilous; he could only activate myriad self twice with Immortal Crane Sect's attack looming.

Fang Yuan converted fifteen immortal essence stones into green grape immortal essence.

His green grape immortal essence rose to seventeen beads, while his immortal essence stones fell to fifteen and a half.

That was the feeding of Immortal Gu.

Fang Yuan simply possessed too many Immortal Gu: Spring Autumn Cicada, Fixed Immortal Travel, Calamity Beckoning, Delight in Water and Mountain, Worldly Wave Trace, Rising Azure Cloud, Cleanse Soul, Connect Luck, and Woman's Heart.

Spring Autumn Cicada fed on the River of Time's water and required no upkeep.

Delight in Water and Mountain Immortal Gu required vast earth qi, water qi, and laughter stones.

Worldly Wave Trace Gu required tens of thousands of underworld jellyfish and thousands of deepsea lightning eels.

Rising Azure Cloud Gu needed cloud dragon scales and tens of thousands of wind scythe bird eyeballs.

Connect luck Immortal Gu needed five thousand kilograms of sand from the resting area of the ancient desolate beast, worldly sand gull.

Cleanse Soul, Connect Luck, Woman's Heart, and Rising Azure Cloud had received only half-portions in Giant Sun's secluded domain. Awake now, they are starving and in desperate need of food."

"Thankfully, Lang Ya land spirit is feeding Rising Azure Cloud, while Landscape as Before and Man as Before are with Tai Bai Yun Sheng for him to sustain," Fang Yuan analyzed.

I spent two stones on the defensive killer move nine cloud ring, and one more on float ball tea seeds in treasure yellow heaven."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng added calmly: "I plan to earn immortal essence stones with Landscape as Before, following Fairy Li Shan's example. It is certainly not inferior to Mountain Pledge Gu."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng sighed: "Unfortunately, showing myself in public is risky. Northern Plains' Gu Immortals consider us primary suspects for Imperial Court's fall. With Ma Hong Yun captive by an unknown Gu Immortal, we might already be targeted."

"That is why Eastern Sea is the ideal destination for you," Fang Yuan finally revealed his intention.

# Chapter 673: Thousand wish tree

"Eastern sea?" Tai Bai Yun Sheng was surprised.

"Right. Eastern Sea's culture is vastly different from Northern Plains, and you will benefit greatly there—especially in air bubble sea. A recent battle poisoned it, troubling its owners—the Ni, Qiu, and Ba clans," Fang Yuan explained.

According to the Biography of Han Li, he should be in a mortal hamlet near Huang clan."

Ever since understanding Connect Luck's effect, Fang Yuan intended to use his rebirth advantage to counter Spring Autumn Cicada's drain on his luck.

With Ma Hong Yun's whereabouts unknown and Fairy Li Shan still searching, Han Li became Fang Yuan's first target.

Disguising himself as a robust, yellow-faced man, Fang Yuan flew toward Huang clan.

# Chapter 674: Monolith Luck

On the fringes of Sha Jing oasis lay populous mortal villages controlled by Huang clan and other Gu Master forces.

Among them was Han village, adjacent to a small natural grassland.

The dagger grass was sharp; all the children wore leather gloves except for one.

Sniffling, this bare-handed child swung his sickle, cutting dagger grass into the basket on his back.

"Hey, Han Li, you're amazing! You cut grass bare-handed without a scratch—how do you do it?" asked a young girl with a ponytail.

Returning home, Han Li pushed open the broken wooden door to find his parents still out.

Working by the stove, Han Li had no idea he was being watched.

At nightfall, Fang Yuan sat statue-still in a graveyard several li from Han village.

Nearly a thousand investigative Gu placed Han village under his surveillance.

In the dark, Fang Yuan opened his eyes and assessed: "The age matches, it should be this kid."

With that thought, he activated rank five luck inspection Gu.

Looking from afar, he saw a small luck cloud hovering over Han village, grey-white and very thin.

Yet amidst the faint traces within, one portion of luck stood out strikingly.

Shaped like a massive stone, it floated above Han Li's home, leaking a golden trace of luck into the communal cloud.

For now, he decided to call this form monolith luck.

With only Han Li at home, Fang Yuan confirmed he was indeed the future rank seven Gu Immortal of boundless fortune.

"What a pity. As an immortal zombie, I cannot inspect my own luck without rank six luck inspection Gu. Is it still the black coffin luck?" Fang Yuan mused, having always been curious about luck.

Just as he retrieved Connect Luck Gu, someone shouted: "Little thief Ling Hu, hiding here won't save you from Plump Lady! Return my immortal essence stones!"

Startled, Fang Yuan turned to see a figure of shifting sand shouting at him from a distance.

His heart sinking, Fang Yuan called out: "Plump Lady? You have the wrong person—I'm not who you're chasing."

"Bullshit! Did you think changing your face would fool me? Daring to steal from me—I'll beat your intestines out!"

Fang Yuan frowned deeply; he had never expected his mortal disguise to get him mistaken for a thief.

Glancing once more at the monolith luck, Fang Yuan charged straight at his attacker.

Built like a water tank, the furious female Gu Immortal glared arrogantly from atop rolling yellow sand waves.

"Heavenly zombie transformation!" Fang Yuan shouted, shedding his disguise.

Instantly, a six-meter-tall monster with eight monstrous arms, fangs, and red eyes loomed before Plump Lady.

With a thunderous stomp that fractured the earth, Fang Yuan shot toward Plump Lady like a cannonball.

"Taste my martial sand armor!" she shouted as yellow sand gushed from her ears, enveloping her body.

Within breaths, she transformed into a sand giant as tall as Fang Yuan, but far bulkier.

With two loud bangs, the eight-armed immortal zombie clashed fists with the sand giant.

The sand giant's fist crumbled into sand, while Fang Yuan's fists fractured.

Plump Lady's giant fist reformed, but Fang Yuan surged forward, his fractured fists healing rapidly as his remaining six fists slammed into the giant.

# Chapter 675: Dead

Fang Yuan snickered inwardly, having anticipated this, and swiftly soared above the sand giant.

Just then, a violent explosion erupted from underground—

Unable to hold him, the massive dragon statue completely disintegrated.

Within breaths, Han Li's luck plummeted to a wispy trace like an ordinary mortal's.

Next, his faint gray-white smoke turned black.

He was extremely hungry, he gobbled up the food.

"Guh, guh!" Han Li suddenly clutched his throat with wide eyes, choking violently.

"Son, spit it out!" His panicked parents scrambled frantically.

But they did not manage to save Han Li.

He was dead.

# Chapter 676: Human Medicine Gu

From afar, Fang Yuan's eyes shone as he murmured: "Found you, Hong Yi."

Hong Yi was another future rank seven legend who possessed immense luck and talent for creating killer moves.

# Chapter 677: First Battle with Hei Cheng

"Lou Lan, stop running. You are my daughter—why would I harm you? My yin-yang life extension method harms no lives. Your mother truly died from the earthly calamity." Hei Cheng floated in the air, adopting an aggrieved tone as he tried to persuade Hei Lou Lan.

# Chapter 681: Nine Dragons Coffin Protection Luck

Seven days later, he perfected three Immortal Gu remnant recipes and completed the transaction with Lang Ya land spirit via stargate, earning forty immortal essence stones.

Fang Yuan activated Divine Sense Gu, connecting to treasure yellow heaven as Eight Arm Immortal to contact the seller.

Calamity Beckoning Gu fed on the black blood of the desolate beast six-headed snake.

However, the store offered skin, flesh, bones, eyes, and tendons, but no blood.

Undiscouraged, Fang Yuan still decided to buy the six-headed snake's bones.

With ample funds, he directly bought the entire skeleton for three immortal essence stones.

The bone marrow could produce blood. Having been a blood path expert skilled in extraction in his previous life, this skeleton resolved Calamity Beckoning Gu's food.

After buying the skeleton, Fang Yuan visited Immortal Monkey King Shi Lei's store.

Rather than staying in person, Shi Lei had left a proud will to oversee the shop.

"How much are you selling this stone monkey fur for?" Fang Yuan inquired Shi Lei's will.

Shi Lei's will stiffly said: "One immortal essence stone for one hundred pieces of fur!"

With battle imminent and stone monkey fur urgently needed for Group Strength Gu, Fang Yuan swallowed his grievance and bought the fur from the haughty will.

He used five immortal essence stones to buy five hundred stone monkey fur.

With the fur on hand, Fang Yuan began refining Group Strength Gu.

Group Strength Gu was an extinct strength path Gu that converged a collective's power into one; paired with Myriad Self, it would greatly elevate Fang Yuan's strength.

These elderly hairy men were refinement path experts near death. Fang Yuan divided the recipe, leaving repetitive, high-success-rate steps to them while handling the crucial procedures himself as a refinement master.

Working three days and nights without rest, they refined forty-five rank five Group Strength Gu.

Without resting, Fang Yuan used the light of wisdom to deduce improvements to Myriad Self, spending a day to seamlessly merge the forty-five Group Strength Gu with it.

Time passed, and the day of Hei Lou Lan's tribulation drew closer.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng returned to Hu Immortal Blessed Land through a stargate.

He brought a pleasant surprise with him.

# Chapter 683: Hei Lou Lan's Immortal Ascension (1/3)

"Underworld jellyfish... deepsea lightning eels... you actually managed to gather them." Fang Yuan inspected the goods, looking at Tai Bai Yun Sheng in surprise.

"When I displayed Landscape as Before, many Gu Immortals welcomed me warmly. Several have even invited me to join Hai Shi blessed land. However, this requires approval from at least half the elders in Hai Shi blessed land," Tai Bai Yun Sheng said.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng continued: "I bought sufficient underworld jellyfish in Hai Shi blessed land. After receiving your letter, I left to find a secluded island to use stargate Gu. By coincidence, I met Shark Demon, a Zombie Alliance immortal zombie bringing large amounts of goods to sell in Hai Shi blessed land."

"He had many deepsea lightning eels that would surely sell well in Hai Shi blessed land. When I asked to purchase them, Shark Demon was initially unwilling and had a terrible attitude. I agreed, obtaining the deepsea lightning eels without spending any immortal essence stones."

He explained: "Do you think I did it for you? That secret place is Yu Lu blessed land, once owned by Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable's second disciple, Fairy Yu Lu. Its entrance was destroyed, so Shark Demon needs my Landscape as Before to restore it. I used this chance to gain his trust and secure an opportunity to explore Yu Lu blessed land."

Two days later, the six-headed snake's skeleton completely melted in the blood pool, yielding a large amount of black blood.

He fed Calamity Beckoning this black blood, then used the jellyfish and eels to feed Worldly Wave Trace.

"Forty-six beads... not enough." Fang Yuan borrowed more from Fairy Li Shan and Lang Ya land spirit.

He converted the forty-five borrowed stones, reaching an unprecedented ninety-one beads of green grape immortal essence.

Soon, the day of Hei Lou Lan's immortal ascension arrived.

As agreed, Fang Yuan and Tai Bai Yun Sheng traveled to Northern Plains via stargate.

Around them lay a silent snowy expanse, where Hei Lou Lan and Fairy Li Shan were already waiting.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng said: "Legend says Reckless Savage Demon Venerable fought here, destroying the battlefield into a void. Afterward, he turned into an immemorial ice phoenix, breathing out absolute profound ice to freeze and restore it."

"That's right," Fairy Li Shan nodded. "With little vitality here, the heaven and earth qi are thin."

Fairy Li Shan opened her palm to reveal a Gu: "If heaven and earth qi are insufficient, we'll use this."

Fang Yuan looked over, surprised: "The ancient rank five small family qi Gu? It absorbs and stores all kinds of qi!"

Tai Bai Yun Sheng's eyes shone: "Tribulations form when heaven and earth qi accumulate densely. With this Gu, can we reduce their force by controlling that qi?"

"Without this small family qi Gu, I would have no confidence in Little Lan succeeding," Fairy Li Shan sighed.

Turning to Fang Yuan, she added: "If Hei Lou Lan succeeds, you only need to repay half the borrowed stones, and I will give you the small family qi Gu recipe."

"Hei Cheng placed an undetectable tracking method on me, detecting me immediately upon my return to Northern Plains."

Hei Lou Lan continued: "We must prepare for the worst. If Hei Cheng attacks at the crucial moment, I will have little means to deal with him. But once I survive taking in qi, the three qi and dao marks will cleanse my body completely, wiping away even an Immortal Gu tracking method. As long as we reach the second step, we can leave."

"I understand, you can start." Fang Yuan said.

Hei Lou Lan nodded, closing her eyes.

The first step of immortal ascension was breaking the aperture.

The moment Hei Lou Lan unsealed her aperture, the ten extreme aperture shattered on its own.

A breach opened in her body, unleashing a massive attraction force upon heaven and earth qi.

Clouds gathered in the deep blue sky as cracks appeared across the trembling ice fields.

Hei Lou Lan relaxed, letting the formless force of heaven and earth lift her into the air.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng and Fairy Li Shan retreated into hiding.

Only Fang Yuan remained gazing at the sky, standing like an immovable rock statue amid the raging blizzard.

Hei Lou Lan started to sprinkle the small family qi Gu.

These rank five Gu scattered into the sky and ground, absorbing and storing qi to greatly slow its accumulation.

# Chapter 684: Hei Lou Lan's Immortal Ascension (2/3)

"With small family qi Gu, we can influence the tribulation," Fang Yuan observed silently.

Hei Lou Lan continued scattering small family qi Gu, retrieving them once full. Many self-detonated in the process, returning their absorbed qi to the world.

Inevitably, the heaven and earth qi thickened to the point of forming the heavenly tribulation and earthly calamity.

Suddenly alert, he pushed his investigative Gu to look into the clouds, spotting a slowly swaying purple chime emitting sound.

It turns out the heavenly tribulation had formed already!

The sound grew sharper and louder, blending with the wind across a hundred li!

Growing increasingly agitated, his heart raced to the rhythm of the chime as his blood began flowing backward.

Hei Lou Lan groaned as blood oozed from her mouth and nose, her condition far worse than Fang Yuan's.

Fang Yuan squinted coldly: "The heart shocking noise tribulation reverses blood flow, accelerating the heart until it bursts. As an immortal zombie with icy, near-stagnant blood, I am affected the least. But Hei Lou Lan's Great Strength True Martial Physique has extremely active blood, directly countered by this noise! We must destroy its source, the purple chime!"

Without hesitation, Fang Yuan activated light illusion bat wings and flew into the sky.

Suddenly freezing in place, Fang Yuan vomited a mouthful of green zombie blood.

A moment ago, his heart had burst under the pressure.

Yet as an immortal zombie, his heart was no weakness; the injury only stoked his ferocity.

Icy Drill Stardust!

Eight starlight lumps formed and crashed towards the tribulation cloud.

Drilling into the cloud, they shattered the fragile purple chime. The demonic sound ceased, lifting Fang Yuan's pressure.

Yet the cloud rumbled as gathering heaven qi began forming another purple chime.

The starlight lump shattered the purple chime again, continuously detonating against forming chimes.

Though he suppressed the tribulation, Fang Yuan did not lower his guard. A ten extreme ascension could never be so simple.

Hei Lou Lan's breathing eased. Sitting cross-legged in midair with eyes shut and a resolute expression, dried blood stained her pale face.

As Fang Yuan looked back, faint weeping noises reached his ears.

Hearing it, even his immortal zombie body felt profound weakness, draining his strength and resolve.

Dismayed, Fang Yuan used investigative Gu to look up, spotting a pink chime beside the purple one.

This was the decadent noise tribulation!

Before Fang Yuan could shatter the pink chime, enchanting noise assaulted him again.

The sound struck deep into his mind, shattering thoughts and paralyzing cognition.

Tremor thought noise tribulation!

With an immortal zombie's sluggish cognition, this tribulation directly countered him.

In this crisis, he used his remaining clarity to activate Delight in Water and Mountain.

Three beads of green grape immortal essence fueled the Gu, flooding his entire mind with joyful will.

Suddenly, a sharp noise approached his ears rapidly.

Fang Yuan reflexively blocked, but all five fingers were instantly sliced off, lost to the wind and snow.

Fang Yuan discerned razor-sharp invisible lines of sound in the blizzard forming an inescapable web.

Fang Yuan's hair stood on end: "This is the flying blade noise tribulation! Hair armor! Light illusion bat wings!"

Twisting left and right, Fang Yuan found a loose gap and broke through the sound web.

Dodging like a phantom, he continuously launched lumps of icy drill stardust upward.

Meanwhile, his fingers rapidly regrew and his shattered heart reformed.

"A ten extreme ascension's power truly exceeds an ordinary Gu Immortal's several times over! Hmm?"

Four more chimes of different colors were forming in the tribulation cloud.

Pushed to his limits by four chimes, the appearance of four new ones left Fang Yuan no choice but to use myriad self.

"This is not an ordinary tribulation, but one of the ten catastrophes—the eight layer enchanting noise tribulation! If all eight ring out over eight hundred and eighty li, heaven and earth will shake and immortals will perish!" Watching from afar, Fairy Li Shan recognized the eight chimes and nearly intervened.

"Eight layer enchanting noise tribulation... if all eight sound at once, failure is certain." Fang Yuan's expression turned cold; the grimmer the situation, the fiercer his battle intent.

Just as he was about to use myriad self, Hei Lou Lan below opened her eyes.

# Chapter 685: Hei Lou Lan's Immortal Ascension (3/3)

From Hei Lou Lan's eyes, a dazzling light was bursting out.

The light gathered into a solid pillar, piercing the tribulation cloud and striking two chimes.

With a loud bang, the chimes shattered permanently, unable to regenerate.

Fang Yuan was shocked: "Unleashing Divert Disaster through sight makes it far more precise. She has already developed an immortal killer move centered on Divert Disaster!"

Opening her eyes once more, Hei Lou Lan eliminated two more chimes.

Blood streamed down her face as Divert Disaster cracked and wailed in her palm.

This hastily created immortal killer move was incomplete and had severe drawbacks.

"Two chimes left!" Gritting her teeth, Hei Lou Lan forced her eyes open, destroying the final two chimes in one shot.

Her eyes shattered completely, blood pouring from empty eye sockets.

With a bang, Divert Disaster burst in her hands, dissolving into light particles that vanished through her fingers.

Hei Lou Lan had gone blind!

Luck path dao marks from Divert Disaster prevented her shattered eyes from healing.

Extremely resolute, Hei Lou Lan paid a terrible price to permanently destroy the heavenly tribulation, leaving only the earthly calamity.

Heaven and earth qi cascaded inward, met by an outpouring of human qi from Hei Lou Lan.

The converging three qi formed a huge cocoon that enveloped Hei Lou Lan.

She had reached the second step—taking in qi.

Retrieving all her small family qi Gu, Hei Lou Lan focused on balancing the three qi, temporarily unable to fight.

With a thunderous crash, a massive frenzied ape leaped from deep within a frozen river.

Snow-white with blood-red eyes, the hill-sized beast stood hundreds of meters tall with a ferocious aura.

"The earthly calamity formed—an ancient desolate beast! Only rank seven Gu Immortals face such a calamity!" Tai Bai Yun Sheng's heart sank.

Fang Yuan remained calm beneath the rank seven icefall divine ape's shadow. If it possessed Immortal Gu, the battle would become far more difficult.

A ruthless glint flashed in Fang Yuan's eyes as he activated his killer move.

Immortal killer move — Myriad Self!

Within breaths, over ten thousand strength path phantoms formed a spherical formation around his main body, filling the sky and ground.

Poised to charge, the icefall divine ape bared its sharp fangs and tensed, but seeing the immense phantom army, it hesitated and held back.

Immediately, the army moved and war cries filled the battlefield.

The icefall divine ape charged forward, but Fang Yuan's phantom army quickly encircled it.

"Kill! Kill! Kill!" the strength path phantoms roared, swarming the icefall divine ape like ants.

The icefall divine ape lashed out wildly, destroying countless phantoms without breaking Fang Yuan's encirclement.

Manipulating the army rapidly depleted joyful will, forcing him to repeatedly activate Delight in Water and Mountain.

"Strange, this ancient desolate beast has no Immortal Gu—it does not even possess a mortal Gu! Where did the earthly calamity find such an oddity?"

Seeing that the icefall divine ape lacked any Gu worms, Fang Yuan knew its threat was greatly diminished.

"In that case, it is time to finish you off!" Sneering with ruthless eyes, Fang Yuan charged directly into the fray.

"Come, group strength support me!" Fang Yuan shouted excitedly in his heart.

The forty-five group strength Gu in his immortal aperture activated simultaneously.

Fang Yuan had fully incorporated group strength Gu into myriad self, and its activation triggered a new transformation!

Hundreds of strength path phantoms dispersed, their power converging into Fang Yuan through group strength Gu.

Fang Yuan raised one right arm, slamming down on icefall divine ape's skull.

The intense recoil caused Fang Yuan's forearm to burst open, pulverizing bone, flesh, and blood.

A massive hole caved the icefall divine ape's skull, its fractures spreading rapidly across the entire head.

At the next moment, the icefall divine ape's skull exploded!

Even Fang Yuan was surprised: "The entire head was destroyed? That shouldn't be for an ancient desolate beast!"

"Be careful!" Tai Bai Yun Sheng revealed himself, shouting a warning.

Fang Yuan turned around and looked, his pupils shrinking rapidly.

The icefall divine ape's massive fist closed in undetected, striking like a viper at lightning speed.

Unable to dodge in time, Fang Yuan was struck directly.

# Chapter 686: Fang Yuan learns from Reckless Savage Demon Venerable!

Boom! Fang Yuan was flung through the air like an insect, crashing hard onto the ice.

Severely wounded, Fang Yuan lay amidst broken ice, unable to budge even with his immortal zombie body. Leaking dark green blood from fractured bones and wounds, only three of his eight arms remained.

Normally, even an ancient desolate beast would die if its head was destroyed. Yet this headless ape had not only survived, but retaliated with a devastating blow.

"Fang Yuan!" Tai Bai Yun Sheng flew over, casting pitch-black rays from his hand onto Fang Yuan.

"Great." Fang Yuan smiled grimly. Regaining his mobility, he stood up from the ice.

Boom! The icefall divine ape underwent an astonishing change and suddenly self-detonated.

A large herd of pegasi appeared where the ape had detonated.

Four-winged pegasi rivaled beast emperors, while six-winged ones were desolate beasts!

It was a massacre; Fang Yuan's phantom army steadily lost ground and suffered heavy losses.

"This is no beast calamity! What is this?" Tai Bai Yun Sheng flew to Fang Yuan's side, staring wide-eyed.

Fang Yuan looked at the pegasi with narrowed, smiling eyes. Waving back, he transmitted his voice to the rushing Tai Bai Yun Sheng: "Old Bai, stand back and watch."

He then showed his sharp teeth and charged forward.

Countless ancient pegasi swarmed him like disturbed hornets. Activating hair armor, Fang Yuan raised his arms to protect his head.

Locking onto a target, Fang Yuan roared and pounced on an injured four-winged pegasus, slamming it from the sky to the ground.

With no time to lose, Fang Yuan smashed his fists down and pulverized the pegasus's head. Yet the headless beast continued struggling as if unaffected.

Fang Yuan unleashed a barrage of heavy strikes with all eight arms.

This four-winged pegasus had no Gu worms, and upon being crushed, dissipated completely without leaving hair, bone, or blood.

Upon the pegasus's destruction, a formless will surged into Fang Yuan's mind with shock and joy.

Kneeling motionless on the ice like a statue, he seemed oblivious to the fierce slaughter above him, entirely absorbed as if in a dream.

"Fang Yuan!" Tai Bai Yun Sheng flew toward him in great alarm.

"Come back, don't disturb him. This is a golden opportunity!" Fairy Li Shan suddenly transmitted.

Breathing heavily as he flew, Tai Bai Yun Sheng demanded irritably: "Are you still not going to explain this speculation?!"

Understanding his concern, Fairy Li Shan explained: "Everyone knows Reckless Savage Demon Venerable was a strength path Immortal Venerable, and founder of both strength and transformation path. Even if they perish, their main killer move would be imprinted in heaven and earth, forming a kind of heavenly tribulation and earthly calamity."

Fairy Li Shan continued: "Back then, Reckless Savage Demon Venerable transformed into an ice phoenix and breathed profound ice to create this icy plain—an act utilizing a transformation path killer move. As the creator of the icy plain, Reckless Savage Demon Venerable imprinted the true meaning of strength path and transformation path in the midst of this piece of heaven and earth. A piece of speculation was circulated among a few Gu Immortals, or more precisely a rumor. As long as a strength path or transformation path Gu Master ascends to Gu Immortal in this icy plain, it will cause a resonance of dao fragments, evoking the true meaning of Reckless Savage Demon Venerable's strength path and transformation path."

"The icefall divine ape and ancient pegasi are merely illusions—they are the true meaning of strength and transformation path manifested as an earthly calamity! When someone completely shatters these external forms, the small true meaning contained within would break out and enter the body of their own accord! What is true meaning? It is the comprehension towards heaven and earth, Great Dao and law fragments. Fang Yuan destroyed a pegasus and obtained the true meaning within it. In other words, Fang Yuan is receiving teachings from Reckless Savage Demon Venerable!"

# Chapter 687: True Meaning Infusion

"So they are the external forms of true meaning, hahaha!" Fang Yuan laughed aloud and stood up in high spirits.

"I advanced to a strength path Gu Immortal, but with my shallow foundation, I only reached quasi-grandmaster realm! Advancing attainment realms normally required decades of accumulation. But now, as long as I kill these true meaning external forms, I can rapidly raise my strength path realm, elevating it to genuine grandmaster realm!"

Attainment realms represented Dao comprehension, progressing from ordinary up to grandmaster, great grandmaster, and supreme grandmaster.

"Nurturing, using, and refining Gu are fundamentally humanity's means of probing and studying nature, the world, and the Great Dao. Be it a xianxia world, a magic-based world, or a scientific world, they are all the same, they are all the exploration and study of nature and the world itself. It is only that the difference in the world's laws make the exploration methods different."

"In this world, one's path attainment realms measure the staged progress of studying heaven, earth, and the Great Dao! It is making Reckless Savage Demon Venerable open the pages of the closed book to the parts which I can understand and let me read it directly. This is a shortcut, an extremely rare fortuitous encounter! This will save me a great deal of time and immense effort!"

'Hei Lou Lan, you intended to absorb Reckless Savage Demon Venerable's true meaning during ascension! However... your greed, I like it a lot. This gift from you, I shall accept it all!'

Fang Yuan thought excitedly; with such immense profits ahead, he would claim every last bit!

"Come!" Fang Yuan straightened as countless strength path phantoms surged from his immortal aperture.

The strength path phantom army flooded the battlefield like a river-engulfing tide, instantly replenishing their ranks and surpassing their previous peak.

Fang Yuan strode forward, raising eight massive arms to rain down lethal punches.

Wretched neighs rang out as pegasi were shattered. True meaning flooded Fang Yuan's mind; his body stiffened for a few breaths to absorb the Dao profundities before moving again.

"Refreshing!" he roared after another infusion, his eyes blazing with intimidating crimson light.

A strength path realm that normally required decades of effort was advancing rapidly under the true meaning infusions.

Before half the pegasi were destroyed, the earthly calamity transformed again, merging into thirty-three giant snakes.

Armored in black scales and shields, the giant snakes crashed to the ground.

Before a battered shield snake could raise its head, Fang Yuan pulverized it with eight arms, empowered by forty-five group strength Gu.

A surge of true meaning far greater than before poured into Fang Yuan's mind.

The headless snake corpse dissipated into countless smaller serpents, quickly creating a ferocious, writhing sea of snakes.

The snake sea attacked madly, quickly covering his enormous body.

This comprehension differed from earlier. With the pegasi, Fang Yuan had lived the life of a pegasus from birth to death, galloping across the ground and soaring through the sky...

Now, he experienced the life of a snake, mastering its constriction strength and striking power.

This advanced not only his strength path realm, but also his transformation path and flying attainment.

# Chapter 689: Second Battle With Hei Cheng (2/2)

He pushed dark arrow Immortal Gu to its limit again, firing three dark arrows toward their target.

The pear orchard surged, countless dragon-like roots coiling outward to desperately intercept the arrows.

Then, Fairy Li Shan's voice echoed: "You fell for it, Hei Cheng. Tree flower sheds tears!"

Hei Cheng's eyes twitched, he had to retreat!

With two dark arrows trapped, Hei Cheng's remaining arrow was useless against Fang Yuan's Immortal Gu Worldly Wave Trace.

Absorbing another trace of the Demon Venerable's true meaning, Fang Yuan sensed Hei Cheng's hostile gaze and returned a disdainful smile.

Still unsatisfied, Fang Yuan urged Hei Lou Lan: "Quick, release the collected earth qi with your small family qi Gu—we might draw more earthly calamities!"

Three breaths later, he vanished, returning to Snowy Mountain blessed land.

# Chapter 690: A Commotion in Northern Plains, A Wisdom Path Inheritance

In the quiet room on Snowy Mountain's third branch peak.

Fang Yuan lay gasping, covered in injuries as zombie blood pooled on the floor.

Fairy Li Shan sat by the window absent-mindedly brewing tea, her attention fixed on Hei Lou Lan beside her.

As the tea came to a boil, Hei Lou Lan exhaled turbid air and slowly opened her eyes.

This movement immediately attracted the other three's gazes.

Fairy Li Shan hurriedly set down the teapot, asking with concern: "Success?"

Hei Lou Lan nodded.

Fairy Li Shan took a deep breath, eyes reddening with tearful excitement: "Little Lan, with your Great Strength True Martial Physique, your successful ascension grants you a super grade blessed land and extraordinary potential. If sister knew of this in the afterlife, she would certainly be happy!"

Hei Lou Lan appeared tranquil: "I've succeeded in advancing to Gu Immortal, but have yet to kill that old scumbag."

"Hei Lou Lan, to be blunt, the chances of the four of us killing even a lone Hei Cheng are rather low," Tai Bai Yun Sheng coughed and said.

"Right, defeating a Gu Immortal is easy, but killing one is another thing altogether." Fang Yuan sighed as he stood up, his injuries essentially healed.

Hei Lou Lan smiled faintly at Fang Yuan: "Fending off the enemy and allowing me to pass the tribulation this time was thanks to your strength."

"As agreed, here is small family qi Gu's recipe. Also, of the thirty immortal essence stones I lent, you only need to return half," Fairy Li Shan said.

# Chapter 694: A gentle gaze

"Oh? Is that so..." Fang Yuan's eyes gleamed: "We are now Immortal Crane Sect's subsidiary. Touching us means going through Immortal Crane Sect first. Indeed... He Feng Yang's ambush earlier was orchestrated by you—or rather, Myriad Dragon Dock, wasn't it?"

Cooperating flawlessly, Hei Lou Lan feigned sudden realization: "Fang Yuan, you're absolutely right! Hu Immortal blessed land, Dang Hun mountain, and guts Gu are immense benefits. Assassinating He Feng Yang forces Immortal Crane Sect to attack us, letting Myriad Dragon Dock profit."

Hei Lou Lan sneered: "Your timing is far too convenient. How could the outside world know what transpired inside Hu Immortal blessed land when He Feng Yang attacked? Why was He Feng Yang ambushed the moment he left? Obviously, you acted as an inside scout, alerting your main body to organize the attack."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng chimed in: "Oh! Didn't Great Heavenly Sword Sect recently try to break away from Immortal Crane Sect's control? Rumors said Myriad Dragon Dock instigated them. Hehe, I get it—killing He Feng Yang would draw Immortal Crane Sect's main forces into besieging our blessed land. Even if they captured Hu Immortal blessed land, their heavy losses would leave them powerless to settle scores with Myriad Dragon Dock afterward."

He fumed: "You scoundrels are fabricating lies! What are your conditions to release my puppet?"

Fang Yuan chuckled, proposing an outrageous condition: "Vicious Lightning Fiend, I'm quite interested in your puppet-refining killer move. Why don't you teach me?"

"In your dreams! That took four years of seclusion to create—I will never give it to you! Even if this puppet is destroyed, you will never have it!" the blue charm lightning shadow roared in furious refusal.

Fang Yuan chuckled: "With rank six battle strength, discarding this lightning shadow puppet would be a waste. How about this: I'll step back and forgo your killer move in exchange for your Blood Deity remnant recipe."

The lightning shadow turned grim: "How do you know I possess Blood Deity's remnant recipe?!"

"Good! I am even more curious about your identities now. I concede this loss!" he gritted.

"Let's trade using treasure yellow heaven." Fang Yuan said.

Little Hu Immortal connected to treasure yellow heaven, locating Vicious Lightning Fiend's main body.

After negotiating, Fang Yuan sent the blue charm lightning shadow over as goods.

"Vicious Lightning Fiend, you have a seventy percent Blood Deity remnant recipe, yet offer forty percent?" Fang Yuan chided.

"I am in no rush. The longer your lightning shadow remains exposed, the more people will find out," Fang Yuan noted casually.

Saying this, he finally tossed out a seventy percent Blood Deity remnant recipe.

Fang Yuan made no further difficulties, swiftly concluding the deal.

Accepting the recipe, Fang Yuan marveled: "Something unattainable in my past life came so easily today. With this recipe, my past-life foundation, and wisdom Gu, I can complete Blood Deity."

# Chapter 707: Overwhelming Profits!

Three days later in Central Continent time, Immortal Crane Sect publicly announced their recognition of Fang Yuan as Hu Immortal blessed land's owner and subsidiary, free to leave at any time.

Rumors regarding Dang Hun mountain, Hu Immortal blessed land, and Vicious Lightning Fiend's killer move drew attention, but guts Gu was the biggest highlight.

Guts Gu could now be stored and traded away from Dang Hun mountain—a prospect of immense profit that stirred every faction.

While calling Immortal Crane Sect shameless, the other nine ancient sects actively reached out to Hu Immortal blessed land.

Seizing this opportunity, Fang Yuan entered Central Continent's spotlight, drawing every faction's gaze as an immortal zombie and owner of Hu Immortal blessed land.

A few days later, Hei Lou Lan delivered the first batch of hundreds of thousands of souls.

Fang Yuan placed them into Dang Hun mountain, where Hu Immortal land spirit unleashed the mountain's power to shatter them into fragments, gradually condensing them into guts Gu on the mountain's surface.

Fang Yuan brought her to the stone nest near Dang Hun mountain.

Standing at the edge of the stone nest and gazing down, Hei Lou Lan was shocked by Fang Yuan's massive investment.

The stone nest spanned tens of acres and plunged hundreds of meters into the ground.

Countless rooms were carved into the pillar and sinkhole walls, each housing an elderly hairy man equipped with the necessary Gu refinement tools and materials.

As Hei Lou Lan guessed inwardly, Fang Yuan said: "Fairy, preparations are complete. You may use strength qi Immortal Gu now."

Hei Lou Lan complied; powerful strength qi billowed into thick fog that blanketed the stone nest.

"Start the Gu refinement," Fang Yuan instructed. The prepared hairy men opened their eyes and began refining.

Whenever they needed strength qi for refinement, the swirling qi outside automatically flowed into their rooms.

In truth, this stone nest was invented during his past life's five regions chaotic war.

"I will name this the Fang Yuan stone nest, built specifically to mass-produce mortal Gu. I split the airsac Gu refinement into over a dozen steps. Hairy men on the top floor complete the first step and pass the product down each subsequent level. This way, each hairy man specializes in a single step. This prevents my recipe from leaking while improving their proficiency and success rate."

Hei Lou Lan nodded. "I was worried a shortage of airsac Gu would limit guts Gu sales, since each airsac Gu holds only one guts Gu. Seeing this stone nest reassures me. How do you plan to sell them?"

Fang Yuan already had a plan: "Most will go to Central Continent's ten great ancient sects. I have already established connections with them via hole earth Gu for trading; the remainder will be sold in treasure yellow heaven."

"Won't you sell directly to other Central Continent sects?"

"No. The ten great sects lead Central Continent, and our identities are already sensitive—there is no need to test their bottom line. Our hard-won peace should be used to quietly reap profits."

Deducting costs and Hei Lou Lan and Fairy Li Shan's forty percent cut, Fang Yuan netted forty-three immortal essence stones from the first batch of guts Gu.

Reinvesting his profits, Fang Yuan bought hairy men in bulk, carved out more rooms, and expanded production.

After five months, his earnings stabilized at forty-eight immortal essence stones of net profit per batch.

However, the supply of souls fed to Dang Hun Mountain now became the main bottleneck limiting guts Gu sales.

# Chapter 708: Returning the Eight Desolate Beasts

Northern Plains, Lang Ya blessed land.

Fang Yuan stood conversing with Lang Ya land spirit in the distance, both turning toward the commotion.

Thanks to the Inkman King, the fifteen layers of the qi path seal on him had been reduced to six.

"Ice spike divine ape, phoenix feather lava crocodile, golden sand dark stallion, azure dragon vine, swamp crab, peach wolf, iron crown eagle, and earth chief desolate beast—I return all eight borrowed desolate beasts without a single scratch. Roaming occasionally does them good. Letting them sleep constantly saves food, but harms their battle strength," Fang Yuan remarked.

Fang Yuan chuckled and extended his hand. "Now that your desolate beasts are returned, by our agreement, hand over the two Immortal Gu, Man as Before and Landscape as Before."

Lang Ya land spirit smiled sheepishly. "Brother Fang, Man as Before and Landscape as Before are incredible. Can you give me a few more days?"

"We made this deal willingly; I didn't force you. Suffer your own loss—it's too late to back out! Hand them over. Don't forget our mountain pledge Gu vow, which includes your friend Mo Tan Sang—breaking it costs a life," Fang Yuan sneered.

"Land spirit, return the Immortal Gu to him," Mo Tan Sang urged, rushing over anxiously.

Unable to bear Mo Tan Sang's gaze, Lang Ya land spirit stomped his foot and reluctantly handed Man as Before and Landscape as Before back to Fang Yuan.

Storing both Immortal Gu in his aperture, Fang Yuan took out three Immortal Gu recipes.

The three remnant recipes Fang Yuan presented had started at sixty percent, taking him half a month of arduous deductions to complete.

Lang Ya land spirit examined the recipes, shaking his head with a sigh. "Lad, I must admit, you're an unparalleled genius at deducing Gu recipes. What a pity you've become an immortal zombie."

Fang Yuan asked, "I also wish to revive from being an immortal zombie. Do you know of any methods?"

"There are many methods, but they carry high risks, low success rates, or require extinct materials."

"Brother Fang might consider joining the Northern Plains Zombie Alliance, whose immortal zombies research regaining life. Years ago, I heard rumors that they made progress on the matter," Mo Tan Sang suggested.

Fang Yuan nodded. "I intend to, but having destroyed Eighty-Eight True Yang Building and Imperial Court blessed land, I cannot appear publicly. Facing wisdom path deductions would be disastrous."

"My wisdom path methods are weak beyond recipe deductions. Having captured Ma and Zhao, Qin Bai Sheng likely knows my appearance."

At the mention of Qin Bai Sheng, Mo Tan Sang's eyes brightened. "He is truly impressive. I thought he had only martial might, but he possesses great wisdom as well. He captured Ma and Zhao to claim the core luck path inheritance, prompting Northern Plains' Gu Immortals to unite against him. Yet within a month, he yielded profits to win allies, enlisted Fairy Li Shan to bind lone cultivators with mountain pledge Gu, and even persuaded Ye Lui tribe."

"Yet he averted the battle and is hosting an auction in his blessed land to sell the luck path Immortal Gu and captives."

"Do you have leads on white lotus giant silkworm Gu?"

Lang Ya land spirit replied, "White lotus giant silkworm Gu was created by Spectral Soul long after my death. Spectral Soul Demon Venerable only rose up after Giant Sun Immortal Venerable, by that time, I was already confined inside this blessed land, how could I have any leads?"

"However, I have an incredible transformation path killer move from Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable. In his youth, he used these Gu worms to alter his appearance and evade pursuers with great success. With this killer move, you will be able to change your appearance and aura, to conceal your identity. Even if Gu Immortals manage to deduce your identity, you might be able to deny it in person and claim that their deduction was wrong, successfully hoodwinking them!"

# Chapter 709: Familiar Face

"Oh?" Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's name piqued Fang Yuan's interest. "Is it the legendary Familiar Face?"

Lang Ya land spirit shook his head. "Familiar Face is an immortal killer move centered on Attitude Gu; you couldn't use it. However, this mortal killer move is closely tied to Familiar Face as its precursor, making it suitable for you to use."

Seeing Fang Yuan's interest piqued, Lang Ya land spirit chuckled. "The move is called Unfamiliar Face. But if you want it, you must do me a favor."

Lang Ya land spirit explained: "Each of my twelve cloud buildings once housed a desolate beast. But during the attack by the mysterious force's Gu Immortals, two were slain and another succumbed to injuries. Now, I only have nine left. If you can enslave a desolate beast with outstanding battle strength for me, not only will I pay you immortal essence stones based on market rates, I will also give you this mortal killer move 'unfamiliar face'."

After obtaining three new remnant recipes and bidding farewell, he returned to Hu Immortal blessed land.

"A fruitful trip," Fang Yuan said, returning Landscape as Before and Man as Before to Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

"Shark Demon is calling urgently; I must go to Eastern Sea." Tai Bai Yun Sheng took the Gu and rushed off without inspecting them.

Alone at last, Fang Yuan began planning his next steps.

"Having repelled Immortal Crane Sect's attack and stabilized Hu Immortal blessed land, I've joined the righteous path faction as a nominal subsidiary. With guts Gu sales underway, I can begin exerting slight influence in Central Continent."

"Four Gu Immortals and eight desolate beasts were merely a borrowed facade. My Snowy Mountain Alliance with Hei Lou Lan has a time limit. Lang Ya blessed land struggles against strong enemies; I cannot mobilize its desolate beasts at will. Even though Immortal Crane Sect retreated and trade began with the ten great ancient sects, my public emergence will invite relentless investigations into my background. They hold back only out of uncertainty; once my background is exposed, they will strike again," Fang Yuan pondered.

"This hard-won peace is my chance to build foundation and raise my cultivation. I must grow strong enough that no surrounding faction dares harbor ill intentions against me."

His most pressing issue was feeding his Immortal Gu.

Satiating Cleanse Soul required ten thousand white lotus giant silkworm Gu, scarce even among collectors.

Without acquiring its recipe to refine in bulk, he could not permanently solve the issue.

The six-headed snake's skeleton had dissolved into black blood to feed Calamity Beckoning Immortal Gu. Feeding Delight in Water and Mountain remained unresolved, though Mo Yao's will had fed it previously, temporarily staving off trouble.

Worldly Wave Trace Gu required tens of thousands of underworld jellyfish and rare deepsea lightning eels.

Though rich in immortal essence stones, feeding Immortal Gu could not be resolved with wealth alone.

# Chapter 710: Crossing the Regional Wall

Fang Yuan's vital Gu was Spring Autumn Cicada, but he lacked a time path inheritance and cultivated strength path.

His Immortal Gu spanned mixed paths, and his dead immortal aperture produced no immortal essence.

As for the final important problem, it was battle strength.

With Cleanse Soul too weakened by hunger to risk activating, Fang Yuan's trump card—the immortal killer move Myriad Self—was temporarily unusable.

Confronting Central Continent's ten ancient sects, evading Northern Plains pursuers, seizing Dong Fang Chang Fan's wisdom path inheritance, capturing a desolate beast for Lang Ya land spirit, searching for the Thieving Heaven inheritance in Luo Po Valley, and taking Dark Limit from Fairy Jiang Yu all demanded formidable battle strength.

"A Gu Immortal's battle strength depends on attainment, Immortal Gu, killer moves, and immortal essence. I do not lack essence. As for Immortal Gu, the Blood Deity remnant recipe is sufficient to deduce a complete recipe, but my wealth falls far short of refining an Immortal Gu."

Thus, his only path to rapidly boosting battle strength lay in killer moves.

"With sufficient immortal essence stones and greater disposable income, I can buy excellent mortal killer moves while deducing, testing, and recreating powerful killer moves from my past life."

Having thought things through, Fang Yuan immediately started with the task.

Central Continent.

Led by Feng Jiu Ge, a group of Gu Immortals stood before an enormous light wall.

This was Central Continent's boundary, the saint regional wall.

"Old Oracle, what are your calculations this time?" Old Lord Can Yang asked a youthful-looking Gu Immortal.

The youthful Gu Immortal replied cheerfully: "It can be done. This section is rather weak—the third spot found in recent days, but much more stable than the previous two. I suggest we use this to cut open an entrance and cross the regional wall to Northern Plains!"

Fairy Ao Xue and Fairy Ling Mei exchanged glances and stepped forward together. "Let Heaven's Envy Manor take the lead this time."

With that, they unleashed their joint immortal killer move, Peerless Crescent Moon Slash.

Feng Jiu Ge led the group into the saint regional wall.

Stepping inside, the immortals' bodies grew heavy, thoughts slowed, and internal apertures began to tremor.

Light spots struck the white-gold saint regional wall, melting it like snow to forge a sixty-three-step passage.

The Gu Immortals took turns using Immortal Gu or killer moves to carve deeper into the wall.

The deeper they ventured, the heavier the oppressive force became, dragging them backward as if the world itself resisted their departure from Central Continent.

As a wisdom path Gu Immortal, Old Oracle had to use various methods and immortal killer moves to reinforce the others' minds.

The deeper they went, the more violently their apertures trembled—cracking ground and killing countless life forms.

Only Feng Jiu Ge still strode forward with a composed expression, unleashing immortal killer moves with every strike to cleave passages over a hundred steps long.

After over three thousand steps, the white-gold light thinned ahead, vaguely revealing a trace of green.

Dripping with sweat, Feng Jiu Ge said: "This section of licorice regional wall is too firm; we must change direction."

"This way." Finally, Old Oracle calculated a direction.

The Gu Immortals changed direction, enduring a bitter day and night before passing the licorice regional wall into Northern Plains.

"Rest and reorganize for three days, we will talk after that." Feng Jiu Ge exhaustedly said.

# Chapter 711: Giving Up on Possession

On the stone bed lay the rotting, ruined body of a young rank five Gu Master: Gu Yue Fang Zheng.

To locate Fang Yuan and aid He Feng Yang's attack on Hu Immortal blessed land, Fang Zheng had been plotted against by Lord Sky Crane; losing control of the failed blood demon flower Gu, severe blood loss left his soul near collapse in deep unconsciousness.

"You want to revive Fang Zheng?" Beside the stone bed, He Feng Yang looked at the spirit incubating flea floating before him.

A firm voice came from the flea: "Yes, Lord. I am willing to give up this possession opportunity; please save Fang Zheng instead."

He Feng Yang looked toward the unconscious Fang Zheng, saying softly: "His physical injuries look terrifying but are no big concern; even without me, the sect has many ways to heal him. The problem is his soul. Forcing the blood sense placed an immense burden on his soul, leaving it a step from collapse."

"With his A grade aptitude, rank five aperture, and weakened soul, you would easily possess him. Wasn't that your goal?"

"He carries First Gen Gu Yue's bloodline, yet he trusts me and calls me master, never imagining I would harm him. He believes in justice just as I once did. If I kill him and possess his body, how could I face myself living in his shell?"

After a brief silence, He Feng Yang placed his hand on Fang Zheng's forehead.

"I have healed his body and stabilized his soul. As a reward, I will grant you another chance, Sky Crane. You don't need to give up on possession yet; take time to think it through properly," He Feng Yang said.

He Feng Yang withdrew his hand: "Our possession technique is incomplete, originating from Northern Plains. Currently, Old Lord Can Yang has accompanied Feng Jiu Ge there on several sect missions. One is to collect information and improve the possession technique. When he returns, Sky Crane, your chances of successful possession will be higher. Reflect thoroughly and give me your answer then."

Without waiting for Lord Sky Crane to finish, He Feng Yang waved his sleeves and vanished.

Hu Immortal blessed land, in an underground cave.

The multicolored halo of wisdom light shone upon Fang Yuan's face.

Suddenly, he coughed up a mouthful of green zombie blood as countless joyful wills in his mind collapsed and disintegrated.

Tremors shook his mind, thoughts disintegrating the moment they formed. Faint cracks lined the boundaries of his mind—the backlash of forceful thinking.

"Deducing a difficult star path problem, I used massive joyful wills and unlimited inspiration from the light of wisdom to explore countless possibilities. This exceeded my mind's endurance limits, causing injury."

"I thought wisdom Gu could deduce star shoot Gu's recipe, but my star path foundation is too shallow. Unlimited inspiration provides countless directions, but I must deduce every single possibility myself. Furthermore, each deduction only generates more choices."

"Although star shoot Gu is mortal Gu, Star Lord Wan Xiang tampered with it, making its recipe hard to reverse engineer. Without star path master attainment, success is unlikely," Fang Yuan realized.

Fang Yuan estimated the difficulty: "If reverse-refining star shoot Gu's recipe requires star path master attainment, researching an entirely new recipe for starlight firefly Gu will be harder, likely requiring star path grandmaster attainment. Modifying Dou Min Jun's inheritance to create a new star path Gu that amplifies attack, defense, movement, and healing would be harder still, requiring at least quasi-great grandmaster attainment."

Fang Yuan assessed his attainments: blood and strength grandmaster, flying quasi-grandmaster, and refinement, enslavement, and transformation master.

Though he possessed Blood Deity's remnant recipe, he refrained from completing it; he lacked the wealth to refine blood deity Immortal Gu now.

Strength path had dim prospects and lost recipes, leaving only enslavement and transformation path.

But enslavement path needed beast groups.

Three days later, he finally made a breakthrough in transformation path.

# Chapter 712: Lion Fur Armor, Transplanting Bat Wings

Time flew by, and in the blink of an eye, ten days passed in Hu Immortal blessed land.

"Hair armor." With a shift of thought, his hair grew wildly, condensing into malevolent, pitch-black spiked armor.

Fang Yuan had seamlessly merged numerous golden lion fur Gu into the hair armor's foundation.

Within breaths, the spiked black armor became smooth bronze armor twice as thick, topped with a roaring lion helmet framing his face. Its defense rose by one hundred and fifty percent, and increased by two hundred percent against metal path attacks.

"Let's call it lion fur armor," Fang Yuan muttered, raising his eight arms to release eight clusters of starlight.

Returning to Dang Hun Palace, he found Little Hu Immortal using connecting heaven Gu to monitor treasure yellow heaven.

"Master, the seller still insists on four immortal essence stones and shows no sign of lowering it," Little Hu Immortal reported.

Fang Yuan wanted to buy a pair of bat desolate beast wings.

Activating divine sense Gu under the alias Eight Arm Immortal, Fang Yuan contacted the seller: "I will pay three immortal essence stones for this pair of bat wings."

The seller's will refused: "Not selling. Four immortal essence stones is the absolute minimum."

Soon, he had Little Hu Immortal inquire with an impatient tone: "How about this, I will pay three immortal essence stones for your bat wings. Speak up, are you selling or not?"

The seller's will hesitated, but still refused: "These wings are the most valuable part of the entire corpse. If you buy only the wings, the rest will be hard to sell. If you are sincere, how about taking the whole desolate beast corpse for five immortal essence stones?"

After consulting Fang Yuan, Little Hu Immortal replied: "I only need the wings; what will I do with the rest? I've wasted enough time already. Three immortal essence stones is already plenty. I'll offer three and a half—my final bottom line. If you still refuse, forget it."

"Alright, I'll sell..." the seller's will began, only for another divine sense to cut in: "Hold on, I want this bat corpse; I'll give five immortal essence stones."

As the seller prepared to agree, Little Hu Immortal followed Fang Yuan's instruction and intervened: "Wait, I will pay five and a half immortal essence stones."

Little Hu Immortal's tone turned gloomy: "In that case, I will pay eight immortal essence stones."

"Eight?" Shi Lei laughed, "Then I will pay nine!"

"Nine and a half." Hu Immortal land spirit immediately quoted.

Shi Lei laughed heartily: "As expected of the guts Gu business, you have deep pockets. I won't bicker over a corpse. Enjoy it!"

The seller received nine and a half immortal essence stones, while Fang Yuan obtained the desolate bat corpse.

After this transaction, Fang Yuan checked his assets: one hundred and seventy-two immortal essence stones and seventy-seven beads of green grape immortal essence.

He had not only upgraded hair armor into lion fur armor, but also greatly improved light illusion bat wings.

To complete light illusion bat wings, he needed to transplant real bat wings onto his body.

"Immortal Monkey King Shi Lei, making me pay triple for this bat corpse... I will remember this."

For the next half month, he concentrated on processing the bat desolate beast corpse.

Using fire and strength path Gu worms, he tempered the bat wings until the expansive wings condensed into a smaller form.

Enduring intense pain, Fang Yuan finally succeeded in transplanting the bat wings onto his back.

# Chapter 713: True Solid Bat Wings

This was his third test flight with the newly transplanted bat wings.

Fully spread, the processed wings were not even half his arm's length. Petite and yellowish-brown, they appeared far less impressive than the former light illusion bat wings.

Replacing phantom wings with physical wings nearly doubled his speed and vastly extended flight duration.

"Light illusion bat wings is no longer appropriate. I should call it true solid bat wings," Fang Yuan renamed the modified killer move.

True solid bat wings held great potential, capable of accommodating up to three pairs of wings. They required desolate beast wings at minimum, though ancient or immemorial desolate beasts would be even better.

As intense winds whipped behind him, Fang Yuan flapped his wings and soared into the sky.

With a strength path immortal body, using the water path worldly wave trace Immortal Gu caused conflicting dao marks that restricted each other.

Most importantly, true solid bat wings was a mortal killer move, offering vastly superior cost-efficiency compared to worldly wave trace Immortal Gu.

"Desolate beast corpses are rare, and new listings in treasure yellow heaven may not be bats. To gather two more pairs of wings, I must seek them out actively. It's time to take some risks and enter Starry Sky grotto-heaven."

Starry Sky grotto-heaven's owner was Seven Star Child, a rank eight Gu Immortal from seventeen hundred years ago.

Seven Star Child had died long ago. In Fang Yuan's previous life, Starry Sky grotto-heaven fell from Central Continent's sky, shattering into dozens of immortal aperture fragments scattered across the region.

"In this life, Starry Sky grotto-heaven remains intact in the sky. The scenery in my memory will allow me to use Fixed Immortal Travel to enter early and seize its resources. I remember numerous desolate and ancient desolate beasts dwell within, including a star demon bat. My goal is to slay it and harvest its wings. Meanwhile, I can see if I can capture a desolate beast for Lang Ya land spirit," Fang Yuan planned.

"In my previous life, I only dispatched subordinates to explore its fragments after the heavenly spirit had already perished. Going now, the heavenly spirit is alive and can mobilize the grotto-heaven's full defenses. Had I not become an immortal zombie, I wouldn't even qualify to explore it."

Days later, Hei Lou Lan brought strength qi Immortal Gu to Hu Immortal blessed land, helping Fang Yuan refine another batch of airsac Gu.

Only Hei Lou Lan was free, agreeing to explore Starry Sky grotto-heaven with Fang Yuan.

Sharing the risk under the Snowy Mountain Alliance, Fang Yuan was exempt from compensating Hei Lou Lan's losses, with gains split sixty-forty in his favor.

After resting a few days in Hu Immortal blessed land, Hei Lou Lan entered Fang Yuan's immortal aperture.

Fang Yuan visualized the scene to activate Fixed Immortal Travel.

After a dozen attempts and expending over ten green grape immortal essence beads, he finally succeeded.

With a flash of jade-green light, he appeared inside Starry Sky grotto-heaven.

# Chapter 714: Fighting Star Desolate Hound

They emerged before a lush, verdant forest at the serene, fog-shrouded foot of a mountain.

Fang Yuan opened his immortal aperture, and Hei Lou Lan stepped out onto the mountain rocks.

Her eyes flashed as she looked around: "This is inside Starry Sky grotto-heaven?"

"Indeed, let's go. The desolate star demon bat should be nearby."

"Five minutes have passed; something is wrong!" Hei Lou Lan halted, asking Fang Yuan solemnly.

Fang Yuan nodded: "Indeed. We have encountered only trees and fog, moving in identical circles."

"Has the Starry Sky heavenly spirit already begun targeting us?" Hei Lou Lan guessed.

"If not a unique law, an illusion is disturbing our perception. Unfortunately, I lack investigative killer moves," Fang Yuan replied.

Fang Yuan shook his head: "My wisdom path methods are specialized and cannot deduce directions. Do you have any investigative killer moves?"

Hei Lou Lan snorted, raising her fists: "I lack investigative killer moves, but I have offensive ones—Self Strength!"

She punched with both fists, unleashing majestic fist qi.

The phantoms converged on Hei Lou Lan, fusing over her body into a giant strength path phantom.

Hei Lou Lan unleashed heavy punches and kicks, quaking the earth, shattering rocks, toppling trees, and dispersing the fog.

Fang Yuan flew into the sky, his vision clearing.

He saw the forest spanned only a hundred li; he and Hei Lou Lan had been moving in circles.

Suddenly, a dog-shaped desolate beast charged down from the mountaintop.

Fang Yuan recognized it at a glance, immediately reminding Hei Lou Lan: "This is a star desolate hound, likely this mountain's overlord. Let's test the desolate beasts in Starry Sky grotto-heaven. If it is weak, don't kill it—it's best to capture it alive, I have other uses for it!"

He added: "You take the lead, I'll support. Decide based on the situation; if we capture it alive, I will pay you with immortal essence stones."

"Alright, let's do that." Decisive as ever, Hei Lou Lan shouted loudly as her giant strength path phantom strode heavily toward the star desolate hound.

The star desolate hound plunged down fiercely, pouncing at the giant strength path phantom.

Not to be outdone, Hei Lou Lan punched and kicked, clashing with the hound. The two huge figures tumbled down the mountainside toward the foot like a rolling gourd.

The star desolate hound fiercely pounced on the giant phantom, opening its jaws to reveal sword-sharp, halberd-long white canines, and bit down.

Seeing his chance, Fang Yuan moved his eight arms and slammed down eight fully charged lumps of starlight.

A series of explosions resounded; the star desolate hound barked furiously, its attack interrupted.

The giant strength path phantom bent its knee, fiercely striking the vital spot between the hound's hind legs.

The hound let out an agonizing cry, leaping as if electrocuted and thrashing through the lush forest.

Fang Yuan fluttered over immediately, giving the star desolate hound no time to recover.

Flapping his wings nimbly, he hurled lumps of starlight at the hound's eyes, mouth, and vitals.

Hei Lou Lan controlled her giant strength path phantom and stood up.

Her giant phantom, the pinnacle transformation of her strength path killer move, was outmatched in strength by the hound.

"In that case, let me use self strength Immortal Gu." Hei Lou Lan gave a sinister smile and prepared to attack.

Suddenly, familiar barks echoed from the two nearby peaks.

Shortly after, two female star desolate hounds charged into their sight.

Fang Yuan slowed, Hei Lou Lan's pupils shrank, and sharing the exact same thought, they simultaneously transmitted: "Run!"

# Chapter 715: Diamond Soil

Three star desolate hounds gave chase as Fang Yuan and Hei Lou Lan retreated.

After flying nearly ten li, the three star desolate hounds finally gave up the chase.

The two stopped at a tall tree to rest and recover.

Standing on the treetop to find their bearings, Fang Yuan observed that the surrounding mountains were close yet distinct and independent.

Seven Star Child had separated these peaks to cultivate different vegetation and boost production.

Looking at the small bat wings on Fang Yuan's back, Hei Lou Lan asked with interest: "Your killer move is not bad, where did you buy it?"

He answered plainly: "It's an improved version tailored for my immortal zombie body. To use it, you must transplant a pair of bat wings onto your back."

Hei Lou Lan frowned: "A desolate beast's body contains dao marks aligned with specific laws. Your bat wings bear wind path dao marks rather than strength path. Aren't you afraid transplanting them will cause a conflict between paths, weakening your strength path killer moves?"

Fang Yuan chuckled: "You know Reckless Savage Demon Venerable could transform into all sorts of fierce beasts, right?"

"Transformation path's essence is turning one's body into a beast or plant, gaining its strength and abilities. A transformation path Gu Master can become a wind path bird, fire path tiger, or water path fish, using one path to project countless others. Why don't their dao marks conflict?" Fang Yuan asked.

"Because each transformation takes the form of a single beast, bearing only one type of dao mark—unlike your mixture of two dao marks, which is like cultivating two paths at once. Furthermore, after transforming, they use Gu worms to cleanse their bodies and remove those dao marks before taking on a form with different dao marks," Hei Lou Lan said.

Fang Yuan laughed arrogantly: "No, that's merely because their methods are lacking. Reckless Savage Demon Venerable ate immemorial desolate beasts to form beast totems, encompassing countless dao marks on his body and transforming at will. During your tribulation, I received the Demon Venerable's true meaning infusion and became a transformation path master."

Hei Lou Lan was truly shocked: "You gained pointers from Reckless Savage Demon Venerable and have a method to balance different dao marks?"

Fang Yuan said: "At master realm, I can only balance three different dao marks, limiting true solid bat wings to three pairs."

"Now I understand why you're hunting star demon bats. Does your intel say one is nearby?" Hei Lou Lan asked.

Fang Yuan nodded: "According to my intel, it's nearby. But the terrain is somewhat different, so let's scout first."

The desolate beast had a transparent, diamond-like body. Resembling a bear as large as a mammoth, it was a diamond bear, rarely seen in the five regions.

Transforming into the strength path phantom giant again, Hei Lou Lan raised her leg and kicked at the diamond bear's belly.

The diamond bear growled, its body shining as it broke the phantom giant's right leg.

"This diamond bear has wild Gu worms that counter my strength path giant!" Hei Lou Lan retreated in shock.

Seeing this, Fang Yuan rushed over, hurling lumps of starlight rapidly like pelting raindrops.

Raising four arms, Fang Yuan hurled down a huge lump of icy drill stardust.

With a loud blast, icy drill stardust engulfed the diamond bear.

The next moment, it charged out of the starlight and flew into the sky.

"This bear can fly?" Caught off guard at close range, Fang Yuan was struck by the diamond bear's raised paws.

Zombie blood poured out—two arms used to block were severed, and three others were fractured.

"Retreat!" Fang Yuan shouted to Hei Lou Lan.

Already intending to retreat, Hei Lou Lan canceled her killer move and fled with Fang Yuan.

The diamond bear did not pursue, picking up Fang Yuan's two arms and chewing them.

Disgusted, the bear slammed the severed arm onto a rock and returned to its cave.

Moments later, Fang Yuan and Hei Lou Lan returned stealthily.

Fang Yuan picked up the amputated arm, inspected it, and aligned it against his wound.

Using healing Gu worms and his immortal zombie regeneration, the severed arm quickly reconnected.

Hei Lou Lan looked at the mountaintop cave entrance: "There are still at least fifteen kilograms of diamond soil left in that cave."

Formed from diamond bear feces, nutrient-rich diamond soil was highly valued in treasure yellow heaven.

Earlier, while Fang Yuan lured the bear away, Hei Lou Lan had looted hundreds of kilograms of diamond soil.

Fang Yuan shook his head: "Fifteen kilograms isn't worth the risk. It worked once, but provoking the diamond bear a second time will be far more dangerous. The bear is sturdy and tough; killing it would cost dearly. My goal is the star demon bat, so let's try another direction."

# Chapter 716: Star Hall

Half a day later, having scouted most of the area and encountered many desolate beasts, they still had not found the star demon bat.

Fang Yuan sat on the ground, using his iron-sharp fingernails to map the explored terrain on a flat rock.

Strangely, however, there were no ancient desolate beasts.

Ancient desolate beasts rivaled rank seven strength; a well-managed grotto-heaven should logically contain them.

Second, the heavenly spirit had still not appeared.

Third, Fang Yuan could not find the poisonous swamp anywhere.

In his past life, this area was a poisonous swamp fragment world his subordinates had explored.
