Looking up at the green sky, they saw it had unknowingly filled with countless specks of starlight.

"This is an astronomical change unique to grotto-heavens." Fang Yuan rose alertly, activating lion fur armor.

Winds surged as the endless starlight suddenly converged atop a mountain.

With a burst of dazzling blue radiance, the starlight dispersed, revealing an exquisite, resplendent giant hall atop the mountain peak.

"Foul beast, take this king's fist!" A hill-sized rockman shouted, smashing down a fist that whipped up gusts and burst the air.

Countless thick, sharp earth spikes protruded from the ground like spears.

Hundreds of earth spikes instantly impaled the desolate beast flying bear.

The rocky giant snorted and emitted piercing light, revealing a Gu Immortal standing proudly midair with crossed arms.

The white-haired man with golden pupils was Combat Immortal Sect's rank seven Gu Immortal, Immortal Monkey King Shi Lei.

Shi Lei gave him an indifferent gaze: "Seven star halls have appeared. Star Lord Wan Xiang, why has the eighth not opened yet?"

Star Lord Wan Xiang smiled brightly: "No need to worry, Immortal Monkey King. The eighth star hall appears only when enough desolate beast blood has seeped into the ground. We have slain six, but the blood is still not enough."

Looking thoughtful, Star Lord Wan Xiang paused before saying: "Based on twenty years of annual explorations and my speculations, we probably need to kill only one more desolate beast."

Star Lord Wan Xiang lowered his head: "As a lone cultivator, I wouldn't dare deceive Lord Immortal Monkey King even with ten times the courage. I also want to plunder resources, but years ago I glimpsed the eighth star hall, cloaked in a foreboding atmosphere. Guarded entirely by ancient desolate beasts, it is definitely this grotto-heaven's central control point and very likely where the heavenly spirit resides."

"My past explorations show a star demon bat nearby that is rather easy to kill."

"Alright, let's go. Usual rules: stand aside during battle, do not interfere." Decisive as ever, Shi Lei immediately flew rapidly toward the destination.

Fang Yuan and Hei Lou Lan cautiously entered the star hall.

Defenseless and empty, the star hall contained only six large wells in the center of the main hall.

The glittering, translucent well water glowed faintly in six different colors: red, brown, yellow, blue, purple, and white.

"What connection do they have?" Fang Yuan murmured, sending a mortal storage Gu into a well to draw water for study.

However, as the mortal Gu entered, the calm water swirled into a whirlpool and swallowed it.

# Chapter 717: Killing Star Demon Bat

Fang Yuan could still sense the faint mortal Gu.

Following the connection in his mind, Fang Yuan deduced the direction and looked up.

Activating investigative Gu, Fang Yuan peered through the roof to spot six huge star shadows in the sky.

Following the mental sensation, he fixed his gaze on one star shadow, knowing the mortal Gu was atop it!

The star demon bat's huge wings whipped up fierce winds as countless arrows shot out simultaneously.

Seeing the barrage, Shi Lei scoffed: "Merely rank two star arrow Gu, just in high numbers."

A thin layer of yellow-white smoke covered Shi Lei.

As the light faded, Shi Lei was replaced by a desolate beast iron crown eagle.

A battle maniac, Shi Lei had already killed eleven desolate beasts, using a different transformation path killer move in each fight.

Star Lord Wan Xiang urged haste, but Shi Lei refused, wanting to accumulate transformation path battle experience.

The iron crown eagle spat blood and flapped to stabilize itself before Shi Lei laughed: "Interesting, bullying my master-level flying attainment?"

Having flown its entire life, the star demon bat possessed at least flying grandmaster attainment.

The star demon bat kept its distance to attack with Gu worms from afar, while the eagle tried to engage in close combat. After a protracted clash, the bat inevitably slipped up; seizing the flaw, the iron crown eagle tore the bat wings with its talons.

With torn wings, the bat's flight plummeted, exposing fatal flaws.

Pursuing this prime opportunity, Shi Lei endured the bat's final struggle and killed it.

Just as Star Lord Wan Xiang said, the ground absorbed the blood, activating a formless energy.

# Chapter 718: Starshine Fake Eye Gu

The starlight specks coiled and fluttered before gathering high above to form a brand-new star hall.

"The eighth star hall has finally appeared—my speculation was indeed correct!" Star Lord Wan Xiang said excitedly.

Shi Lei canceled the eagle transformation, returning to human form as his bleeding wounds slowly recovered. Glancing indifferently with golden pupils, he said: "No wonder you guessed this was the grotto-heaven's central control point; it certainly looks the part."

Just then, sounds of battle echoed from the eighth star hall.

As a newly ascended Gu Immortal, Hei Lou Lan could not identify this Gu and cautiously suggested: "Let's detour."

Fang Yuan smiled: "No need. This is starshine fake eye Gu with long-range sensing, allowing Gu Immortals to observe the surroundings through it. It spans five li but cannot detect stealth. We can turn invisible and boldly walk past it."

# Chapter 719: Small methods have profound meaning, the more one understands the more shocking it is

Concealing themselves, they strode into the starshine fake eye Gu's range without attracting any Gu Immortal's attention.

Fang Yuan used various methods—invisibility, counters, and tunneling—to slip past the investigative Gu.

However, these dao marks are so faint that even attentive Gu Immortals cannot sense them without thread trace Gu, which I developed. By observing these marks, I can deduce information about them."

Pointing to where Star Lord Wan Xiang had stood, Fang Yuan said: "Look, the azure-blue dao marks form a human shape, indicating a star path Gu Immortal observed the battle. And looking at the concentration of the dao marks, it seems to be a rank six Gu Immortal."

He continued: "The dark path dao marks belong to the vanishing shadow leopard, while the red marks belong to its killer—though whether that killer is man or beast remains uncertain. # Chapter 720: Picking them up one by one, a windfall of a great fortune

Walking back, Fang Yuan hummed: "Summing up the clues, I largely know their identities already."

"One is a mysterious rank six star path Gu Immortal who hasn't acted yet. This way, provided all went well, Fang Yuan's mission with Lang Ya land spirit would be completed.

"A star demon bat! A pity the wings are damaged, but I can repair and transplant them." Fang Yuan secured the corpse.

After collecting nearly ten desolate beast corpses, the two hurried toward the eighth star hall.

"This is the ancient desolate beast, astral wind flying heavenly boar!"

Exchanging glances and transmitting messages, Fang Yuan and Hei Lou Lan were visibly moved!

# Chapter 721: Walking Meat Tree

The two looked up towards the sky at the same time.

High in the air, the eighth star hall trembled slightly as loud explosions and beastly growls echoed from within.

A heavily injured desolate beast flame tiger roared, spitting a fireball from its mouth.

As the fireball flew toward a massive tree, the flame tiger lunged right behind it with slashing claws.

The tree's branches were peculiar, resembling soft, thick octopus tentacles.

Flung back a hundred paces, the flame tiger crashed and reverted to Immortal Monkey King Shi Lei.

Spitting out three teeth, Shi Lei looked excited and crazed: "What a great walking meat tree, as expected of legend, this ancient desolate plant is truly incredible."

Star Lord Wan Xiang transmitted helplessly: "Lord Shi Lei, stop playing around and unleash your earth path strength."

Shi Lei did not hesitate: "Alright, having killed an astral wind flying heavenly boar with transformation path, I am satisfied. Next, I will use my true earth path cultivation to destroy this walking meat tree."

Yet Shi Lei sat down to heal: "Hold on while I purge the fire path dao marks from my body."

Star Lord Wan Xiang could only swallow his anger and fly forward to face the walking meat tree.

With a loud crash, Star Lord Wan Xiang was overpowered and sent flying, smashing through a thick pillar and hurtling right out of the star hall.

"Useless!" Shi Lei opened his eyes, golden pupils surging with battle intent as he roared and charged the walking meat tree.

Star Lord Wan Xiang tumbled far outside the star hall before stabilizing himself.

"Fang Yuan, your lingering Gu worms successfully deceived the enemy!" Hei Lou Lan said excitedly.

"It is only a hologram. Let's claim this prize first!" Fang Yuan crept toward the astral wind flying heavenly boar's corpse.

Under Fang Yuan's control, the Gu worms swarmed around the astral wind flying heavenly boar's body as he nodded to Hei Lou Lan.

Guided by these Gu worms, the astral wind flying heavenly boar corpse was swiftly stowed into Hei Lou Lan's immortal aperture.

Light and shadow formed a realistic decoy of the astral wind flying heavenly boar.

As he watched, a broken tree flew out from the star hall.

"This is a walking meat tree!" Fang Yuan and Hei Lou Lan stared with bright eyes.

# Chapter 722: Zombie Dragon

The walking meat tree was a legendary plant recorded in The Legends of Ren Zu.

The Legends of Ren Zu Chapter Three, Section Sixteen states:

Ultimately, Desolate Ancient Moon sensed life's mysteries and sacrificed herself, turning into a damaged life gem.

Northern Dark Ice Soul carried the life gem, attempting to return and revive his father, Ren Zu.

Walking aimlessly, Northern Dark Ice Soul unknowingly left the ground and wandered deep into black heaven.

Unable to discern direction, he tripped and fell repeatedly until he suddenly spotted a lump of fire ahead.

Drawing close to the fire, he realized it was a Gu.

Fire Gu said: "I can help you, but you must help me first. I am starving to death—go find me some food."

Fire Gu continued: "I am the least picky Gu worm in the world and will eat whatever you feed me."

Northern Dark Ice Soul searched around, finding some tree branches and throwing them towards fire Gu.

After eating, fire Gu shone brighter, gave off warmer light, and grew from the size of a fist to a basin.

Northern Dark Ice Soul proposed: "Fire Gu, follow me and light the way. I will feed you whatever you wish along the journey, alright?"

Fire Gu agreed and condensed into a small lump, letting Northern Dark Ice Soul hold it.

Northern Dark Ice Soul thus began his return journey, feeding various things to fire Gu along the way.

Suddenly, countless footsteps echoed. Northern Dark Ice Soul looked up to see a massive group of trees running toward him under the firelight.

The pursuers shouted: "Whoever is in front, stop running."

"We do not want to harm you, we just want to escape into the light."

"Dream realms are upon us! Please help us live under the fire's light!"

Panting heavily and nearly caught, Northern Dark Ice Soul could run no further. Fire Gu said: "Human, do not fear! These pursuers are my food—just toss me at them."

These were walking meat trees, their fleshy branches resembling octopus tentacles.

Fire Gu incinerated the trees, turning their trunks to ash and branches to cooked meat. Attracted by the fragrant aroma, Northern Dark Ice Soul ate one, exclaiming it was delicious.

Hei Lou Lan stared wide-eyed at the broken trunk and tentacle-like branches, asking in disbelief: "This is a walking meat tree?"

"Absolutely." Fang Yuan nodded: "Since black heaven still exists, walking meat trees can still be found. Seven Star Child was a rank eight Gu Immortal capable of exploring black heaven; he likely obtained this walking meat tree during his explorations."

"It possesses at least rank seven battle strength and is a rare strength path plant," Hei Lou Lan said eagerly.

Just as the two prepared to sneak over and claim the walking meat tree, a thunderous explosion rocked the sky.

The eighth star hall shook violently and fractured as vast amounts of starlight dispersed, leaving it half-ruined.

A huge dragon flew out of the star hall.

Hundreds of meters long, the eerie dragon bore silver horns, rock-like scales, eight claws, and coiling pale zombie energy.

"Is this... a zombie dragon?" Hei Lou Lan exposed the identity of this dragon.

"With eight claws, it was a rank eight immemorial desolate beast in life. As a zombie dragon, it holds peak rank seven strength," Fang Yuan analyzed.

The dragon opened its maw, spewing a stream of pale white zombie fire.

Wary, Shi Lei refused to take the attack head-on. He veered left, dodging the zombie fire only for a massive dragon tail to sweep into view.

Before the eyes of Fang Yuan, Hei Lou Lan, and Star Lord Wan Xiang, the zombie dragon turned gracefully mid-air, slamming its massive tail directly into the evading Shi Lei.

Shi Lei crashed deep into the mountainside. The entire mountain trembled as falling boulders quickly buried him completely.

Soon, Shi Lei roared from beneath the rubble: "Worm, you have truly angered me! Taste my immortal killer move—Shocking Rock Break!"

The sky split open as a small hill hurtled toward the zombie dragon.

With a loud bang, the zombie dragon rammed its head into the hill.

Fang Yuan's pupils shrank: "This zombie dragon is extraordinary; defensive Immortal Gu must have been applied to its body."

"What do we do now?" Hei Lou Lan frowned. "Under their watchful eyes, we cannot possibly seize the walking meat tree."

# Chapter 723: Shocking Appearance of Star Constellation Immortal Venerable

"In life, this was an azure dragon; now as a zombie dragon, its speed is amplified by Immortal Gu," Hei Lou Lan observed.

"Seven Star Child possessed the wind path Wind Sprint Immortal Gu. Rumors say Seven Star Child developed a killer move applying an Immortal Gu's effects to another target long-term; judging by this, the rumors were true," Fang Yuan added.

Hei Lou Lan's expression turned grave: "Shi Lei's battle strength far exceeds my estimates! Facing that zombie dragon's onslaught, I would be killed within moments. Even you, Fang Yuan, could only hold out slightly longer without Myriad Self—there would be no hope of victory."

Hei Lou Lan agreed: "Risking discovery accomplishes nothing; let us withdraw."

Fang Yuan's eyes glinted as he voiced Hei Lou Lan's unspoken thought: "Unlike us, they lack Fixed Immortal Travel, even if they possess other space path Gu. If they used a loophole, we can ambush or plot against them for immense profit!"

Her overwhelming rank nine aura proved she was genuine!

Central Continent, Spirit Affinity House, Bai Qing blessed land.

After a prolonged coma caused by Dream Wings Immortal Gu, Feng Jin Huang awakened.

"I am fine, Mother! I have discovered the true use of Dream Wings Immortal Gu—it allows me to enter dream realms!" Feng Jin Huang said.

# Chapter 724: Pitiful Dreamer, Precarious Situation in Dream

"Yes," Feng Jin Huang affirmed. "Using Dream Wings Immortal Gu, I traversed a dream realm. Finally, I met an eccentric old man named Kong Jue who constantly muttered to himself and terrifyingly killed and dissected corpses. He tried to block me, forcing me to dodge and flee for a long time. Otherwise, I would have awakened much earlier."

That Kong Jue is likely Old Immortal Kong Jue, one of history's Three Olds alongside Old Eccentric Tian Nan and Long Hair Ancestor. Central Continent, Starry Sky grotto-heaven.

"Star Constellation Immortal Venerable!" Facing her, Fang Yuan and Hei Lou Lan stood dazed with shock.

"I must escape, or all my rebirth plans and path to eternal life end here! True solid bat wings, detonate!"

Instantly, the scene shifted—Star Constellation and the eighth star hall vanished, replaced by a blue-robed Gu Immortal looking up at a clear moon above the clouds.

He muttered: "Heaven has pitied me! I, Seven Star Child, have unified the seven star spaces into Starry Sky grotto-heaven. Another hurdle passed—I am one step closer to rank nine! Hahaha!"

"A dream within a dream! Having escaped Star Constellation's dream, I am now trapped in Seven Star Child's!"

But this time, Fang Yuan had no bat wings left to detonate.

# Chapter 725: Seven Star Child Awakens

"Not good! Dream realms embody a person's emotions. Feeling joy from Seven Star Child's laughter means the dream's emotions are infecting me!" Inside the dream realm, Fang Yuan knew his situation was dire.

Not yet deeply entrapped, Fang Yuan knew severe pain was the most effective way to break free.

Feeling his fists clench, Fang Yuan's red eyes gleamed with joy: "There is hope! Though rank eight, Seven Star Child falls far short of Star Constellation. Her dream paralyzed me completely, But in Seven Star Child's dream, I have not lost all of my movement ability yet."

Struggling, he slowly opened his fingers to conjure a lump of starlight in his palm.

"Hidden dream realms cannot be attacked normally, but this surfaced dream realm interacts with the outside world—meaning external forces can disrupt and destroy it!"

Exerting all his strength with trembling fingers, Fang Yuan slowly launched the icy drill stardust from his palm.

"Hahaha, I fused the seven stars into one! Hahaha... guh!" Seven Star Child's laughter choked off as his turning body shattered like a mirror.

Regaining his mobility, Fang Yuan immediately retreated before the dream realm could recover and trap him again.

Along with Seven Star Child's body, the clouds and moon shattered, causing the entire dream realm to vanish in an instant.

"How is this possible? My weak icy drill stardust should have only temporarily shattered his image... Wait, could it be?!"

As if in response, a sharp roar echoed through the eighth star hall, sending out powerful shockwaves: "Who? Who disturbed my slumber!"

Soon, an immortal zombie resembling an ordinary human stepped forth in fury, locking his gaze onto Star Lord Wan Xiang, Hei Lou Lan, and Fang Yuan.

"Seven Star Child didn't die, but became an immortal zombie! No wonder the heavenly spirit didn't appear. Hei Lou Lan, I can only help you this much." Gritting his teeth, Fang Yuan fired icy drill stardust at Hei Lou Lan before leaving.

"Worms, you court death!" Seven Star Child first went to Star Lord Wan Xiang.

With a loud boom that blasted a hole in the eighth star hall, he nearly shattered Star Lord Wan Xiang's chest, sending his body plummeting like a shooting star into the forest.

Struck by the icy drill stardust, Hei Lou Lan narrowly awoke from Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's dream realm under intense cold and pain.

Seven Star Child immortal zombie snickered sinisterly. Closing to fifty or sixty paces from Hei Lou Lan, he thrust out his left arm.

Instantly, a massive starlight pillar silently shot from Seven Star Child immortal zombie's hand.

As star billow pillar was a straight-line attack, Hei Lou Lan narrowly dodged its path and rapidly retreated.

Reaching Fang Yuan's side, Hei Lou Lan could hardly believe she had survived and escaped!

Fang Yuan grabbed her arm and ran deeper into the forest: "Quickly go! Seven Star Child immortal zombie was trapped in that dream realm too long—his condition is abnormal, his thoughts sparse, and his cognition too slow to think normally."

Hei Lou Lan suddenly stopped. Seeing the icy drill stardust marks on herself, she angrily shouted: "Fang Yuan! You actually attacked me?"

"Shut up! I was saving you. Without that icy drill stardust, could you have escaped Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's dream realm? If you hadn't reacted in time, Seven Star Child immortal zombie's killer move would have killed you!" Fang Yuan replied displeased, without looking back.

Pausing briefly, Hei Lou Lan followed Fang Yuan: "I will remember this lifesaving favor and compensate you handsomely! But what was that dream realm? We have Fixed Immortal Travel."

Running along, they looked up to see Seven Star Child immortal zombie fly out of the eighth star hall, his attention fixed on the rolling rock battlefield in the air.

After brief consideration, Seven Star Child immortal zombie extended his left arm, unleashing another star billow pillar.

# Chapter 726: Retreat

Next, a massive hand of grand starlight formed and slammed forcefully against the rolling rock battlefield.

After two immortal killer moves, the rolling rock battlefield cracked open, revealing the interior through a wide rift, though it still held together.

Exhaling a misty breath, Hei Lou Lan felt mostly relieved: "Good, Seven Star Child immortal zombie is fighting Shi Lei—the best possible situation. Fang Yuan, why are you still running?!"

"Saving someone," Fang Yuan replied curtly.

Rounding a mountain wall onto a cliff, Fang Yuan pointed: "Him."

Reaching Star Lord Wan Xiang, they saw a gaping hole in his chest. Completely pierced through, nearly his entire chest was gone, held together only by flesh at the sides.

"This is the power of Seven Star Child immortal zombie's stomp." Fang Yuan crouched, his eight arms searching Star Lord Wan Xiang's body in turn.

Fang Yuan soon sighed inwardly in disappointment: "His physical injuries could be healed at great cost, but his soul was sucked into the dream realm. Unless Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's dream is broken, this Gu Immortal's soul can only wander inside it or transform into another dream realm."

"What a pity," Fang Yuan muttered, hands still working. "Alive, he could have provided vital intelligence. We could even have enslaved him with your Immortal Gu to do our bidding. We could even have plotted against Shi Lei to kill him risk-free and without suspicion, reaping maximum benefits!"

"If you have time for that, help me seal his immortal aperture." Fang Yuan's words drew all of Hei Lou Lan's attention.

"He died leaving behind his obsession, so the blessed land now has a land spirit." Fang Yuan's eight arms worked continuously, planting various Gu worms into Star Lord Wan Xiang's corpse.

Frowning in deep concentration, Fang Yuan said: "Sealing a blessed land is troublesome, and I lack Gu worms. Watch the battle above while communicating with treasure yellow heaven to buy these Gu worms. Remember, not a single one can be missing!"

Guarding Fang Yuan, she connected to treasure yellow heaven through her immortal aperture and used the moving perspective cup Gu he lent her to seek Fairy Li Shan's help.

Unable to endure the pressure, the rolling rock battlefield finally shattered.

Shi Lei, who broke it, was also in poor shape. Covered in wounds, a deep slash on his chest stretched from shoulder to waist, exposing bone.

"Intruder, die," Seven Star Child immortal zombie shouted, pointing expressionlessly at Shi Lei.

Both killer moves activated swiftly with immense power. Starlight erupted from Seven Star Child immortal zombie's fingertip, instantly tearing through space to pierce Shi Lei's chest.

Earth path, transformation path — dual immortal killer move — Rock Mountain Immortal Monkey King Transformation!

A burst of golden light repelled Seven Star Child, revealing a sixteen-meter-tall giant monkey.

The massive Immortal Monkey King faced off against the starry-cloaked immortal zombie; the two remained at a standstill, neither attacking yet.

Watching with a trembling heart, Hei Lou Lan knew their clash would be devastating. She urged Fang Yuan: "Quick, the situation is worsening."

"I know, but without Immortal Gu, this seal lasts only seven minutes before the immortal aperture must land and take root." Dizzied from the intense exertion, Fang Yuan finally halted his eight arms' complex movements.

Immortal Monkey King shifted his golden pupils, eyeing Fang Yuan and Hei Lou Lan with his peripheral vision.

Fang Yuan's pupils shrunk: "He found us. Quick, hide the corpse!"

Solemn-faced, Hei Lou Lan grabbed Star Lord Wan Xiang by the leg and tossed him into her immortal aperture.

Seven Star Child immortal zombie howled toward the sky.

Desolate beasts emerged from the pillars: diamond bear, flying sword rat, star desolate hound, golden pangolin...

Having regained his intellect, Seven Star Child immortal zombie used the grotto-heaven's advantage, unleashing desolate beasts from the seven spaces to establish overwhelming dominance!

Seeing this, Fang Yuan immediately activated Fixed Immortal Travel.

Hei Lou Lan entered Fang Yuan's immortal aperture, and within a few breaths, both vanished.

"Fixed Immortal Travel, immortal zombie... Fang Yuan!" These thoughts flashed through Immortal Monkey King's mind before Seven Star Child charged him again. Bold as he was, Shi Lei was not stupid enough to keep fighting.

Flying down to the walking meat tree, he stored its two segments into his immortal aperture.

Enduring Seven Star Child immortal zombie's attacks, he flew to the astral wind flying heavenly boar corpse and reached out, only to grab empty air!

"What?!" Shocked, Shi Lei noticed the broken mortal Gu on his arm and instantly flew into a rage—it had to be Fang Yuan!

The next moment, a star billow pillar struck Immortal Monkey King directly on the back, slamming him to the ground.

# Chapter 727: Escape

Growling angrily, he spat out dirt and scrambled to his feet.

Striding forward and uprooting trees in his path, he looked toward the star demon bat corpse and rejoiced to see it still intact.

Shi Lei shouted in fury: "Damn it, what method is this to look so real?! Right, there is still the flying bear!"

Nearing the flying bear corpse, Shi Lei found only five living flying bears surrounding the bloody ground.

Shi Lei's hope was completely dashed as rage overwhelmed him: "Every desolate beast I killed was stolen by that despicable thief Fang Yuan! Those were my spoils, the fruits of my victory! How long has it been since anyone dared steal from me, the Immortal Monkey King?!"

Though Star Lord Wan Xiang's death cost Shi Lei his exit from Starry Sky grotto-heaven, he knew the loophole's location; reaching it, he could blast a larger opening connecting to Central Continent.

Shi Lei veered away, only to find five flying bears charging ahead, three blazing divine stallions closing in on the left, a giant ghost face tortoise to the right, and seven star desolate hounds behind him.

The mountain-sized ghost face tortoise on his right was the least agile, offering the best route to break through.

Resolved, Shi Lei took a huge stride and charged toward the ghost face tortoise.

At last, Shi Lei reached the grotto-heaven's loophole opening.

Laughing heartily, he strode forward to force his way out.

Glancing around, Shi Lei saw five flying bears closing in from five directions.

"What is going on?" Looking up, he saw six enormous star shadows looming in the sky.

Seven Star Child immortal zombie laughed coldly: "Little monkey, did you think my seven star space was so simple? I should thank you—without you awakening me, I'd still be stuck in that dream realm. In return, I will bury your corpse beneath my favorite mountain peak."

Seven Star Child had fully regained his senses and could think normally again!

"This is bad." Shi Lei's heart sank.

"Scram!" Shi Lei was about to erupt when flickering starlight weighed him down and slowed his movements—Seven Star Child immortal zombie had attacked.

"I have no choice but to seek help from the sect! To think that I, the grand Immortal Monkey King, am forced to use seek help Gu! Where will my reputation go after this? Fang Yuan, this is all your fault—once saved, I will make you pay!!" Shi Lei raged internally, nearly vomiting blood in fury.

Immortal Monkey King raised his head, shouting at Seven Star Child immortal zombie: "Fight me for three hundred more rounds if you have the guts!"

The golden monkey growled as dazzling golden light erupted, forcing Seven Star Child immortal zombie to squint.

As the golden light faded, Shi Lei reverted to human form and sped into the forest.

"You dare trick me? I took you for a champion who would battle to the death! Run, go ahead—let's see where you can escape in my grotto-heaven!" Seven Star Child immortal zombie raged after a stunned moment.

# Chapter 728: Star Form Blessed Land

"We're here." Looking around, Fang Yuan nodded in satisfaction.

"Where is this?" Hei Lou Lan came out of Fang Yuan's immortal aperture.

"This place is Earth Abyss." Fang Yuan lightly replied.

"Earth Abyss?" Hei Lou Lan looked at Fang Yuan in astonishment.

Hei Lou Lan nodded, then pivoted: "But Ancient Soul Sect's headquarters is in Earth Abyss. As one of the ten great ancient sects, that colossus has dominated the far west for millennia. They claim Earth Abyss as their exclusive domain. Placing the blessed land here is like planting flowers in someone else's backyard—aren't you afraid of being found?"

Fang Yuan laughed: "Don't worry. Earth Abyss's depths are utterly secluded. Over thousands of years, Ancient Soul Sect has fully explored only eighteen layers, briefly reaching the twenty-seventh. From the twenty-eighth to thirty-sixth layers, their Gu Immortals only roam occasionally. As long as we place the blessed land below the fortieth layer, even a massive commotion won't be discovered."

In the thirty-fifth layer, an Ancient Soul Sect rank six Gu Immortal was being wretchedly pursued by an ancient desolate beast and four desolate beasts.

Guided by previous-life memories, Fang Yuan led the way to the key location.

After setting up six Gu formations, Fang Yuan pointed downward: "My attack power lacks punch; use your Immortal Gu to strike this muddy ground."

Following his directions, Hei Lou Lan morphed into a strength path phantom giant and pounded the muddy ground three times.

Under the continuous bombardment, the crater deepened thousands of feet until it broke through completely into an opening.

By the time they reached the fortieth layer, the seal on Star Lord Wan Xiang hit its time limit.

"Your estimate was spot on." Setting Star Lord Wan Xiang's corpse down, Hei Lou Lan gave Fang Yuan a deep look.

At Fang Yuan's thought, hundreds of mortal Gu buzzed out of Star Lord Wan Xiang's corpse like locusts and flew into his immortal aperture.

Freed from suppression, Star Lord Wan Xiang's body gradually radiated bright starlight.

The starlight absorbed surrounding earth qi and formed a hovering door inscribed with four words: Star Form Blessed Land.

Hei Lou Lan exhaled turbid air: "We finally succeeded; our luck held. Despite the huge commotion, the local wild beasts didn't attack."

"Let's go." Fang Yuan led the way, opening the starry entrance.

Hei Lou Lan followed closely behind. The two entered Star Form blessed land.

Like late night, the sky inside was pitch-black and studded with stars.

Star Form blessed land resembled a giant basin: elevated ground rose in the center, while continuous mountain ranges encircled the perimeter like a circular wall.

"So much star fragment grass!" Fang Yuan looked at the ground, which was covered entirely in star fragment grass.

"If not for Song Zi Xing severely injuring my body and soul, how could my grand main body, Star Lord Wan Xiang, perish in the eighth star hall?" A boy suddenly appeared before Fang Yuan and Hei Lou Lan.

# Chapter 729: Splitting Loot

"Star Lord Wan Xiang? It's him..." Hearing the land spirit introduce himself, Fang Yuan showed a flash of comprehension.

"Land spirit, do you remember me?" Fang Yuan smiled lightly. "I previously bought star fragment grass and the killer move spring star rain from your main body."

Star Form Child's gaze flickered. Reassessing Fang Yuan, his expression softened: "So it is you, I have some impression."

"A land spirit alone cannot manage the entire blessed land. Would you like to seek refuge with one of us?" Fang Yuan asked directly.

Star Form Child nodded his small head sadly: "To protect this foundation, I need help. But I have conditions."

Star Form Child frowned and pouted, saying angrily: "My main body died in the eighth star hall because of Song Zi Xing. He severely injured my main body, forcing me to expose my secret and explore the grotto-heaven with Immortal Monkey King Shi Lei. To become this blessed land's owner, bring me Song Zi Xing's head!"

"Song Zi Xing's head?" Hearing this condition, Hei Lou Lan laughed bitterly.

Song Zi Xing was a notorious rank seven demonic expert with formidable blood path methods, comparable in strength to Shi Lei.

"Alright, I will give it a try," Fang Yuan agreed calmly.

"Hurry and do your best! Star Form blessed land's earthly calamity is imminent. If it fails, the blessed land will be destroyed, making your efforts futile," Star Form Child urged.

Fang Yuan's eyes flashed: "In that case, I can help you resist the earthly calamity first."

Star Form Child shook his head like a rattle: "I won't let outside Gu Immortals stay in Star Form blessed land over seven minutes. People are unpredictable; only my master may help me pass tribulations. Soon, I will use treasure yellow heaven to spread this news and rally others against that accursed Song Zi Xing!"

Star Form Child laughed: "Don't worry, I won't expose our location. Only those meeting my condition may enter Star Form blessed land. Leave now, and keep this location secret."

With the land spirit seeing them off, Fang Yuan did not linger. Bidding farewell, he and Hei Lou Lan exited the blessed land back into Earth Abyss.

The moment they stepped into Earth Abyss, the door behind them vanished completely.

Silently erasing their traces, Fang Yuan and Hei Lou Lan used Fixed Immortal Travel to return to Hu Immortal blessed land.

Now safe, they immediately began splitting the loot.

"Our journey into Starry Sky grotto-heaven was safe and vastly profitable. Had I known, I wouldn't have agreed to a forty-sixty split," Hei Lou Lan sighed, retrieving the loot from her immortal aperture.

"Why so many desolate beast corpses? This boar looks ancient. Eh, this lion isn't dead yet!" Little Hu Immortal was immediately drawn to the beasts.

A blazing divine stallion, flying bear, star demon bat, chestnut yak—seven desolate beast corpses in total, plus a near-dead yellow jade lion.

"Seven desolate beast corpses are worth about two hundred and eighty immortal essence stones, the dying yellow jade lion around eighty, and the astral wind flying heavenly boar corpse four hundred. The diamond soil is worth about thirty immortal essence stones, and excluding the mysterious trees for now, our total profit is seven hundred and ninety immortal essence stones."

Facing nearly eight hundred immortal essence stones, even Fang Yuan sighed inwardly.

He had never experienced this before; across the five hundred years of his previous life, his peak savings had been merely sixty-odd immortal essence stones.

"We made such huge profits without fighting or expending immortal essence; we merely picked them up for free," Fang Yuan said calmly.

"That monkey is probably fuming. Will he attack Hu Immortal blessed land?" Hei Lou Lan asked, worried by the massive sum.

"No," Fang Yuan shook his head. "A rank seven Gu Immortal like Shi Lei possesses at least several thousand immortal essence stones!"

Fang Yuan analyzed: "Central Continent's ten great ancient sects have long histories compared to other regions' super forces. They value order, stability, and reputation. Shi Lei will seek revenge through righteous suppression rather than force, since we are now part of Immortal Crane Sect."

"How will we split Star Form blessed land?" Hei Lou Lan asked seriously, unwilling to yield such massive profit.

Fang Yuan pondered, then said: "Since it is hard to divide, let us compete fairly. Whoever fulfills the land spirit's condition first claims Star Form blessed land without compensating the other. If anyone else, even Fairy Li Shan or Tai Bai Yun Sheng, tries to contest it, we unite to stop them. What do you think?"

Hei Lou Lan nodded with flickering eyes: "That works best!"

# Chapter 730: Giving You Qingpu Tea

Central Continent, Bai Qing blessed land.

Reclining against a tall tree on the grassy ground, Feng Jin Huang inhaled deeply, savoring the breeze and fragrant grass.

Holding the exquisite book The Legends of Ren Zu, Feng Jin Huang had already reached its final pages.

At the book's end, Ren Zu's ten children had died one after another, and Ren Zu himself neared death from old age. Before dying, Ren Zu gathered his children's corpses and sacrificed himself, feeding them all to derivation Gu.

Drawn by the aroma, vast dream realms entered derivation Gu's mouth alongside them.

Derivation Gu's stomach burst, shining life's light across the lands to create the first mortals.

"Because dream realms were involved in derivation, mortals dreamed in their sleep. Like Northern Dark Ice Soul, humans often sink too deeply into dreams to escape." Feng Jin Huang closed The Legends of Ren Zu and stood up.

"Mother, send me back to the building. I am tired." She said softly.

"Okay," Fairy Bai Qing's gentle voice echoed beside her.

Feng Jin Huang vanished, reappearing in her room inside the building.

In the room, Fairy Bai Qing was already waiting.

Feng Jin Huang beamed: "Mother, why are you free today? Don't you need to assimilate earth qi?"

Fairy Bai Qing looked dotingly at her daughter: "Huang Er, this dream realm trained your mentality well. In the past, you would have complained and demanded my company. Yet this time, while I assimilated earth qi for three days and nights, you quietly read and refined Gu. You have matured greatly; mother is very pleased."

"Of course!" Feng Jin Huang smiled proudly, the bells on her phoenix coronet chiming. "I am my parents' daughter—how could I tarnish your reputations!"

Fairy Bai Qing smiled back: "Since mortals first appeared, nearly everyone has dreamed. Over the ages, countless geniuses and even Venerables have left behind dream realms. Together, these form an unprecedentedly vast hidden realm. Huang Er, your Dream Wings Immortal Gu lets you traverse dream realms freely without being influenced! This is a huge opportunity you must utilize well."

"I understand, mother. Lately, I discovered my refinement path attainment reached quasi-master level. Despite never practicing refinement path before, the dream realm's benefits are simply immense. My attainment rose so sharply after that dream realm that I've surpassed many in the sect," Feng Jin Huang sighed.

"You navigated Old Immortal Kong Jue's dream and absorbed some of his refinement path true meaning. Because he was a supreme grandmaster, you gained immensely. Dream realms are complex, and you might not be so fortunate next time to find someone of his caliber," Fairy Bai Qing analyzed.

Fairy Bai Qing turned solemn: "Huang Er, do not lower your guard. You emerged safe this time only because the dream realm happened to be harmless. If you ever enter a Venerable's dream, retreat immediately; their power exceeds all imagination."

Softening her expression, Fairy Bai Qing produced a letter Gu: "Your father breached the regional wall and found shelter in Northern Plains. He has not learned of your awakening yet. We can reply through this letter Gu to relieve his worries during his Northern Plains mission."

Fairy Bai Qing then produced another letter sending green bird Gu, a rank five mortal Gu.

"Here is another letter for you from Fang Yuan, sent long ago," Fairy Bai Qing said.

"Fang Yuan!" Feng Jin Huang gritted her teeth, her sharp brows knitting as her face flushed with indignation.

She snatched the letter Gu and checked it.

In the letter, Fang Yuan praised Spirit Affinity House, accepted Feng Jin Huang's challenge, and apologized for the delayed reply.

At the end, he wrote: I await Fairy Feng Jin Huang in Hu Immortal blessed land. I have heard that Spirit Affinity House's qingpu tea is renowned. If you spar with me, savoring this famous tea would be truly enjoyable.

"Hmph! He wants to enjoy qingpu tea? Evil scoundrel! Lecherous thief! I'll tear you to pieces and feed your bones to dogs!" Feng Jin Huang's eyes blazed, squeezing the letter sending green bird Gu until it chirped in distress.

Fairy Bai Qing swiftly rescued the Gu: "Huang Er, Fang Yuan has exceeded our expectations again. He is not who he was—if you spar now, you cannot win."

"What?" Feng Jin Huang stared at Fairy Bai Qing in shock.

Fairy Bai Qing explained that Fang Yuan was now an immortal zombie whose mysterious backers repelled Immortal Crane Sect's assault.

"An immortal zombie? He became an immortal zombie?" Feng Jin Huang muttered, finding it unbelievable had her mother not said so.

Fairy Bai Qing spoke solemnly: "Fang Yuan sent this right before Immortal Crane Sect attacked, intending to establish ties with Spirit Affinity House to introduce a third party. Holding Dang Hun Mountain and trading with the ten ancient sects, his name is known to almost every Gu Immortal in Central Continent."

"Will you ignore or reply to this letter? I'll let you decide," Fairy Bai Qing tested her.

Feng Jin Huang said immediately: "Of course we will reply! Since this challenge was set by me, and he has already responded. If I avoid battle because he is an immortal zombie, then I would be showing weakness."

"However..." Her eyes shifted. "He is strong while I am weak, so head-on confrontation is foolish. Soon, the Central Continent Refinement Path Convention begins. I'll defeat him publicly in refinement path! That will soothe my anger. Mother, what do you think?"

Fairy Bai Qing nodded in satisfaction: "This is a good idea."

Drafting her reply, Feng Jin Huang chuckled coldly: "You want qingpu tea? I'll send fifty jars! But any competition needs a wager—I will make you lose both reputation and substance!"

# Chapter 731: Four to You, Six to Me

Northern Plains, Lang Ya blessed land.

"Land spirit, I brought a living desolate beast; come look," Fang Yuan said, opening his immortal aperture and activating a dozen Gu to set the lion on the ground.

Pleased with the yellow jade lion, Lang Ya land spirit promptly handed Fang Yuan eighty-eight immortal essence stones along with the killer move unfamiliar face.

Fang Yuan examined the details before Lang Ya land spirit.

This killer move had extraordinary origins, created by Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable.

"As expected of Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's ingenious creativity," Fang Yuan praised. "Only three hundred Gu worms are used, yet they span six paths including transformation, strength, and wisdom. Hmm.., several Gu are rare. Collecting them to assemble this killer move will take time. Lang Ya, do you have them?"

Lang Ya land spirit shook his head with a chuckle: "Why keep them? I can't use it. Unfamiliar face, vaguely familiar face, and familiar face form a trilogy. Yours is merely the mortal killer move, disguising you only as a stranger. The latter two are immortal killer moves that prevent exposure even when impersonating acquaintances. Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable left an inheritance behind; perhaps you might obtain the other two killer moves in your lifetime."

He recalled obtaining clues in Northern Plains regarding Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's Luo Po Valley inheritance.

Clearing his mind, Fang Yuan handed over three completed Immortal Gu recipes: "Here is our current transaction."

Inspecting the recipes and finding no issues, Lang Ya land spirit praised: "Rascal, I rarely admire anyone, but your deduction talent truly impresses me."

"Land spirit, I wanted to discuss changing the terms of our Immortal Gu recipe transactions," Fang Yuan said.

"I've completed all your recipes with high completion rates. The remainder have only sixty to seventy percent, or even under fifty percent. I suggest that we change the details of our transaction..."

Fang Yuan laughed confidently: "My suggestion is this: from now on, you take charge of deducing the Immortal Gu recipes. Whenever you get stuck, I will help you deduce the next step over that hurdle, charging only two immortal essence stones each time."

Fang Yuan laughed: "Land spirit, this transaction benefits you too. Having gained so many Immortal Gu recipes and regained your freedom, you can refine Immortal Gu again. When refining Immortal Gu, the vast majority of attempts fail with an abysmal success rate, expending immense resources. I am helping you save immortal essence stones—shouldn't you thank me?"

"Hmph, I knew you would say that." Lang Ya land spirit rolled his eyes. "I can agree, but on one condition."

"It is a long story. Do you know about Qin Bai Sheng's auction?" Unable to leave the blessed land, Lang Ya land spirit was nonetheless well-informed about Northern Plains affairs.

"Of course I know." Fang Yuan nodded.

Lang Ya land spirit continued: "You know a mysterious force attacked my Lang Ya blessed land some time ago. They failed, and I captured several Gu Immortals. I intend to sell them all—or rather, sell their blessed lands."

"Selling blessed lands?" Fang Yuan looked at Lang Ya land spirit in shock; this was a massive move.

Fang Yuan's expression turned solemn: "That would be a thousand times more popular than my guts Gu business! Buying these blessed lands allows Gu Immortals to swallow them, raising their cultivation and skipping tribulations and calamities. Why didn't you keep them for yourself?"

Lang Ya land spirit shook his head: "To swallow a rank six blessed land requires master attainment in that path; a rank seven requires grandmaster, and a rank eight grotto-heaven demands great grandmaster. Although my refinement path attainment is high, I am not involved in many other paths. And the most important reason is, I do not want to devour them. My Lang Ya blessed land has already reached the limits of a blessed land, any progress would elevate it to a grotto-heaven. A grotto-heaven's tribulations are far more dangerous. Back then, I purposely weakened Lang Ya grotto-heaven until it became a blessed land, why would I raise it up again?"

Fang Yuan understood: "That is true. Wait, your condition is for me to sell these blessed lands at the auction in your stead?"

Lang Ya land spirit gave a thumbs-up, flattering him: "You are a smart lad!"

Fang Yuan stared with wide eyes: "Do you want to get me killed? Absolutely not! Selling these blessed lands will make me everyone's target! It attracts too much attention—how could I have the ability to capture all these Gu Immortals? If I appear like this, that mysterious force would know and associate me with Lang Ya blessed land. Next time when they attack you, they might even attack my blessed land! Isn't the Inkman King Mo Tan Sang your good friend, ask him to go."

"Don't make it sound so terrible. Don't you have the killer move unfamiliar face? With it, other Gu Immortals cannot identify your true form," Lang Ya land spirit said in a low tone.

Fang Yuan appraised the land spirit: "I wondered why you were so generous in giving me this precious killer move. You had a plan from the start."

Unable to take it anymore, Lang Ya land spirit glared furiously and shouted: "Rascal, do you think I don't know you?! You have ridiculous guts—since when have you been scared? You even destroyed Imperial Court blessed land and toppled Eighty-Eight True Yang Building, as long as the benefits are high enough, you are a desperado! Afraid of this matter? Just tell me, how much do you want?"

Fang Yuan snorted coldly: "We will split the profits from selling the blessed lands—at least a four to six ratio."

"Four to six ratio? You are too greedy, demanding forty percent?!" Lang Ya land spirit screamed.

Cold light flashed in Fang Yuan's grim eyes: "You are wrong, land spirit. My intention is: I take sixty percent, you take forty!"

He took a deep breath, staring at Fang Yuan: "You actually have the nerve to say that?"

"Why wouldn't I?" Fang Yuan's face was thick as a city wall. "I am taking a huge life-threatening risk; without enough profit, I will not do it. This is already my lowest friendly price as old friends."

"No deal then? Think it over. There is still time before the auction—I am leaving first." Fang Yuan opened a stargate.

"Get lost!"

# Chapter 732: Top Tier Mortal Killer Move

Hu Immortal blessed land, Dang Hun palace.

Fang Yuan sat cross-legged on a cushion, intently studying a pair of bat wings before him.

A pair of large bat wings hovered before him, covered in thin, pinkie-sized eerie blue scales that refracted light like starlight.

After returning from Lang Ya blessed land, Fang Yuan began repairing the star demon bat wings. After nine days and nights of effort, he reached the crucial moment.

The mortal Gu turned into a drop of jade-green liquid, shooting into the bat wings and casting a layer of green light.

Standing outside the door, Fang Yuan lightly stamped his foot, calling: "Land spirit."

"Master, master, you called for me!" Little Hu Immortal immediately appeared beside Fang Yuan, eyes shining with joy at seeing her master.

"How is the business in treasure yellow heaven going?" Fang Yuan asked as he walked.

Little Hu Immortal followed closely, replying: "Master put the desolate beast corpses up for sale in treasure yellow heaven, but only one has sold so far."

However, Fang Yuan did not want immortal essence stones this time.

He left a will informing other Gu Immortals that buying these beast corpses required exchanging specific goods.

First was a method or clues for immortal zombies to turn back into humans.

Second was the recipe, the Gu worm itself, or clues regarding white lotus giant silkworm Gu.

Third was the wings of bat desolate beasts.

Fourth was top-tier mortal killer moves—the more outstanding, the better.

Fifth was bone path Gu worms like Battle Bone Wheel that could form the killer move White Bone Chariot.

Last was wisdom path inheritances or related clues.

With such strict conditions, only one corpse sold after twelve days in Hu Immortal blessed land.

"Oh? What did that beast corpse exchange for?" Fang Yuan asked excitedly.

"One whole chestnut yak was exchanged for a pair of bat desolate beast wings and an investigative killer move called hundred li eye." Little Hu Immortal replied.

"Hundred li eye..." Fang Yuan nodded. "This mortal killer move is valued at six immortal essence stones, allowing a Gu Immortal to observe scenery within a hundred li as clearly as palm lines. Good, I was lacking this kind of investigative killer move. But of course, the greatest satisfaction in this transaction is that I obtained another pair of desolate beast bat wings."

Yet Fang Yuan dared not slacken. Ever since seeing the external manifestation of a dream realm in Starry Sky grotto-heaven, he felt urgency, sensing the waves of a new era approaching.

Over the next few days, Fang Yuan began processing the newly obtained bat wings.

Fang Yuan entered the secret room and stood before the green-haired bat wings.

By now, the green hair on the bat wings had grown extremely thick and lush.

"Success or failure will be decided now." Fang Yuan activated a mortal Gu, snapping a spark flying outward.

The spark reached the wings and ignited the hair in a flash of green fire.

The fire appeared quickly and disappeared just as quickly.

The green hair burned away, revealing charred black bat wings covered in thick ash.

Fang Yuan showed a trace of disappointment: "Failure."

He softly exhaled; when the weak breath touched the bat wings, they collapsed to the ground like charcoal and shattered.

"Fortunately, I have another pair of bat wings." Quickly overcoming his disappointment, Fang Yuan was soon busy refining.

# Chapter 733: Recognizing one's own ordinariness

With previous refinement experience, Fang Yuan found this second attempt at refining desolate beast bat wings much easier.

After half a month, he transplanted the desolate beast bat wings onto his back, choosing to retain their sensation of pain.

That day, Fang Yuan tested his killer moves atop Dang Hun Mountain.

Hundred li eye.

Activating hundred li eye, his red pupils enlarged, bringing grassland and debris within a hundred li before him in extreme clarity.

At four hundred li, his line of sight reached its limit, blurred into mere colors and shadows.

"Hundred li eye is the base for thousand li eye, which is an immortal killer move requiring corresponding Immortal Gu." Fang Yuan nodded in satisfaction; valued at six immortal essence stones, this killer move had an outstanding effect.

Lion fur armor.

He willed and activated the defensive killer move.

Bronze armor encased his body with a lion-headed helmet, while thick plates shielded his wings to boost defense.

But the speed, however, became slower.

"Lion fur armor and true solid bat wings cannot perfectly complement each other. Activating lion fur armor reduces the wings' speed, but without it, my defense is lacking," Fang Yuan frowned.

Balancing three paths' dao marks in lion fur armor pushed the limit of his transformation path master attainment.

Transformation path grandmaster attainment would make it possible, but reaching grandmaster required decades or even centuries of deep accumulation.

"If I want my battle strength to improve drastically, relying solely on advancing step by step would be very long and inefficient. In my previous life, I spent over two hundred years to comprehend a dozen mortal killer moves and create hundreds of new blood path Gu. I must learn from this lesson."

"In this world, countless heroes and geniuses shine throughout history. To stand out and move forward bravely, one must draw upon predecessors' inheritances and accumulations, absorbing their essence. All rivers flow into the sea; only by gathering diverse specialties together can one rise above the rest and achieve supreme feats."

Fang Yuan flew about, his gaze flickering as he sighed deeply.

There was a record in The Legends of Ren Zu —

Ren Zu set out on the road of life, surrounded by pure darkness and walking through filthy mud.

Ren Zu asked self Gu: "Where is this?"

Self Gu replied: "This is the ordinary marsh in the lowest level of ordinary abyss."

"How is that possible? I have not passed Luo Po valley or charged through Reverse Flow River," Ren Zu said incredulously.

Self Gu said: "Human, you speak of the path fate Gu traveled. The path you walk is completely new, created by yourself. Where it leads is decided by your own intent. Like I said before, as long as you want to walk, there will be a road for you to step on."

Self Gu said: "Humans are born ordinary. Though the spirit of all living beings, they lack tiger claws, cannot absorb nutrients from the earth like plants, and cannot transform like clouds and rain. You came to the ordinary marsh, what's strange about it? It is not only you, look at the mud under your feet carefully, you will see traces of many other footprints."

Ren Zu lowered his head to look closely; just as self Gu said, ordinary marsh was filled with marks: beast claw prints, plant root imprints, and traces of flowing water and rolling stones.

Self Gu laughed loudly: "If you think being ordinary is an abyss, it is an abyss; if you think it is heaven, it shall be heaven. Since you refuse to stay, then use your two legs to walk out of ordinary marsh step by step and become extraordinary!"

Ren Zu took the first step.

It was not easy to walk in the marsh, one step was deep, another was shallow. The path which looked almost uniform had some parts that were rather solid, while some were very loose.

After taking several steps, Ren Zu's eyes brightened as he thought of a trick.

He purposely stepped on spots with claw marks, as ground capable of holding prints was far more solid.

Thus, Ren Zu walked smoothly, almost running compared to his previous pace.

He exclaimed with emotion: "In ordinary marsh, walking in the footsteps of predecessors is much faster than finding the way on your own!"

After testing true solid bat wings and lion fur armor, Fang Yuan descended onto a slope.

Unfamiliar face.

Fang Yuan activated this newly obtained mortal killer move.

Under unfamiliar face, his wings retracted, eight arms became two, fangs shortened, and scarlet eyes lightened.

Finally, Fang Yuan's six-meter-tall body shrank back to normal human height, his appearance drastically changed.

Only his immortal zombie body remained impossible to disguise.

Even so, Fang Yuan praised: "Wonderful! A mere mortal killer move capable of altering my immortal body to this degree—truly worthy of Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable."

Crucially, this was no illusion, but a real physical transformation that even subtly altered his aura.

"Master, your appearance became much better looking. Ah, this letter just arrived." Little Hu Immortal appeared, handing Fang Yuan a letter Gu.

"Letter sending green bird Gu... Spirit Affinity House finally responded?" Fang Yuan's gaze flashed as he took the letter Gu and sent in his consciousness.

Retracting his consciousness, he pondered: "Feng Jin Huang actually wants me to participate in the Refinement Path Convention to compete in refinement path? I remember she had no interest in refinement path in her early years, and her foundation is practically a blank sheet. Why is she so confident in competing with me in Gu refinement? Could she have already discovered the true use of dream wings Immortal Gu?"

Fang Yuan's heart sank.

"Dream Wings, dream path..." Fang Yuan's eyes clouded as he recalled details of his previous life.

In his previous life, he had attacked Hu Immortal blessed land precisely to kill Feng Jin Huang and seize dream wings Immortal Gu!

# Chapter 734: Two Great Events

"To think dream realms had already appeared over four hundred years before my previous life ended." Holding the letter sending green bird Gu, Fang Yuan sighed.

People soon discovered that despite their extreme, perilous nature, dream realms offered immense benefits: exploring them yielded ancient foundations, rapidly elevating cultivation realms.

The legendary rank eight wisdom path Gu Immortal Yi Yan's 'Prophecy of Three Venerables' resurfaced once again.

He predicted that after three great eras, three venerables would appear—two men and one woman: Spectral Soul Demon Venerable, Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable, and Great Dream Immortal Venerable, who would resolve the space escape Gu problem.

This gave rise to a prevailing theory: dream realms were the key to becoming Great Dream Immortal Venerable. Whoever controlled them could harness ancient accumulations to transcend all sages and become a venerable above venerables!

"In my previous life, I rose to become a regional lord not only through my blood path encounter, but also due to the chaotic five regions war. Unfortunately, once I gained control in the real world, the great forces had already carved up dream realms. Even exploring with mortal dream path Gu, I lagged behind as a beginner. Unless I had a dream path Immortal Gu, that was the only way to catch up."

Precisely because of this, Fang Yuan gathered Song Zhong and other demonic path Gu Immortals to attack Hu Immortal blessed land, killing Feng Jin Huang. Unfortunately, he did not get her dream wings Immortal Gu.

"It turns out dream realms surfaced over four hundred years earlier. Super forces had interacted with them long ago, so when dream realms manifested extensively in three centuries, they could immediately expand their influence. They were prepared long in advance; I did not lose from lack of ability."

"Seven Star Child's matter happened originally, but Feng Jin Huang understood dream wings Immortal Gu's true use far earlier than in my previous life. Was this caused by me snatching Hu Immortal blessed land?" Fang Yuan thought.

"Once Feng Jin Huang learned its true effect, Spirit Affinity House would be alerted, subsequently affecting the other nine ancient sects and all of Central Continent. No wall can block every wind; thus, I've drastically accelerated the world's discovery of dream realms."

After pondering briefly, Fang Yuan wiped the letter sending green bird Gu with primeval essence and inscribed his reply with his thoughts.

He agreed to Feng Jin Huang's challenge to compete during the Refinement Path Convention.

"Feng Jin Huang has dream wings Immortal Gu and confidence, but my refinement path attainment has advanced from master to quasi-grandmaster. Why fear this junior?"

Deducing Immortal Gu recipes for Lang Ya land spirit had recently enabled his refinement path breakthrough.

"The Refinement Path Convention involves the Infallible inheritance. Even without her challenge, I would participate for a share of rewards. However, joining requires me to prepare my own refinement materials."

Securing a good rank required vast materials worth at least five hundred immortal essence stones.

"Besides this, I must attend the grand auction Qin Bai Sheng and Fairy Li Shan are organizing." Latest intelligence indicated it featured an Immortal Gu exchange.

This Northern Plains auction would likely be the only large-scale Immortal Gu exchange for the next two centuries; Fang Yuan naturally had to seize it.

"Both the auction and Convention require vast immortal essence stones. With only two hundred on hand, I can barely join either. I must rely on Lang Ya land spirit's plan of selling Gu Immortal blessed lands."

# Chapter 735: Finally Obtaining a Wisdom Path Inheritance

Even with guts Gu sales, too little time had passed for Fang Yuan to accumulate enough immortal essence stones.

# Chapter 736: What a Huge Transaction

Replacing delight in water and mountain Immortal Gu with malicious thought Gu would require an enormous quantity.

Fang Yuan estimated he needed at least two thousand malicious thought Gu activated simultaneously to barely suffice under the light of wisdom.

Most importantly, these two thousand malicious thought Gu must be rank five.

Fang Yuan held the recipes for ranks one through five, which differed only in thought output per activation and primeval essence consumption.

The source of this confidence was none other than Wisdom Gu.

Wisdom's light provided endless inspiration, allowing him to force deductions even with lacking attainment.

During this period, he sold two more desolate beast corpses in treasure yellow heaven.

He exchanged them for a second pair of bat desolate beast wings and dozens of immortal essence stones.

Fortunately, Fang Yuan's plan of improving malicious thought Gu's recipe succeeded.

Now, rank five malicious thought Gu required only two steps: refining a half-finished version, then completing it.

Northern Plains, Bai Zu grotto-heaven.

Qin Bai Sheng, a rank seven Gu Immortal rivaling Shi Lei in battle strength, lost interest upon seeing only a bottom-tier rank six immortal zombie.

When Fang Yuan proposed selling Gu Immortal blessed lands, both Qin Bai Sheng and Fairy Li Shan paled.

Qin Bai Sheng calmed down, deducing that Fang Yuan was the subordinate of some hidden great expert.

Qin Bai Sheng reevaluated Fang Yuan, his smiling tone shifting subtly: "This is indeed a huge transaction. Since Brother thinks so highly of this auction, how could I refuse?"

Fang Yuan directly cupped his fists with a smile: "Brother Qin."

# Chapter 737: Joining Zombie Alliance

Qin Bai Sheng was quite the character.

Matching Immortal Monkey King Shi Lei in battle strength, he bore no arrogance; conversing with Fang Yuan, he remained calm, amicable, and magnanimous, laughing heartily.

Fang Yuan had naturally appeared disguised with the mortal killer move unfamiliar face.

Using the alias Sha Huang, Fang Yuan condensed his eight arms and shrank to an ordinary, slightly short build.

Beside them, Fairy Li Shan watched them converse, smiling with narrowed eyes.

Seeing their growing enthusiasm, Fairy Li Shan chuckled: "You two talk like long-lost brothers reunited at last, leaving me ignored in the corner."

"I am ashamed." Fang Yuan quickly said.

Qin Bai Sheng's eyes brightened: "Well said, Fairy! Brother Sha and I hit it off like old friends—why not become sworn brothers? With Fairy's mountain pledge Gu, as long as I eat meat, little brother won't starve!"

Fang Yuan gasped, feigning the look of a tempted youngster: "I am not worthy, I am not worthy."

"What is brother saying? There is no such thing as worthiness—this is fate! Unless... beneath the surface, you look down on a cultivator without a force?" Qin Bai Sheng's eyes gleamed as he fixed Fang Yuan with a half-smile.

Thoughts flashing through his mind, Fang Yuan smiled bitterly: "Truthfully, I hit it off with Brother Qin, but as a minor figure, I cannot decide this—unlike Brother Qin and Fairy Li Shan, I am not free. The matter of becoming sworn brothers, it is not that I do not want to, but I cannot."

"So that is the case. Brother has his difficulties, and I can even help." Qin Bai Sheng patted his chest, continuing to probe Fang Yuan's background as he spoke.

Fang Yuan cupped his fists in thanks, then turned to Fairy Li Shan: "Fairy, I also came on a task to borrow your mountain pledge Gu."

"This..." Fairy Li Shan looked at Qin Bai Sheng, hesitating: "Sha Huang, we are going to invite Prince Feng Xian to the auction. Our time is tight, and as he is our last stop, I am unsure if delaying might anger him."

Qin Bai Sheng countered: "Prince Feng Xian is a righteous model—how could he be so petty? Since flying there takes time, lending it to Brother Sha Huang is no problem."

"It is fine, I am in no rush." Fang Yuan cupped his fists: "Fairy and Brother Qin should go first; we can part here."

"Why not come with us, Brother Sha Huang? Meeting Prince Feng Xian is a rare opportunity," Qin Bai Sheng invited.

How could Fang Yuan dare approach a rank eight Gu Immortal, especially one possessing an investigative Immortal Gu of at least rank seven?

Fang Yuan declined the invitation; as their figures vanished into the sky, his expression turned cold.

He had finally learned how troublesome Qin Bai Sheng was.

Compared to the brutish Shi Lei, this man possessed an exquisite mind, yet could project outward magnanimity and passion as if speaking from the bottom of his heart.

"As a lone cultivator, he built an alliance network influencing all of Northern Plains' Gu Immortals—his methods and skill are truly remarkable. Unfortunately, his luck in my past life was poor; he clashed with Blood Hunter upon that monster's emergence from seclusion and succumbed to his methods," Fang Yuan recalled, flying toward another direction.

"The ripples of my rebirth grow larger; this auction never occurred in my past life. Hopefully, joining Northern Plains Zombie Alliance will proceed smoothly."

# Chapter 738: Old Earth Wood, Immortal Zombie Gu Ye

Ku Mu Mountain resembled a giant dead tree extending into the clouds rather than an actual mountain.

To join Northern Plains Zombie Alliance, Fang Yuan needed a recommendation from Gu Ye, a wood path immortal zombie.

Arriving at the old earth wood tree, Fang Yuan called out: "Is Old Earth City Lord present? I am Sha Huang, here on a visit."

Tall, skinny, and yellowish, he resembled the old earth wood, his skin etched with markings of a dead wood immortal zombie body.

Seeing Fang Yuan, Gu Ye froze, his anger fading into hesitation: "Sir is?"

"I am Sha Huang, recently forced into becoming an immortal zombie. Wishing to join Northern Plains Zombie Alliance, I hope Old Earth City Lord might recommend me?" Fang Yuan cupped his fists, stating his intent directly.

"Oh, a newcomer seeking to join Zombie Alliance. Pleasure to meet you." Gu Ye smiled and returned the greeting: "I thought it was... never mind. We are in the same boat, please come in."

"The city is dead and empty. Brother Sha's title of City Lord is quite hollow now," Gu Ye laughed bitterly. "Truthfully, if this place didn't produce the wood path resource wilted essence, who would care about it?"

Gu Ye sighed deeply: "Had I known how barren it was, I never would have taken this Zombie Alliance mission. Fortunately, my assignment is nearly over, and I can finally leave this painful place. Brother, learn from my pathetic state: when you enter Zombie Alliance, never choose the mission to guard old earth wood."

Fang Yuan had already deduced Gu Ye was injured and naturally directed his gaze to the man's face.

Gu Ye's face was swollen, one cheek bulging like a pink peach while the other was caved in and cracked, giving his head the strange shape of a deformed melon.

Gu Ye began to speak when a loud crash shook the tree violently, sending wilted leaves flying as rotting branches crashed down.

A shout came from outside: "Gu Ye, come out! This Divine Lord is here to do business with you!"

Gu Ye's face darkened, eyes blazing with fury as he gritted his teeth: "Divine Lord Tian Du again!"

Clenching his fists and taking deep breaths, Gu Ye forced a smile at Fang Yuan: "Brother Sha, take a seat first. I will be back shortly."

"No worry, I will go with you." Fang Yuan said.

Touched, Gu Ye cupped his fists gratefully: "Then I thank Brother in advance."

The two walked out of the old earth wood tree, seeing the two rank six Gu Immortals in the sky.

Seeing Fang Yuan, Divine Lord Tian Du paused before laughing: "To think Gu Ye found a helper! Too bad you found an immortal zombie."

Divine Lord Tian Du waved dismissively: "I won't waste words with you. I know you have wilted essence—my friend has an immortal essence stone and will buy a hundred and fifty kilograms of wilted essence from you."

Meanwhile, Divine Lord Tian Du and Shi Hou were eyeing Fang Yuan. Tian Du had extorted Gu Ye repeatedly and knew his background, but knew nothing of Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan's gaze flickered with hesitant weakness as he asked Gu Ye: "Brother Gu, what is going on? Who are they? With such absurd demands, why isn't Zombie Alliance interfering?"

Seeing Fang Yuan's hesitation, Gu Ye lost hope and sighed: "Zombie Alliance can intervene, but I cannot afford it. It was better when the leader was around, but now... you will understand once you join, Brother."

"Is that so..." Fang Yuan's face showed a mix of shock, disappointment, and dread for the future.

Helpless, Gu Ye complied, selling one hundred and fifty kilograms of wilted essence for a single immortal essence stone.

# Chapter 739: Dark Flow Giant City

Fang Yuan watched Divine Lord Tian Du and Shi Hou vanish into the horizon, then turned his gaze back to Gu Ye with slightly flickering eyes.

In a trembling, hesitant voice, he asked: "Brother Gu... may I ask... how many times has this happened?"

Suppressing his grief, Gu Ye patted Fang Yuan's shoulder comfortingly: "Not often. With Qin Bai Sheng's auction approaching, shameless scoundrels are scraping together capital by any means necessary for such a grand event."

He shook the stone: "Divine Lord Tian Du and Shi Hou might be strong, but they still fear Zombie Alliance behind us and had to give us face in this way."

Patting Fang Yuan's shoulder again, Gu Ye said: "Brother Sha, you know an immortal zombie's hardships. Our blessed lands are dead—incapable of operation or producing immortal essence. A thick beam of green light soared skyward from the withered yellow branches and leaves.

Pitch-black and colossal, Dark Flow Giant City sprawled across the ground like a giant beast.

"This mountain-sized city is our Northern Plains Zombie Alliance headquarters. It is divided into seven floors; the lower five are bustling residential quarters for mortal Gu Masters. The sixth floor houses immortal zombies and their associates, while the top floor holds the conference hall where three rank seven immortal zombies are stationed year-round," Gu Ye explained.

The two walked without encountering anyone until they reached a grand hall.
