When the city lord departed Northern Plains, three deputy city lords took charge; he is one of them, capable of commanding immortal zombies in battle."

"Yin Liu Gong..." Fang Yuan silently engraved this name to his mind.

"Come, push the door," Gu Ye stepped aside. "Opening this large door proves your qualification to join Zombie Alliance."

Instantly, over twenty sharp, gloomy, and dull gazes pierced through the crack toward Fang Yuan.

Gu Ye laughed and patted Fang Yuan's shoulder: "Pushing open this door proves you are a person of Northern Plains. Come in—your timing is exquisite, as our alliance meeting is held today!"

# Chapter 740: Nine Heavens Fragment

Three rank seven Gu Immortals from Combat Immortal Sect gathered in this sky.

"According to Immortal Monkey King's distress call, this should be the place," Qian Zhu Xian said, looking around.

"The entrance has closed. To confirm the location, we need Divine Mother's help," said Valley Lord Ming He.

Moments later, she opened her eyes and exhaled misty air: "Indeed, Starry Sky grotto-heaven is located here."

"Seven Star Child quietly achieved such cultivation and even absorbed a blue heaven fragment, allowing Starry Sky grotto-heaven to endure until now. Remarkable," Qian Zhu Xian sighed.

"Absorbing a nine heavens fragment brings tremendous benefits: mysterious abilities, limitless heavenly power in the immortal aperture, and vastly weakened or eliminated tribulations. If I could obtain such a fragment world, I'd wake up laughing in my sleep," Valley Lord Ming He said with envy.

"Dream on, Ming He. Reach rank eight first—only a rank eight Gu Immortal's grotto-heaven can absorb a nine heavens fragment world," Qian Zhu Xian laughed.

Blessed lands brought fortune, but heaven and earth maintained balance through periodic calamities and tribulations.

Rank six Gu Immortals faced an earthly calamity every ten years and a heavenly tribulation every hundred. Thus, heavenly tribulations served as the benchmark for cultivation; in his previous life, Fang Yuan had passed two heavenly tribulations.

Surviving three heavenly tribulations advanced a rank six Gu Immortal's blessed land, elevating them to rank seven.

Rank seven Gu Immortals face an earthly calamity every ten years, a heavenly tribulation every fifty years, and a grand tribulation every one hundred years. Qian Zhu Xian and Valley Lord Ming He were one grand tribulation Gu Immortals, while Divine Mother Jue Kong was a level higher than them, being at two grand tribulations cultivation level.

As for rank eight Gu Immortals, they no longer experienced any earthly calamities, but they faced a heavenly tribulation every ten years, a grand tribulation every fifty years, and a myriad tribulation every one hundred years.

Far more terrifying than heavenly tribulations, myriad tribulations were dubbed 'hopeless myriad tribulations' among Gu Immortals due to their extreme difficulty.

Thus, nine heavens fragments were much more precious.

The immemorial nine heavens belonged to the main world. Calamities and tribulations struck only immortal aperture worlds like blessed lands and grotto-heavens, never the five regions or nine heavens.

By devouring a nine heavens fragment, a grotto-heaven essentially became part of the main world, greatly weakening tribulations and surviving even if the Gu Immortal died. Starry Sky grotto-heaven, for instance, remained intact despite Seven Star Child turning into an immortal zombie.

"The benefits of absorbing a nine heavens fragment are immense, but so is the drawback: absorbing even a sliver takes in the greater world's aura. Once rooted into it, the grotto-heaven can never be retrieved into your body again," Divine Mother Jue Kong reminded them.

Qian Zhu Xian nodded: "The Gu Immortal loses their freedom, confined to their aperture, yet if a nine heavens fragment appeared before me, I would take it without hesitation!"

"Indeed," Valley Lord Ming He agreed. "Tribulations are so grueling that even becoming an immortal zombie seems tempting at times—at least dead lands face no tribulations."

"Our task comes first. Having stalled for days, I'm sure Monkey King has learned his lesson," Divine Mother Jue Kong said, slowly closing her eyes.

"Open." Her eyes snapped open, her piercing gaze boring a hole into the void before her.

Yet the next moment, all three Gu Immortals reappeared in the sky.

Solemnity replacing her relaxed demeanor, Divine Mother Jue Kong muttered: "Inside is outside, space is inverting... is this the mystical ability Starry Sky grotto-heaven gained from absorbing the blue heaven fragment?"

Meanwhile, in Northern Plains' Zombie Alliance branch, inside Dark Flow Giant City.

Fang Yuan pushed open the door under the scrutiny of over twenty gazes.

Feigning fear and hesitation, he stepped into the discussion hall.

He paid his respects, shouting: "I am Sha Huang, greetings to my fellow brethren."

"Fellow brethren... well said. We members of Zombie Alliance share the same situation and should help each other," an immortal zombie on the discussion hall's main seat smiled and said.

Yin Liu Gong sat at the center, flanked by the ruthless Dragon Commander Ye Cha and the aged, hunched Huang Quan Weng.

"Sha Huang... is this your real name?" Dragon Commander Ye Cha asked, his steely words bursting with intense killing intent, as if on a terrifying battlefield.

"Of course not." Fang Yuan laughed bitterly: "Sha Huang is the name I gave myself the day after becoming an immortal zombie, signifying a new start to temporarily forget past glory. I swore to heaven that only upon regaining my real body and shedding this zombie status would I use my former name again."

"Since Sha Huang opened the door, he is a Northern Plains Gu Immortal. Zombie Alliance grows stronger with another member. He has proven himself—after all, even Yao Huang failed to push open this door. Guh, guh guh..." Huang Quan Weng coughed, showing his aged, frail state.

# Chapter 741: Immortal Zombie Discussion

Yin Liu Gong nodded: "Huang Quan Weng is right. Take a seat, both of you—you're just in time. Also, credit Gu Ye with three hundred contribution points for recommending a new member according to the rules."

He pulled Fang Yuan's arm: "Come, brother Sha, sit beside me."

"We do not always attend in person; if busy, we send a will instead. Brother Sha, do you have wisdom path Gu? If not, I will give you one," Gu Ye whispered.

Seeing them seated, Yin Liu Gong coughed: "Alright, let us begin the meeting with the important affairs."

"The flame furnace has erupted, as everyone knows. This troublesome matter must be suppressed as soon as possible; the longer it drags on, the harder it will be to deal with. Our initial assessment awards one thousand Zombie Alliance contribution points to whoever successfully suppresses the flame furnace," Yin Liu Gong announced.

Yin Liu Gong announced: "A yaksha octopus has appeared in Earth Trench, wreaking havoc and severely disrupting our black oil extraction. Doctor Yin Xuan and Landlord Lei Yu were recently injured by this ancient desolate beast. Driving it away awards one thousand contribution points, while killing it grants two thousand."

Fang Yuan heard this and his heart jumped.

The treasure he sought lay deep within Earth Trench, guarded by a group of yaksha octopuses.

This treasure was his primary reason for joining Northern Plains Zombie Alliance.

Seeing no response, Yin Liu Gong turned to Dragon Commander Ye Cha: "Dragon Commander, this yaksha octopus aligns with your business—why not take this task?"

Dragon Commander Ye Cha shook his head in refusal: "Frankly, I received Qin Bai Sheng's invitation and plan to attend the auction. Several items there are things I've sought for years. At this crucial juncture, I cannot take the risk. However, I will add an extra six hundred contribution points to this mission."

Seeing the reward increased, Yin Liu Gong felt inward relief: "Next is the final mission, involving the Red Fiend Divine Boat."

"Red Fiend Divine Boat?" Fang Yuan's eyes shone as he recalled the colossal flying boat that charged freely across battlefields during the five regions chaotic war.

Gu Ye softly explained: "As a newcomer, it's normal not to know. The Red Fiend Divine Boat is a famously powerful Immortal Gu House in history. Our leader paid a steep price to purchase about half of this recipe."

"We encountered problems," Yin Liu Gong said in a low voice. "The Gu Immortal selling the Divine Boat's recipe broke the agreement and refused further dealings. He wants to auction the recipes for the Divine Boat and its core Immortal Gu for a higher price. How should Zombie Alliance handle this?"

# Chapter 742: Earth Trench Black Oil

Yin Liu Gong gestured to the table: "Next, let us discuss other matters."

"You may now put forward your own requests," Yin Liu Gong said.

Fang Yuan spoke up, asking for a revival method to shed his immortal zombie status.

"Brother Sha, without taking the oath, receiving an alliance token, or having contribution points, how can you post a mission?" Gu Ye reminded him.

"So that's it." Fang Yuan frowned.

"Don't worry, after the meeting I will take you to get your identity token, which records all your alliance contributions. Besides, every immortal zombie shares your desire—no need to purchase it separately. Look at the top missions," Gu Ye pointed at the shifting projection.

Fang Yuan looked over and saw several missions pinned at the top of the board, one displayed in much larger font.

"Selling Zombie Alliance's generational research on shedding zombie status and regaining life," Fang Yuan read.

"Prices are listed, but even the smallest research finding requires twenty contribution points," Gu Ye explained familiarly.

Zombie Alliance catered shrewdly to its members' psychology. By dangling revival research as bait to keep them working, virtually no immortal zombie could resist.

"But thankfully, the inheritance in Earth Trench was left behind by a great expert immortal zombie. There are research findings inside for the rebirth of immortal zombies as well. In my previous life, because Northern Plains' immortal zombies obtained this, their battle strength surged rapidly. For a time, Northern Plains Zombie Alliance even isolated itself from other regions and surpassed the Eastern Sea main branch."

Fang Yuan had joined Northern Plains Zombie Alliance precisely to obtain that inheritance.

The most popular mission was venturing deep into Earth Trench to collect black oil.

Black oil slowed dead aperture disintegration for immortal zombies and was a widely sought Gu refinement material with a massive market.

Earth Trench's black oil was Zombie Alliance's core trade commodity, akin to Fang Yuan's guts Gu business.

When harvesting black oil from Earth Trench, immortal zombies kept whatever remained after meeting mission quotas. Consequently, this mission was widely recognized as one of the most lucrative.

Fang Yuan wanted to vie for it as well; entering Earth Trench through this task to secretly claim the inheritance would be ideal.

Without a token and pressed for time by the auction and Refinement Path Convention, competing for it now was unrealistic.

# Chapter 743: Harboring Malicious Heart

After the conference ended, Fang Yuan left a malicious will in the hall and followed Gu Ye to receive his Zombie Alliance token.

Fang Yuan focused on inquiring about the leader of Northern Plains Zombie Alliance.

The leader was Blazing Heaven Demoness, a tyrannical rank eight female immortal zombie renowned for extraordinary battle strength.

When Fang Yuan asked how, Gu Ye explained: "Before her lifespan ended, she deliberately became an immortal zombie just to achieve a breakthrough."

"Rumor in the alliance says the leader already possesses a revival method," Gu Ye whispered cautiously mid-conversation.

The rumor held weight; having chosen zombification of her own accord, she likely possessed a revival method.

Flying high and altering course until confirming no pursuers, he landed in an inconspicuous forest, set up mortal Gu, and activated Fixed Immortal Travel.

Jade green light flashed and he disappeared from the spot.

Back in Hu Immortal blessed land, Fang Yuan researched the wisdom path killer move Harboring Malicious Heart while awaiting news from Fairy Li Shan.

This non-offensive mortal killer move used wisdom path methods to transform a Gu Immortal's heart with wisdom path dao marks, turning it into a 'malicious heart'.

If successful, it could automatically generate abundant malicious wills from blood essence and greatly reduce their consumption during deduction.

But as a strength path immortal zombie without blood essence, Fang Yuan could not use it directly.

Though unusable directly, the move gave him inspiration—its mechanics shared several similarities with a killer move he had obtained previously.

That killer move was poison breath, obtained from Fairy Li Shan.

Poison breath emitted poison with every breath, while harboring malicious heart produced will with every heartbeat.

"I lack both poison and wisdom path foundations, but given their common ground, I might as well use wisdom Gu to experiment."

Northern Plains, Feng Xian grotto-heaven.

In the guest hall, rank eight Gu Immortal Prince Feng Xian sat upright as Fairy Li Shan and Qin Bai Sheng bowed to take their leave.

Prince Feng Xian shook his head: "It cannot be helped. I was balancing heaven and earth qi in my immortal aperture when the Immortal Gu forced me out. Managing my aperture is at a critical juncture, so I cannot attend personally. I will send a representative. You Lan, see them off."

At Prince Feng Xian's command, the aloof female Gu Immortal bowed to him, then said to Qin Bai Sheng and Fairy Li Shan: "Guests, please follow."

"We trouble Swordmaster You Lan," Qin Bai Sheng and Fairy Li Shan replied respectfully.

Fairy Li Shan exhaled: "We visited five rank eight powers, bound them with mountain pledge Gu, and secured their attendance. The auction is now guaranteed."

"It is all thanks to Fairy's mountain pledge Gu," Qin Bai Sheng smiled.

Saying this, he took out an Immortal Gu and handed it to Fairy Li Shan.

"As agreed, this is your remuneration," Qin Bai Sheng said with sincere gratitude.

# Chapter 744: Vaguely Familiar Face

"Then I shall not stand on ceremony." Fairy Li Shan laughed, receiving the Immortal Gu.

Storing the inspected Immortal Gu in her immortal aperture, she said: "With this settled, let us part and meet in half a month."

The auction was set for half a month later in Qin Bai Sheng's Bai Sheng blessed land, located in Crimson Reed Marsh.

While Fairy Li Shan used moving perspective cup Gu to contact Fang Yuan on her journey, another figure appeared in Feng Xian grotto-heaven's entrance hall.

The rank eight Gu Immortal asked: "Feng Jiu Ge, have you truly decided to attend this auction in my place?"

Dressed in a red-and-white robe, the rank seven Gu Immortal smiled and nodded: "That is indeed the case."

Prince Feng Xian frowned: "You became an immortal in Central Continent, the heaven and earth qi of your immortal aperture world come from Central Continent, it is different from Northern Plains. There are powerful experts going to the auction, even rank eight Gu Immortals will be present. Being discovered would be disastrous. Northern Plains' Gu Immortals are furious right now, hunting the culprit behind Imperial Court blessed land's collapse. Before dying, Dong Fang Chang Fan deduced the culprit was from another region. If your identity as a Central Continent Gu Immortal is exposed now, the consequences will be severe."

Feng Jiu Ge laughed brightly: "Prince, don't be anxious, look at my method."

With a flash of bright light, his appearance transformed.

Feng Jiu Ge transformed into an exact copy of Swordmaster You Lan, resembling her like a twin.

"What method is this?" Prince Feng Xian praised. "Not only is your appearance flawless, but your dao marks mimic sword path, and your aura matches a Northern Plains Gu Immortal."

"This is vaguely familiar face." Feng Jiu Ge said the answer.

"No wonder," Prince Feng Xian exclaimed in realization. "Only Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable could create something so mystical and breathtaking."

Feng Jiu Ge nodded: "Unfamiliar face, vaguely familiar face, and familiar face originated from Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable. The first is merely a mortal killer move. Vaguely familiar face is an immortal killer move powered by three Immortal Gu, including two of transformation path, making the deception almost impossible to detect."

This explained why Feng Jiu Ge chose Swordmaster You Lan—her taciturn nature required little acting skill to impersonate.

Prince Feng Xian nodded repeatedly: "Rank nine venerables are truly incredible geniuses. With this move, I need not worry about you being exposed."

Feng Jiu Ge laughed proudly: "Even if exposed, who could stop me from leaving?"

Feng Jiu Ge cupped his fists sincerely: "It pales beside Senior Brother and Junior Sisters ascending in Northern Plains and remaining hidden for centuries for Spirit Affinity House's mission. I hold deep admiration for you."

Prince Feng Xian's expression darkened: "A pity someone used our methods before I activated the plan, taking our fruits. If I find out who it is... hmph."

In truth, the great Prince Feng Xian, one of Northern Plains' few rank eight experts, was actually a spy from Spirit Affinity House!

The culprit, immortal zombie Fang Yuan, was already in Lang Ya blessed land.

After using mountain pledge Gu to make an agreement with Lang Ya land spirit, over ten coffins emerged from the cloud soil at the spirit's cry.

Opening a coffin revealed a sleeping Gu Immortal inside.

Each coffin held a captive Gu Immortal—thirteen coffins in all, thirteen Gu Immortals!

Though mentally prepared, Fang Yuan was still shocked upon seeing this number.

Lang Ya land spirit laughed smugly, loving to see Fang Yuan shocked: "Who do you think I am? These Gu Immortals courted death by attacking my blessed land. Selling them is their deserved punishment."

That a mysterious force behind the scenes could gather such power to repeatedly attack Lang Ya blessed land made Fang Yuan's heart shudder.

"The moment I sell them, I become a thorn in that mysterious force's side." Fang Yuan sighed, touching a coffin.

Yet before such enormous profits, Fang Yuan resolved to do it regardless of the mysterious force's strength.

Fang Yuan asked Lang Ya land spirit: "You interrogated them intensely with various methods, did you gain nothing from it?"

Lang Ya land spirit waved his hand: "None. These Gu Immortals gathered for various reasons. Three key figures contacted them, organized the attack, and supplied intelligence on Lang Ya blessed land. However, all three died in battle; despite controlling my attacks, I couldn't prevent their deaths. Strangely, their souls completely dissipated upon dying, leaving not even a fragment."

# Chapter 745: Incomplete Immortal Move

Before Fang Yuan left, Lang Ya land spirit instructed: "These killer moves are the key to unsealing the immortal killer move sleeping cloud coffin. Follow the exact order I gave you, or the coffins will be destroyed along with the Gu Immortals inside."

Fang Yuan brought the thirteen Gu Immortal captives back to Hu Immortal blessed land successfully.

He first summoned Hu Immortal land spirit and asked for the latest news.

After checking Hu Immortal blessed land's situation, Fang Yuan turned his attention to Immortal Crane Sect and Combat Immortal Sect.

Immortal Crane Sect was heavily suppressed in the reincarnation battlefield, forcing their Gu Immortal Lei Tan to recuperate.

I must make good use of my time; the advantages of my rebirth are shrinking rapidly."

Meanwhile, Fang Yuan planned to use the light of wisdom to pursue the inspiration that had struck him earlier.

Time passed quickly, two months went by in Hu Immortal blessed land's time.

Fang Yuan came out from the underground cave with a satisfied look.

His deductions under the light of wisdom yielded great results: he successfully merged poison breath and harboring malicious heart into a new, incomplete immortal move, which he named poison spit.

With Woman's Heart Immortal Gu as its core, it was deemed immortal, yet each activation caused severe toxic backlash, leaving it incomplete.

"With my immortal zombie body, I can use poison spit three times. Any more, and the residual toxicity could kill even my soul. Those two killer moves crystallized my wisdom and poison path attainments, providing a solid foundation. With limitless inspiration from the light of wisdom, I could build upon this foundation to create something new."

# Chapter 746: Joyful News, A Way To Escape The Zombie Body

A few days later, Tai Bai Yun Sheng returned to Hu Immortal blessed land.

Seeing the joy in Tai Bai Yun Sheng's eyes, Fang Yuan said: "Old Bai, it seems your journey to Eastern Sea was quite fruitful."

Fang Yuan remarked curiously: "Fairy Yu Lu was an attendant of Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable, cultivating earth and water paths with great skill in defense and healing. Knowing the group you went with, did you actually manage to conquer Yu Lu blessed land on your first attempt?"

Tai Bai Yun Sheng's expression stiffened as he sighed: "So junior brother foresaw our failure—and rightly so. We assaulted the blessed land for seven days and nights, only to be routed by the land spirit with heavy losses. One Gu Immortal nearly died, but I saved them with Man as Before Immortal Gu."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng continued: "Once Man as Before was exposed, I gained great attention and respect. Shark Demon enthusiastically invited me to visit Eastern Sea Zombie Alliance as a guest. Not daring to enter their headquarters alone, I declined. Instead, Shark Demon and two other immortal zombies hosted me in Hai Shi blessed land, where I learned an important piece of news."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng said solemnly: "It is a method to revive you, junior brother—a way to break free of your immortal zombie body!"

"What method is it?" Fang Yuan asked.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng explained: "Shark Demon's wife, Su Bai Man, is also an immortal zombie. Long ago, after defeating formidable foes, she acquired a time path Immortal Gu named Time Anchor. This Gu leaves a mark in the River of Time. Though useless alone, paired with other time path Immortal Gu, its effect is incredible."

Fang Yuan's eyes brightened, then quickly dimmed: "Old Bai, I understand. I've heard of Time Anchor before. Paired with Landscape as Before, it could indeed restore a mountain or river to a past state. Used with Man as Before, it could theoretically revert a target's body to an earlier point in time. But the prerequisite is that Time Anchor must leave a mark in advance."

"With Time Anchor's assistance, Man as Before can break free of its single-instant limit, but..." Fang Yuan shook his head, continuing: "Coordinating two Immortal Gu is never as simple as activating them together; many mortal Gu are required. But you do not have a corresponding immortal killer move, I think Shark Demon is providing you such hospitality because he wants you to help them, to contribute Man as Before so that they can research the immortal killer move, right?"

"Old Bai, my state as an immortal zombie has long been set in stone. Perhaps Shark Demon and the others used Time Anchor before becoming immortal zombies to mark the River of Time, but I never did. Thus, even if you research this killer move successfully, it is useless for me." Fang Yuan sighed.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng chuckled: "Your concern is valid, junior brother. But the good news is that neither Su Bai Man nor Shark Demon left a mark with Time Anchor beforehand."

"Back then, Su Bai Man repelled her enemies and obtained Time Anchor without knowing its usage. Heavily injured, she had no choice but to become an immortal zombie. Learning of this, Shark Demon chose to become an immortal zombie despite ample lifespan just to accompany his wife. Only years later did they discover Time Anchor's origin and usage."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng continued: "When they discovered its usage, they were full of regret, but it was already too late. I raised the same concern during the banquet, and Shark Demon mentioned an alternative method: Spring Autumn Cicada."

Without suspecting anything, Tai Bai Yun Sheng added: "Spring Autumn Cicada is unreliable, mentioned only as an example. Shark Demon meant that even if one missed the timing for Time Anchor, using an Immortal Gu like Spring Autumn Cicada could bring a Gu Immortal before the River of Time. One could then place a mark upstream with Time Anchor and successfully use Man as Before. I believe this method has a high chance of success."

"Besides Spring Autumn Cicada, other time path Immortal Gu like Looking Back and Vivid Recollection allow a Gu Immortal to stand in the present and observe the past, though with distinct differences. Refining the two together yields the rank eight Immortal Gu Extreme Past, allowing a Gu Immortal's will to traverse the River of Time and observe everything in the past."

Fang Yuan deduced inwardly: "If I had the time path investigative Immortal Gu Extreme Past, combining it with Time Anchor might allow me to create an immortal killer move that marks the past from the present. Then I could use Man as Before to revive into a living human without losing Wisdom Gu. Of course, Extreme Past is just an example; other time path Immortal Gu might be even more compatible with Time Anchor."

"Old Bai, thank you." He thanked Tai Bai Yun Sheng sincerely: "Although this method is innovative, it would demand tremendous time, effort, and resources—at least a hundred-year endeavor. But it is still a beacon of hope."

Understanding Fang Yuan's meaning, Tai Bai Yun Sheng sighed: "Indeed, it is hope at least. Though it will take time, you can use Zombie Alliance's black oil in the interim to slow your blessed land's destruction. While black oil is hard to obtain, my partnership with Shark Demon will secure enough."

Fang Yuan chuckled: "While you were gone, I already used the alias Sha Huang to join Northern Plains Zombie Alliance."

Fang Yuan continued: "Come with me to Northern Plains' auction. Here is Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's mortal killer move, Unfamiliar Face. I also have several cloud path killer moves for you to review, since you cultivate cloud path now as well."

Fang Yuan showed him the Gu Immortal captives and the deal he had with Lang Ya land spirit.

Shocked, Tai Bai Yun Sheng said with mixed worry and excitement: "This auction will be quite a spectacle! I'll accompany you; it would be best if Hei Lou Lan and Fairy Li Shan attend as well."

"They will definitely go. But even though our alliance was exposed to Hei Cheng, we cannot travel openly with them just yet," Fang Yuan said.

# Chapter 747: Auction (1)

# Chapter 750: Auction (4)

As time passed, arriving Gu Immortals dwindled until Qin Bai Sheng closed the blessed land's entrance.

Stepping onto the platform before the main hall, he announced concisely: "The time has arrived—the auction officially begins!"

"Strange, why haven't Fairy Li Shan and Hei Lou Lan arrived?" Tai Bai Yun Sheng transmitted to Fang Yuan.

"I am puzzled too. By her nature, Fairy Li Shan would sit in the main hall, yet there's no trace of her," Fang Yuan replied.

"The auction has three sections: the main hall, single rooms, and secret rooms. Had they chosen a secret room, they would have entered via secret pathways without appearing publicly. But even if Fairy Li Shan entered a secret room, she would not have done so without even greeting us. Have you noticed this, there are no Gu Immortals of Hei tribe present." Tai Bai Yun Sheng pointed it out.

Fang Yuan murmured: "Let's send an inquiry letter first. Bound by the Snowy Mountain Alliance, betrayal from Fairy Li Shan and Hei Lou Lan is unlikely. If they encountered an ambush from Hei Cheng and others, with the strength of those two, they should have been able to send a message to request for support."

As the two discussed secretly, the first auction item was displayed on stage.

"As you know, these sky chief clouds span over thirteen hundred square kilometers when spread. Such an amount is rare even in treasure yellow heaven! The starting bid is twenty immortal essence stones, with minimum increments of five. Please begin!" Qin Bai Sheng announced.

"Sky chief clouds are useful for my Tai Bai blessed land." Tai Bai Yun Sheng's interest was piqued, and he promptly placed a bid using the secret room's mortal Gu.

Qin Bai Sheng announced: "The eleventh secret room bids thirty immortal essence stones."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng chuckled, activating the mortal Gu to raise his bid by ten, to forty-five immortal essence stones.

"Forty-five immortal essence stones, going once," Qin Bai Sheng called, seeing no further bids.

"My blessed land already has abundant float ball tea, with its first harvest at month's end. Later, I plan to introduce jade hummingbirds. What do you think of my plan?" Tai Bai Yun Sheng chuckled, transmitting to Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan pondered and replied: "Sky flowers grow on clouds, and floating sparrowhawks host cloud path Gu worms. Old Bai, do you plan to dual cultivate time path and cloud path?"

Qin Bai Sheng called for the third time: "Forty-five immortal essence stones for thirteen hundred square kilometers of sky chief clouds, going thr—"

"Hold on, fifty-five immortal essence stones." Just before the hammer fell, another Gu Immortal bid.

Surprised by the sudden challenge, Tai Bai Yun Sheng hurriedly bid, "Sixty immortal essence stones."

This price finally deterred all competitors, securing the purchase for Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

"The second item is a group of rare black spirit antelopes: three hundred twenty thousand beasts with five beast emperors. Starting bid is ten immortal essence stones, with minimum increments of four. The price can be offset with vertical rainbow ointment," Qin Bai Sheng announced.

"The third item is the Medieval Antiquity Era Gu recipe set, Inch of Time, spanning rank one to five. Crucially, these recipes have been improved. All of the refinement materials can be found commonly. The lowest price is twenty-two immortal essence stones and you can also use the desolate beast, six headed snake's skin to reduce the price." Qin Bai Sheng announced.

Far more Gu Immortals joined the bidding this time.

Inch of time was a time path Gu worm unusable on humans but widely used in Gu refinement.

This drove explosive bidding from the starting twenty-two immortal essence stones up to forty-eight.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng bid: "Fifty-eight immortal essence stones."

He jumped the price by ten, aiming to deter competitors.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng's bid scared off most competitors, but a few persisted.

With two more bids, the price climbed to sixty-six immortal essence stones.

"Sixty-six immortal essence stones, going once," Qin Bai Sheng began closing the bids.

Fang Yuan transmitted to Tai Bai Yun Sheng: "Old Bai, shall we split the cost and bid together?"

Tai Bai Yun Sheng was glad: "Good, you want it too, junior brother."

He raised the bid to sixty-eight, and only one competitor added a single stone.

Ultimately, Fang Yuan and Tai Bai Yun Sheng bought Inch of Time for a steep seventy immortal essence stones.

Treasures continued to be auctioned off one after another.

Gradually, rank six Gu Immortal bidders became sparser.

Fang Yuan also had only a few hundred stones. He bid occasionally with little success, waiting patiently for the main event.

Finally, Qin Bai Sheng announced: "Next, we shall begin the auction of Immortal Gu."

"The most important part is here!" Fang Yuan's eyes brightened.

The earlier bidding had merely been a prelude; the true event had begun!

Immortal Gu trade!

# Chapter 751: Auction (5)

Qin Bai Sheng took out several mortal Gu and passed them around the hall.

Qin Bai Sheng explained: "The Immortal Gu auction is crucial. Gu auctioned first hold an advantage, as they can be traded for a wider variety. Thus, for fairness, this auction will not follow the listed order; these mortal Gu will point randomly to one of the Immortal Gu up for auction. As for which one, it is completely random, nobody can manipulate them, go ahead and inspect these mortal Gu."

After the Gu Immortals finished inspecting them, the mortal Gu were passed back to Qin Bai Sheng.

Qin Bai Sheng activated the mortal Gu publicly; they glowed brightly as rising smoke coalesced into the words 'conceal luck'.

"The first Immortal Gu selected is Conceal Luck!" Qin Bai Sheng announced.

"Conceal Luck was originally listed last, yet now it is first," Tai Bai Yun Sheng muttered after checking his east window Gu.

The stage's screen shifted to display Conceal Luck Immortal Gu.

Qin Bai Sheng introduced: "This palm-sized, white-skinned beetle is the rank six luck path Conceal Luck Immortal Gu, capable of hiding one's luck. The seller wants a metal path defensive Immortal Gu. Whoever has a metal path defensive Immortal Gu can bid for it. There is no lower limit for this."

"This rank six Conceal Luck can block rank six Luck Inspection. The effect is good, but its application is too narrow."

"Damn it..." In a single room, the female Gu Immortal owning conceal luck Immortal Gu bit her lip, helplessly watching it pass without a single bid.

The first Immortal Gu's failure to sell defied expectations. With a slightly darkened face, Qin Bai Sheng used his mortal Gu to start bidding for the second item.

The image changed, and showed a cicada-like Immortal Gu.

"This is heavenly gong Immortal Gu, a rank six sound path Immortal Gu, to be traded for a transformation path Immortal Gu," Qin Bai Sheng said.

In the main hall, a Gu Immortal flew into a rage upon seeing it, shouting: "Heavenly gong Immortal Gu! Hmph, He Lang Zi snatched that Gu from me. He Lang Zi, come out!"

"I'll come out, do you think I fear you?" He Lang Zi stepped out from a secret room with a ruthless smile.

"It really is He Lang Zi, Northern Plains' famous demonic path loner!"

"Rumor says he obtained Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's inheritance, allowing him to snatch others' Immortal Gu."

"Raised by wolves, his nature is wild and insidious. He is a loner whom even Old Ancestor Xue Hu failed to recruit."

He Lang Zi crossed his arms, walking into the main hall and sitting before the shouting Gu Immortal.

"You, you!" The shouting Gu Immortal pointed at He Lang Zi, trembling with a flushed, enraged face.

"Me what?" He Lang Zi licked his lips with a cruel, mocking gaze. "Old man Xiong Yuan, as a sound path Gu Immortal, if you don't bid now, when will you?"

"I have a transformation path Immortal Gu called demon ferret skin. It turns one's skin into that of a heart demon ferret," Unfettered Scholar voiced from a single room.

He Lang Zi already possessed three desolate wolf transformations; he wanted to develop his aquatic combat ability instead.

Thus, He Lang Zi slightly shook his head, not speaking.

Observing silently, Qin Bai Sheng asked: "Any other Gu Immortals wish to bid?"

"I offer moon demon bat claw Immortal Gu, which transforms hands into the claws of a moon demon bat," Feng Jiu Ge announced.

None knew Swordmaster You Lan was actually Feng Jiu Ge, a sound path Gu Immortal who naturally desired heavenly gong Immortal Gu.

He Lang Zi did not speak, he shook his head.

He Lang Zi was poor at aerial combat and hated the sky, having grown up fighting on all fours.

Receiving a transmission, Qin Bai Sheng announced: "The Gu Immortal in the first secret room offers grand smoke sea turtle shell Immortal Gu, along with verified information regarding Ascending Heaven Plain."

He Lang Zi's eyes gleamed. The grand smoke sea turtle was an aquatic beast that suited his needs, though its illusory nature differed from his combat style.

"Ascending Heaven Plain, what is that?" He Lang Zi asked. Despite his formidable battle strength, being a distrustful loner left him ill-informed.

"Ascending Heaven Plain is a place where anyone, even a mortal, can enter the immemorial nine heavens. In legends, Northern Dark Ice Soul reached black heaven through it," Qin Bai Sheng explained patiently.

"So that's it." He Lang Zi was moved.

"I have the strength to pierce the heavenly wind qi wall, but I cannot fly. If I obtain this information on Ascending Heaven Plain..." He Lang Zi grew increasingly tempted.

Ultimately, He Lang Zi accepted the first secret room's offer, receiving the grand smoke sea turtle shell Immortal Gu and a large pack of water wolves.

They transacted publicly, with Qin Bai Sheng acting as middleman since the secret room's Gu Immortal could not appear.

He Lang Zi inspected the Ascending Heaven Plain intelligence with anticipation, but upon reading it, his eyes blazed with fury and he shouted in rage.

# Chapter 752: Auction (6)

"Why, is there an issue with the Ascending Heaven Plain information?" Qin Bai Sheng's expression changed. Under the auction's oath, neither party could lie, guaranteeing the verified location was authentic.

"No." He Lang Zi's expression darkened as he fell silent, looking as though he had suffered a massive loss.

"Ascending Heaven Plain is in Eastern Sea; I know its location. How did the first secret room learn of it?" Fang Yuan wondered suspiciously.

"I recall a Northern Plains super force has ties to Eastern Sea—Murong tribe, wasn't it?"

Qin Bai Sheng had brought up the third auction item: Fang Yuan's rising azure cloud Gu.

Qin Bai Sheng announced: "Immortal Gu Rising Azure Cloud, rank six cloud path, specializes in aerial ascent and descent. The seller seeks a strength path Immortal Gu. Bidding begins!"

"I offer star desolate hound strength Gu, granting the strength of a star desolate hound!"

"Iron crown eagle strength Gu, plus one hundred and fifty kilograms of great lake soil!"

"Qi grand lion strength Gu and five drops of rule eye blood!"

Before a winner emerged, Fang Yuan messaged Qin Bai Sheng: "Enough, I choose the third bidder with the iron crown eagle strength Gu."

The transaction concluded promptly: Fang Yuan gained iron crown eagle strength Gu and needed immortal materials in exchange for rising azure cloud Immortal Gu.

He chose iron crown eagle strength Gu because it was the only flying beast offered, while the others were land-based.

"Next is the twenty-third item, Worldly Wave Trace, a rank six movement Gu..." Qin Bai Sheng was still introducing it when two Gu Immortals began staring with burning eyes.

"Finally! Worldly Wave Trace, a core Immortal Gu of Water Pavilion. I must obtain it at all costs!" Feng Jiu Ge clenched his fists.

"Worldly Wave Trace, excellent! My efforts were not in vain. With its recipe in hand, acquiring it gives me a high chance of refining worldly horizon Immortal Gu. Worldly horizon Immortal Gu allows free entry into the immemorial nine heavens, reducing the cost of piercing the heavenly wind qi wall," the Eastern Sea Gu Immortal anticipated with excitement.

Feng Jiu Ge smiled, speaking in Swordmaster You Lan's voice: "I offer the strength path Immortal Gu, Pulling Mountain. It grants the strength to uproot mountains, and I will add one hundred and fifty kilograms of heaven metal."

In the first secret room, the Eastern Sea Gu Immortal snorted, bidding again through his mortal Gu.

The strength path Immortal Gu Overturn River, plus two hundred and fifty kilograms of crack divine water!

"Oh?" Feng Jiu Ge was slightly surprised by such fierce competition.

Laughing arrogantly with fewer reservations under Swordmaster You Lan's guise, he declared: "Whatever the seller needs—materials, Gu recipes, beast groups, or variant human slaves—just name it."

Yet his competitive spirit flared as he chuckled: "Prince Feng Xian is rank eight, but am I not rank eight as well?"

Soon, his voice echoed across the hall: "My offer matches Fairy You Lan's. Can the seller provide a list of requirements?"

"Oh?" In the tenth secret room, Fang Yuan was equally surprised.

His eyes shifted as he chuckled: "Neither party is ordinary, and both truly desire this Gu. It would be remiss of me not to oblige."

Multiplying the quantities on Lang Ya land spirit's list several times over, he handed it to Qin Bai Sheng.

Qin Bai Sheng took it with a strange expression, then displayed it to everyone.

Even Feng Jiu Ge and the Eastern Sea Gu Immortal were momentarily stunned.

# Chapter 753: Second Immortal Gu!

"Interesting." Viewing Fang Yuan's material list, Feng Jiu Ge's eyes brightened as he regained his composure.

Murong Jin Xiao answered promptly: "Northern Plains has four major refinement path grandmasters. The foremost is Yao tribe's rank eight Yao Huang, rumored to have surpassed grandmaster and perhaps reached quasi-great grandmaster level. The fourth is a lone cultivator, she is called Lady Miao Li, she is skilled at refining enslavement path Gu worms."

After a brief silence, Feng Jiu Ge spoke first: "I will add one hundred and fifty pieces of thunder sound leaves."

"Hehehe," the Eastern Sea Gu Immortal chuckled. "Is Prince Feng Xian so petty? The list clearly demands two hundred and eighty thunder sound leaves."

Pausing briefly, the Eastern Sea Gu Immortal called out: "I offer three hundred and sixty heaven flying jades!"

Without hesitation, Feng Jiu Ge countered: "I add ten thousand star pupils."

"I remind the seller that intact and fragmented star pupils differ vastly in value," the Eastern Sea Gu Immortal cautioned.

"Can you make a better offer?" Feng Jiu Ge sneered, naming seven rare immortal materials to shock everyone with his variety.

"The seller surely cultivates refinement path. Refining Gu requires a broad variety of materials; sheer quantity of a single type is insufficient. Since he is offering variety to entice them, I must adjust my tactics," the Eastern Sea Gu Immortal decided before bidding again.

Their intense bidding war of vast immortal materials left the listening Gu Immortals dazed, as if in a dream.

Their combined bids would already cover half the listed materials!

Neither party was foolish; their fierce pursuit of Worldly Wave Trace proved they stood to gain immense benefits from it.

"I offer five kilograms of drunk immortal qi!" the Eastern Sea Gu Immortal declared.

The Eastern Sea Gu Immortal's immense wealth struck a heavy blow, turning even Feng Jiu Ge solemn.

Calming his mind, he asked himself: "Is Worldly Wave Trace alone worth such a price?"

Rebuilding Water Pavilion was Spirit Affinity House's longstanding ambition, and each recovered core Immortal Gu brought immense rewards.

"In that case, so be it!" After rapid consideration, Feng Jiu Ge gritted his teeth and brought out another Immortal Gu.

"This is the strength path Immortal Gu, Pulling Water." He reported.

The entire hall became silent.

# Chapter 754: Domination Immortal Chu Du

Even the organizer, Qin Bai Sheng, was stunned and asked: "Exchanging two for one, Fairy You Lan?"

"Indeed." Having made his choice, Feng Jiu Ge hesitated no longer.

Feng Jiu Ge's mission in Northern Plains was twofold: uncover Eighty-Eight True Yang Building's destroyer, and gather as many Immortal Gu as possible. For this, the Central Continent sects had provided numerous unpopular Immortal Gu for trade.

Backed by ten ancient sects, Feng Jiu Ge far outmatched the solo Eastern Sea immortal.

Making a final effort, he bid: "I add a sandalwood sacred elephant egg!"

In the silent auction hall, everyone awaited Fang Yuan's decision.

After considering, Fang Yuan secretly conveyed his decision to Qin Bai Sheng.

Qin Bai Sheng nodded and announced: "The seller has chosen to trade Worldly Wave Trace to Fairy You Lan!"

"Prince Feng Xian..." the Eastern Sea Gu Immortal muttered, his expression darkening.

In his secret room, Fang Yuan toyed with the two strength path Immortal Gu while watching the auction.

With Feng Jiu Ge's cooperation, Fang Yuan completely refined both strength path Immortal Gu, claiming ownership.

"Worldly Wave Trace... after so many years, it has finally returned to Spirit Affinity House," Feng Jiu Ge sighed with emotion.

"Next is the thirty-fourth item, strength path Immortal Gu Cauldron Strength—a rare defensive Gu that creates a protective strength cauldron. The seller seeks a wisdom path Immortal Gu," Qin Bai Sheng announced.

As the seller grew anxious, a distinct hoarse voice called from a single room: "Wisdom path Immortal Gu Loving Affection."

"That voice—it's Domination Immortal Chu Du!" someone in the hall shouted.

"Domination Immortal Chu Du..." In his room, Feng Jiu Ge sipped tea, eyes gleaming.

Chu Du was an exceptional strength path Gu Immortal endowed with immense battle strength and extraordinary talent, having personally pioneered a new branch of strength path.

A voice echoed: "Delight in water and mountain Immortal Gu, and five thousand kilograms of cloud soil."

Feng Jiu Ge spat out his tea, eyes wide as he lost his calm.

"Delight in water and mountain Immortal Gu!" He shouted: "Damn it, my worry came true."

Fang Yuan had long sought a strength path Immortal Gu; offering Delight in Water and Mountain was part of his original plan.

"One heaven pillar wind." Facing Fang Yuan's competition, Domination Immortal Chu Du raised his offer.

"Domination Immortal Chu Du..." Fang Yuan muttered, quickly realizing, "It seems you are my biggest competitor this time!"

# Chapter 755: Fang Yuan vs Chu Du

"The tenth secret room bids an intact sky dragon skeleton and one thousand five hundred grams of fury powder," Qin Bai Sheng announced from the platform.

He had just bid a heaven pillar wind, yet the tenth secret room immediately raised the price without hesitation.

Chu Du had recently passed a tribulation, thinning his foundation and forcing him to explore white heaven for resources.

Though he gained some loot, the heavy cost of borrowing Immortal Gu to heal his injuries left him at an overall loss.

"Strength path defensive Immortal Gu are rare—in all my years, this is the first I've found. I must obtain it."

Chu Du gritted his teeth and continued bidding.

Yet no matter how much he added, Fang Yuan kept matching him.

Several rounds later, Chu Du could no longer persist and secretly asked Qin Bai Sheng to communicate with the tenth secret room.

Surprised, Qin Bai Sheng impassively relayed the message to Fang Yuan.

With Fang Yuan's permission, Chu Du sent a letter to the tenth secret room.

Chu Du promised to owe Fang Yuan a favor of equal value if Fang Yuan backed down. They could make a vow using Immortal Gu, and Chu Du even offered precious information regarding Reckless Savage Demon Venerable's true meaning.

Reading the letter, Fang Yuan was both surprised and delighted.

Fang Yuan also needed Cauldron Strength, and having already absorbed Reckless Savage's true meaning, Chu Du's offer held no allure.

"I thought Domination Immortal Chu Du had deep pockets, but he embarrassed himself so quickly. His fortune must be at rock bottom. Hehehe." Fang Yuan snickered, making another high bid.

Chu Du gritted his teeth and bid again, but his offer was a mishmash of random goods.

Fang Yuan raised his bid with highly valuable rank seven immortal materials that could serve as main ingredients for refining rank seven Immortal Gu.

Unwilling to concede, Chu Du sighed and pieced together numerous rank six immortal materials to match the value of Fang Yuan's rank seven materials.

Chu Du was anxious, but Feng Jiu Ge was even more so.

"Even Domination Immortal cannot handle this!" Feng Jiu Ge was disappointed, having hoped Chu Du would overwhelm the tenth secret room with his might.

Yet Chu Du's embarrassing lack of funds was unbearable to watch, forcing Feng Jiu Ge to find a way to stop Fang Yuan from winning.

"Worldly Wave Trace and Delight in Water and Mountain, these two Immortal Gu both belong to the Gu Immortal in the tenth secret room. This person is mysterious and seems to have a major origin, it is even possible that they are the main culprit of the Imperial Court case. Not to mention the chance of inadvertently alerting them, if they infer some clues and decide to not sell the Immortal Gu, that would be anything but good."

"If I directly interfere and participate in the bidding, that would be inappropriate as well! I am under the identity of Swordmaster You Lan, but I have already bought Worldly Wave Trace, if I openly buy Delight in Water and Mountain again, in the case that the person in the tenth secret room knows of the secret of Water Pavilion, the possibility of exposing myself increases greatly."

Having made his decision, Feng Jiu Ge quietly contacted Domination Immortal Chu Du.

Chu Du felt strange receiving Swordmaster You Lan's letter; he was close to Yao Huang, but had met Prince Feng Xian only once.

Feng Jiu Ge offered to fund Chu Du to win Cauldron Strength Immortal Gu, requesting in exchange to purchase Chu Du's true heaven silver.

Though somewhat doubtful of Feng Jiu Ge's true intentions, Chu Du urgently needed Cauldron Strength Immortal Gu.

Chu Du promptly thanked Feng Jiu Ge, promising detailed information on the true heaven silver's location after the auction.

Backed by Feng Jiu Ge, Chu Du regained confidence and bid again.

Surprised, Fang Yuan exhausted his materials from Lang Ya blessed land and had to start bidding with his previously acquired materials.

Feng Jiu Ge could not help but feel vexed.

These materials had been his own; he never imagined they would be turned against him so swiftly.

Unable to stay seated, Fang Yuan stood up and paced the secret room.

"Chu Du was on the brink of failure—how did his wealth suddenly surge? Someone must be backing him from the shadows."

Tapping his immortal zombie head, Fang Yuan sat back down to mobilize wills in his mind to aid his thinking.

While he thought, he continued bidding.

After two more bids, he suddenly opened his eyes.

A sharp light flashed in his eyes as several conjectures formed.

"I must have this Cauldron Strength Immortal Gu!" Fang Yuan shouted in a show of force. "Whatever the seller wants, speak—I will do my utmost to satisfy it."

"The same goes for me—whatever the seller wants, please speak," Chu Du echoed after a pause, refusing to show weakness.

The seller quickly stated a new requirement: a wisdom path inheritance.

Chu Du smiled bitterly at the request; where would he find a wisdom path inheritance?

Feng Jiu Ge also smiled wryly; though rich in Immortal Gu, the seller's demand for a wisdom path inheritance created an awkward dilemma.

For a while, Fang Yuan and Chu Du went silent.

# Chapter 756: Fang Yuan vs Feng Jiu Ge

Demanding a wisdom path inheritance was excessive, as such inheritances were extremely rare.

Fang Yuan had only a severely fragmented wisdom path inheritance that could not meet the requirements.

He sat in silence, licking his dry lips as anticipation grew in his heart.

As neither the tenth secret room nor Chu Du spoke, the hall fell into a peculiar silence.

Sensing something amiss, the anxious seller of Cauldron Strength Immortal Gu quickly added to his demand.

Receiving his transmission, Qin Bai Sheng announced: "The wisdom path inheritance need not be complete—an incomplete one is acceptable, though the more complete, the better."

Fang Yuan laughed heartily, he had a rather incomplete wisdom path inheritance.

His bid came from the tenth secret room: "I have an incomplete wisdom path inheritance."

Lacking any inheritance, Chu Du placed his hopes on Swordmaster You Lan, trusting Prince Feng Xian's deep foundation.

Feng Jiu Ge laughed bitterly.

Spirit Affinity House had collected incomplete wisdom path inheritances, but Feng Jiu Ge carried none. He promptly used hole earth Gu to contact the other nine Central Continent Gu Immortals.

Feng Jiu Ge quickly negotiated with Chen Zhen Chi, purchasing his incomplete wisdom path inheritance.

But after getting it, Feng Jiu Ge became hesitant.

He could provide the inheritance to Chu Du, but doing so was far too obvious.

Just as Feng Jiu Ge prepared to risk Chu Du's suspicions with the inheritance, Chu Du announced: "I lack an inheritance and back out from this bid."

But just as Qin Bai Sheng prepared to award the bid to Fang Yuan, a third competitor appeared.

"The eleventh secret room bids a wisdom path Immortal Gu, an incomplete wisdom path inheritance, and immortal materials matching the tenth secret room!" Qin Bai Sheng suddenly announced.

Qin Bai Sheng was especially confused; knowing Tai Bai Yun Sheng and Fang Yuan were allies who arrived together, why were they competing?

Sitting in the tenth secret room with half-closed eyes, Fang Yuan tapped his armrest and continued bidding against Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

After several rounds, Tai Bai Yun Sheng pieced together miscellaneous materials, displaying strained finances.

Next, he purposely hesitated before bidding, displaying a changing mind.

After several more rounds, Tai Bai Yun Sheng approved Qin Bai Sheng's notification and received a letter.

Like the letter to Chu Du, it offered funding in exchange for materials.

"Junior brother, just as you expected, someone is willing to fund me," Tai Bai Yun Sheng secretly reported to Fang Yuan.

"Oh?" Fang Yuan opened his eyes, straightening his back subconsciously: "Who?"

"Swordmaster You Lan."

"Swordmaster You Lan?" Fang Yuan's eyes shone with brilliance.

"Swordmaster You Lan... Prince Feng Xian..." Unable to sit still, Fang Yuan began pacing the room.

Fang Yuan had only intended to test a suspicion, yet the confirmed result still surprised him.

"Chu Du obtained funding to continue competing with me—that person was likely Swordmaster You Lan."

"Why fund them both? Not for materials, but to keep Delight in Water and Mountain from others."

"Delight in Water and Mountain is useless to me, so I am selling it. But if the seller acquires it, he will keep it for himself."

"She bought Worldly Wave Trace and now desperately blocks Delight in Water and Mountain's sale—why?"

The answer flickered in his mind: the rank seven Immortal Gu House, Water Pavilion.

Fang Yuan sneered inwardly: "Impressive! In my previous life, a Spirit Affinity House supreme elder swayed Prince Feng Xian's heart and recruited him during the chaotic war. Prince Feng Xian's sudden defection caught everyone off guard, nearly killing rank seven Gu Immortal Ma Hong Yun and severely worsening Northern Plains' situation. Spirit Affinity House rose above the other ancient sects. To think Prince Feng Xian was their pawn all along!"

Though ignorant of their mission, Feng Jiu Ge's use of Fairy You Lan's identity inadvertently helped Fang Yuan deduce Spirit Affinity House's deepest secret!

# Chapter 757: Resurrection From The Dead

"Swordmaster You Lan has impressive methods. Without Chu Du's letter and my past-life memories, I would never have spotted the flaw or connected the dots," Fang Yuan sighed inwardly.

Fang Yuan sat down, continuing to think while bidding against Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

Fang Yuan weighed his options: keep Delight in Water and Mountain to ruin Spirit Affinity House's plans, trade it for Cauldron Strength Immortal Gu, or sell it directly to Swordmaster You Lan?

Fang Yuan was pragmatic; if satisfying Spirit Affinity House brought immense benefits, he was glad to do so.

On the other hand, he did not want to give up Cauldron Strength Immortal Gu.

Such a strength path defensive Immortal Gu was rare; missing it might mean never finding another.

Just as Fang Yuan was hesitating, a voice came from a single room.

"A wisdom path Immortal Gu, Kindness Thought Gu, an incomplete wisdom path inheritance, and double the immortal materials for Cauldron Strength Immortal Gu."

The entirety of the hall gasped.

The new bidder was rank eight refinement path expert Yao Huang!

"Yao Huang is bidding too?"

Beside Yao Huang in the single room sat Yin Liu Gong, a leader of the Northern Plains Zombie Alliance.

Yin Liu Gong said: "Senior Yao Huang, are you really buying this cauldron strength Immortal Gu?"

Yao Huang chuckled: "Refining Resurrection From The Dead requires a formless vessel as a container. It must be ethereal, without the five elements, light, or darkness. Phantom path is best, followed by strength, space, and rule path."

Yin Liu Gong realized: "Phantom path Immortal Gu are as rare as wisdom path inheritances, and ones that can serve as formless vessels are rarer still. This cauldron strength Immortal Gu, even though it uses strength to create a cauldron, it does not have the five elements or light or darkness in it, it is formless and ethereal, but it can defend against attacks. It is really a top tier vessel for Gu refinement."

Yao Huang nodded: "Nurture, use, refinement—all depend on the person. Immortal Gu are tools whose use varies. Little Liu, you believe my sincerity now, right?"

"I previously collaborated with your alliance, using immortal zombies as test subjects to research the law of life and death. Over the years, I've made great gains and now have thirty percent confidence in refining Resurrection From The Dead," Yao Huang said with pride.

"Once refined, the biggest beneficiary is not me, but Zombie Alliance," Yao Huang said to Yin Liu Gong while bidding.

Yin Liu Gong's heart jumped: "Senior means?"

"That's right," Yao Huang admitted. "This Gu involves the law of life and death, turning death into life. It can allow you immortal zombies to revive and shed your zombie status!"

Yin Liu Gong was stunned: "Beyond immense benefits, Lord could also use this Immortal Gu to extend your lifespan?"

"Hahaha, sharp as ever. Lifespan Gu are rare, and my life is short. How about collaborating?" Yao Huang smiled.

Yin Liu Gong smiled bitterly: "Collaborating requires at least ten immortal zombies. Though I am a leader, there are two others. Even the three of us together are only left to administer the Northern Plains Zombie Alliance branch. This matter is very important, I need to inform Leader Blazing Heaven."

"Ten immortal zombies is the bare minimum. Refining Resurrection From The Dead requires materials that interact with life and death dao marks—immortal zombies are optimal. I know Zombie Alliance has a graveyard in Earth Trench where past generations of immortal zombies are buried." Yao Huang frowned.

Yin Liu Gong waved his hands rapidly: "Lord Yao Huang, that is impossible. The dead should rest in peace; in our physical state, Zombie Alliance values that deeply. I have two immortal zombie bodies in my possession, they are traitors of Zombie Alliance. But even so, I used my killer move, stone casket, to seal them up and place them as defenses for the discussion hall's doors, they will not be mobilized under normal circumstances!"

Enduring the intense pressure, Yin Liu Gong dared not relent: "Senior, this matter is too serious for me—or even all three leaders—to decide alone. We need to inform Leader Blazing Heaven, she will decide! In a few months, I will definitely give you a reply."

Yao Huang snorted coldly and bid again, directing his displeasure toward the auction.

"I'll back out." In the tenth secret room, Fang Yuan spoke.

Soon after, Tai Bai Yun Sheng in the eleventh secret room said: "I dare not compete with Senior Yao Huang; I concede."

Obtaining cauldron strength Immortal Gu was not Yao Huang's only goal; he also wanted to show Yin Liu Gong his resolve.

He revealed part of his wisdom inheritance and an Immortal Gu to win.

The transaction was quickly completed.

Holding cauldron strength Immortal Gu, Yao Huang sighed: "It is only rank six; raising it to rank seven will take effort, but it will increase the chances of successfully refining Resurrection From The Dead."

With cauldron strength Immortal Gu sold, attention turned to the next Immortal Gu.

# Chapter 758: Eat Strength

As if prearranged, several luck path Immortal Gu appeared consecutively in the auction.

There was Leave Luck to rapidly expend luck, Seal Luck to seal it, Transfer Luck to transfer it, and the Break Luck Immortal Gu Fang Yuan coveted!

Unfortunately, sellers demanded mainstream paths like metal, wood, water, fire, and earth, locking Fang Yuan out.

"The next item is the rank seven luck path Immortal Gu, Calamity Beckoning..." Qin Bai Sheng introduced it slowly as the auction began.

Calamity Beckoning harmed oneself to help others, drawing another person's calamity and tribulation onto oneself.

But because Fang Yuan demanded a rank seven strength path Immortal Gu, no one in the hall made an offer.

Fang Yuan allowed a rank seven time path Immortal Gu instead, but still received no bids.

"It really is Calamity Beckoning. Is it from the Gu Immortal in the tenth secret room?" Feng Jiu Ge pondered, then asked Qin Bai Sheng to speak with the owner.

"Fairy You Lan, you finally lost your patience..." Fang Yuan snorted, rejecting the request unhesitatingly.

With no one bidding, calamity beckoning Immortal Gu went unsold.

"The next item is the rank six wisdom path Immortal Gu, Delight in Water and Mountain. The seller requests a rank six strength path Immortal Gu, preferably defensive," Qin Bai Sheng announced.

Once Qin Bai Sheng spoke, several Gu Immortals started bidding.

Fang Yuan listened carefully to the bids, remaining unmoved as he waited for Swordmaster You Lan.

Before long, 'Swordmaster You Lan' indeed bid: "I have an Eat Strength Immortal Gu. This strength and food path Gu allows strength path dao marks to grow naturally on one's body by consuming strength-related beasts or vegetation."

This Immortal Gu was not from Central Continent's ten great ancient sects; Feng Jiu Ge had obtained it from Prince Feng Xian knowing Fang Yuan's requirements.

"Fairy You Lan, would you trade this Gu to me? I will offer another strength path Immortal Gu plus valuable immortal materials, and promise not to compete for Delight in Water and Mountain," Chu Du messaged.

"Domination Immortal's interest is natural, but how could any strength path Gu he offers be more attractive than Eat Strength?" Feng Jiu Ge replied, rejecting Chu Du's request.

Just as Feng Jiu Ge expected, hearing the description of eat strength Immortal Gu left Fang Yuan overjoyed.

A Gu Immortal's cultivation mainly involved tribulations in their immortal aperture. Each successful tribulation increased the dao marks of their path on their body.

More dao marks amplified the effects of corresponding Immortal Gu through resonance.

Fang Yuan's greatest problem was being an immortal zombie with a dead aperture. While parts of his blessed land crumbled over time, he faced no tribulations.

Without calamities and tribulations, Fang Yuan gained no dao marks, causing his cultivation level to stagnate.

"Of course, I could use Immortal Gu like iron crown eagle strength Gu to carve dao marks on my body. Seeing Fang Yuan's gleaming eyes, Fairy Li Shan conceded helplessly: "I won't hide it: I have a method using time luck Immortal Gu as the core of an immortal killer move. It expends another person's lifespan to amplify one's own luck."

Fairy Li Shan's expression chilled: "Fang Yuan, are you trying to ruin my plans?"

"I would still choose this Immortal Gu," Fang Yuan replied, "simply because I obtained an improved mortal Gu recipe for inch of time. Using inch of time might replace the time expenditure and protect my lifespan."

Fairy Li Shan's expression softened, though her tone remained stiff: "Even so, designing a brand new immortal killer move based on Time Luck Immortal Gu and inch of time is a massive undertaking. Why not leave Time Luck Immortal Gu with me first, and I will use the killer move to improve your luck instead?"

# Chapter 769: Testing Immortal Gu

Hu Immortal blessed land.

# Chapter 770: Refining Dream Path Mortal Gu

Fang Yuan sat in his room, facing his brother Fang Zheng.

"Brother, how ungrateful! Uncle and aunt raised us, yet you reported them!" Fang Zheng scolded self-righteously.

With a calm face and ice-cold eyes, Fang Yuan looked around: "This dream realm is remarkably realistic."

"This is the dream realm's entanglement." Suppressing his disgust, Fang Yuan brushed past Fang Zheng and headed for the door.

"Brother!" Fang Zheng turned around, grabbing Fang Yuan's arm.

Fang Yuan sighed helplessly; with a sharp glint in his eye, he kicked Fang Zheng to the ground.

Freed, Fang Yuan turned and strode out the door.

The moment he stepped outside, the scenery shifted.

He was in the Gu Yue clan's discussion hall.

Elders sat along both sides while the clan leader presided at the center, looking down at Fang Zheng and Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan found himself kneeling on the floor alongside Fang Zheng.

Fang Yuan was fully aware that kicking Fang Zheng had stirred his emotions, tightening the dream realm's entanglement.

The more emotion he invested, the deeper the dream realm's entanglement would drag him.

Fang Yuan searched for the refinement material fruitlessly. Just as he pondered, the clan leader spoke.

"We give you one last chance. Do you have anything to say?" the clan leader asked Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan sneered inwardly; this was the dream realm's trap—speaking would stir his emotions and endanger him.

Without hesitation, Fang Yuan mobilized his primeval essence into his Gu.

Snatching the Nine Leaf Vitality Grass, he charged out the door without lingering.

As soon as Fang Yuan stepped outside, the scenery shifted again.

He found himself in a cave surrounded by pale white bones, reminiscent of Southern Border's Bai Gu Mountain.

Gu Yue clan leader and nearly ten elders appeared, chasing after Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan quickly retreated.

Fang Yuan ducked into a small cave and sat down to refine Gu according to memory.

Midway through refinement, pursuers discovered him and blocked the cave's sole exit.

Sighing helplessly, Fang Yuan summoned strength path beast phantoms and fought his way out.

Shaking off the pursuers, Fang Yuan reached a hall identical to where he had refined Bone Flesh Unity Gu.

Here, Fang Yuan finally refined his dream path Gu worm.

As pursuers closed in, Fang Yuan laughed, muttering to himself: "Time to wake up."

As he spoke, the scene vanished into pure darkness.

Fang Yuan opened his eyes in Dang Hun palace, his hands still mirroring his motions within the dream.

Fang Yuan was not shocked, he checked inside his mind.

In his mind, a dream path mortal Gu floated amidst bubbling, vanishing thoughts.

"The first dream path mortal Gu is finally done." Fang Yuan smiled in satisfaction.

Dream path mortal Gu lacked physical forms, existing only in the mind.

# Chapter 771: Lord Vice Envoy

"Ah—!" Qin Bai Sheng shouted in pain.

# Chapter 772: Silence and Sigh

Snowy Mountain blessed land, first peak.

"In luck theory, Gu Immortals have extraordinary protective luck. Yet Fortune Rivalling Heaven is the emperor of luck, so we are still affected. The longer this drags on, the more uncertainties will arise. In the end, not only would the refinement fail, we might even attract a huge disaster," Old Ancestor Xue Hu explained slowly.

Old Ancestor Xue Hu nodded: "That is why we must prepare multiple sets of refinement materials and use other luck path Immortal Gu to protect our luck. Thankfully, using Ma Hong Yun as the main material saves substantial immortal materials compared to refining Fortune Rivalling Heaven from scratch."

"Hahaha, go ahead and refine it, wife. Success or failure, I will accept the outcome without resentment. "Fang Yuan, go carry that box of goods!" the caravan steward shouted, pointing at a box.

Possessing power would breed killing intent—the dream realm's trap to lure him into attacking and draw out his rage.

"They've investigated this far already?" In the dim room, Fang Yuan frowned and sighed faintly.

Su tribe leader's cup was empty, but as Su Xian Er went to pour wine, he scolded her: "Are you blind? Go pour wine for our Su tribe's esteemed guest!"

Su Xian Er replied meekly, walking to Hei Cheng's table.

Watching Su Xian Er's retreating back, he stood up and asked: "May I know your name, miss?"

Su Xian Er turned, bowing with lowered head and replying softly: "My name is Su Xian Er."

Then, we will be free of the Imperial Court contest and the ten-year blizzard. Hei tribe is a super force, but Snowy Mountain blessed land is the demonic path's headquarters!"

As the elders fantasized, Su tribe leader noted their lingering hesitation and said harshly: "Why hesitate at this final moment? Even if we do nothing or inform Hei tribe, what can we do? If we offend Snowy Mountain, they won't let us off! Don't forget that fairy saved our Su tribe's lives. If she could save us so easily, she could slaughter us just as effortlessly!"

"Hei Cheng is protected by at least five hidden experts from Hei tribe," Su tribe leader shared his intel.

Hearing this, Fang Yuan knew what to say: "Then we shall execute Lord Tribe Leader's orders!"

As a healing Gu Master, Fang Yuan was assigned to support two elders against the strongest enemies.

The moment he left the secret room, the dream realm shifted into the second scene.

The night had a bright moon and strong, howling winds.

A rank three Hei tribe Gu Master stood arrogantly, glaring furiously around him: "Your Su tribe is truly daring, attacking our young master Hei Cheng!"

Two Su tribe elders charged the Hei tribe Gu Master while Fang Yuan supported from behind.

"Hei Lou Lan isn't here yet. Judging by this, I can only enter the third scene after killing this Gu Master," Fang Yuan thought, activating wood path Gu worms to heal his allies.

Suddenly, the wounded Hei tribe Gu Master roared and charged at Fang Yuan.

# Chapter 774: Unravel Dream Succeeds

"Unravel." Fang Yuan extended his right palm toward the Hei tribe Gu Master.

Simultaneously, a green-purple light flashed in his eyes.

Despair and shock flashed in the Hei tribe Gu Master's eyes as his body faded into thin air.

"Quickly, let's reinforce the others. The priority is killing Hei Cheng," Fang Yuan urged.

The two Su tribe Gu Masters nodded, rushing with Fang Yuan deeper into the grassland.

"In battle, there is victory, defeat, life, and death. Academy elder sacrificed herself and will be honored. But Su Xian Er betrayed our tribe to help that Hei Cheng lad escape—an unforgivable crime!"

"Hei Lou Lan, it's me, Fang Yuan!" Without hesitation, Fang Yuan bypassed Su tribe leader and rushed toward her.

Hei Lou Lan looked momentarily dazed, but ruthless gleam filled her eyes: "Scram!"

Fang Yuan snorted coldly, saying: "Unravel dream!"

# Chapter 775: Dream Path Pioneer
