Though the immortals suspected he might be bluffing, nobody stopped Fang Yuan's group as they landed by the Gu formation to search for clues to Dong Fang Yu Liang.

A few breaths' later, they all gasped.

"What a teleportation Gu formation!" Fairy Li Shan said hoarsely.

"Truly worthy of Dong Fang Chang Fan, purposely leaving behind a Gu formation to mislead us..." Hei Lou Lan said.

"The clues here point toward the right direction, but finding Dong Fang Yu Liang still relies on luck," Fang Yuan added.

Without answering, Fang Yuan's trio soared into the sky, leaving Tai Qiu in three different directions and rapidly vanishing from sight.

A moment later, Unfettered Scholar landed as well.

Upon inspecting it, he realized Fang Yuan's group had not lied.

Dong Fang Chang Fan had altered the Gu formation to transport only mortal Gu Masters.

Thus, he intentionally left multiple trails while concealing the true route among them, mixing truth with falsehood.

This forced the Gu Immortals to split up, greatly reducing the pressure on Dong Fang Yu Liang even if someone located him.

Fang Yuan's trio had chosen the three most probable directions.

Unfettered Scholar pondered before choosing a fourth direction, swiftly leaving Tai Qiu.

After he departed, the remaining immortals landed one by one, gathering clues and scattering in their chosen directions.

# Chapter 784: Ordinary Desolate Beasts Are Not My Match

"Where is this?" Dong Fang Yu Liang slowly regained consciousness, his blurred vision clearing.

"According to the map, we only traveled half the path," Dong Fang Yu Liang puzzled, treating his wounds.

"Could Lord Chang Fan's map be fake? Perhaps the latter half was false and the true destination was midway."

"Tan Wu Feng and Dong Po Kong were teleported with me, but there's no trace of them. They might be nearby. I should find them before exploring this hall."

Once his wounds healed, Dong Fang Yu Liang began searching the area.

The grand, dilapidated halls formed sprawling ruins.

"Tan Wu Feng!"

"Young master!"

After walking a while, Dong Fang Yu Liang met Tan Wu Feng, who also had been looking for him.

Shortly after reuniting, they found Dong Po Kong by the hall's exit.

Dong Fang Yu Liang and Tan Wu Feng revived him, all three delighted to be reunited.

Dong Fang Yu Liang decided: "This is where Lord Chang Fan set the inheritance. Let us check the next hall."

Boom!

A giant strength path hand smashed down like a mountain.

"Baaa!"

The giant horned sheep bleated miserably, covered in injuries and completely pinned down beneath the giant hand.

The desolate beast struggled repeatedly, but the giant hand pressed down firmly until the sheep exhausted its energy and ceased resisting.

Fang Yuan exhaled turbid air, a look of satisfaction flashing in his eyes.

"The giant horned sheep is a pure strength path desolate beast; I will raise it in the blessed land. Periodically, I can carve its flesh and use Eat Strength Immortal Gu to increase my strength path dao marks. Who would have expected to capture a live giant horned sheep here? This is truly an unexpected blessing."

Fang Yuan steadied his breath, the injuries on his immortal zombie body already healed.

He willed and the giant hand grabbed the giant horned sheep and transported it to his immortal aperture.

"Extorting Self Strength Immortal Gu was truly a great move. With rank seven battle strength and the versatile giant hand, ordinary desolate beasts like the giant horned sheep are no longer my match. Even against the swamp crab that damaged Dang Hun Mountain, I could now clash head-on and safeguard the mountain even if it had Gruel Mud Immortal Gu!"

He was well aware of the situation: with many wolves and one prey, relying on his strength alone offered slim chances of seizing Dong Fang Chang Fan's wisdom path inheritance.

"Barring the unexpected, even if this wisdom path inheritance falls into my hands, it will only be partial. Sigh, when will I obtain a truly intact wisdom path inheritance?"

As Fang Yuan pondered this, Fairy Li Shan's message arrived in his immortal aperture.

Fairy Li Shan reported that others had discovered the true inheritance ground, where an intense battle raged!

Because of this loud commotion, more and more Gu Immortals were heading there.

Fang Yuan regrouped with his allies and arrived where a dozen Gu Immortals paced.

"I just returned from the southeast and saw him capture a desolate giant horned sheep alive with a giant hand!"

Thus, as Fang Yuan's group flew over, the Gu Immortals subconsciously parted to make way in the air.

"This is the inheritance ground? Dong Fang Chang Fan truly put much thought into this," Fang Yuan observed from above, noticeably moved.

Below him was the corpse of a ruin bat.

In life, this immemorial desolate ruin bat possessed rank eight battle strength.

Its countless space path dao marks warped the area into illusory halls.

Anyone stepping into range would be dragged into the halls; only rank eight Gu Immortals could resist this colossal force.

While the Gu Immortals hesitated above the ruin bat's corpse, Dong Fang Yu Liang progressed smoothly, already charging into the eighth hall.

"My chosen inheritor, you have finally arrived." A lump of star will condensed into Dong Fang Chang Fan's appearance before Dong Fang Yu Liang and the others.

"Master!" Dong Fang Yu Liang prostrated with tearful eyes.

The star will nodded slowly at Dong Fang Yu Liang: "Reaching here proves your superior talent. This is not the final hall, but it is the end of the inheritance. If you can perfect this Gu formation and successfully activate it, you will fully inherit this wisdom path inheritance and receive my wisdom path Immortal Gu!"

"Master, I will definitely do my best." Dong Fang Yu Liang showed an intense fighting spirit.

"Be quick, there is little time left." The star will looked up toward the sky.

# Chapter 785: Phantom Beasts Obstruct The Way, Immortals Are Troubled

In the sky, Gu Immortals were fighting everywhere.

Having found the true inheritance ground, the pragmatic demonic path Gu Immortals acted immediately, and someone promptly dove down.

The massive phantom beast army stirred, rising like a giant black cloud from beneath the demonic Gu Immortals' feet.

Strange in appearance, the phantom beasts attacked fearlessly and dodged adeptly, with several desolate beast level phantom beasts blocking the demonic path Gu Immortals.

"Phantom beasts are rare, only appearing where space path dao marks abound. Why are there so many here?" Hei Lou Lan cursed while fighting fiercely.

"Stay calm," Fairy Li Shan consoled. "Phantom beasts naturally phase into phantoms to evade attacks. As long as no ancient desolate beast level phantom beast appears, we will eventually enter the immemorial ruin bat's corpse."

As she spoke, a large flock of phantom beast birds swooped over.

Fang Yuan snorted, shielding the other two as he unleashed Myriad Self's first style: Giant Hand.

A strength path giant hand appeared, stretching its fingers and grabbing.

Though immensely powerful, the hand dealt little damage when it grabbed; only a few dozen among the thousand phantom beasts died.

When he retracted the hand, the solidified phantom beasts charged back.

Fang Yuan snorted coldly while Fairy Li Shan waved her hand, unleashing a spreading sea of fire.

The moment they rushed out of the fire, Fang Yuan was waiting, seizing them with his strength path giant hand.

Hundreds of phantom beasts were crushed into meat paste, losing their lives.

Fang Yuan's expression remained grim: "Ordinary phantom beasts phase briefly, but desolate beast level phantom beasts are the real problem."

The two rank seven Gu Immortals, Unfettered Scholar and Pi Shui Han, were each fighting two desolate level phantom beasts. These special beasts could remain in phantom form for extended periods.

In contrast, Lu Qing Ming's side was in a dangerous situation.

A desolate level phantom beast phased into intangibility, accelerating rapidly toward Gu Immortal Han Dong beside Lu Qing Ming.

Caught off guard, Han Dong fell inside its stomach.

Growling proudly, the phantom beast flew away with Han Dong, leaving Lu Qing Ming and Su Guang behind.

The Traveling Three Elites rivaled a rank seven when united, but were far weaker individually.

The phantom beast carrying Han Dong dove downward, enduring Lu Qing Ming and Su Guang's attacks without phasing again.

With Han Dong also attacking from within its stomach, the phantom beast was battered inside and out, spitting blood in distress as it fled.

Lu Qing Ming's face was grim: "Can't you tell? There is a mastermind behind this. Dong Fang Chang Fan, I underestimated you..."

In a hall within the ruins, Dong Fang Chang Fan's star will watched the sky with hands behind his back.

Though dead, his remaining methods still directed the phantom beasts to buy time.

"Quick, faster! Just a bit faster!" Behind him, Dong Fang Yu Liang was drenched in sweat, exerting every ounce of potential to complete this Gu formation.

"Enslavement path, wisdom path, and soul path share similar origins, so this is not strange." Lu Qing Ming's eyes shone with determination: "Yet Dong Fang Chang Fan, we feared and avoided your deductions in life. Now that you are dead, you still trouble us. But if you think these methods can take us down, you underestimate the world's talents!"

The wind danced, forming tens of thousands of wind blades in the air!

The spinning wind blades intertwined into a sphere resembling dark green vines, surging toward the desolate level phantom beast.

Just as he was about to succeed, a vine dragon flew over, targeting the entangled wind.

"Unfettered Scholar, don't even think about it!" Su Guang glared furiously and hurriedly used a killer move to intercept the vine dragon.

Suddenly, a water lotus appeared beneath the entangled wind.

Lu Qing Ming snorted as the entangled wind bypassed the lotus and surged toward the phantom beast.

Right at this moment, a strength path giant hand emerged from the clouds and seized the entangled wind.

With a loud bang, the strength path giant hand and the entangle wind both dissipated.

Finding an opening, the desolate level phantom beast landed on the palace below and vanished into a spatial ripple.

"Ah!" With success slipping away, Su Guang roared in rage and glared furiously at Fang Yuan: "I will kill you!"

Fang Yuan snickered coldly, wagging a finger at Su Guang.

Su Guang was about to attack, but Lu Qing Ming flew over and stopped him in time.

"Stay calm, Su Guang!" Lu Qing Ming's eyes were blood-red. "We will definitely take revenge later, but saving Han Dong is the urgent priority."

Su Guang contained his rage: "Brother Lu is right. Rescuing Han Dong restores our rank seven power!"

Desperate to save their companion, Su Guang and Lu Qing Ming went all out, pushing back the three desolate level phantom beasts.

"Most importantly, they've lost their rank seven battle strength—one less true competitor." Unfettered Scholar smiled, glancing at Pi Shui Han and Fang Yuan while dealing with his desolate level phantom beast.

Seeing that Fang Yuan's group remained unengaged by any desolate level phantom beasts, a solemn look flashed in his eyes.

"These three have it too easy; that won't do." Unfettered Scholar adjusted his position, luring the desolate level phantom beast toward Fang Yuan and the others.

Fang Yuan had been observing the surroundings; seeing this, his gaze turned cold.

He retreated as he stretched out both hands.

Two giant hands flew out, charging unrestrained toward Unfettered Scholar.

Simultaneously, a third giant hand appeared behind him, guarding against the surroundings.

"He can actually use three hands at once?" Unfettered Scholar paused, his wariness deepening.

Just as they were skirmishing and scheming outside, an elderly Gu Immortal appeared silently behind Dong Fang Yu Liang in the large hall.

His gaze swept across the star will and Dong Fang Yu Liang before inspecting the Gu formation.

"Good formation, good formation. Even I, Old Lord Can Yang, am seeing this for the first time in my life." He praised continuously.

# Chapter 786: One Against Two Rank Sevens

"Who are you?" Shocked, Dong Fang Yu Liang stared at Old Lord Can Yang.

Tan Wu Feng and Dong Po Kong grew vigilant; Old Lord Can Yang's natural aura instilled deep fear in them.

Dong Fang Chang Fan's star will turned slowly, asking Old Lord Can Yang calmly: "Are you also here to inherit my wisdom path inheritance?"

Slightly stunned, Old Lord Can Yang assessed the star will and asked in surprise: "Oh, I am also qualified?"

"Passing the test proves you are capable. Appearing at this moment shows you have an affinity with the inheritance. The wisdom path inheritance I left behind cannot be given to useless people—that would ruin my reputation."

The star will continued: "You qualify, but my main body chose this lad; while he undergoes the test, you cannot interfere. If he succeeds, you will not be able to get it. But if he fails, you are allowed to try."

Old Lord Can Yang sighed: "I intended to seize it by force, but since this is the case, I do not mind waiting."

With a chance to obtain a complete wisdom path inheritance, Old Lord Can Yang did not want to spoil it.

His gaze moved from the star will to Dong Fang Yu Liang, then turned toward Tan Wu Feng and Dong Po Kong.

Though Old Lord Can Yang's gaze was calm, Tan Wu Feng and Dong Po Kong felt an immense, blaring sense of danger filling them.

"What are you planning to do?" Sensing something amiss, Dong Fang Yu Liang shouted loudly.

Old Lord Can Yang snickered without moving, yet Tan Wu Feng and Dong Po Kong's bodies instantly ignited on the spot!

"Ah—!" The two screamed shrilly, collapsing to the floor and struggling intensely as the yellow-green flames continued roasting them, subjecting both rank five Gu Masters to agonizing pain.

Deeply affected yet astute, he knelt and begged Dong Fang Chang Fan's star will: "Master, without these two, I would not have made it here. Please save them!"

Waving its sleeves, the star will said coldly: "Mercy does not suit a commander, kindness does not suit scheming. Dong Fang Yu Liang, my main body is dead; I am merely a star will. My assistance has reached its limit; begging is useless. Rather than wasting time, you should complete the Gu formation and pass the test."

While speaking aloud, the star will transmitted its voice into Dong Fang Yu Liang's mind: "Yu Liang, this Gu Immortal possesses immense battle strength—even my main body would be wary of him. As a mere will, I have only stalled him. You must quickly complete this Gu formation; it is both an inheritance and a deterrent against enemies. If completed, you can challenge Gu Immortals and save your subordinates!"

Dong Fang Yu Liang was shaken, finally understanding the star will's predicament. Standing up, he yelled to Tan Wu Feng and Dong Po Kong: "Brothers, hang in there! I will definitely save you!"

Tears in his eyes, he turned back to resume completing the Gu formation.

Old Lord Can Yang frowned and stoked the flames. Tan Wu Feng and Dong Po Kong's faces contorted in agony, their screams redoubling.

Hearing their cries, Dong Fang Yu Liang grew clearer and more determined rather than succumbing to rage. His eyes began bleeding from the intense mental exertion of his deductions.

Torturing the two had no effect; instead, it spurred Dong Fang Yu Liang to construct the incomplete Gu formation even faster.

At this rate, Dong Fang Yu Liang's success would ruin his plans.

Dong Fang Yu Liang had a strong chance to succeed; as Dong Fang Chang Fan's chosen heir, his potential was undeniable.

However, coming to Northern Plains as a Central Continent Gu Immortal was inherently risky.

All five regions in this world were inherently hostile to foreigners.

Especially in Northern Plains, where Eighty-Eight True Yang Building's collapse caused immense turmoil, exposing his Central Continent identity would invite disaster.

Thus, Old Lord Can Yang preferred moving covertly to save time, stay concealed, and avoid battle.

Old Lord Can Yang looked toward the star will, his gaze flickering with uncertainty.

He wanted to attack Dong Fang Yu Liang secretly, but feared forfeiting the opportunity and ending up with an inheritance too incomplete to be of value.

As expected of a wisdom path Gu Immortal, Dong Fang Chang Fan's posthumous star will could sway a formidable foe like Old Lord Can Yang with mere words.

Seeing Fang Yuan's three hands, Unfettered Scholar grew warier. Pausing only briefly, he accelerated and charged toward Fang Yuan.

Undeterred by Unfettered Scholar's advance, Fang Yuan calmly maneuvered both hands to strike at him without restraint.

Unfettered Scholar was exceptionally agile; Fang Yuan's grasping giant hands could not even touch his clothes.

Seeing them miss, Fang Yuan shook his body, manifesting two more hands.

Including the one guarding his body, he had now summoned five strength path giant hands!

Each giant hand concentrated the power of twenty thousand strength path phantoms.

Yet Fang Yuan's immortal zombie form was that of an eight-armed zombie.

With eight arms, he could summon up to eight strength path giant hands!

Four strength path giant hands flew through the air, assailing Unfettered Scholar.

Though pressed harder, Unfettered Scholar remained unscathed, laughing loudly: "Sir, is that all you can do?"

True to his title, Unfettered Scholar excelled at movement; Fang Yuan's hands were immensely powerful but lacked the speed to touch him.

Though holding the upper hand, Unfettered Scholar was inwardly shocked.

Fang Yuan's displayed battle strength weighed heavily on him. With Fairy Li Shan and Hei Lou Lan holding back behind him, could they be even stronger?

"Even Unfettered Scholar cannot force out their true strength?" Nearby, Pi Shui Han grew suspicious. "This cannot continue!"

With a resolute gaze, he split the water beneath him, sending a hundred-foot wave crashing toward Fang Yuan's group.

Setting aside past grudges, Pi Shui Han attacked Fang Yuan, joining forces with his rival against this formidable foe.

"Come then!" Fang Yuan laughed fearlessly as three more hands flew out.

With all eight giant hands deployed, three engaged Unfettered Scholar, three attacked Pi Shui Han, and two guarded Fang Yuan.

Hei Lou Lan and Fairy Li Shan also radiated Immortal Gu auras.

The two exchanged glances before one shouted: "Possessing so many Immortal Gu, you must be famous experts. Concealing your identities so deeply—could you be righteous path Gu Immortals?"

Unfettered Scholar shouted: "I know many Northern Plains Gu Immortals. Which old friend is playing a joke, or are you not even from Northern Plains?"

# Chapter 787: Plotting For The Tribe Even After Death

Ever since Eighty-Eight True Yang Building collapsed and Imperial Court blessed land was destroyed, Northern Plains' Gu Immortal world had been frantically searching for the culprit.

Unfettered Scholar and Pi Shui Han acted maliciously, joining forces against Fang Yuan while slandering him to isolate him.

Fang Yuan retorted: "Are you trying to slander me? You look down on every immortal present. My Northern Plains aura is clear for all to see. If you want to defame me, at least concoct a credible lie."

Hei Lou Lan's mouth twitched.

Having their verbal gambit countered, Unfettered Scholar and Pi Shui Han fell silent and intensified their attacks.

Assailed by two rank seven experts at once, Fang Yuan broke into a cold sweat, struggling to defend from all sides.

Though Myriad Self granted rank seven battle strength, sustaining the giant hands heavily strained his arms.

"I have a wood path trump card that could gravely injure one of them, but you must restrain them and shift our location." Seeing Fang Yuan at a disadvantage, an anxious Fairy Li Shan transmitted her message.

Fang Yuan smiled bitterly: "The giant hands are too slow to trap them. Fairy, wait—I have a plan. If this fails, it will not be too late for you to strike."

"Oh?" Fairy Li Shan curbed her anxiety upon hearing this.

After several exchanges, Pi Shui Han and Unfettered Scholar pressed in, deepening Fang Yuan's disadvantage.

"Now." Eyes flashing, Fang Yuan directed six strength path giant hands to slam downward.

Familiar with the giant hands, Pi Shui Han scoffed and Unfettered Scholar smiled, both activating movement killer moves to evade.

Uncharacteristically, Fang Yuan did not halt his attack, continuing to slam all six giant hands into the ground.

This change caught everyone off guard, even Dong Fang Chang Fan's star will below became stunned.

"Oh no." The star will's expression changed, but it was too late to intervene.

Boom!

Six strength path giant hands smashed into the empty air, rippling space with a thunderous roar.

The giant hands shattered countless space path dao marks embedded in the air.

Dong Fang Chang Fan's arrangements shattered, dispelling the illusion to reveal the corpse of an immemorial desolate beast ruin bat.

Around the wound, corroded flesh and fur exposed white bones, where dense space path dao marks wove together to form a small pocket space.

Inside this space stood a hall so dilapidated it resembled ruins.

Fang Yuan's six strength path giant hands breached this small space, connecting it to the outside world.

"Dong Fang Chang Fan's arrangements were broken!"

As the first demonic path Gu Immortal dove downward, the others felt an urgent frenzy and plunged down in pursuit.

While Unfettered Scholar hesitated, Pi Shui Han abandoned Fang Yuan and flew into the tunnel below.

Unfettered Scholar gave Fang Yuan a deep look, then transformed into white light and shot into the tunnel.

Instantly, six new desolate phantom beasts and an ancient desolate phantom beast surged from the space, colliding with the demonic Gu Immortals.

The two sides fought in a chaotic mess again.

"Someone is definitely orchestrating this." Fang Yuan squinted, inwardly surprised.

Old Lord Can Yang was equally startled, the escalating crisis sobering him completely.

Snorting coldly with a cruel smile, he incinerated Tan Wu Feng and Dong Po Kong into charcoal.

Simultaneously, Dong Fang Yu Liang coughed up blood as if struck by lightning and collapsed to his knees.

"Old scoundrel, you killed my men and still dare attack me!" Dong Fang Yu Liang yelled in fury, struggling to rise.

Old Lord Can Yang's eyes darted around, he sneered: "Don't frame me, I did nothing."

Even so, his gaze remained fixed on Dong Fang Chang Fan's star will.

This was his probe to test whether the star will's capabilities were genuine.

Dong Fang Chang Fan's star will sighed: "Since it has come to this, so be it. Everyone, come out."

Once he said that, a change occurred.

In the hall, a mysterious light burst out.

As the light faded, eight Dong Fang tribe Gu Immortals appeared, surrounding Old Lord Can Yang and shouting:

"Speak! Who leaked the information to you in secret?"

Panic flashed across Old Lord Can Yang's eyes. Glaring at the star will in shock and fury, he said: "A plot against me!"

The star will nodded: "Indeed. My main body taught Dong Fang Wan Xiu how to unlock the secret passageway, which he shared with the others. En route, they triggered my arrangements and were stalled by desolate beasts."

"The traitor is clearly among these eight. Stalled by the beasts and fearing the wisdom path inheritance would fall to others, the traitor leaked the secret to you. Armed with this intel, you outpaced the demonic immortals and arrived here first."

The situation was in a deadlock.

Dong Fang tribe had eight rank six Gu Immortals, whereas Old Lord Can Yang was an expert rank seven.

Despite their superior numbers, knowing a traitor lurked among them made the Dong Fang immortals wary of one another, preventing an immediate assault.

Old Lord Can Yang frowned at the star will: "If you targeted me from the start, why wait until now instead of springing your trap before I entered?"

The star will stood silently, refusing to answer.

Old Lord Can Yang realized: "You wanted my strength against the demonic immortals, using Yu Liang's failure to draw me in. The demonic Gu Immortals would become my enemies. With your wisdom, turning me into your pawn would be effortless. Once the demonic immortals and I mutually weakened each other, your tribe would reap the rewards. What a brilliant scheme..."

"Unfortunately, no arrangement is immune to accidents," the star will admitted.

This accident was Fang Yuan's six strength path giant hands.

"Teacher..." Dong Fang Yu Liang stood stunned and helpless, overcome with mixed feelings of joy and sorrow.

He felt joy at the tribe's preparations, yet grief that he and his subordinates were mere bait.

Sensing his thoughts, the star will turned to his chosen heir: "Yu Liang, do not overthink this. I used the wisdom path inheritance to trap our enemies and root out the traitor. Yet the inheritance is real. This enemy hails from Central Continent's Immortal Crane Sect, which boasts its own wisdom path Gu Immortals. Only by placing the genuine wisdom path inheritance here could I avoid leaving flaws for enemy wisdom path Gu Immortals to detect."

"So that is it!" Dong Fang Yu Liang felt both ashamed and deeply admiring.

# Chapter 788: Cards Revealed, The True Traitor's Identity

"Now, Yu Liang, complete the Gu formation. Clear this final round to inherit my main body's true legacy. As for you, Old Lord Can Yang, you die here today," the star will said.

Old Lord Can Yang took a step back, he spoke arrogantly: "Hmph, although I am alone, you are only a group of rank six along with a mere will, you want to take my life? Don't forget that my ally is among you. And outside, ravenous demonic path Gu Immortals will soon overwhelm your phantom beasts!"

The star will chuckled: "In the Remote Antiquity Era, wisdom path's creator, Star Constellation Immortal Venerable, deduced events a million years posthumously, thwarting three Demon Venerables to protect Heavenly Court. Though far inferior to her, I can still deduce matters a century after my death. Having set this trap, I naturally hold trump cards."

Saying so, an illusory Gu formation appeared in the hall.

Old Lord Can Yang's expression darkened: "A phantom formation! To think your phantom path attainment was deep enough to construct one!"

As the Gu formation activated, blinding light engulfed the hall.

Old Lord Can Yang laughed: "If I cannot touch the phantom formation, I will slaughter you all instead!"

"Do not panic; he cannot reach us yet," the star will said calmly.

Old Lord Can Yang charged forward, yet his movements became agonizingly slow.

"This is?" Old Lord Can Yang soon realized that space itself had warped imperceptibly before him.

"I shifted the corpse's space path dao marks into this hall. Though we appear steps apart, the true distance is vast," the star will explained.

The star will continued: "This grand formation uses my wisdom path Immortal Gu as the core and blood path Immortal Gu as support. Once activated, its earth-shaking power is overwhelming. Furthermore, the blood path Immortal Gu gives it tremendous power against Gu Immortals, capable of slaughtering both Old Lord Can Yang and the demonic immortals outside. After this battle, our Dong Fang tribe will be renowned across Northern Plains, feared by both righteous and demonic forces. Once it ends, you can move this formation back to our blessed land. If Yu Liang obtains my inheritance, he will control this formation."

The star will laughed: "Everything has gains and losses. Activating this formation requires extracting the immortal aperture origin cores of Gu Immortals."

"What?" Many of Dong Fang tribe's Gu Immortals shouted in shock.

The immortal aperture origin core was the very foundation of an immortal aperture.

Once extracted, the immortal aperture would regress—its space shrinking and internal lifeforms dying en masse.

Dong Fang Wan Xiu declared: "There is no gain without sacrifice. For Dong Fang tribe, I will gladly sacrifice!"

"No rush." The star will waved his hand, saying slowly: "I have more to tell you all. Once you enter the Gu formation and the extraction begins, none of you can move or leave. Your lives and deaths will be in my control. Are you still willing? If you are not, you can step out now."

The star will chuckled: "In that case, enter the formation."

The phantom Gu formation had eight core points, which the Dong Fang Gu Immortals occupied.

As the Gu formation activated, the Gu Immortals felt their immortal apertures tremble under a powerful suction force, their expressions changing.

"Relax your minds and cooperate; let the formation run fully." The star will was solemn.

Hesitant though they were, the Gu Immortals opened their immortal apertures, allowing traces of their origin cores to be drawn out through the formation's eight core points.

In the phantom formation, a faint blood-colored light quickly surfaced.

Under the blood-colored light, the eight different immortal aperture origin cores converged within the formation, fusing into one.

"Sharing identical bloodlines allows your immortal aperture origin cores to fuse, accumulating immense power!" Dong Fang Chang Fan's star will explained.

The star will laughed lightly: "Regardless of who the traitor is, they are now under my control, contributing strength to our tribe. Everyone, relax, as I extract more of your immortal aperture origin cores."

Just then, Dong Fang Yu Liang stood up, shouting: "Master, I succeeded in completing the Gu formation and fulfilling your request!"

The star will smiled: "Very good, Yu Liang. Enter the formation's center to experience the power of a Gu Immortal. When the battle begins, experiencing the power of a Gu Immortal will greatly help your future."

He leapt into the air, utilizing the phantom formation's power to hover at its central core.

Despite Unfettered Scholar and Pi Shui Han's heavy interference, Fang Yuan finally found an opening.

With the sky before him unobstructed, he seized the fleeting chance and dove down, paying minimal heed to his safety!

Seven strength path giant hands slammed downward while one remained to protect him.

The next moment, Old Lord Can Yang flew up, blocking Fang Yuan's attack and forcing him back into the sky.

"My efforts were not in vain! This plot to regain life through possession culminates now!" The star will laughed loudly in extreme excitement.

Dong Fang Chang Fan's soul suddenly appeared, charging into the formation's center and entering Dong Fang Yu Liang's body.

"Hahaha, you fools! The true traitor of Dong Fang tribe is your beloved Lord Chang Fan, hahahaha!" Old Lord Can Yang laughed maniacally.

# Chapter 789: Blood Veil Obstruct Immortals

"What?" Dong Fang Wan Xiu stared with wide open eyes.

"How could it be Lord Dong Fang Chang Fan? Careful, this must be an illusion! He cannot break the formation, so he is trying to confuse us!"

Old Lord Can Yang scoffed: "Immobile as you are, you are meat on the chopping block and still cannot see the truth."

The star will chuckled leisurely. Though merely a will, he had condensed into his living appearance—an upright frame, a jade-like face, eyes full of splendor, and the graceful aura of a great commander.

The phantom formation transformed again, finally releasing the enormous power it had condensed.

Like surging waves, blood-colored light erupted everywhere, forming a thick bloody veil over the core of the ruin bat's corpse.

"Dong Fang Chang Fan, why are you harming us!?" Dong Fang Wan Xiu snarled, his face twisted in pain and grief.

"Why else? Life is the foundation of everything—who wants to die? As long as a sliver of hope exists, who could resist the temptation?" Old Lord Can Yang sneered, staring unblinkingly at the phantom formation.

Watching the phantom formation operate, Old Lord Can Yang took a deep breath: "This possession technique carries a steep price. Does every activation require sacrificing Gu Immortals?"

Dong Fang Chang Fan's star will shook its head slowly: "Do not worry, Old Lord. I obtained this possession technique in Eighty-Eight True Yang Building; it allows one to possess mortals or Gu Immortals. However, possessing a Gu Immortal requires higher cultivation than the target and leaves one with an ill-fitting immortal aperture with severe drawbacks. While alive, I was a wisdom path Gu Immortal, but lacked a suitable wisdom path target to possess. Thus, I spent years calculating before finally devising this formation."

"This formation was built upon the possession technique. It allows possessing a mortal while fusing bloodline origin cores into a new wisdom path immortal aperture, instantly regaining immortal status."

Hearing this, Old Lord Can Yang sized up the star will, inwardly shocked: 'Dong Fang Chang Fan hid his depth well. Beyond having the top wisdom path attainment in Northern Plains, he can also use space path dao marks to control the phantom beast army. Now, it seems his blood path attainment is also formidable!'

Unaware of Old Lord Can Yang's thoughts, the star will continued: "Do not underestimate this formation. The sacrifice of these eight Gu Immortals supplies me with abundant resources! Old Lord Can Yang, feel free to observe and ask questions. I will explain every crucial step."

He laughed heartily, looking deeply at the star will: "What a scheme, having me safeguard you. I am here to help you fend off these demonic Gu Immortals. When you ascend, the impending tribulation will force me to protect you even if I am unwilling."

Unashamed that his scheme was exposed, Dong Fang Chang Fan's star will smiled and said in a deep voice: "To gain anything in this world, one must pay the price. Nothing comes for free; the more you desire, the higher the risk. What is your decision, Old Lord? Please confirm quickly."

Dong Fang Chang Fan's star will laughed: "Good, I will explain the first step..."

Outside, Fang Yuan looked down at another sight.

An immense blood veil covered the ruin bat's corpse like a mountain, radiant with thick blood-colored light and exuding a terrifying might that made hearts palpitate.

The demonic Gu Immortals turned their attention to the blood veil, ceasing their infighting.

Fang Yuan frowned. Despite his blood path expertise and past memories, he had never heard of this Gu formation.

"Who cares what Gu formation this is? It will break under my hammer!" Gu Immortal Zhuo Zhan shouted and charged forward.

As he neared the blood veil, his blood went out of control and began draining from his body.

While still far from the blood veil, half of Zhuo Zhan's blood had already sprayed out.

"This is the effect of menses blood Gu, drawing out blood."

Fang Yuan frowned. Though a blood path expert previously, he lacked blood path Immortal Gu and was helpless against this formation.

"We must use long-range killer moves! Attack together to destroy Dong Fang Chang Fan's arrangements before fighting for the spoils! Otherwise, a mortal will seize the inheritance right before our eyes. If that happens, I, Unfettered Scholar, will have no face left in Northern Plains!" Unfettered Scholar shouted.

Water, fire, wind, and lightning converged as colorful lights and countless explosions bombarded the blood veil, shaving down its mass.

The blood veil constantly shrank yet unceasingly regenerated; the demonic Gu Immortals' attacks failed to inflict sufficient damage on its deeper layers.

# Chapter 790: Contest of Offense and Defense

Unexpectedly resisted by the blood veil, Pi Shui Han shouted amid the urgency: "Make way!"

As a renowned rank seven Gu Immortal in the demonic path, everyone parted to make way for him.

Water path and ice path killer move — Flood Glacier!

Endless surging waves froze from the inside out, transforming into an enormous glacier pressing down like a heavenly pillar.

In the hall, Dong Fang Chang Fan's star will lost his earlier leisure, focusing entirely on maximizing the formation's defenses.

The glacier heavily smashed at the blood veil.

The blood veil deformed under the immense weight, yet rigidly withstood the glacier's crushing pressure and freezing cold.

Though Flood Glacier was powerful, the blood veil was formed from eight Gu Immortals' origin cores and held firm.

"Even using all eight strength path giant hands together, I couldn't block this move head-on." Fang Yuan's gaze flickered.

"Though myriad self gives me rank seven battle strength, it is only barely at that level. In a true life-and-death battle against an expert like Pi Shui Han, I would likely lose. If I had to confront such a move, I would evade and maneuver rather than clash head-on."

"Cultivation is the foundation. My immortal zombie body offers little growth; I must regain a living body."

"Brother Pi is truly mighty! Let me try my hand." Unfettered Scholar laughed and flew toward Pi Shui Han.

Under everyone's gazes, Unfettered Scholar flew right above the ruin bat's corpse.

Having prepared beforehand, he snapped his eyes open—his pure white pupils shooting out two thin beams of faint white light.

As the white light shone down, the glacier instantly melted and the blood veil shook violently, revealing immense power.

"Hmm? Unfettered Scholar? What a move—thousand disintegrations!" In the hall, Old Lord Can Yang recognized it.

"Chen clan specialized in rule path and among its Gu Immortals, rank six could use the killer move hundred disintegrations, rank seven could use thousand disintegrations, and rank eight could use myriad disintegrations. This killer move excels in both offense and defense, disintegrating almost anything. In Central Continent's history, many sect Gu Immortals suffered crushing defeats against it!" Old Lord Can Yang sighed reminiscently.

"Stop with the nonsense, are you not going to strike? Unfettered Scholar is heavily depleting the blood veil—those are precious origin cores being burned!" Dong Fang Chang Fan's star will urged.

Old Lord Can Yang chuckled: "Unfettered Scholar is alone against eight of you. Watch my method."

He then let out his rank seven aura.

His killer move was potent and illustrious, but consumed immense amounts of red date immortal essence.

Opposing another rank seven while his own allies were divided, Unfettered Scholar knew he could not squander immortal essence. Otherwise, when the decisive clash arrived, running out of immortal essence would render his efforts wasted and hand the advantage to others.

Thinking this, Unfettered Scholar halted his killer move.

"See? It stopped." Old Lord Can Yang laughed heartily with a pleased look.

"The longer this drags on, the more favorable it is for Dong Fang Yu Liang. To breach such a thick blood veil, we must use our trump cards," Unfettered Scholar said, glancing toward Fang Yuan.

"Fairies, protect me while I exert full strength." After receiving confirmation, Fang Yuan sat cross-legged in midair.

Eight strength path giant hands flew towards the blood veil.

Fang Yuan directed eight strength path giant hands to grip the iceberg tightly, digging deep into the ice.

"Rise!" Fang Yuan shouted, and an immediate rumbling echoed in everyone's ears.

Under everyone's astonished gazes, the iceberg covering the blood veil slowly rose, lifting off the ground!

The hall trembled and swayed. Old Lord Can Yang blurted: "This is?"

The star will's expression shifted: "Not good. I anchored the ruin bat's corpse into a corpse mountain. The enemy can pull up mountain roots, directly countering my arrangements! Can Yang, you must make a move!"

"Who is this person?!" Startled and bewildered, Unfettered Scholar unleashed thousand disintegrations at the blood veil once more.

Old Lord Can Yang laughed, finally stepping in: "Witness my life chasing fire."

# Chapter 791: Unstoppable Life Chasing Fire

Immortal killer move — Life Chasing Fire!

Old Lord Can Yang looked solemn, opening his palm to reveal a faint flame.

"Life chasing fire, go." Old Lord Can Yang flicked the flame outward.

The unremarkable flame passed through the blood veil and pierced into the cold iceberg.

Boom!

Almost instantly, a massive yellow flame soared skyward and engulfed the entire iceberg.

For all its fierceness, the fire possessed no heat; the engulfed iceberg showed no signs of melting.

Just as several demonic Gu Immortals began to scoff, rank seven Gu Immortal Pi Shui Han shrieked miserably.

Engulfed in flames, Pi Shui Han twisted in agony, venting cold air and rivers of water to defend himself. Yet the faint yellow flame did not weaken, burning even fiercer.

"Could this be... life chasing fire?" Realizing danger, Fang Yuan hastily withdrew his giant hands.

The fire engulfed the iceberg and swiftly spread to the eight strength path giant hands.

Though the hands remained unharmed, faint flames appeared within Fang Yuan's immortal aperture, incinerating his strength path phantoms!

Recognizing the terrifying killer move, Fang Yuan decisively willed his strength path phantoms to collapse.

Without the phantoms, the eight strength path giant hands pulling the iceberg also crumbled.

Boom, the ruin bat's corpse mountain crashed down with a massive tremor, cracking the ground and scattering stones amid swirling dust.

Fang Yuan suffered intense backlash from halting Pulling Mountain, trembling with severe dizziness and nausea.

Seeing this, Hei Lou Lan quickly moved to support him.

Fang Yuan, however, evaded and shouted: "Don't approach me!"

He retreated quickly as faint yellow flames began burning his body just like Pi Shui Han.

Meanwhile, Unfettered Scholar paled, struck by the move and similarly engulfed in flames.

"This fire path immortal killer move actually tracks auras back to their source, directly reaching our immortal apertures!" Unfettered Scholar was greatly shocked.

Immortal killer move — Thousand Disintegrations!

This time, the light shone not on the iceberg and blood veil, but onto himself and his immortal aperture.

Under the white light, the faint yellow flame continuously disintegrated and weakened rapidly.

Soon, the flames on his body completely dispersed, and the fire in his immortal aperture was suppressed.

Shortly after, Fang Yuan stood up as the fire on his body completely dissipated.

Only Pi Shui Han's flames burned hotter; charred black, he had no choice but to activate healing Gu while enduring the blaze.

Suddenly shouting aloud, Pi Shui Han soared high and, engulfed in flames, shot away like a meteor.

Inside the hall, Old Lord Can Yang laughed heartily to Dong Fang Chang Fan's star will: "How was that?"

"Truly worthy of being called life chasing fire," the star will nodded. "It traces auras back to their source. Gu Immortals normally store Gu worms in their immortal apertures, so it burns inside them. It fuels itself on life force, requiring special methods like Thousand Disintegrations to extinguish. Otherwise, one must sever the burning parts before it consumes bodily life force; without fuel, the fire disperses. Unfortunately, Pi Shui Han failed to realize this and continuously healed himself, increasing his life force and intensifying the fire."

"Life chasing fire... Old Lord Can Yang... why is he here?" Hovering in the air, Fang Yuan looked down at the blood veil in doubt.

'Not good,' Fang Yuan thought, urges to retreat rising within him.

Central Continent forces had secretly infiltrated Northern Plains hunting him, already investigating his Sha Huang identity.

"I extinguished the fire quickly because as an immortal zombie, my dead land aperture has almost no life force to burn. Old Lord Can Yang is experienced and may have recognized me as an immortal zombie. Hiding like this might arouse his suspicion!" The more Fang Yuan thought, the heavier his mood grew.

# Chapter 792: Lightning of Heaven and Earth, Risky Attempt

To Fang Yuan, a wisdom path inheritance was not worth exposing his identity to Northern Plains' pursuers.

Realizing the dire situation and considering retreat, Fang Yuan naturally stopped his attacks.

Seeing the demons quiet down, he smiled: "The time is ripe; my possession starts now. Old Lord Can Yang, I explained the initial steps. The crucial moment has arrived; I must trouble you to guard me."

Suddenly, a large vortex formed on the surface of the blood veil.

Blood energy condensed in the vortex and erupted downward in a giant pillar, engulfing Dong Fang Yu Liang in the phantom formation.

Old Lord Can Yang's eyes widened as he shouted: "Damn it!"

Old Lord Can Yang understood: the blood veil was purifying and melting the eight extracted immortal aperture origin cores together. The demonic immortals' attacks tempered the molten cores, eliminating their wills before funneling the fused product into the vessel.

Dong Fang Chang Fan had calculated everyone into his scheme; even Fang Yuan had unknowingly served as his blacksmith.

As blood energy flowed inward, the blood veil weakened dramatically. Bound by sect duty and promised benefits, Old Lord Can Yang acted.

Seeing the blood veil weakening, the demonic path Gu Immortals indeed were moved.

The Gu Immortals unleashed a torrential barrage.

Channeling blood energy inward while enduring the barrage, the strained blood veil swayed unstably.

Old Lord Can Yang had to act, unleashing the immortal killer move — Final Afterglow!

A faint sunset light barrier formed outside the blood veil, halving the power of every incoming attack that passed through.

With Dong Fang Yu Liang's soul eliminated, Dong Fang Chang Fan seized the body and focused on the aperture.

Filled with blood energy, the aperture ruptured with a loud roar.

Dong Fang Yu Liang's aura rose higher instead of shrinking.

An astonishing transformation was occurring — surpassing mortal, charging to Gu Immortal!

In the clear sky outside, a lightning bolt flashed.

Within breaths, dark clouds surged and spread across the clear sky.

Heaven and earth qi churned as a heavenly tribulation and earthly calamity formed!

"Someone is actually ascending to immortal inside?!"

The Gu Immortals quickly stopped their attacks, feeling baffled.

"Amazing! This is the heavenly star lightning tribulation."

Pitch-black lightning balls erupted from craters, exploding violently against the corpse mountain.

In just breaths, countless lightning strikes bombarded the iceberg, smashing it to pieces and scattering ice everywhere.

Even Unfettered Scholar was moved: "Tyrannical heavenly star lightning and underhanded earth ghost lightning... These two great lightning tribulations are called the twin lightnings of heaven and earth, their power is increased further when they combine. Even I have to worry if I face them!"

Inside the corpse mountain, Old Lord Can Yang strained grimly to maintain Final Afterglow.

This ingenious defensive killer move was pushed to its utmost to weaken the twin lightnings of heaven and earth.

However, all of Old Lord Can Yang's effort only weakened the lightning by fifteen percent.

With his red date immortal essence depleting rapidly, sweat soon beaded on his forehead.

"How could this tribulation be so strong!" Dong Fang Chang Fan's star will muttered worriedly.

Fifteen minutes, thirty minutes, one hour, two hours... time continued to pass, but the lightning tribulations from heaven and earth did not show any signs of weakening, instead they were constantly increasing in strength.

"Of course! The tribulation's abnormal power is all because of you, Dong Fang Chang Fan." Old Lord Can Yang said, "You are dead; by fate, your soul belongs in the Door of Life and Death. Reviving and attempting immortal ascension is truly defying heaven! No wonder heaven and earth are so enraged!!"

Dong Fang Chang Fan's star will laughed: "Ever since Red Lotus broke fate, destiny has been in our own hands. So what if I defy heaven? My fate is in my own hands! With all my planning and preparations, I will definitely succeed!"

He had just spoken when they heard a rumbling sound.

Dong Fang Chang Fan's star will shook and instantly dispersed!

Blinding white light filled the world, forcing the demonic immortals to retreat in alarm and Old Lord Can Yang to shut his eyes.

From the white light, a ray of divine lightning struck down.

Fierce divine lightning swept past all obstacles, shattering Final Afterglow and the blood veil toward Dong Fang Yu Liang.

At the brink between life and death, 'Dong Fang Yu Liang' suddenly opened his tightly closed eyes!

Rage surged within him: 'Fluctuating light! A tribulation within a tribulation... Accursed heaven, I refuse to die!'

The phantom formation started to give off bright radiance.

Boom!!!

A piercing explosion resounded. Endless rays of white light shot out from the ruin bat's corpse.

The Gu Immortals retreated kilometers until the blinding rays dispersed before returning.

Nothing remained of the enormous, lofty ruin bat's corpse mountain.

In the air above, a young figure stood proudly, looking at Fang Yuan and the others.

Dong Fang Yu Liang!

# Chapter 793: Myriad Star Fireflies versus Band of Experts

"Dong Fang Yu Liang? Am I seeing wrongly?"

"How did he become a Gu Immortal? It seems this heavenly tribulation and earthly calamity was caused by him."

"Becoming an immortal on the spot, was that Dong Fang Chang Fan's inheritance? Sigh, a mortal actually snatched it!"

'Dong Fang Yu Liang' was expressionless; devoid of pupils or whites, his eyes flickered continuously with multicolored crystalline light.

Bristling at his arrogance, the demonic immortals shouted: "Arrogant junior! Take my hammer!"

The demonic path Gu Immortals charged toward 'Dong Fang Yu Liang', fearing they would be left behind.

Unaware that Dong Fang Chang Fan had possessed the body, Fang Yuan remained wary of Old Lord Can Yang.

"Dong Fang Yu Liang appeared, but where is Old Lord Can Yang?"

Old Lord Can Yang stood concealed behind 'Dong Fang Yu Liang', undetected by the demonic immortals.

Quite injured, he saw the immortals charging and transmitted to 'Dong Fang Yu Liang': "Do you need my help?"

'Dong Fang Yu Liang' quickly rejected him: "No need, let me deal with them!"

If Old Lord Can Yang was exposed, Northern Plains would ostracize 'Dong Fang Yu Liang' for colluding with Central Continent.

Furthermore, he wanted to crush his foes alone to rebuild his reputation and restore his tribe's power.

Though alone and merely at bottom-tier rank six, Dong Fang Yu Liang was neither flustered nor scared.

His lips curled into a mild smile, as if in complete control of the situation.

Pulling back his white sleeve, Dong Fang Yu Liang raised his right arm, pointed at the sky, and spoke leisurely word by word: "Myriad. Star. Fireflies."

Hearing this, the immortals halted their advance, their expressions changing.

Myriad Star Fireflies was Dong Fang Chang Fan's signature, world-renowned wisdom path killer move.

This wisdom path killer move was the pinnacle of Dong Fang Chang Fan's battle strength, its fame deeply ingrained in Northern Plains Gu Immortals' hearts.

"He is just a newly ascended Gu Immortal; how can he manipulate so many Gu worms immediately?" Lu Qing Ming snickered.

"Hmph, I lost to Myriad Star Fireflies back then. I wonder how much of its power you can use?" Unfettered Scholar's expression flashed with rage.

The clouds had just cleared, yet darkness now descended, dimming the world.

Amidst the surrounding darkness, countless firefly-like spots of light appeared, dancing across the sky.

Starlight burst out, it was a brilliant and dazzling sight!

"Myriad star fireflies!!" The demonic path Gu Immortals cried out in alarm as they fell amidst the star fireflies.

Unfettered Scholar paled; this was truly Myriad Star Fireflies, seemingly even stronger than in his memories!

Specks of starlight attacked them from all directions.

A single speck was weak, but millions together formed an overwhelming swarm.

Crucially, each starlight speck contained a star thought.

Even if destroyed, the specks released star thoughts that forced their way into the Gu Immortals' minds.

Endless starlight specks breached defenses, releasing star thoughts that invaded the Gu Immortals' minds.

"What are you doing?!" Beside Zhuo Zhan, a demonic path Gu Immortal shouted angrily.

Zhuo Zhan's face turned purplish-red: "Sorry, my attack changed directions all of a sudden!"

"Infiltrated by star thoughts so quickly—you're more trouble than help!" the nearly hit immortal snapped.

"Stop fighting amongst yourselves! We must escape—staying in Myriad Star Fireflies only increases danger!"

Another rebuked: "Escape? He is only rank six while we have numbers and Lord Unfettered Scholar. Attack!"

With Pi Shui Han gone and Fang Yuan far away, Unfettered Scholar was the only rank seven battle strength here, their pillar of support.

He and Dong Fang Chang Fan had fought before, having lost to Myriad Star Fireflies in the past.

Having learned a bitter lesson from that defeat, he had focused on studying Dong Fang Chang Fan, gaining a much deeper understanding of Myriad Star Fireflies than others.

Unfettered Scholar knew this: once inside the move's range, one would be plotted against, and each of a Gu Immortal's thoughts would produce star thoughts.

Myriad Star Fireflies formed these star thoughts into starlight specks to attack the Gu Immortal.

In intense battle, Gu Immortals considered many things; as their minds raced, they generated more star thoughts.

The more star thoughts produced, the stronger the killer move became, especially with more Gu Immortals in range. Once star thoughts completely overtook their minds, they would become Dong Fang Yu Liang's puppets, fighting for him.

Even before reaching that stage, star thoughts induced mistakes—like earlier, when Zhuo Zhan nearly injured an ally.

Thus, myriad star fireflies suited fighting multiple enemies rather than a single foe. Against a crowd, foes restrained each other, making the battle easier to win.

"Dong Fang Yu Liang wants this. We are numerous yet disunited, and in battle we will only hinder each other. Not only that, earlier fighting suggests a fire path Gu Immortal is hiding here as well."

As Unfettered Scholar pondered rapidly, far more starlight specks gathered around him than anyone else.

Yet despite these concerns, Unfettered Scholar did not retreat; his battle intent surged!

"Losing to Dong Fang Chang Fan was my greatest humiliation. How could I retreat before his successor? If I flee without fighting, which Northern Plains Gu Immortal would ever respect me?"

# Chapter 794: Internal Threat, Chaotic Battle, Advance or Retreat

His resolve set, Unfettered Scholar's vigor rose as he shouted: "Fight! The enemy is just one person—anyone afraid can leave!"

Flicking his sleeve, Unfettered Scholar used a killer move to dispel the surrounding starlight and charged at Dong Fang Yu Liang.

Obscuring vision and invading minds, the starlight sowed chaos among the immortals, expanding Dong Fang Yu Liang's advantage.

Immortal killer move — Thousand Disintegrations!

Unable to prolong the fight, Unfettered Scholar unleashed his trump card killer move.

"Right. Dong Fang tribe's headquarters is at its weakest in history. Imagine the wealth of an undefended super force..." Fang Yuan spoke leisurely, yet his words ignited blazing ambition in both women.

"Then what are we waiting for? Let's rob Dong Fang Chang Fan's base!" Hei Lou Lan eagerly flew toward their headquarters.

# Chapter 796: Everyone With Different Intentions, Going After Precious Treasures

Pi Shui Han prepared to counterattack, but froze as Fairy Li Shan and Hei Lou Lan unleashed their auras.

Pi Shui Han's eyelids twitched; gritting his teeth, he halted his attack.

Fairy Li Shan explained: "Thatched Hut stores Dong Fang tribe's public wealth; even Dong Fang Chang Fan couldn't embezzle it. As for Miniscule Mountain, it requires earth qi to stabilize its form and cannot be easily moved. Furthermore, Dong Fang Chang Fan forged his righteous path alliance agreement upon it!"

"The chances they were moved are slim. Follow my directions to Thatched Hut's location stealthily."

# Chapter 797: Flick, Flick, Flick, Subduing a Shark Fin Wolf

Hei Lou Lan replied excitedly: "Rest assured, little aunt, I'm already deep in the pool, tunneling underground!"

Midair, Fairy Li Shan coughed up blood—backlash from the alliance pact—yet she endured it.

Wiping the blood, she continued transmitting: "I'll scout from above. Move stealthily and stay undetected by the other Gu Immortals. Especially Fang Yuan—he is shrewd enough to make even Pi Shui Han dance to his tune. Our Snowy Mountain Alliance nears its end; remain on guard against him."

"That goes without saying!" Hei Lou Lan quickly replied.

Suddenly, the thumb slightly relaxed and the middle finger flicked.

It very accurately struck this male wolf's penis!

"Awoooo—!" The desolate beast shark fin wolf convulsed as if electrocuted, eyes nearly bulging out as it howled to the sky in boundless agony.

The desolate shark fin wolf's resolve broke completely, and it yielded.

The giant hands released it, and the wolf collapsed. It curled like a shrimp, paws clutching between its hind legs as it whimpered weakly.

Fang Yuan mumbled while chuckling: "This is a good method."

He then turned to look at the distant Half Moon Brutemaster.

He had naturally already discovered the latter's stealthy glances.

Half Moon Brutemaster felt Fang Yuan's gaze coil around him like an icy snake.

Half Moon Brutemaster shivered as an ominous chill rose from deep within his heart, feeling particularly cold between his legs.

"This person is exceedingly savage. I must avoid him!" Half Moon Brutemaster swallowed hard and fled rapidly.

# Chapter 798: Extorting Regretful Spiders

After subduing the desolate beast shark fin wolf, Fang Yuan stored it in his immortal aperture.

He continued searching pools, but found only vast quantities of common, unremarkable resources.

With countless pools and competing demonic immortals, finding treasures depended largely on luck.

Not long later, good luck arrived once again for him.

Fang Yuan identified them as eerie fire dragon pythons.

Fang Yuan felt excited—every part of the eerie fire dragon python held value. Its blood fed blood path Gu worms, while its skin and tendons served as premium refinement materials. In particular, its gallbladder was exceptionally precious and sold well in treasure yellow heaven.

He had obtained some eerie fire dragon python eggs in Imperial Court blessed land that had since hatched in Hu Immortal blessed land, though he had neglected them due to their small numbers.

Raising this large group in Hu Immortal blessed land would provide a steady supply of gallbladders to sell in treasure yellow heaven as supplementary income.

Lacking refined methods, Fang Yuan acted crudely. Pressed for time, he captured roughly ten thousand pythons before decisively leaving the fire pool.

Fang Yuan flew past pools after pools.

Feeling increasing urgency as time passed, he began bypassing common resources.

Meanwhile, Fang Yuan remained vigilant for any arrangements Dong Fang Chang Fan might have left behind.

Flying further, Fang Yuan suddenly spotted deep pools devoid of water.

These fifty to sixty completely dry, interconnected pools spanned tens of li.

Intrigued, Fang Yuan veered sharply and rapidly approached the pools.

"I discovered these pools first, the regretful spiders inside are mine!"

"Aren't you too greedy? You've already collected so many, and with these regretful spiders spread over such a vast area, you want them all for yourself?!"

Drawing closer, Fang Yuan found two demonic path Gu Immortals tensely arguing over ownership at the edge of a pool.

Seeing Fang Yuan approach, the two Gu Immortals paled, ceased their argument, and stood side by side.

"Senior, forgive us, but we discovered these regretful spiders first. According to the rules, hehe..." one Gu Immortal stammered vigilantly.

"Our demonic path rampages freely—what rules?! If you want rules, join the righteous path! Only Pi Shui Han qualifies to discuss rules with me." With a fierce demeanor, Fang Yuan slowly advanced the two giant hands, flaunting his might.

The two demonic Gu Immortals dared not speak, yet remained reluctant to leave.

The other demonic Gu Immortal steeled his resolve and said, "Senior, I desperately need these regretful spiders. How about I exchange information of equal value for them?"

"Hmm? What information?" Fang Yuan halted the strength path giant hands.

"This information concerns Miniscule Mountain." The demonic path Gu Immortal spoke directly.

"Miniscule Mountain, hahaha!" Fang Yuan laughed heartily, then threatened, "Good, I'll exchange. But your information had better be true, otherwise..."

"It is true. I couldn't break through, but Senior can." The demonic Gu Immortal transmitted the coordinates to Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan's eyes narrowed as he listened, remarking leisurely, "Good, but its authenticity remains to be verified. Hand over the regretful spiders you just gathered."

"Senior, you!" The demonic path Gu Immortal's eyes widened, flushing with anger.

Fang Yuan sneered matter-of-factly: "What if your information is false? These regretful spiders serve as collateral. Don't worry, I only want what you've gathered; the rest is yours."

"Senior, if you renege, wouldn't I..." the extorted demonic Gu Immortal squeezed out through clenched teeth.

"What?! Do you think I'm that shameless? Why would a senior cheat juniors?!" Fang Yuan retorted angrily, manifesting two more strength path giant hands.

# Chapter 799: Knowing When to Retreat and Advance, A True Champion

Gu Immortals cannot casually take it, and this Miniscule Mountain belongs to no individual Dong Fang Gu Immortal."

Fang Yuan raised his defenses, but just as he prepared to enter, two figures appeared nearby.

"Fang Yuan, wait a moment." Fairy Li Shan transmitted her voice.

Hei Lou Lan stood silently at the side.

"Oh, it's you two!" Fang Yuan smiled faintly, eyes flashing.

Hei Lou Lan spoke without awkwardness: "Fang Yuan, you arrived at the right time; we were just worrying over how to breach this place."

Fairy Li Shan added unabashedly: "Right. This place is called captivating sea, a restricted region of Jade Pool blessed land. It has an illusory peach tree forest above a sea of flowers and groundmat grass. The fragrant sea of flowers includes tens of thousands of poisonous purple heart flowers close to blooming."

Though lacking poison path cultivation or strength path poison defenses, Fang Yuan's immortal zombie body was highly poison-resistant, and he possessed the poison path Immortal Gu, Woman's Heart.

Seeing Fang Yuan listening indifferently, Fairy Li Shan continued: "Though numerous, those are minor issues for Gu Immortals. "As a wood path Gu Immortal, Fairy Li Shan naturally covets Miniscule Mountain and minimen. In captivating sea, her battle strength should exceed her normal state. Yet after breaching deep into the flower sea, they were still repelled. Captivating sea's defenses far exceed my expectations."

Fang Yuan lowered his head in thought without replying immediately.

Moments later, he shook his head with a bitter smile: "Beneath this juicy meat lies a tough bone. Miniscule Mountain is great, but time is too limited to waste here. I advise you both to drop unrealistic thoughts; plenty of easier resources lie outside, so why take unnecessary risks?"

Fang Yuan remained firm: "The defenses are tight, guarded by both Gu Immortals and a pack of peach wolves. Even if all demonic Gu Immortals here united, breaching this place would take time. Would Dong Fang Chang Fan give us that time? And what about the other demonic immortals?"

Fairy Li Shan stepped forward: "Fang Yuan, that's reasonable, but this is Miniscule Mountain—its value might exceed all the rest of Jade Pool blessed land!"

"Hahaha, Fairy, don't waste your breath. I'll take my leave!" Laughing loudly, Fang Yuan flew away.

# Chapter 800: Three Fish Groups, Great Harvest

# Chapter 801: Big to Small, Suppressing the Demonic Cultivators

# Chapter 802: Looting Persistently, Internal Strife

# Chapter 803: Band of Demons Repels Righteous Immortals

Fang Yuan joined Fairy Li Shan to obstruct Old Lord Can Yang.

# Chapter 804: Old Schemer Vanishes Without a Trace

# Chapter 805: A Short Break, Another Battle

By nightfall, Dong Fang Chang Fan's body gradually faded and vanished, leaving behind a lump of Gu worms.

Fang Yuan collected the remnants, finding only rank five Gu worms disguised with heavy Immortal Gu aura.

"I lost him. Dong Fang Chang Fan has likely escaped—as expected of a legendary super force leader, he has countless trump cards. The priority now is returning to Jade Pool blessed land to plunder its remaining resources."

Dong Fang Chang Fan sat on the ground, deathly pale. His newly possessed body was heavily injured, with bones visible and flesh exposed to the air.

His aura weak, Dong Fang Chang Fan furrowed his brow: "Defying heaven truly incurs the wrath of heaven and earth. Thankfully, abandoning Miniscule Mountain and feigning split shadow allowed me to escape."

"Bodily injuries are minor; eliminating the internal threat is critical. Without immortal essence, a battle of wills is my only chance to defeat these nine wills."

The battle of wills was vicious, depending purely on the wills themselves rather than cultivation level.

The wills of Dong Fang tribe's eight Gu Immortals and Dong Fang Yu Liang joined forces to resist Dong Fang Chang Fan's will.

Though initially evenly matched, Dong Fang Chang Fan's will soon fell at a disadvantage.

"Dong Fang Chang Fan, you deceived us, you betrayed us!"

Of the ten wills, only Dong Fang Chang Fan and Dong Fang Yu Liang could recover and grow.

The former had possessed the body and occupied the mind to replenish his will, while the latter was the original owner, most compatible with the body.

Knowing this, they sacrificed themselves to protect Dong Fang Yu Liang's will, allowing him to grow stronger.

"I left my injuries unhealed to slow his recovery, but in a war of attrition, his will will outlast mine."

He now had to stake his life, using his will to influence and destroy the other wills from within.

Determined, Dong Fang Chang Fan dispersed his will like a river, directly engulfing the other nine wills.

"Dong Fang tribe was destroyed in your hands..." Dong Fang Yu Liang raged.

Dong Fang Chang Fan's will remained calm: "As long as I live, our tribe can rise again. In The Legends of Ren Zu, to escape ordinary abyss, Ren Zu abandoned even his own daughter!"

"He didn't abandon her, self Gu caused trouble!" Dong Fang Yu Liang's will rebuked.

Dong Fang Chang Fan sneered: "Whose self Gu was that? It was Ren Zu's self Gu, his deepest thoughts! To stop being ordinary, what is sacrificing a tribe when even wives and children can be cast aside?"

"Without me, Dong Fang tribe would have perished long ago! I nurtured you and gave you everything you achieved! I planted this tree through my own efforts, while you merely sat in its shade, eating the fruits of my labor!"

These thunderous words dealt a heavy blow to the nine wills.

Scenes of his life replayed in reverse, flooding Dong Fang Chang Fan's mind.

Remembering his solitary resolve in the dark hall, he sneered: "If heaven wants me to die, I will defy heaven!"

# Chapter 806: Outcome Concluded, Turning Around and Leaving!

"Young man, what is your name?" the old beggar asked warmly, his messy purple hair resembling uncut grass.

"Dong Fang Chang Fan." He said.

"Chang Fan... this name does not suit you." The purple-haired beggar's eyes were deep as an abyss.

The beggar studied him before saying: "You are a good child; I shall pass my most important inheritance to you. Barring surprises, you will surely make a name for yourself."

The three super forces—Dong Fang, Meng, and Gong tribes—had gathered for a martial competition.

Under everyone's gaze, his opponent stepped onto his head in the arena.

"Dong Fang Guang Yao, by our battle rules, you must promise me one thing! I detest your name—I'll give you a new one for life. Let's go with Dong Fang Chang Fan! Hehehe, this suits you better," his opponent mocked.

"Okay... from today on, I change my name to Dong Fang Chang Fan," he squeezed out reluctantly.

"I swear to avenge this with my own hands and lead Dong Fang tribe back to glory! This is the aspiration of Dong Fang Chang Fan—let heaven and earth bear witness!!!!"

Reliving Dong Fang Chang Fan's life in an instant, the engulfed wills understood his deep anguish over his sacrificed tribe.

Before this will, the nine wills ceased resisting and crumbled into nothingness.

The battle of wills was extremely perilous, but he won in the end!

"Eh?" His eyes widened as a black-robed Gu Immortal appeared before him out of nowhere!

It was Fang Yuan.

"This is not luck," Dong Fang Chang Fan said. "Thirty split shadows barely delayed you. Above this cavern lies an ordinary rabbit den, yet it failed to deceive you. Your intelligence is far scarier than your strength."

Fang Yuan smirked: "Heh, is this a dying man's final praise?"

Dong Fang Chang Fan smiled faintly: "A pity you arrived late. A few breaths earlier, I would still be trapped in the battle of wills. But now..."

"As expected of Northern Plains' number one wisdom path immortal!" Fang Yuan praised.

Fang Yuan said warmly: "Man proposes, heaven disposes. If this next method fails, I will leave immediately."

Saying so, he took out a person from his immortal aperture.

Seeing this girl, Dong Fang Chang Fan's expression changed.

The nearly dispersed will solidified instantly, surging up to regain control of the body.

"Sister!" He shouted.

Within a breath, Dong Fang Chang Fan suppressed the will again, glaring at Fang Yuan with burning rage.

Fang Yuan laughed heartily, assessing the situation: "Dong Fang Yu Liang, your sister is in my hands—watch closely."

Saying so, he reached out with his monstrous zombie hand, seized the girl's left shoulder, and pulled.

Dong Fang Chang Fan's pupils shrank to pinpricks as he roared: "Damn it..."

Before he finished his words, he lost control again, Dong Fang Yu Liang emerged.

"Sister!! You dare harm her, you actually dare harm her!!!" Dong Fang Yu Liang screamed madly.

"Good, this is how it should be." Fang Yuan chuckled sinisterly, launching a strength path giant hand.

The giant hand was about to grab Dong Fang Yu Liang, when a light pillar burst out from his body.

The pillar blocked the giant hand as Dong Fang Chang Fan roared: "A Gu Immortal stooping to torture a mortal—despicable!"

Severely weakened, Dong Fang Chang Fan's soul could not escape.

Fang Yuan easily caught him.

The inheritance of Northern Plains' number one wisdom path immortal was obtained!

# Chapter 807: People Who Refuse to be Ordinary

The Legends of Ren Zu, Chapter Three, Section Eighteen states:

Embarking on his road of life, Ren Zu left the door of life and death, only to end up in ordinary abyss.

Cognition Gu advised: "Human, following others' trails offers no hope if you wish to become extraordinary and leave ordinary abyss. Since you walk your own road of life, you must brave every hardship yourself, innovating and carving your own footprints."

Cognition Gu added: "You cannot become extraordinary while seeking comfort—walk through the thorns and blades."

Taking the hint, Ren Zu gritted his teeth and deliberately walked along paths covered in thorns and blades.

Whenever he lifted his foot and moved forward, a small stem of grass grew in his footprint.

The name of this grass was — accomplishment.

"This way, I won't lose my way." Ren Zu endured the pain, tenaciously trudging through thorns and blades.

Gradually, the grass growing from his footprints turned into accomplishment trees.

Even after the forest covered the entire ordinary abyss, Ren Zu found no way out.

He plucked a fruit and tasted it, but it no longer tasted sweet, only bitter and hard to swallow.

Perplexed, Ren Zu investigated and discovered that a second heart had quietly grown within his body.

This heart was called discontent.

His heart spoke in self Gu's voice: "Plant an accomplishment tree taller than ordinary abyss, and you can climb it to escape."

Self Gu said: "Foot blood produces only ordinary trees. Use heart blood to grow a great accomplishment tree. Blades lie buried under ordinary abyss—stab your heart with them, and use the flowing heart blood to water the trees."

The more blades he drove in, the more heart blood flowed, growing ever larger trees.

When a tree's crown finally reached the height of ordinary abyss, its trunk cracked open and a girl emerged.

This was Ren Zu's fourth child, called Boundless Forest Samsara.

Boundless Forest Samsara urged him: "Father, why exhaust yourself? We have fruit, shelter, and peace here until old age."

Ren Zu firmly shook his head, planting an even greater tree whose branches stretched completely beyond ordinary abyss.

Boundless Forest Samsara wept, clinging to him: "Father, don't abandon me. I cannot climb trees—I will starve alone."

Ren Zu said: "Why would I abandon you? You are my daughter, I will carry you and leave this place."

Cognition Gu warned: "This is your accomplishment tree; it cannot help others become extraordinary, not even your daughter."

Hope Gu urged: "Put her down! Your heart blood is exhausted—this is your last hope, and the tree is collapsing!"

Fang Yuan returned to Dang Hun palace to continue researching the wisdom path inheritance.

# Chapter 819: Returning To The Blessed Land, Putting Up A Show

Hu Immortal blessed land.

# Chapter 820: Insufficient Wealth To Refine Immortal Gu
