# Chapter 821: Strategy To Attack Blessed Land, Conversation About Dao

Tai Bai Yun Sheng was stunned before laughing: "Junior brother, you mock me! I've heard that phrase countless times since beginning cultivation; it has rung in my ears ever since. Even mortals know it."

Fang Yuan nodded: "This phrase originated from the first rank nine Gu Immortal, Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable. Yet in my opinion, it is not brilliant enough. I summarize it in a single word—Dao."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng sat up straight, eyes shining as he repeated: "Please enlighten me."

Fang Yuan said slowly: "Man is the spirit of all living beings—possessing the highest intelligence and comprehension, humans understand heaven and earth to experience the Great Dao. Gu are the essence of heaven and earth. Uniquely among living beings, mortal Gu contain meager traces of the Great Dao, while Immortal Gu harbor law fragments. Hence, they are the essence of heaven and earth."

"What is Dao? Water flowing downward, hunger, trees growing from rain—all are Dao. Gu Masters unleashing fire, lightning, or healing wounds with Gu worms are likewise Dao."

"By nurturing, using, and refining Gu, humans utilize Gu worms to display the might of heaven and earth, gradually grasping the laws of the world through life and procreation. Upon becoming a Gu Immortal, the aperture turns immortal, and dao marks are carved onto the body. One could say Gu Masters nurture Dao when nurturing Gu, use Dao when using Gu, and refine Dao when refining Gu. Gu Masters walk diverse paths—strength, fire, time, poison—each forged step-by-step into cultivation routes by predecessors exploring the unknown."

Fang Yuan paused before concluding: "In other words, Gu Master cultivation is fundamentally cultivating Dao."

"When Gu Masters cultivate, they are basically cultivating Dao..." Tai Bai Yun Sheng sat frowning as he pondered Fang Yuan's words.

Fang Yuan continued: "The immortal aperture—a blessed land or grotto-heaven—is a small world containing dao expressed solely through dao marks."

"For instance, my Hu Immortal blessed land possesses basic time path dao marks, allowing it to draw in a tributary of the River of Time so time can flow within. It also has substantial space path dao marks, keeping it vast and allowing Hu Immortal land spirit to teleport freely. It is richest in enslavement path dao marks. Because of these marks, Hu Immortal blessed land aids in raising foxes, enslaving fox-like beast groups, and promoting the growth of desolate beasts."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng nodded in agreement: "Exactly! My Tai Bai blessed land has mostly time path dao marks, making time resources abundant—one day outside equals thirty-three days within. Having the fewest earth path dao marks, it lacks mountains and has infertile soil. In terms of space path dao marks, it is only ordinary—the area isn't large, but the sky is very high."

"That is why I said a blessed land's offense and defense boil down entirely to its composition of dao marks," Fang Yuan continued.

"Blessed lands restrict enemies and suppress their Gu worms because their abundant dao marks act like a pond. Mortal Gu contain traces of Dao, like water droplets or sparks. Dropped into a pond, a droplet easily merges, while a spark is easily extinguished. Once the blessed land's dao marks activate, heavenly power is enforced and mortal Gu lose effect."

"Why are Immortal Gu unrestricted? Because they are unique law fragments, like rocks. Toss a rock into a pond, and no ripple can halt its entry. Yet while Immortal Gu cannot be sealed, their power is amplified or suppressed by the blessed land's dao marks."

"Invading Gu Immortals are similarly suppressed by a blessed land's dao marks. Yet Gu Immortals possess immortal bodies fundamentally different from mortals—simply put, bodies carved with dao marks! During an invasion, the more dao marks a blessed land has, the greater the suppression on the immortal; conversely, the more dao marks on the Gu Immortal's body, the less suppression they experience."

"Truly insightful!" Tai Bai Yun Sheng sighed in realization. "I understand now. Public blessed lands have weak defenses because they are pieced together from fragments sacrificed by numerous Gu Immortals. Their dao marks are chaotically mixed, canceling each other out without forming cohesive strength—like five fingers from different people, they act individually rather than forming a fist."

"Blessed land that have a sole origin also have dao marks that are pure. If there are land spirits, they can expend immortal essence and mobilize the dao marks to use the heavenly power. Immortal Gu are the law fragments, there are dao marks on the desolate beasts' bodies, Gu Immortals have been mentioned already, Immortal Gu Houses are formed by combining Immortal Gu, while immortal killer moves are the fusion of many types of dao marks, they are an effect or great power formed from varying sources."

"Thus, the purer a blessed land's dao marks, the harder it is to conquer; land spirits and immortal essence merely assist in mobilizing them. Looking at Imperial Court blessed land, if not for the land spirit and Eighty-Eight True Yang Building contesting against each other, if it was fully protected, how could it be destroyed?"

Saying this, Tai Bai Yun Sheng rose, straightened his posture, and bowed to Fang Yuan: "Hearing your words has truly enlightened me, answering my questions and teaching me much. From today onwards, I would not dare to call you junior brother, a skilled person is a teacher, on the road of cultivation, you have already surpassed me."

"Hehehe, Old Bai, this is just casual talk. No need to be humble; you already knew this deep down, just less clearly than me." Fang Yuan waved his hand, calm and composed.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng looked solemn: "No, simple as it is, this reasoning is profound. The concept of 'dao' far surpasses the adage 'man is the spirit of all living beings, Gu are the essence of heaven and earth." I was quite ignorant in the past, only now have I seen the essence of Gu Master cultivation. This reasoning, I am afraid ordinary Gu Immortals have not comprehended it yet.""

In truth, Fang Yuan understood this because of his advantage as a transmigrator.

The two spoke a while longer before Tai Bai Yun Sheng took his leave.

Though they had regularly communicated via Gu, this face-to-face talk erased any lingering distance between them.

Having already saved Dang Hun Mountain before, Tai Bai Yun Sheng completed the process smoothly and without incident.

Yet pooling the resources of all four allies might make it affordable.

From Dong Fang Chang Fan's inheritance, I obtained an immortal killer move called star fog concealment. It shields against heavenly secrets and suits our needs."

If you increase the scale of production, Immortal Crane Sect is bound to become even more jealous, if the balance in their mindsets change, they might target Hu Immortal blessed land again, what will you do then? We have enough trouble already, the less complications, the better."

Fang Yuan went silent before replying: "You're right, forget it."

After Fairy Li Shan left for Snowy Mountain, Hei Lou Lan remained in a stone nest refining airsac Gu for Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan began with hope but met disappointment; Lang Ya land spirit's attitude was an impenetrable iron wall.

"Targeting my hairy men? Don't even dream of it! To trade with me, there is only one way—complete the mission!" Lang Ya land spirit reiterated his demand for the rank six immortal material, poisonous flower petals.

Intrigued, Fang Yuan pondered before asking: "If I obtain this immortal material, will you sell me hairy man slaves or your rearing experience?"

Lang Ya land spirit waved his sleeves dismissively: "Impossible, anything involving hairy men is not for sale! But if you find that immortal material, I can give you the all-out effort Gu recipes. In fact, I have not only the rank one to five recipes, but also the rank six all-out effort Immortal Gu recipe! Isn't that what you need?"

This enticing bait tempted Fang Yuan, though it also stirred a trace of annoyance.

With his plans failing, Fang Yuan sighed and focused on the upcoming calamity.

Two days later.

"Myriad self giant hand, rise!"

Fang Yuan activated his immortal killer move; four of the eight strength path hands gripped Dang Hun Mountain's sides while the other four hoisted its base aloft.

Dang Hun Mountain rose swiftly, suspended tens of meters above the ground in moments.

From a distant stone nest, Hei Lou Lan watched the massive Dang Hun Mountain floating in midair and murmured: "In such a short time, he grew stronger again..."

Lifting the mountain was far easier now, having fully integrated Pulling Mountain Immortal Gu as a core component of myriad self.

"Don't just stare, take it." Fang Yuan shouted.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng quickly opened his immortal aperture as the eight giant hands steadily carried Dang Hun Mountain inside.

"Next, the land spirit will guide you to collect resources in the blessed land," Fang Yuan said.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng nodded and, teleported by Little Hu Immortal, vanished from sight.

Fang Yuan landed on the ground.

Sitting with eyes closed, he activated Time Luck Immortal Gu as countless mortal Gu soared from his dead aperture.

Consuming green grape immortal essence, Time Luck Immortal Gu worked alongside the supporting mortal Gu to form a vast white-gold mist of light.

The radiant mist drifted through the grey sky for several li toward a group of captive Gu Masters.

As the mist enveloped them, the captives screamed: "What is this thing?"

The spiral spun briefly before erupting into a towering white-gold pillar of light.

Immortal killer move —Time Assist Luck!

The light pillar surged out from his aperture, coursing up his spine and shooting through the crown of his head into the sky.

Simultaneously, the white-gold spiral inside his aperture dispersed, leaving the Dong Fang tribe captives dead across the decaying ground.

Such was the effect of time assist luck—plundering others' lifespan to grant the Gu Immortal a temporary surge in luck.

"I won't give in!"

Suddenly, numerous vengeful remnant souls emerged within Fang Yuan, coiling around his soul and attacking fiercely.

Directing his soul, Fang Yuan slaughtered them one by one, annihilating the remnant souls at great cost.

After the battle, Fang Yuan's soul had shrunk to thirty percent of its original size—dim, severely injured, and flickering like a dying candle.

He crushed airsac Gu one after another, releasing guts Gu to heal and nourish his battered soul.

Moments later, Fang Yuan's soul made a full recovery, returning to peak condition.

Tempered like forged steel, his soul was now denser, firmer, and more refined than before.

"The backlash of remnant souls is time assist luck's greatest flaw, yet surviving it offers the benefit of tempering the soul," Fang Yuan noted, weighing the killer move's pros and cons.

# Chapter 823: Advantages Outweigh Disadvantages, Time Assist Luck

Second, time assist luck could only be used once a month, measured by the time experienced by the immortal body.

Fang Yuan retrieved Time Luck Immortal Gu and the supporting mortal Gu, then instinctively looked up.

"Pity I lack Luck Inspection Immortal Gu to check my luck or gauge time assist luck's efficacy. Wait—though I cannot inspect myself, I can inspect others!" A thought struck him.

He possessed mortal Luck Inspection Gu; though useless on himself, his luck was connected to Ye Fan, Han Li, and Hong Yi.

Fang Yuan could not inspect his own luck, but he could inspect the others—after all, they were still mortals!

Southern Border.

In a lush mountain forest, Ye Fan bounded along the ground like an ape.

His eyes had turned golden rather than normal black and white as he fixed an anxious gaze on a blue speck of light ahead.

"This blue face Gu is so slippery! But I must capture it—altering my appearance is vital while I'm wanted!"

Suddenly, an odd itch welled in Ye Fan's chest.

Glancing down, Ye Fan saw thick ape fur already covering his arms, and his heart sank: "Damn it! I forcibly activated ape transformation; the longer I maintain it, the more fur grows, and exceeding the limit might turn me into a half-ape monstrosity. Yet if I stop, my speed will drop, and I'll only watch this wild blue face Gu escape..."

As Ye Fan faced this dilemma, dark clouds rapidly gathered, and within breaths, bean-sized raindrops escalated into a torrential downpour.

The downpour blinded his vision, causing Ye Fan to completely lose track of the blue speck.

Crackle... Just then, a bolt of lightning struck a large mountain tree.

The tree crashed down in flames that spread rapidly, defiant of the rainstorm.

"Tung Oil Mountain is covered in flammable tung trees. I must leave quickly before a wildfire traps me."

Fifteen minutes later, he stood at the mountain base, watching the wildfire rage uncontrollably despite the heavy rain.

Sighing, he turned to leave when a flicker of blue light caught his eye.

It was that blue face Gu!

Covered in thick soot, the blue face Gu was clearly heavily injured.

Ye Fan snatched it; severely weakened by the fire, the wild blue face Gu was refined in mere breaths.

Thrilled by this unexpected harvest, he was about to leave when he suddenly froze stiff as a statue.

Behind the blue face Gu, three more heavily injured wild Gu worms were fleeing the blaze, flying straight toward him...

Western Desert.

Across a rocky beach, boulders of all sizes formed a sprawling natural rock field.

Breathing heavily, Han Li sprinted across the jagged rocks, enduring the fierce pain in his legs.

"Brat, drop those three nodding stones!" a rank three Gu Master roared in hot pursuit.

Han Li ran even faster when he heard the voice.

Ahead, a towering pile of boulders loomed larger and larger.

Unwilling to let him escape, the rank three Gu Master gritted his teeth and unleashed his trump card.

With the remaining ten percent, he punched out a stone fist.

A direct hit would have killed Han Li instantly.

Thus, the stone fist grazed Han Li's right leg and smashed into the boulder pile, sending shattered rocks and dust flying with muffled booms.

Han Li was severely injured, his right leg instantly fractured.

Yet possessing a resolute will and knowing his life hung by a thread, he yelled and leaped forward with all his strength.

His petite frame slipped right into a narrow crevice.

"Brat, keep running if you can!" the rank three Gu Master sneered, stepping closer with a vicious grin.

Boom!

Suddenly, the massive boulders forming the crevice collapsed directly onto him.

His sternum crushed and lungs punctured, the Gu Master struggled briefly before dying.

Han Li was left stupefied on the spot.

Central Continent.

Universal Life Academy.

The Gu refinement competition had already entered its final round.

Sixteen young Gu Masters sat cross-legged on the plaza, refining Gu simultaneously under everyone's watchful eyes.

With the Central Continent Refinement Path Convention approaching, even a small sect like Universal Life Academy held a participation quota.

Now, sixteen disciples were battling for that single student slot.

"This competition will soon reach the crucial moment."

"Indeed. Refining red face Gu requires hands and mind coordinating flawlessly to regulate the flame."

"Look, Cao Yu has reached this stage. He's intentionally slowing down to give himself ample reaction time."

After a while, two others entered this final barrier.

"As expected, they are Xie Lan and Lu Wen."

"Together with Cao Yu, they are recognized as our academy's top three refinement path prodigies."

# Chapter 824: Blood Poison Kerria Flowers, Seventh Calamity

Turning the topic to Hong Yi, the refinement hall elder remarked: "Speaking of which, your son Hong Yi is remarkably talented to reach the finals. What's most impressive is that he achieved this despite not being a refinement hall disciple and having barely practiced."

The principal snorted: "You only praise him because he is my son—do you think I can't tell? He reached the finals on dogshit luck alone, dabbling in everything without working hard at anything. Learning everything means mastering nothing. After this competition, send him into seven days of seclusion to reflect on himself."

Sweat covered Hong Yi's forehead as he stared at the flame in his hands.

In the fire, the Gu worm was gradually taking form.

"Finally at the last step, but I wasted too much time!" Hong Yi observed the others as he refined.

"Forget it, I can only take a shot in the dark. In a refinement path master's hands, red face Gu is refined in an instant. The fire is hard to control, so the others are slowing down. I can't finish instantly, but if I surpass their speed, I have a chance of winning."

His sneeze blew at the fire, instantly extinguishing the flames.

Hu Immortal blessed land.

Fang Yuan, Tai Bai Yun Sheng, the Hu Immortal land spirit, and Hei Lou Lan floated in the air, awaiting the earthly calamity.
