As they waited, earth qi started to rumble as the earthly calamity began.

Stalks of flowers breached the ground and grew rapidly, blanketing Hu Immortal blessed land in bright red within a few breaths.

"This is the blood poison kerria," Fang Yuan said quietly.

In this blood calamity, the flowers wilted within ten breaths, liquefying into toxic blood that contaminated the blessed land and devastated living beings.

Only wood path techniques were suited to counter them; destroying blood poison kerria by any other means would simply turn it into a pool of poisonous blood.

The flowers quickly wilted into ankle-deep poisonous blood, blanketing the ground across the entirety of Hu Immortal blessed land.

The eastern lake was completely tainted. In the west, wolf and fox groups suffered countless deaths, their corpses lying in the blood pools as their spilled blood fed the toxic mire.

In the south, rockman slaves were rudely awoken, many sprouted with blood poison kerria. When the flowers wilted into poisonous blood, the rockmen wailed in pain, though few died.

Hei Lou Lan consoled him: "Tribulations are hard to endure; this is already quite good. Though most of the land is polluted and your losses are severe, the earth qi has settled. The calamity is over."

Little Hu Immortal's eyes were watery: "Master, we have to clear the poisonous blood! The polluted soil won't yield anything for years, and our pink flower rabbits, wolves, and foxes suffered heavy losses!"

He used pulling water Immortal Gu to siphon the poisonous blood into his immortal aperture.

His immortal aperture was a dead land full of death energy and devoid of life, leaving nothing for the poisonous blood to pollute.

Yet with poisonous blood blanketing the vast blessed land, even using pulling water Immortal Gu was too slow.

After a day and a night, Fang Yuan finally extracted all the poisonous blood into his immortal aperture.

Though the poisonous blood was gone, the topsoil remained thoroughly toxic, oozing bloody red mush when squeezed. Left unsettled, it would rot within days into poisonous blood and contaminate surrounding soil.

Though Tai Bai Yun Sheng had Landscape as Before to restore the land, Fang Yuan chose not to use it.

Working together over several days, Fang Yuan, Tai Bai Yun Sheng, and Hei Lou Lan removed the soil layer. Moving all the poisonous soil into his aperture left even Fang Yuan's immortal zombie body thoroughly exhausted.

---

# Chapter 825: Developing the Blessed Land, Lou Lan Comes to a Realization

After the earthly calamity ended, Hei Lou Lan stayed in Hu Immortal blessed land, her safest refuge at present.

Under Fang Yuan's arrangement, she continued using strength qi Immortal Gu to help the stone nests' hairy man slaves mass-refine airsac Gu.

With so many airsac Gu stored, guts Gu production could no longer keep pace.

Fang Yuan changed his refinement plan, assigning one stone nest to airsac Gu and the other two to mortal star thought Gu.

This made Hei Lou Lan grit her teeth in anger.

Their prior agreement dictated that Hei Lou Lan would help refine airsac Gu before the tribulation, and all profits from selling guts Gu stored in them would go entirely to Fang Yuan.

Now that the tribulation had passed, subsequent guts Gu sales were supposed to include Hei Lou Lan's share of the profits.

The three stone nests belonged to Fang Yuan; he could refine whatever he wanted without consulting her.

Unwilling to give up easily, Hei Lou Lan approached Fang Yuan, urging him to allocate at least two stone nests to airsac Gu to boost guts Gu sales.

Fang Yuan warmly feigned difficulty: "Fairy Lou Lan, refining airsac Gu has killed countless hairy men. Replenishing them is expensive, whereas refining star thought Gu is much milder and causes fewer deaths. I've lost thirty percent of my slaves and must be frugal after the tribulation's heavy losses."

Feigning poverty before an unhappy Hei Lou Lan, Fang Yuan smiled: "Actually, my earlier suggestion remains the best approach. We can pool our funds to buy knowledge on raising hairy men, then buy slaves and breed them ourselves. As a long-term investment, it is exceptionally worthwhile."

Fang Yuan mentioned his suggestion again as Hei Lou Lan sighed in her mind.

Fang Yuan's plan benefited all four of them, yet Fairy Li Shan had objected immediately when he first proposed it.

Because Fang Yuan would be the biggest winner, gaining far too great an advantage.

Fang Yuan was developing too quickly for a veteran Gu Immortal like Fairy Li Shan to permit; their Snowy Mountain Alliance would eventually expire.

Hei Lou Lan sighed with tightly knitted brows, dropping the conversation and turning to leave.

Fang Yuan smiled and called after her: "This is not urgent, Fairy, do give it some thought."

"Wait, no!" Hei Lou Lan slowed down after a few breaths: "Even with reduced airsac Gu refinement, Fang Yuan has a huge inventory. He can easily maintain guts Gu sales—or even sell several times the current amount!"

Her flight slowed further as her heart grew colder: "This was Fang Yuan's scheme targeting me! His monthly revenue won't fall—it might even rise. What about me? I refined all the airsac Gu in inventory, but under our earlier deal I earn nothing from them. With little aunt facing so many problems now, Fang Yuan is exploiting the timing to take advantage of me! How can I trouble little aunt further when she has already helped me so much?"

"I have the Great Strength True Martial physique, Fang Yuan is only an immortal zombie, but unknowingly, he has already gone far ahead of me."

"My greatest weakness is lacking economic support. Gu Immortal cultivation isn't just about fighting—management is the foundation, and in that I lag far behind."

Thinking of this, Hei Lou Lan slapped herself across the face a few times.

"Time to wake up!" Her expression turned steel-firm: "From youth, I was nurtured as successor. Raised with abundant resources, I lacked economic awareness. Fang Yuan has awakened me—truly, the best teacher is your strongest enemy! My first step now is to become truly independent!"

Having gained this awareness, she stopped approaching Fang Yuan, focusing instead on developing profitable businesses suited to her immortal aperture.

He first took Dang Hun mountain out of Tai Bai Yun Sheng's immortal aperture, and returned it to the center of Hu Immortal blessed land.

Next, he started creating new homes for the dragonfish and air bubble fish.

Reorganizing the area was a massive project: Fang Yuan excavated around the original lakes and ponds, then arranged Gu worms to establish formations within the earth.

At the base of each Gu formation, he filled the ground with large amounts of purchased fertile soil.

For the dragonfish and air bubble fish lakes, Fang Yuan laid dragon scale and jade root soil.

Located in eastern Hu Immortal blessed land, these were the two largest lakes.

Dragon Scale Lake was the largest, containing countless dragonfish and even a desolate beast dragonfish.

Above Jade Root Lake, a thick cloud plain grew star fragment grass where swarms of starlight fireflies fed and danced, creating a sky of beautiful starlight specks.

---

# Chapter 826: New Dao Marks, Deeper Foundation

Fang Yuan had also placed starlight fireflies and star fragment grass into Tai Bai Yun Sheng's immortal aperture; recombining them restored their original scale.

The blood poison kerria's toxic blood had only contaminated the ground, leaving the airborne star fragment grass completely unharmed.

Dragon Scale Lake and Jade Root Lake sat opposite each other at a distance, surrounded and linked by many small lakes like stars encircling twin moons.

Remaining water wolves and shark fin wolves lived in these small lakes, where Fang Yuan's subdued desolate shark fin wolf also roamed, eating fish when hungry.

Hardy blue jade carp filled the lakes, with a portion mutating into blood jade carp.

In the west, Fang Yuan excavated soil and arranged Gu formations to build Charcoal Lake.

Fang Yuan named it Charcoal Lake, the second-best breeding ground for eerie fire dragon pythons—behind only Dong Fang tribe's setup in Jade Pool blessed land.

He placed the eerie fire dragon pythons inside to multiply. Moving further away, Fang Yuan dug small lakes at set intervals, sealed them with simple Gu formations, and poured the poisonous blood from his immortal aperture into them.

Isolated by the Gu formations, these poisonous blood lakes would only seep slightly each year, contaminating surrounding soil.

Across western Hu Immortal blessed land, Fang Yuan dug hundreds of small blood lakes.

For instance, the previous earthly calamity—a desolate swamp crab carrying Gruel Mud Immortal Gu—had targeted the blessed land's most valuable feature, Dang Hun Mountain. As a result, Dang Hun Mountain began dissolving into gruel mud and was only narrowly saved by Fang Yuan.

Heaven valued balance; any exceptional superiority drew heaven's envy, prompting calamities to weaken it. Though not absolute given the sheer variety of tribulations, this probability was very high.

After the swamp crab calamity, Hu Immortal blessed land had gained abundant enslavement path dao marks alongside a few earth path dao marks.

More enslavement path dao marks made it easier to control captive populations and boosted their reproduction, including rockmen, hairy men, foxes, wolves, and fish.

This was Hu Immortal blessed land's greatest strength, as Hu Immortal was an enslavement path Gu Immortal; after each tribulation, enslavement path dao marks increased the most.

The earth path dao marks enhanced soil fertility, firming the ground to absorb more earth qi and support Dang Hun Mountain.

As for the blood poison kerria calamity, Fang Yuan guessed heaven and earth had sent it in response to his blood path grandmaster attainment.

Surviving the calamity granted another influx of dao marks—predominantly enslavement path, accompanied by numerous blood path dao marks.

The mutation into blood jade carp was only one manifestation. After Fang Yuan painstakingly removed the topsoil, the newly exposed layer sprouted abundant tender grass and delicate flower buds.

The blood sickle grass blades grew sharp as knives.

Both were excellent materials, capable of refining rank three mortal Gu.

Once mature, the widespread blood sickle grass and red axe flowers would yield astonishing quantities, serving as a lucrative source of wealth.

Poisonous blood seeping into the soil had mutated existing roots and seeds into blood sickle grass and red axe flowers. Crucially, the new blood path dao marks remodeled the blessed land's environment, creating the foundation for both plants to thrive.

Rank six Gu Immortals face an earthly calamity every ten years and a heavenly tribulation every century. After three hundred years—surviving thirty earthly calamities and three heavenly tribulations—they can advance to rank seven.

Though weaker than heavenly tribulations, every earthly calamity was a difficult heavenly test, fraught with danger yet brimming with opportunity.

The newly added dao marks reformed the blessed land to produce more valuable resources, supplying the necessities for Gu Immortals to cultivate.

Hu Immortal had weakened repeatedly until, facing her fifth earthly calamity, she died at the hands of the blue charm lightning shadow.

After inheriting the blessed land, Fang Yuan barely overcame the sixth calamity, the desolate beast swamp crab; it had now passed seven earthly calamities.

This latest earthly calamity added blood path dao marks, creating an environment suitable for blood sickle grass and red axe flowers.

Like an experienced farmer suiting crops to the soil, Fang Yuan managed the blessed land by playing to its strengths. For this reason, he had forbidden Tai Bai Yun Sheng from using Landscape as Before, opting instead to dig poisonous blood lakes.

"Beyond these plants, with these blood path dao marks, I can raise blood stripe foxes. Their reproduction rate is higher than any fox group previously raised in Hu Immortal blessed land. The annual yield will be even greater. If I purchase knowledge on raising them, with some luck, I could turn them into a modest income source."

Blood stripe foxes required importing blood stripe rabbits for food.

He also planned to purchase poison beard wolves to foster competition for the foxes.

Fang Yuan's remodeling of Hu Immortal blessed land finally concluded.

Western lakes now outnumbered the east, with Charcoal Lake at the center.

Hundreds of small poisonous blood lakes were evenly spaced across the western region, forming a magnificent spectacle from a bird's-eye view. Meanwhile, more blood stripe foxes were continuously imported from outside, swelling their numbers daily.

---

# Chapter 827: Fang Zheng Wakes Up

In the south, some rockmen still hibernated underground. Because countless blood poison kerria flowers had bloomed and died within their tunnels, these subterranean dwellings would yield bloodstone ores after several decades. The underground cave sheltering wisdom Gu was restored with Landscape as Before. Though weakened, the zhi forest could purge the poison independently without treatment, potentially mutating into a blood zhi forest.

The northern part of the blessed land, narrower and smaller, was arranged as a breeding ground for regretful spiders.

At the center stood Dang Hun Mountain. In Dang Hun Palace, Dong Fang Chang Fan's soul was imprisoned alongside the remaining Dong Fang tribesmen, while storerooms held abundant immortal materials. Immense quantities of oil water, the worldly sand gull egg, and stockpiled airsac Gu filled the storerooms.

By now, the three major resource points—eerie fire dragon pythons, regretful spiders, and dragonfish—were truly established. Rather than merely being stored, they could now multiply and be sold for profit.

The day after Hu Immortal blessed land was restored, Tai Bai Yun Sheng bid farewell to Fang Yuan.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng prepared to return to Northern Plains, place down his blessed land, and absorb earth qi.

While Tai Bai Yun Sheng departed, Hei Lou Lan remained behind.

Soon, Fang Yuan also departed for Central Continent.

Central Continent's Refinement Path Convention was about to begin!

Central Continent, Fei He mountain, Immortal Crane Sect.

In an underground secret room of Immortal Crane Sect, damp and dark with mossy walls, sat only a single stone bed.

On the stone bed lay a young Gu Master with a paper-pale face and no visible injuries, seemingly comatose.

It was Gu Yue Fang Zheng.

Faint light flashed in the room as a Gu Immortal appeared.

Handsome with wide sleeves, his long green eyebrows reached his waist above dark, eerie eyes.

"Lord He Feng Yang!" The Gu worm on Fang Zheng's chest fluttered up, greeting him excitedly.

This was the spirit incubating flea housing Lord Sky Crane's soul.

"Lord, please heal Fang Zheng's soul, please awaken my disciple." Lord Sky Crane implored.

"Sky Crane, is this still your decision?" He Feng Yang sighed in disappointment.

"Sky Crane, do you know the possession technique our Immortal Crane Sect obtained is virtually flawless? In the past, possession might have caused body-soul mismatches and side-effects. Heaven offers you this opportunity—why refuse it?" He Feng Yang urged.

"Lord..." The spirit incubating flea fluttered its wings, replying softly, "Forgive my obstinacy. Fang Zheng is my disciple. He resembles my past self, and this future belongs to him. Possessing him would betray my own conscience. Please, Lord, remember my years of service and grant my request."

Yet he held his tongue, unable to help seeing his own past in Lord Sky Crane's plight.

He Feng Yang sighed deeply: "Fine. Since you are resolved, I will help you as compensation for your past service. But should you seek possession later, my aid will not be free."

He Feng Yang waved his wide sleeve past Gu Yue Fang Zheng's face.

With that, He Feng Yang vanished.

A few breaths later, Fang Zheng's soul stabilized, and he awoke from his coma.

"You're awake!" The spirit incubating flea fluttered before his eyes.

Gu Yue Fang Zheng was dazed: "Mas... Master, where are we?"

"In Immortal Crane Sect, of course, foolish disciple," Lord Sky Crane laughed heartily.

"Why am I here?" Fang Zheng mumbled in confusion, before suddenly shivering in terror.

He recalled the blood pool—the horror of blood vines overrunning his body as he peered into Hu Immortal blessed land.

"Aaaahh!" Gu Yue Fang Zheng screamed and subconsciously leaped back.

The back of his head slammed into the stone wall, knocking him unconscious.

Lord Sky Crane: "..."

Three days later.

Immortal Crane Sect officially announced that Gu Yue Fang Zheng had awakened.

Fang Zheng reappeared before the disciples, shockingly possessing rank five cultivation.

During morning assembly, the sect leader publicly appointed Fang Zheng as an elder of Immortal Crane Sect.

Still adjusting to his new status, Fang Zheng felt at a loss.

Fortunately, Lord Sky Crane guided him, while the sect leader occasionally inquired after his well-being, leaving Fang Zheng overwhelmed by such favor.

Having previously sacrificed Fang Zheng, the higher-ups showered him with perks to rebuild his loyalty.

He subconsciously evaded the horrifying memory of peering into Hu Immortal blessed land. Only in late-night dreams would the agony of the blood pool return, waking him drenched in cold sweat.

---

# Chapter 828: Five Virtues Mountain, Five Virtues Sect

One day, returning from another elder's lecture, Fang Zheng was stopped by a disciple named Shi Hong.

"I seek Elder Fang Zheng's guidance. One of the four entry tasks for the Refinement Path Convention involves refining earth treasury flower Gu. The third from last step requires matching upstream grass with zen lion's mane through a refinement method, but I always fail. What is the correct technique?"

"This..." Fang Zheng froze. Though highly proficient in enslavement path and crane manipulation among mortal Gu Masters, he knew nothing of refinement path.

Fortunately, Lord Sky Crane transmitted the answer through the spirit incubating flea.

Fang Zheng replied: "That technique is called 'one after another'. It entwines every stalk of upstream grass with a strand of zen lion's mane. Thus, without familiarity with this technique, failure is likely."

Shi Hong's expression shifted to astonishment before bowing: "Thank you for your guidance, Elder Fang Zheng, I have learned much."

After parting ways, Fang Zheng walked a short distance before slowing his pace.

He frowned in realization: "Shi Hong didn't come for real advice—he was deliberately trying to make things difficult for me."

"Hehe, you noticed it? Good, good." Lord Sky Crane smiled.

"Nonsense, your age and background are common knowledge. Everyone knows you don't cultivate refinement path, so why else would Shi Hong ask such a question if not to trouble you?"

"Why?" Fang Zheng did not understand.

Lord Sky Crane explained: "Because Shi Hong likes a disciple named Yi Yue, daughter of Elder Yan Tang. Elder Yan Tang is weak and sidelined in the sect, facing constant difficulties. He wants to marry her to you—the youngest elder in sect history—to form a beneficial alliance. Why else would he invite you for drinks and deliberately seat her beside you every time?"

"Foolish boy, every organization is held together by benefits. Genuine warmth is rare and precious," Lord Sky Crane sighed. "Don't shy away from this, and don't refuse Elder Yan Tang. Even if you don't marry his daughter, don't ruin your relationship. Right now, you are even weaker than he is."

"Master, everyone is talking about the Refinement Path Convention lately. What is it?" Fang Zheng asked.

"Refinement Path Convention, is it an event of refinement path Gu Masters?"

"Not quite. Gu cultivation involves nurture, use, and refinement. The convention is open to anyone with skill, experience, or insight in Gu refinement, not just refinement path specialists."

Lord Sky Crane continued: "It is the world's largest refinement path event. Hundreds of thousands of Gu Masters from sects across Central Continent take part, and participants even arrive from the Eastern Sea, Western Desert, Southern Border, and Northern Plains."

Fang Zheng then asked: "What are the four entry tasks Shi Hong mentioned?"

Lord Sky Crane explained: "The four entry tasks serve as qualification tests. Every Gu Master refines Gu at some point in cultivation. Hence, the four entry tasks filter for those with genuine skill and refinement attainment."

"With my guidance and intense training, you can succeed as well."

"Truly? My vision will be expanded!" Fang Zheng was joyous.

Central Continent, Five Virtues Mountain.

Five Virtues Mountain, modest in height and situated in eastern Central Continent, was the base of the mid-sized Five Virtues Sect.

Five Virtues Sect held considerable influence, founded by a former elder of Heavenly Lotus Sect.

Disguised as a mortal Gu Master, Fang Yuan moved with the crowd up Five Virtues Mountain.

To his left, a shabbily dressed master and disciple were conversing.

"Master, there are so many people!" the disciple exclaimed excitedly.

The master chuckled: "Stay close. With your great talent in refinement path, this is your chance for a meteoric rise. You'll pass the four tests easily, but you must secure a top ranking so factions will compete to recruit you."

As the master spoke, a sudden shove sent him sprawling from behind.

"Out of the way!" five burly men shouted, advancing arrogantly.

Behind them, an old Gu Master with a dangerous glint in his eyes sat comfortably in a sedan carried by four men.

"Flying Frost Sect's lord first elder is here—make way!" the men bellowed.

"Damn it, that's outrageous!" The disciple rushed to confront them.

"Are you deaf? Make way!" the men yelled furiously behind Fang Yuan, trying to shove him aside.

Fang Yuan ignored them, not even turning around.

"Hmm?" The men's fury instantly turned to shock: "Rank five cultivation?"

Disguised as a rank five Gu Master, Fang Yuan deliberately released a wisp of his aura.

From his sedan, Flying Frost Sect's first elder, An Han, straightened up and stared at Fang Yuan's back.

"Rank five aura... it's genuine! Such a disguise... a demonic Gu Master..." An Han narrowed his eyes and commanded, "Go around him!"

The burly men promptly detoured around Fang Yuan.

Nearby cultivators stopped, several stepping forward to curry favor with Fang Yuan.

Facing these people, Fang Yuan only said one word — "Scram."

Chilled to the bone, the crowd blanched and dared not disturb him further.

# Chapter 829: First Round of Gu Refinement

Entering the Disciple Selection Stage, he located spot sixty-three and sat down.

Once everyone was seated in the square, a Five Virtues Sect elder declared: "The four entry tasks begin now!"

Instantly, hundreds of Gu Masters on the Disciple Selection Stage began displaying their skills.

Dozens of starlight specks danced from Fang Yuan's hands like blue fireflies flitting around him.

Sequentially adding the refinement materials, Fang Yuan completed all tasks in fifteen minutes and stood up.

Knowing Fang Yuan was rank five, the elder in charge had watched closely in shock.

"What, someone already finished?!" Fang Yuan's movements drew the attention of many refining Gu Masters.

Fang Yuan stepped onto the highest platform as the Five Virtues Sect elder rose to inspect his four Gu worms.

"No flaws—the Gu worms are well-fed and healthy." Secretly shocked, the Five Virtues Sect elder cupped his fists and said warmly: "Lord, please come this way into the mountain."

Fang Yuan nodded, slowly leaving the Disciple Selection Stage.

Here for the Refinement Path Convention, Fang Yuan had no need to hide his skill; as a Gu Immortal, concealing his ability was unnecessary.

As he walked up the mountain, a Five Virtues Sect elder approached him: "Sir, please hold on..."

Fang Yuan waved his hand, cutting him off: "I know your intention, and I have no interest. A mere Five Virtues Sect cannot accommodate me."

The elder was stunned before rage flashed on his face.

"What else do you want?" Fang Yuan looked at him coldly.

The elder's face turned purple, he snorted coldly: "Sir, you actually are looking down on our Five Virtues Sect, aren't you being too arrogant?"

"You want to duel me?" Fang Yuan's voice was cold.

Reining in his anger, the elder stared deeply at Fang Yuan: "Good, good, good! Since you think so highly of yourself, I'm sure you will achieve a great rank in the Refinement Path Convention. Five Virtues Sect will be watching!"

Saying so, he waved his sleeves and left.

Indifferent, Fang Yuan continued along the cliff until he reached the wood virtue hall.

Inside the hall, elite Five Virtues Sect disciples managed rows of tables and chairs. Seeing Fang Yuan enter, a disciple stepped forward: "Senior, may I ask for your name, sect, and main cultivation path?"

Fang Yuan replied: "My name is Fang Yuan. My sect and main path will remain secret."

Fang Yuan tossed him the prepared primeval stones.

A short while later, Fang Yuan obtained a token.

The token bore the name 'Fang Yuan', while the back read: Sect hidden, path hidden, registered at Five Virtues Sect, followed by the registration timestamp.

"Senior, please safeguard this token. If lost, replace it immediately, otherwise you cannot join the Refinement Path Convention. Please proceed up the mountain. The first refinement round is at the fire virtue hall; passing it qualifies you for the second round," the disciple explained patiently.

Taking the token, Fang Yuan left the wood virtue hall.

Established by the ten great ancient sects, Central Continent's Refinement Path Convention was secretly backed by Heavenly Court.

The convention was massive, with hundreds of sign-up locations across Central Continent. Most were powerful sects like Five Virtues Sect, closely tied to or representing the ten great ancient sects.

Because many demonic Gu Masters and cultivators from the other four regions signed up, registration was flexible. Names could be made up, and sects and paths omitted—only the token mattered.

Holding the token, Fang Yuan walked up the mountain into the fire virtue hall.

"I must refine at least a hundred rank one water light Gu in thirty minutes to pass into the second round, two hundred and forty takes third place, two hundred and sixty takes second, and two hundred and seventy-six earns first place, rewarding the heat-toxin healing rank four green shine Gu."

With his high status, the rewards held no appeal for Fang Yuan, but the challenge itself intrigued him.

"Refinement materials are provided for free alongside the recipe for water light Gu, which I can follow casually. Yet even going all out with water refinement, I can only refine two hundred and fifty—only third place, which has already been taken at Five Virtues Sect."

"First place isn't impossible. I could add expensive materials to increase yield; since water light Gu is only rank one, rank two or three materials would boost production. However, I'd have to bear the cost myself. I could also easily modify the recipe using my wisdom path inheritance without wisdom Gu's help, but that would ruin the fun of the challenge. Hmm.., maybe I can try a water-fire refinement technique. Water light Gu is usually refined with water or ice, but doing the opposite with fire refinement might yield unexpected results!"

# Chapter 830: Red Lotus Demon Venerable's Inheritance Clues

Thirty minutes later, Fang Yuan claimed first place and obtained the green shine Gu.

Though he had barely practiced water-fire refinement, water light Gu was simple enough that even his rusty technique produced two hundred and seventy-seven—one above the first-place threshold.

Fang Yuan's exemplary performance prompted the sect leader of Five Virtues Sect to visit personally, apologizing for the elder's attitude and tactfully hinting at recruiting him.

Fang Yuan flatly rejected him, yet the sect leader remained unoffended, politely seeing him out to the astonishment of onlookers.

Fang Yuan left Five Virtues Sect and returned to Hu Immortal blessed land.

"Master, master, I've prepared everything you wanted!" Little Hu Immortal appeared the moment he returned, bringing good news with an expression begging for praise.

"Very good." Fang Yuan patted her head, and she happily closed her eyes in delight.

Fang Yuan had instructed the land spirit to prepare mortal Gu worms, bought from treasure yellow heaven and refined by stone nest hairy men.

Taking the mortal Gu, Fang Yuan mobilized a stream of star will from his mind into his immortal aperture.

In his immortal aperture, Mo Yao's fake will was imprisoned.

"Fang Yuan? What will is this?" Seeing Fang Yuan's arrival, Mo Yao's fake will felt something amiss.

Fang Yuan's star will laughed and silently pounced at her.

"Where are you going?" Fang Yuan sneered. Several Gu worms flew out under his command, forming a mortal killer move that froze her fake will in place.

"Fang Yuan, think it through! Ordinary wisdom path methods cannot control me! Push me to my limits, and we'll both suffer!" Though immobilized and under attack by his star will, Mo Yao's fake will could still speak.

Just then, Fang Yuan unleashed a third killer move, striking Mo Yao's fake will with a swirling starlight spiral.

Fang Yuan's star will extracted memory fragments from Mo Yao, exchanging memories amidst collision.

Amidst their collision, Mo Yao screamed: "Fang Yuan, you are too foolish and arrogant! In that case, so be it!"

With that, Mo Yao's fake will shrank rapidly in an attempt to destroy herself.

Fang Yuan chuckled, having anticipated this; a starlight pillar descended from above onto the spiral.

A portion of Fang Yuan's star will converted into fake will to replenish her, keeping her at a fixed size and preventing her suicide.

"Mo Yao, you are too naive. Now, you live or die entirely at my whim. Be obedient and tell me everything you know!" Fang Yuan laughed heartily.

The battle in the immortal aperture soon ended, and Fang Yuan's star will returned with immense gains.

Fang Yuan shut his eyes, checking the details in the star will.

Most importantly, this search yielded what Fang Yuan wanted most: clues to Red Lotus Demon Venerable's inheritance.

"Red Lotus Demon Venerable, time path inheritance..." Fang Yuan opened his eyes and muttered.

Red Lotus Demon Venerable's inheritance was located in the River of Time. Though Mo Yao didn't know what it contained, obtaining it required Spring Autumn Cicada as the primary condition.

Furthermore, the Gu Immortal had to self-detonate, using Spring Autumn Cicada to carry their will into the River of Time to find a stone lotus island.

Only upon reaching a stone lotus island would they meet the will Red Lotus left behind.

"Red Lotus Demon Venerable's inheritance is truly hard to obtain!" Fang Yuan sighed.

Despite entering the River of Time three times before, Fang Yuan had never found a stone lotus island.

"To control Spring Autumn Cicada to that extent, I need assisting methods—which I lack."

Setting Red Lotus Demon Venerable's inheritance aside for now, Fang Yuan stayed in Hu Immortal blessed land awaiting the convention's second round, using the light of wisdom to deduce the immortal killer move vaguely familiar face.

Obtained from the Northern Plains auction, vaguely familiar face was fifty percent complete, and its three core Immortal Gu were known.

Using vaguely familiar face required modifying the killer move to replace its missing core Immortal Gu.

This proved exceedingly difficult, as Fang Yuan's attainment in transformation path and wisdom path was not very high.

# Chapter 831: Still First Place

Central Continent, east coast.

The second round of Central Continent's Refinement Path Convention was underway, with Flying Frost Sect as a venue.

Token in hand, Fang Yuan arrived at Flying Frost Sect.

The task was refining rank two ghost fire Gu, with winners determined by speed rather than quantity.

Refining ten ghost fire Gu simultaneously in under fifteen minutes secured first place.

The first-place reward—five rank three ice path Gu recipes—held great appeal for refinement path masters, ice path cultivators, and major forces alike.

When Fang Yuan entered the hall to refine Gu, the top three positions remained open.

"The second round is much harder. Refining ten ghost fire Gu consecutively under fifteen minutes is simple, but refining ten simultaneously is the true challenge. Belonging to fire and soul paths, ghost fire Gu drains immense mental energy during refinement. This is a defining trait of soul path Gu worms."

Fang Yuan decided to combine soul and fire path techniques to burn ghostly souls into fake ghost fires, using them to refine true ghost fires.

As a righteous sect, Flying Frost Sect would not provide ghostly souls, so Fang Yuan had to supply them himself.

"Evil and unorthodox methods!" Outside, An Han snorted at Fang Yuan's technique.

At a crucial moment, the soul fire exploded; one forming ghost fire Gu burned to ash.

As Flying Frost Sect's first elder, An Han rejoiced at Fang Yuan's failure.

Yet just as they rejoiced, the ghost fire in Fang Yuan's hands split into two.

Inside the larger lump were nine incomplete ghost fire Gu, while the smaller lump was empty.

Holding and sustaining the larger ghost fire with one hand, he threw three souls—boar, goat, and human—into the smaller one with his other.

Tossing in materials, the ghost fire fluctuated in size and strength. At a crucial middle step, he swiftly threw in a fire pellet Gu and a soul ball Gu.

The two Gu fused in the fire into an incomplete ghost fire Gu.

"Throwing two Gu consecutively—that's the refinement path technique, consecutive toss."

Shortly after, Fang Yuan salvaged the refinement as the two ghost fires fused back into one.

Eventually, the ghost fire scattered, and ten ghost fire Gu flew out together.

With a dark expression, the Flying Frost Sect elder announced helplessly: "Refinement succeeded in under fifteen minutes. First place goes to—Fang Yuan."

# Chapter 832: Senior Fang Yuan, I want to duel you!

Under everyone's gaze, Fang Yuan quietly stood up and walked off the stage.

"Such profound refinement foundation! He multitasked effortlessly, slowing the refinement of nine incomplete ghost fire Gu while restarting the final one at high speed. Refining ghost fire Gu drains immense mental energy—could he cultivate soul or wisdom path?" An Han wondered.

An old Gu Master sighed softly: "An Han's situation doesn't look good."

"Why is that, Master?" the youth beside him asked in confusion.

"That demonic Gu Master Fang Yuan is terrifying. With his high refinement attainment, what he just did went far beyond mere multitasking. An Han understands all the more that he cannot defeat Fang Yuan. His unsettled demeanor shows intimidation."

The young Gu Master smiled: "That is because Master taught me unreservedly. Without Master taking me in, I would have starved to death; my achievements come entirely from your nurturing. I planned to take first place using thirteen refinement techniques, but now that demonic Gu Master has claimed it. Master, let me seize that green shine Gu for you!"

"What?" Startled, the old master quickly blocked him: "Disciple, don't!"

Fearless in his youth, the young Gu Master called out loudly: "Senior Fang Yuan, I boldly request a duel with you!"

Fang Yuan paused while waiting to receive his reward, drawing everyone's attention.

"I know him—he took second place at Five Virtues Sect, a genuine refinement path genius."

Under everyone's gaze, the young Gu Master stepped forward with head held high, confronting Fang Yuan with a resolute, shining gaze.

"Duel? Who wants to duel me?" Fang Yuan smiled faintly, turning to look at the challenger.

Sizing up the spirited youth, Fang Yuan felt some interest: "Lad, if you want to duel, wager something interesting. Otherwise, I won't duel."

The young Gu Master nodded seriously: "I have a rank five Gu recipe that will suit a rank five expert like senior. I want to bet it against your rank four green shine Gu."

Fang Yuan nodded: "Green shine Gu is a rare rank four Gu equal in value to a normal rank five Gu. But lad, do you know my path? Are you certain your recipe suits it?"

The young Gu Master was stunned: "Senior, aren't you in refinement path?" Judging from his words, the wagered recipe belonged to refinement path.

Fang Yuan chuckled: "My main cultivation path is not refinement path. You bet only one recipe against my rare Gu. If rank five refinement fails, even I could be injured. Why would I agree to such terms?"

His master hurried over and bowed deeply to Fang Yuan: "Since sir refuses, we will not duel."

"Five Virtues Sect competition's first-place winner, the demonic cultivator Fang Yuan, and runner-up, young Gu Master Zheng Shan Chuan—is this clash between dragon and tiger cancelled over insufficient betting capital? Come, let us all lend a hand—many stones make a mountain," an onlooker suggested.

An Han's eyes flashed ominously as he quietly gave instructions. Soon, someone in the crowd offered resources, and many others followed suit, urging the duel to proceed.

# Chapter 833: Shan Chuan Hall Creator

As the stage atmosphere grew more intense, Fang Yuan and Zheng Shan Chuan could no longer avoid the duel.

The name 'Zheng Shan Chuan' felt familiar, and Fang Yuan searched his sluggish memories.

Centuries later on Central Continent's east coast, a super force named Shan Chuan Hall would arise, founded by Zheng Shan Chuan.

"Based on the timeline, could this Zheng Shan Chuan be the creator of Shan Chuan Hall? Placing second in Five Virtues Sect means he definitely possesses master-level refinement path attainment. A refinement path master at his age is truly a genius. This matches the descriptions; and since a great teacher produces fine students, this elder must be Old Man Qi Shan."

"Old Man Qi Shan suffered greatly from a secret poison, and the filial Zheng Shan Chuan tried everything to heal him. Indeed, green shine Gu is among the best healing Gu for heat toxins. Unfortunately, even Old Man Qi Shan didn't know it was a transforming poison. Though seemingly a heat toxin, green shine Gu would turn it into a cold poison of double the toxicity. Eventually, Zheng Shan Chuan cured him by creating the killer move nine shine to suppress all poisons. Later, his descendant became Shan Chuan Hall's Gu Immortal leader, upgrading the technique into the immortal killer move profound light nine shine and gaining renown as a light path healer during the five regions chaotic war."

He used luck inspection Gu on the two of them.

Zheng Shan Chuan's luck was a dazzling seven-colored rainbow, while Old Man Qi Shan's resembled a cracked jade bowl leaking grey luck.

A portion of the rainbow luck flowed into Old Man Qi Shan's jade bowl, significantly alleviating his grey luck.

Intrigued, Fang Yuan mused: "To think I'd meet Shan Chuan Hall's founder here. If I kill him, that super force will never exist centuries from now."

The moment Fang Yuan felt killing intent, their luck wavered as if in a gale, the rainbow light dimming toward destruction.

"What benefit is there in that? Northern Plains is already in chaos because of me—though that was unintentional, caused by Mo Yao's fake will. But whom could I explain that to? I'll spare Zheng Shan Chuan; keeping people on their original paths preserves my rebirth advantage," Fang Yuan reconsidered.

Instantly, their luck returned to normal, even growing vaguely stronger than before.

Fang Yuan waved his hand: "We can duel, but I have no interest in these stakes. If I lose, you get green shine Gu. But if you lose, you become my slave for life."

"Disciple, you cannot agree!" Old Man Qi Shan cried, turning pale.

"Senior, isn't this request excessive?" Though young, Zheng Shan Chuan would not agree lightly when his entire future was at stake.

"You can refuse, but without yourself as the wager, I won't duel," Fang Yuan sneered. "Do you think green shine Gu is common? It is the ideal cure for heat toxins. Time waits for no one. Miss the opportunity before you, and you will regret it for life."

"Disciple, don't agree!" Old Man Qi Shan warned, seeing Fang Yuan's words were a trap.

Old Man Qi Shan was about to intervene, but Fang Yuan cut in: "Lad, I offer this chance moved by your filial piety. If you refuse, I won't accept any future duel. To show I'm not bullying a junior, I'll even let you propose the duel task."

"What, senior, you are letting me choose?!" Zheng Shan Chuan was moved.

"Master's heat toxin is severe; delaying treatment will be fatal. The Gu I know best is careful Gu. This rank three Gu is our specialty, requiring complex steps and numerous techniques. After three years of hard practice, I have an eighty percent success rate. I'll challenge him with this!"

His mind made up, Zheng Shan Chuan told Fang Yuan: "I will duel!"

# Chapter 834: Refinement Path Killer Move, Spinning Golden Bell

"Disciple!!" Old Man Qi Shan was extremely anxious.

Zheng Shan Chuan turned to Old Man Qi Shan with bright, clear eyes: "Master, forgive your unfilial disciple for defying your wishes. Choosing the topic is a massive advantage—I have no reason to refuse! Backing down now would leave a mental scar, robbing me of the courage to advance in refinement path!"

Hearing this, Old Man Qi Shan fell silent.

Old Man Qi Shan gripped his disciple's shoulder: "I understand your filial intentions. Make your decision, and I will support you. Use careful Gu as the task, but compete on time rather than mere success! Whoever refines it first wins!"

Careful Gu was Old Man Qi Shan's uncirculated secret inheritance. Yet to support his disciple, he shared this precious recipe with his opponent, Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan and Zheng Shan Chuan took the stage to begin their duel.

Zheng Shan Chuan handed the careful Gu recipe to Fang Yuan.

Under the watchful crowd, Zheng Shan Chuan skillfully executed nearly ten refinement techniques in a dazzling display.

Yet Fang Yuan was still studying the recipe, not having started refinement.

"Oh no." Old Man Qi Shan frowned: "This man is calmly deciphering every step before refining—the true composure of an expert! Fortunately, I made speed the condition; whoever refines it first wins. Careful Gu's process is complex; without deep familiarity and extensive practice matching Little Chuan's, he cannot win."

Careful Gu was strictly a wisdom path Gu worm, but extremely useful in refinement path. Fang Yuan deduced it was the core of Zheng Shan Chuan's inheritance.

After reviewing the recipe a few times, Fang Yuan mastered it. As a refinement path quasi-grandmaster, grasping a rank three recipe was effortless.

Fang Yuan extended his hands and began refining.

Fang Yuan proceeded step by step, drawing disdain from onlookers who recognized he was copying Zheng Shan Chuan's techniques.

Soon, Fang Yuan modified the process with different techniques, accelerating his refinement speed.

Old Man Qi Shan frowned, inwardly alarmed: "His speed isn't what is terrifying, but his unhurried composure and flawless technique. His refinement attainment likely exceeds master level! Little Chuan will feel the pressure, but he cannot panic. Careful Gu becomes harder later on; Little Chuan must hold his lead. Against such a formidable foe, losing composure means certain defeat!"

"Such skill! He has used over ten techniques and is still going. His mental capacity far outmatches mine. He's catching up..." Zheng Shan Chuan's mouth went dry, his heart pounding in panic.

His gaze hardened: "I'll use my trump card and leave you in the dust!"

His mind made up, Zheng Shan Chuan slowed his refinement and activated Gu worms within his aperture.

Zheng Shan Chuan inhaled deeply, eyes shining with golden light as a radiant glow enveloped his body.

The golden light condensed into a small golden bell.

Covering the refinement fire, the golden bell spun faster and faster, emitting a powerful suction force.

The golden bell lasted only six breaths before fading.

The next moment, an incomplete careful Gu formed before everyone's eyes.

"This is a refinement path killer move!"

Zheng Shan Chuan exhaled turbid air, feeling spirited: "I will definitely win! My killer move instantly ground six materials, finishing the longest step. I'm far ahead of Fang Yuan now!"

Unmoved, Fang Yuan steadily boiled and processed the six materials.

# Chapter 835: Promise of Three Matters

As time passed, Zheng Shan Chuan reached the final steps, the incomplete Gu worm taking clearer shape in the fire.

To be safe, he glanced at Fang Yuan and saw he had only just finished fusing the six materials.

Zheng Shan Chuan had to admire Fang Yuan's composure, but thought: "What a pity—victory is mine. I will definitely obtain this green shine Gu!"

Just as a confident Zheng Shan Chuan looked away, Fang Yuan suddenly laughed: "Hahaha, Zheng Shan Chuan, you've lost! Behold my refinement path killer move!"

"What?" Zheng Shan Chuan's heart shuddered as he turned to look.

Fang Yuan had taken out a Gu worm and crushed it.

He screamed in fury: "You! You actually destroyed green shine Gu!"

With his focus broken, the fire in his hands destabilized and exploded.

By the time he regained composure and restarted, Fang Yuan had already reached the final step.

Without further suspense, Fang Yuan emerged victorious.

"Senior, please spare him! We were blind to offend senior. Please be magnanimous—my disciple is young and innocent. I am willing to take his place and offer all my savings for his freedom. Please have mercy!"

Old Man Qi Shan dropped to his knees, kowtowing incessantly to Fang Yuan.

His forehead slammed repeatedly against the floor in loud thuds, blood covering his face.

"Master!" Jolted back to reality, Zheng Shan Chuan rushed to help Old Man Qi Shan up.

Then Fang Yuan said to Old Man Qi Shan: "It is not impossible to spare him."

"What?" Zheng Shan Chuan was stunned.

Overjoyed, Old Man Qi Shan cried out: "Thank you, senior, for your magnanimity and kindness!"

Fang Yuan smiled with warm benevolence: "Kindness to others is kindness to oneself."

His tone shifted: "However, offending me still requires punishment."

"I won't make you a lifelong slave, but you must perform three tasks for me. You aren't yet qualified, and I haven't decided what they are. I might never ask anything of you, or I might demand all three the next moment—it depends entirely on my mood," Fang Yuan said slowly.

Old Man Qi Shan exhaled in relief, tearfully crying: "Thank you, Lord, for your mercy!"

Zheng Shan Chuan lowered his head: "Junior thanks senior."

Seeing their profound gratitude, Fang Yuan chuckled: "Bite your tongues and offer me a drop of blood from the tip."

Exchanging fearful glances, they bit their tongues and presented the blood to Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan extended his right hand, clasping the two drops of blood.

Old Man Qi Shan and Zheng Shan Chuan stared wide-eyed—they were a pair of rank four Gu.

"A blood path technique! Astounding blood path refinement!" Flying Frost Sect's higher-ups wore dark expressions.

"This pair of rank four Gu can sense each other; you keep one, and I'll keep the other. If I have requests, my messenger will carry this blood path Gu as proof. They can sense each other to verify authenticity. Even after your death, these three obligations pass to your descendants and disciples. Are you willing? If not, become my slaves," Fang Yuan said.

"Willing, we are willing." Old Man Qi Shan replied hurriedly.

Fang Yuan tossed one of the blood path Gu worms to Old Man Qi Shan.

He tossed Zheng Shan Chuan another Gu.

Catching the Gu, a stunned Zheng Shan Chuan stammered: "This... is this green shine Gu?"

Storing his blood path Gu, Fang Yuan laughed: "Did you truly believe I destroyed green shine Gu?"

Laughing, he turned and walked away, leaving the dumbfounded Gu Masters behind.

Zheng Shan Chuan stared blankly at Fang Yuan's retreating back while Old Man Qi Shan carefully stored the Gu. Neither dared violate the pact, witnessed by Flying Frost Sect and the entire Refinement Path Convention.

Afterward, Old Man Qi Shan used this ordeal to teach Zheng Shan Chuan about Fang Yuan's viciousness and grasp of human nature. He also exposed Flying Frost Sect's first elder, An Han, whose jealousy had surreptitiously driven the duel.

Zheng Shan Chuan matured greatly, realizing his shortcomings and the world's cruelty. Keeping a low profile for most of his life, he focused on raising his refinement attainment while seeking cures for his master. At fifty-three, he cured Old Man Qi Shan's poison; at eighty-eight, he quietly attained refinement path grandmaster.

As for the promise of three matters, that was another story.

# Chapter 836: Preliminary Success of Vaguely Familiar Face

After the convention's second round concluded, Fang Yuan returned to Hu Immortal blessed land.

With time having passed in the blessed land, Mo Yao's will had recovered enough for another search.

Showing no mercy, Fang Yuan searched Mo Yao's will.

This time, he extracted several of Mo Yao's refinement techniques, including a refinement path killer move.

"Once my role in True Yang Building's collapse is exposed, Central Continent and Northern Plains will issue arrest warrants, and the other three regions will pursue me for Giant Sun's true inheritance. Hu Immortal blessed land will be attacked immediately. Thus, I must develop myself as much as possible before the truth comes to light."

"I must use this time to develop—accumulating immortal essence stones and immortal materials, maximizing my battle strength, and most importantly, shedding this immortal zombie body to regain a living one!"

Over the following days, Fang Yuan competed in the convention, practiced refinement, and expended numerous star thought Gu to deduce modifications for the immortal killer move, vaguely familiar face.

Fang Yuan got through the third, fourth, and fifth rounds.

Possessing quasi-grandmaster refinement attainment rare even among Gu Immortals, he took first place in all five rounds, sending his reputation surging.

The day before the sixth round, Fang Yuan achieved preliminary success in modifying the immortal killer move vaguely familiar face.

Immortal Gu were unique, and Fang Yuan lacked all three of its original core Immortal Gu, which were held by Feng Jiu Ge.

His modified version was greatly simplified compared to the original, relying on just one core Immortal Gu—eat strength Immortal Gu.

Adapting eat strength Immortal Gu as the core was possible largely thanks to his foundation as a strength path grandmaster.

It could not alter Fang Yuan's appearance, only his aura.

As a Northern Plains Gu Immortal, exerting himself seriously would leak his aura and expose his identity. But with this modified move, he could disguise his Northern Plains aura as that of Central Continent, Southern Border, Eastern Sea, or Western Desert. Unless an opponent specialized in investigation, they would be unable to expose him.

Furthermore, this killer move had a major flaw: a very steep cost.

Each activation consumed several strength path dao marks.

Eat strength Immortal Gu allowed a Gu Immortal to consume pure strength path immortal materials and absorb their natural dao marks into the body.

After many failed deductions, Fang Yuan racked his brains and targeted himself.

Thus, Fang Yuan chose to 'eat' his own body, pairing Eat Strength with numerous mortal Gu to consume strength path dao marks and disguise his aura.

The greatest credit belonged to wisdom Gu; under its light, boundless inspiration allowed Fang Yuan to forcefully make a strength path Immortal Gu the core of vaguely familiar face.

Buoyed by success, Fang Yuan competed in the sixth round and took first place.

Returning to Hu Immortal blessed land, he rested briefly before using Fixed Immortal Travel to depart for Western Desert.

Western Desert, impassable dunes.

Xiao clan's Gu Masters maintained battle formation, clashing fiercely with hidden sand spiders.

Swarming from the sand with deadly mandibles, the hidden sand spiders attacked Xiao clan. Watching from the sky, Fang Yuan estimated at least thirty thousand of them.

# Chapter 837: Doing Business in Western Desert

Concealing his figure, he flew directly above the battlefield undetected.

Their opponents were three massive hidden sand spider queens, each a desolate beast.

Leading the charge, Xiao Hu Chi roared in exhilaration, immersed in the thrill of battle.

Deputy leader Xiao Shi Rang sighed, transmitting: "Leader, training is complete. We should order our Gu Masters to retreat now."

"I almost forgot! Handle it yourself—hahaha, these three spider queens are greatly weakened, time to capture them!" Xiao Hu Chi laughed wildly, but just as he moved to attack, he snapped his gaze left and shouted, "Who's there?!"

In reply, an imposing giant hand tore through the sandstorm, directly seizing a hidden sand spider queen.

Xiao Hu Chi stared in fury, but the giant hand's timing was flawless—the moment Xiao clan forced the spider queen back, the hand snatched it from behind as if walking it into a trap.

As Xiao clan's Gu Immortals furiously prepared to attack, seven more strength path giant hands emerged from the sandstorm.

Amid resounding collisions, five rank six Xiao clan Gu Immortals were routed in panic.

Only rank sevens Xiao Hu Chi and Xiao Shi Rang matched their two giant hands equally.

"No need to be nervous, I harbor no ill intent. Look." Fang Yuan slowly emerged, smiling faintly.

All eyes turned to the hidden sand spider queen, screeching and struggling desperately in the strength path giant hand's iron grip.

Fang Yuan accomplished this easily thanks to perfect timing while the queen was weakened, and because integrating a second Immortal Gu, Pulling Mountain, into myriad self giant hand vastly increased its might against earth path desolate beasts.

Sensing no hostility, Xiao Hu Chi asked in a low voice: "Sir, who might you be? What is your intention?"

Fang Yuan chuckled: "I am merely a nameless Western Desert recluse. Forced to become an immortal zombie recently, I have only now emerged into the open. I come seeking long-term trade with your esteemed clan. Are you interested in regretful spider groups?"

"Oh? Regretful spiders?" Xiao clan's Gu Immortals felt joyous.

Naturally excited, Xiao Hu Chi asked immediately: "How many do you have, sir, and how shall we transact?"

Fang Yuan added: "I can supply your esteemed clan with this amount of mortal spider Gu every month."

"As for trading..." Fang Yuan said slowly, "your Ten Thousand Li Silk Corridor is ideal. Give me a nearby node token; on the thirtieth of every month, I will deliver the goods and collect payment there."

Fang Yuan took out a sample, Xiao clan's Gu Immortals were greatly pleased at the quality.

After bargaining, they agreed on a price and completed the first transaction on the spot. Xiao Hu Chi paid on behalf of Xiao clan, while Fang Yuan received a node token.

Transaction complete, Fang Yuan turned and departed.

Returning to headquarters, Xiao Hu Chi's group immediately reported the encounter to Xiao clan's first supreme elder.

Learning the details, the first supreme elder nodded slowly: "Little Hu, you did well. Your contribution points for this task will be doubled."

Xiao Hu Chi said heavily: "Lord, he appeared so suddenly—a rank six immortal zombie with rank seven battle strength! Do you know his origins?"

The first supreme elder smiled indifferently: "Western Desert is vast, with many secluded Gu Immortals beyond my knowledge. Since immortal zombies cannot produce immortal essence, emerging from seclusion is hardly strange. Since he seeks sincere trade, we will cooperate for now. Our clan has endless demand for mortal spider Gu. If all goes well, granting him a Xiao clan transaction token is no issue."

The elder pondered before adding: "To provide a long-term supply, he must possess other blessed lands. Investigate him discreetly; he cannot be treated as an ordinary immortal zombie. Right now, our priority is competing with Dong clan for the northwest market. We must expand Ten Thousand Li Silk Corridor as quickly as possible."

Central Continent, Floating Flower Riverbank, Hearing Wave Pavilion.

This was a testing location for round seven of the Refinement Path Convention.

The audience buzzed with discussion, countless gazes fixed upon Fang Yuan.

Clad in his black robe and mask as before, Fang Yuan unhurriedly walked off the stage in silence.

Right now, Fang Yuan's name was imprinted on first place!

# Chapter 838: Origin of the Refinement Path Convention

Under everyone's discussions, Fang Yuan slowly started walking out of Hearing Wave Pavilion.

At the outer gate, Gu Masters from various forces hawked information in a booming business.

Approaching the Gu Master, Fang Yuan tossed ten primeval stones: "Give me a copy."

Fang Yuan waved his hand, taking the information path Gu worm as he walked away.

Inspecting it, Fang Yuan found that over eight thousand participants had cleared all seven rounds of the convention.

And among those four hundred, only about eighty had taken first place in every round.

Fang Yuan was among them.

Expert evaluations placed his name only in the upper-middle ranks.

Looking over the ranking, Fang Yuan recognized many familiar names.

Firesmith Dragon Chief, Fang Huai, Tian Min Mie, Feng Jin Huang, Yu Mu Chun, Lui Pin Tian, Dou Ping Tan, Qu Wen... all were prominent figures in his previous life.

"Among them are future superstars of the five regions chaotic war, future Gu Immortals, and lifetime refinement path grandmasters."

Fang Yuan felt pressure inwardly.

"With my ability, reaching the top ten is difficult, yet benefiting from the Infallible inheritance requires at least top six!"

The convention originally began as a refinement contest among Central Continent's ten great ancient sects to fight over and divide the Infallible inheritance's benefits.

But because the inheritance could even aid the recovery of fate Gu, Heavenly Court took over.

This year's standard was moderate, featuring five refinement path grandmasters.

"I excel at blood path refinement, but I lack blood path Gu worms, and using those techniques openly would give Immortal Crane Sect an excuse to attack Hu Immortal blessed land. To reach the top six, I must scheme!" Fang Yuan resolved.

An Zu Earth Trench, Demon Expelling Sect.

# Chapter 839: Fang Zheng's Inner Thoughts

Fang Zheng and another elder led a dozen Immortal Crane Sect disciples into the venue.

"Immortal Crane Sect elders and disciples." Spotting Fang Zheng's group, surrounding Gu Masters stared and hushed their chatter.

"Look over there—Myriad Dragon Dock's elders and disciples!"

The next moment, all eyes turned toward another arriving group.

Twice the size of Immortal Crane Sect's entourage, this group was led by four elders and packed with elite disciples.

"Myriad Dragon Dock..." An Immortal Crane Sect elder narrowed his gaze.

"Ah, it is Immortal Crane Sect's people."

"Hehehe, what are you here for? To watch your elders fail?"

Choking with anger, Immortal Crane Sect's disciples remained silent as Myriad Dragon Dock brushed past them toward their seats.

An onlooker remarked: "Even among the ten sects, strength varies. Immortal Crane Sect is visibly weaker than Myriad Dragon Dock, and Myriad Dragon Dock is fielding the formidable refinement master Firesmith Dragon Chief!"

Nearby, Fang Zheng and the other Immortal Crane Sect elder discussed quietly.

Fang Zheng asked: "What are Elder Yan Tang's chances of winning this round?"

Frowning, the elder beside him sighed: "Elder Fang Zheng, you know Elder Yan Tang primarily cultivates fire path, with refinement only on the side. Whereas Firesmith Dragon Chief specializes in refinement path with fire path as secondary. The gap is too vast."

The elder shook his head with a bitter smile: "Elder Fang Zheng, after round seven, the convention uses a brutal single-winner system. In this entire venue, only one Gu Master will advance."

"What? It is really like that?!" Shocked, Fang Zheng took a moment to process. Tempered by past setbacks, he asked: "If the opponent is so strong, why didn't Elder Yan Tang choose another venue? The convention doesn't restrict participants from choosing their venue."

"A sensible thought—retreating to advance is sound strategy. But other venues are also occupied by experts, and... the higher-ups specifically assigned Elder Yan Tang here." The elder whispered those final words quietly.

Fang Zheng was startled—he would be an idiot not to understand now!

"So the higher-ups decided to sacrifice Elder Yan Tang just to probe Firesmith Dragon Chief?"

He suddenly recalled Lord Sky Crane's words: Elder Yan Tang was isolated in the sect, inviting Fang Zheng for drinks only to form an alliance.

'Because he is alone, he was chosen to be a sacrifice... Elder Yan Tang is probably filled with discontent. What if I was treated as a sacrifice one day?'

Right then, the elder's voice resounded: "All participants have entered the venue, this round of the competition is about to begin."

Fang Zheng looked up to see over a hundred Gu Masters stepping onto the stage.

He saw Immortal Crane Sect's Elder Yan Tang standing expressionless, his gaze filled with discontent and helplessness.

To the side, the red-robed Firesmith Dragon Chief looked around arrogantly, unconcealing his disdain and contempt for the surrounding participants.

"A group of weaklings, it is my win for sure. Start already." Firesmith Dragon Chief laughed loudly, openly urging Demon Expelling Sect's hosting elder.

'Repulsive, truly repulsive!' Fang Zheng still had the nature of a young man, he was clenching his teeth and shouting furiously inwardly, 'Damn it, if only I had enough strength. I really hope someone will beat down this Firesmith Dragon Chief right now, and destroy this Myriad Dragon Dock group's arrogance.'

As if answering his wish, a figure quietly appeared; stepping onto the stage, countless gazes turned toward him.

Black robe.

Fang Yuan!

The whole venue was silent before being sent into an uproar!

# Chapter 840: Fang Zheng's Nightmare

Nobody expected Fang Yuan to appear here. According to the Refinement Path Convention's rules, from round eight onwards, each test venue could produce only a single winner.

The further one advanced, the greater the glory and rewards; an early decisive showdown would only let others reap the benefits.

Seeing Fang Yuan, many Gu Masters guessed: "Does Fang Yuan have some enmity with Firesmith Dragon Chief?"

"This is Fang Yuan? The famous owner of Hu Immortal blessed land from our sect?" Immortal Crane Sect's disciples began to speculate.

"Fang Yuan and Feng Jin Huang's agreement is widely known. Our sect has plenty of exemption quotas—Fang Yuan could have conserved energy and joined from round ten onwards."

Immortal Crane Sect's disciples discussed, many stealthily glancing at Fang Zheng.

Fang Zheng pursed his lips, pale-faced, hands clenched inside his large sleeves. As blood brothers, he intuitively recognized his older brother the moment Fang Yuan appeared!

The nightmare he had tried so hard to evade since waking from his coma assaulted his mind once again!

Fang Yuan's unorthodox behavior made Firesmith Dragon Chief startled, furious and doubtful.

Firesmith Dragon Chief probed: "Fang Yuan of Immortal Crane Sect! Have you come to lose in advance?"

The moment he spoke, the uproar turned even louder.

"Big news! Who knew he was a disciple of the ten great ancient sects... But why come here? Is Immortal Crane Sect feuding with Myriad Dragon Dock? I haven't heard of any disputes."

"Big brother..." Fang Zheng gritted his teeth, paper-pale and drenched in cold sweat, struggling for breath and feeling completely drained as if from intense exertion.

Lord Sky Crane consoled him from his aperture, but to little effect.

Behind his mask, Fang Yuan's eyes swept around, pausing briefly on Fang Zheng before settling on Firesmith Dragon Chief.

Breaking the long silence, he chuckled hoarsely and proudly proclaimed: "Right, I am Immortal Crane Sect's Fang Yuan."

The clamor off-stage turned the other participants into ignored props. Gazing at Firesmith Dragon Chief, Fang Yuan deliberately raised his voice: "Firesmith Dragon Chief, I came here to defeat you. Defeating those incompetents is far too boring. You are a decent opponent who will add radiance to my advancement. So use your full strength without holding back—I recall your strongest method was, what was it... mad deity's blazing flames? Use it against me, so when I defeat you, I can feel some satisfaction."

Firesmith Dragon Chief was startled: 'He actually knows my hidden trump card?! Impossible, I've never exposed this technique. How did he find out?'

Astonishment gave way to rage as he countered: "Fine, since you boast so shamelessly, junior, let me teach you a thorough lesson and make you understand true pain!"

# Chapter 841: Fang Yuan's Public Provocation

Fang Yuan taunted: "Good—this gaze, this mood, this rage! Only like this will you bring out your full strength. Only such an opponent holds my interest. Remember, use all your strength, or you will be Myriad Dragon Dock's disgrace! Hahaha."

Contrary to appearances, though brazen on the outside, Fang Yuan remained extremely vigilant inwardly.

"Contrary to outside intelligence, Firesmith Dragon Chief cultivates fire path rather than refinement path. Back at Myriad Dragon Dock, he was indeed a refinement path Gu Master. Myriad Dragon Dock naturally would not turn away a Gu Immortal and had secretly accepted him. With the Refinement Path Convention underway and his refinement attainment at grandmaster level, they rushed him into the competition to seize first place and reap benefits for the sect!"

"Firesmith Dragon Chief's refinement path attainment exceeds mine; in my past life, he ranked second in this convention. "Begin quickly!" Firesmith Dragon Chief shouted, impatient to crush the rampant Fang Yuan.

Provided materials included immortal soul grass, worry stones, one rank four apathy Gu, six rank three muted mouth Gu, and two rank four sinking Gu—outside materials were strictly forbidden.

Gu Masters had to reverse-refine apathy Gu, muted mouth Gu, or sinking Gu to extract materials, utilizing them to ultimately refine the rank five sound path keep silent Gu.

Fang Yuan had brazenly urged him to use his strongest refinement killer move, mad deity's blazing flames.

Yet for this task, what would Firesmith Dragon Chief use mad deity's blazing flames for—burn the air?

However, the key thing was the appearance of Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan's true skill posed a genuine threat. Between experts of similar caliber, even a slight dip in capability decided victory, let alone a twenty-percent handicap!

'His timing and luck are absurdly good! No, I must defeat him!' Firesmith Dragon Chief swore, glancing at Fang Yuan.

However, at the next moment, his eyeballs almost popped out!

Fang Yuan had already started refining!

Even as a refinement grandmaster, Firesmith Dragon Chief estimated he would need about eight minutes.

Yet Fang Yuan had started refining immediately from the very outset!

Fang Yuan had the lead and was progressing extremely quickly.

With other Gu Masters yet to begin, most spectators naturally fixed their gaze on him.

Fang Yuan knew haste made waste, but he already knew this task's exact contents.

In his previous life, after becoming a blood path Gu Immortal, Fang Yuan had planned to enter the Refinement Path Convention.

# Chapter 842: Capturing Fang Zheng in Public

To compete in the convention, Fang Yuan had prepared over eighty years in advance in his previous life.

With the mindset of an Earth student facing mountains of exam prep, Fang Yuan collected past convention tasks and practiced them laboriously to discern the examiners' intentions.

Those practice days were terrifying memories, yet they built his refinement path foundation—without them, he would never have reached his current quasi-grandmaster level.

Thus, Fang Yuan not only remembered this competition's tasks, but those of past and future ones as well!

Far ahead of second-place Firesmith Dragon Chief, Fang Yuan refined Gu calmly and confidently, breeding despair in competitors struggling to catch up.

Fang Yuan's method was the optimized plan perfected by countless Gu Masters over repeated attempts in his previous life.

In Hu Immortal blessed land, he had specially drilled refining keep silent Gu, practicing the entire procedure at least two hundred times!

Under countless watching eyes, Fang Yuan won without suspense, maintaining a massive lead.

Only Fang Zheng remained seated, gazing at his brother on stage as though that black robe shrouded his heart.

With the round over, Fang Yuan slowly stepped down from the stage.

Fang Yuan claimed the victor's reward from Demon Expelling Sect: a wide variety of immortal materials in small quantities.

At the mountain gate, Immortal Crane Sect's group was waiting already.

"Lord Fang Yuan!" Seeing his arrival, Elder Yan Tang and another elder greeted him together.

As an accompanying elder, Fang Zheng stood helplessly behind them with an expressionless face, offering no greeting.

"Fellow sect members, a good day to you all." Fang Yuan's warm voice sounded from beneath his mask.

Directing a cold gaze at Fang Zheng, Fang Yuan said with disappointment: "Brother, what is with that expression? Afraid I will scold you? Your performance is as disappointing as always. Failing to pass even the first round of the Refinement Path Convention simply makes us lose face!"

Fang Zheng snorted with hatred, about to speak.

Fang Yuan waved his hand, attacking him in public!

While Immortal Crane Sect stared blankly, Fang Yuan struck, immediately immobilizing Fang Zheng from a distance.

"Fang Zheng, you are too disappointing. Wandering outside instead of settling down to cultivate! What is the point of drawing attention with such strength? Our parents are gone; as your brother, I bear a father's duty to educate you! Since you favor refinement path, you will stay by my side from today on as I impart my experience. You must cultivate wholeheartedly until I am satisfied," Fang Yuan chided.

"I don't need your care! I am an elder of Immortal Crane Sect, grown up already!" Fang Zheng screamed like a rebellious youth refusing discipline.

But in fact, he was feeling an icy chill inside.

He could not control himself—the words he shouted were not what he wanted to say!

This wisdom path killer move from Dong Fang Chang Fan controlled Fang Zheng's mind, generating false thoughts that forced him to act in accordance with them.

"No! Save me, anyone! Master, master!" Fang Zheng screamed inwardly.

But there was no response from the spirit incubating flea.

Fang Yuan had cut off Fang Zheng's connection to his aperture.

# Chapter 843: Immortal Gu Change Form

What is more important—the monopoly on guts Gu, or the two of you?"

Lord Sky Crane was speechless.

Two hours later, Fang Yuan walked out of this underground prison. Behind him, the entrance shut tightly.

Yet he would lose his second aperture and all his strength path dao marks, forcing him to undergo immortal ascension once more.

"If possible, I would rather not possess Fang Zheng. But if my identity is exposed and I fail to revive, possession is necessary. My current target is the Refinement Path Convention—reaching the top six grants the Infallible inheritance and a guaranteed successful Gu refinement!"

Once in the top six, he would be transported into a hidden blessed land, where he planned to refine Change Form Immortal Gu!

With this rank six transformation path Immortal Gu, vaguely familiar face would be elevated far beyond merely concealing his regional aura.

Fang Yuan had also nearly finished preparing the immortal materials to refine Change Form.

In subsequent rounds, Fang Yuan went on the offensive, using his rebirth advantage to defeat tough foes in advance.

# Chapter 844: Contest Between Two Fangs

Central Continent Refinement Path Convention, twelfth round.

At this crucial moment of the competition, the entire arena focused on two people.

One was a masked, muscular figure in black robes manipulating the flame before him—Fang Yuan.

The other was Fang Huai, clad in plain white robes with snow-white hair and a forehead tattoo.

"Even so, Fang Yuan holds the advantage. His quick thinking is peerless—he took a massive lead right from the start!"

All other Gu Masters in this round had been eliminated, leaving only Fang Huai and Fang Yuan.

Fang Huai was a wood path Gu Immortal who had placed third in Fang Yuan's previous life; this round's task was the most unfavorable for him.

Fang Yuan seized this opportunity to challenge and eliminate him early.

But Fang Huai had gone all out midway, using three refinement path killer moves—including an immortal killer move—to close the distance instantly, making the outcome uncertain again.

"Worthy of third place in my previous life; he is truly difficult... eh!" Fang Yuan's expression shifted suddenly.

The flame flickered, and the half-melted blue peacock head suddenly turned to ash and fell.

"This?!" Fang Yuan's expression did not change, but his heart sank.

"A failure probability!" Reacting swiftly, he turned and grabbed for the final blue peacock on his right.

Just as he killed the peacock and moved to toss its head into the flame, Fang Huai spoke: "I use my chance to remove Fang Yuan's blue peacock!"

The elder hosting the competition immediately responded: "Approved."

Instantly, the blue peacock beside Fang Yuan vanished, taken away.

"Fang Yuan was near the end, but losing crucial materials forces him to alter the recipe and take a massive detour. Fang Huai can easily catch up and eliminate him now!"

"Fang Yuan, I win," Fang Huai smiled confidently, as if victory were already in his grasp.

"Is that so?" Fang Yuan sneered, beckoning the headless peacock corpse into his hand.

Fang Yuan opened his fist, releasing a thick blood-colored fog that enveloped the headless corpse within breaths, obscuring it from view.

Soon, the fog faded; the headless corpse had shrunk by twenty percent, but a blue peacock head had appeared.

"A blood path Gu refinement killer move—it can transform corpses into materials!"

Fang Yuan tossed the peacock head into the fire; it melted and fused into the incomplete Gu.

While everyone gasped, Fang Huai sneered inwardly: "Think you've won? Removing your blue peacock achieved my goal of wasting your time. With my final killer move, I will surpass you and win. Challenging me was your mistake—defeating you means claiming all your victories. Hahaha!"

Just then, Fang Yuan spoke: "I want to use a chance to remove one of my opponent's materials."

The hosting elder immediately replied: "Please speak."

Fang Huai was startled, then sneered inwardly: "Remove whatever you want!"

Fang Yuan glanced at Fang Huai, his gaze calm: "I remove the wild bull eyeball."

The audience was confused—hadn't Fang Huai already fused the wild bull eyeball into his incomplete Gu?

Attempting to remove an already-used Gu refinement material was forbidden by the rules.

Fang Yuan insisted: "Fang Huai, will you not surrender the wild bull eyeball you secretly hid? Are you trying to break the rules?"

Fang Huai's face showed extreme disbelief.

He had hidden the wild bull eyeball with a unique technique—how did Fang Yuan sense it? It was crucial for the killer move that would bring him victory.

Under shocked gazes, he gritted his teeth and pulled the wild bull eyeball from the fire.

"Take it!" Enraged, he smashed the eyeball onto the ground, extinguished his flame, and stormed off.

Ignoring the commotion, Fang Yuan unhurriedly refined his Gu to completion.

"A top six spot is secured." Bathed in shock and admiration, Fang Yuan exhaled impassively: "Thankfully, my past-life memories warned me of his trump card, or he might have won!"

Though appearing at ease, he actually faced great internal pressure.

# Chapter 845: Failure Has Value

The Legends of Ren Zu states that after climbing the giant tree out of ordinary abyss, Ren Zu left behind his daughter, Boundless Forest Samsara.

You, however, walk your own path and possess self Gu. With self Gu, you will not lose yourself even if you break failure Gu. Please appraise it for me."

Ren Zu touched the Gu and wished: "Please return my fourth child, Boundless Forest Samsara, to my side."

# Chapter 846: Persuading Fang Zheng

Central Continent, Hu Immortal blessed land.

Heeding Mo Yao's suggestion, Bo Qing set up exquisite Gu formations to perfectly conceal the cave.

"After so many years, if the cave remains undiscovered, it must hold a huge amount of rank eight stone heart liquid. Even if I cannot use it, I can collect it. Later, I can sell or trade it in treasure yellow heaven for needed materials. Many Gu Immortals covet rank eight immortal materials."

Postponing retrieving the stone heart liquid from True Yang mountain range, Fang Yuan got up and entered the prison cell, standing before his younger brother, Fang Zheng.

Lying on the ground with eyes shut, Fang Zheng alternated between ruthless and relaxed expressions, screaming and flailing as if trapped in a nightmare.

Panting heavily and soaked in sweat, Fang Zheng eventually got up and demanded: "What did you do to me?"

Fang Yuan chuckled, stating plainly: "My good brother, I only showed you the truth, combining my memories with Lord Sky Crane's. You should now know the disaster on Qing Mao mountain was caused not by me, but by your so-called master, Lord Sky Crane.
