Stunned, Fang Zheng was left at a complete loss for words.

"Hehehe," Fang Yuan laughed. "My beloved brother, did you never consider that your master, Lord Sky Crane, bears undeniable responsibility for Qing Mao mountain's destruction? Acknowledging him makes you a true traitor."

"Shut up!" Fang Zheng screamed, he had never felt so angry in his life!

"Shut up, stop talking! You demon, you murdered the clan and killed uncle and aunt! Without Master's help, I would have died long ago. I won't allow you to slander him..."

"Oh?" Fang Yuan chuckled mockingly. "Didn't Lord Sky Crane save you only to track me down? When Immortal Crane Sect used you to attack Hu Immortal blessed land, didn't you nearly die? My foolish brother, they are exploiting you, yet you play along willingly?"

Fang Yuan's tone turned icy: "Weak-willed brother, you lack the courage to face reality. Though you have rank five power, inside you remain an immature child. Yet as your elder brother, I will give you a chance. Join me, and I will train you to become strong and mature."

"No... no!" Fang Zheng stared with bloodshot eyes in pure rage. "You murderer! Work for you? Never! Even if Immortal Crane Sect used me, I don't hate them. They nurtured me! But you murdered uncle, aunt, and our whole clan! I hate you and will never forgive you! Given the chance, I will kill you myself for revenge!!!"

Laughing instead of becoming angry, he said, "Hehehe, you've learned quite a bit in Immortal Crane Sect. I look forward to your murderous intent."

Saying this, Fang Yuan turned around and left the cell.

Though focusing mostly on the Refinement Path Convention lately, Fang Yuan continued deducing with wisdom Gu and star thought Gu.

If the relative sacrificed their life willingly without resistance, the resulting blood deity would be closely bound and easily commanded. But if filled with hatred, it could backfire on its master.

This was why Fang Yuan sought to persuade Fang Zheng.

If he found another way to revive, he would use Fang Zheng as material instead, having no intention of sparing him.

Song Zi Xing's head was the only requirement to become Star Form blessed land's owner!

Land spirits were straightforward: presenting Song Zi Xing's head would grant ownership, regardless of whether he lived.

Retrieving the arm was tricky; simply breaking the golden bell would make it explode into blood mist.

Fang Yuan had to use specific methods on the severed arm, otherwise his plan would fail.

After observing for a while, Fang Yuan cautiously probed it with mortal killer moves.

The golden bell phantom did not move, it was indeed an immortal killer move.

Circling it over a dozen times, Fang Yuan devised a plan.

Just as he prepared to strike, his ears twitched at approaching sounds.

Intermittent voices could be heard, drawing steadily closer.

Fang Yuan realized surrounding Gu Masters had been drawn over by the commotion.

Being on the periphery of True Yang mountain range near Yuan Yang City, desolate beasts rarely appeared, but Gu Masters were active.

"A bunch of insects." Fang Yuan sneered, a cruel light flashed in his eyes.

With a thought, strength path phantoms poured from his immortal aperture.

Soon, thousands of strength path phantoms surrounded Fang Yuan.

"Kill," Fang Yuan ordered. Thousands of strength path phantoms charged downward, blending into the dark night.

Amid frantic screams and furious shouts, a life-and-death struggle ensued; within breaths, the Gu Masters were routed.

As the phantom army slaughtered mercilessly, the stench of blood quickly spread to Fang Yuan.

With hands clasped behind his back, Fang Yuan gazed calmly at the golden bell phantom beneath his mask.

Fang Yuan waited for a while, as expected, three or four Gu Masters sneaked in.

Manipulating his strength path phantoms, Fang Yuan sent them to slaughter the death-seeking Gu Masters.

With nowhere to hide, the Gu Masters were all killed.

Quiet returned as the stench of blood thickened; with no birds stirring in the trees, the area was utterly dead and silent.

Fang Yuan started to make his move.

Myriad Self First Style — Giant Hand!

A strength path giant hand appeared out of nowhere, grabbing the golden bell.

Empowered by Pulling Mountain and Pulling Water, the giant hand could easily crush the bell.

The real issue was how to prevent the severed arm from exploding into blood mist once the bell broke.

Fortunately, as a grandmaster in strength and blood path, Fang Yuan knew countering methods.

He deployed over a hundred coordinated blood path killer moves, reinforced by layers of Gu formations.

As the golden bell phantom shattered, the arm's impending detonation was restrained and sealed under multiple layers.

Song Zi Xing had been extremely weak, infusing less than ten beads of immortal essence into this arm.

# Chapter 851: Land Spirit's Master, Second Blessed Land

After obtaining the severed arm, Fang Yuan carefully kept it in his immortal aperture.

Soon after, he cleaned up the area, erasing all traces.

Returning to Hu Immortal blessed land, he spent four days refining the arm into Song Zi Xing's head.

Next, he used Fixed Immortal Travel and went to Earth Abyss.

"Star Form land spirit, I brought Song Zi Xing's head!" he shouted in the eerie, dark underground world.

A speck of starlight appeared first, then erupted like a fountain.

Moments later, a massive starlight door materialized, bearing the plaque: Star Form blessed land!

As Fang Yuan waited, a small slit opened in the starlight door.

"It's you? You really brought Song Zi Xing's head?" Star Form land spirit's wary voice asked from behind the slit.

Fang Yuan chuckled as he tossed the head over.

The slit opened further as suction pulled the head inside.

"It really is Song Zi Xing's head!" A joyful and surprised voice came from behind the door.

Boom!

The door swung open, and Star Form land spirit bowed cheerfully: "Star Form land spirit greets master."

"Mm." Fang Yuan nodded calmly, striding along the starlight path into Star Form blessed land.

The moment he stepped in, starlight overwhelmed Fang Yuan's vision.

In the blink of an eye, the starlight faded, revealing Star Form blessed land's unique terrain before him.

The whole of Star Form blessed land resembled a giant bowl.

Like Hu Immortal blessed land's perpetual day, Star Form blessed land had only night, lacking a full day-night cycle.

"Bring me around to inspect the blessed land." Fang Yuan ordered.

Star Form land spirit resembled an adorable young boy in pinkish-blue clothes, with limbs like white jade.

Having acknowledged him, Star Form land spirit gazed at Fang Yuan with warmth and admiration.

Hearing Fang Yuan, Star Form land spirit nodded: "Master, follow me."

Starlight gathered around Fang Yuan, rapidly lifting him into the air.

As the starlight halted, the scene before him had already shifted.

"Master, you are at the southeast side now. This arrow bamboo forest is the largest plantation in the blessed land," Star Form land spirit introduced.

Fang Yuan looked over at the vast arrow bamboo forest extending beyond his vision.

The straight arrow bamboos resembled Qing Mao Mountain's green spear bamboo, but their leafless shoots were black and covered solely in branches rather than green jade. At each segment of the arrow bamboo, about three long, sharp branches grew, resembling arrows.

Beneath the forest lay abundant star cave rocks, countless dark fragrance mushrooms, and a field of white shadow grass.

"If I'm not mistaken, this should be the production area for star dart Gu?" Fang Yuan asked.

"Master is correct." Star Form land spirit answered immediately.

Star dart Gu formed when insects entered deep slumber inside porous star cave rocks. After forty-nine days, a portion of the slumbering insects would transform into star dart Gu.

Star dart Gu fed on bamboo juice from the arrow bamboo forest.

"In the past, the bamboo juice formed a thick blue fog, making this a top-quality ground to raise star dart Gu. Unfortunately, lacking good watering liquids, it deteriorated like this," Star Form land spirit said wistfully.

"It seems I have to buy moon well water in batches," Fang Yuan muttered, knowing what water the arrow bamboo forest needed.

"Master is knowledgeable," Star Form land spirit added excitedly.

Guided by the land spirit, Fang Yuan inspected the northern meteorite pits, where stellar fire Gu were raised and falling meteor Gu were produced.

Next, he visited the vast, shimmering broken star lake at the center, which produced star river Gu.

Next, he inspected several fields of star fragment grass planted in black soil. Their plump, glossy blades were far superior to those in Hu Immortal blessed land!

"Arrow bamboo forest, meteorite pit, broken star lake, star fragment grass field." Floating above the lake, Fang Yuan looked satisfied.

These four areas were Star Lord Wan Xiang's four main revenue sources.

Star Lord Wan Xiang's development was solid, mainly selling star dart Gu, stellar fire Gu, falling meteor Gu, star river Gu, and starlight firefly Gu.

While Fang Yuan only traded guts Gu and regretful spiders, Wan Xiang already possessed four established revenue streams.

"With these four revenue sources, my financial power will double! I will be drowning in immortal essence stones!" Fang Yuan rejoiced.

Having operated his blessed land for a long time, Star Lord Wan Xiang had already carved out his own market share in treasure yellow heaven. Inheriting the blessed land allowed Fang Yuan to take over Wan Xiang's businesses directly.

After inspecting the blessed land, a pleased Fang Yuan turned toward what he anticipated most.

"Land spirit, take me to see the blessed land's Immortal Gu!" he instructed.

# Chapter 852: Three Immortal Gu, All Are Useful

Broken star lake spanned as far as the eye could see, and Star Lord Wan Xiang's usual cultivation grounds lay at its bottom.

Reaching the lake bed, Fang Yuan discovered a modest crystal palace comprising a main hall and two side halls.

Star Lord Wan Xiang's Immortal Gu were kept in the main hall.

Guided by Star Form land spirit, Fang Yuan smoothly entered the main hall.

Upon entering, he saw an Immortal Gu flying about.

Resembling an arm-length black centipede, the Immortal Gu zigzagged across the hall, its segments flashing blue.

"This rank six Immortal Gu, Star Mark, temporarily adds six hundred star path dao marks," the land spirit introduced.

"Six hundred dao marks?" Fang Yuan was startled.

"Two hundred dao marks increase power by twenty percent, so six hundred means sixty percent. Unfortunately, they are star path dao marks, and I am not a star path Gu Immortal."

Undoubtedly, Star Mark was a high-quality support-type Immortal Gu!

Though specialized in strength path, activating Star Mark would allow Fang Yuan to disguise his path.

Besides Star Mark, two other Immortal Gu rested in the main hall.

One was a fist-sized prismatic crystal resting quietly on a desk.

Another resembled a tender white bean sprout brimming with vitality.

From the land spirit's introduction, Fang Yuan learned the crystal was Starlight Immortal Gu, while the bean sprout was Star Shoot.

Fang Yuan could not help feeling joyous.

Mortal starlight Gu was an essential material for producing wisdom path star thought Gu.

With Starlight Immortal Gu, he could mass-produce star thought Gu far faster, mirroring his airsac Gu refinement.

Starlight Immortal Gu removed the troublesome step of purchasing mortal starlight Gu.

Using an Immortal Gu base also lowered failure rates, reducing hairy man casualties.

First, using Starlight Immortal Gu required modifying the star thought Gu recipe.

Second, activating Starlight Immortal Gu would consume immortal essence.

With Wisdom Gu and the complete recipe, modifying it was merely a matter of time.

The second issue would indeed have troubled Fang Yuan in the past. With Star Form blessed land's assets, his immortal essence stone earnings would soon quadruple. Such wealth gave Fang Yuan the confidence to continuously expend immortal essence activating Starlight Immortal Gu.

While Starlight Immortal Gu greatly accelerated star thought Gu accumulation, Star Shoot Immortal Gu was equally useful.

Fang Yuan had once purchased a mortal killer move from Star Lord Wan Xiang, called spring star rain.

This move irrigated land and nourished vegetation to boost productivity; Fang Yuan had used it repeatedly since acquiring it.

Frequently activating spring star rain consumed vast numbers of mortal star shoot Gu.

Possessing Star Shoot Immortal Gu, Fang Yuan could elevate spring star rain into an immortal killer move.

Star Mark, Starlight, and Star Shoot were the only Immortal Gu remaining in the blessed land.

Though the three Immortal Gu still held Wan Xiang's will, subduing them with Star Form land spirit's assistance posed little difficulty.

"Master, this is the immortal inheritance held in the blessed land, please have a look." The land spirit handed an inheritance to Fang Yuan.

Becoming the master of Star Form blessed land had doubled Fang Yuan's strength!

Three star path Immortal Gu, four economic pillars, and a complete star path inheritance would take Fang Yuan considerable time to fully digest.

He instructed Star Form land spirit to maintain the ownership request in treasure yellow heaven, feigning that the blessed land remained unclaimed.

He also refrained from telling Hei Lou Lan and Tai Bai Yun Sheng for the time being.

The longer he could conceal it, the better.

Hu Immortal blessed land was exposed, making this secret blessed land a vital retreat if needed.

The following day, Fang Yuan went to participate in the Refinement Path Convention.

Finally, the day arrived for the duel between Fang Yuan and Feng Jin Huang.

Though not an official tournament match, it drew a large audience.

"Feng Jin Huang, show me your wager first; if it is too low, this duel is off," Fang Yuan declared in full view of everyone.

Regardless of the duel, Fang Yuan only aimed for a top-six placement to secure the Infallible inheritance.

Moreover, losing would not eliminate either party or affect their tournament rankings.

Feng Jin Huang secretly transmitted: "My wager will interest you. As an immortal zombie, I possess a method for your revival!"

# Chapter 853: Dueling Feng Jin Huang (1/4)

"A revival method?" Fang Yuan's eyes narrowed, his expression noticeably shifting.

Fang Yuan had long sought a revival method, and Spirit Affinity House possessed one.

By wagering this method, Feng Jin Huang struck directly at his core interests, making refusal impossible!

"Hehehe," Fang Yuan chuckled, suppressing his agitation as he looked at her. "Tell me, this isn't Immortal Crane Sect's possession technique, is it?"

"Of course not." Feng Jin Huang smiled indifferently.

"I am indeed interested, but this wager falls far short of matching Hu Immortal blessed land."

"Value is relative. Fang Yuan, if given the choice between Hu Immortal blessed land and revival, which would you choose?"

'Revival, of course!' Fang Yuan decided instantly, yet replied without hesitation: "Hu Immortal blessed land, naturally. It is my greatest foundation; even as an immortal zombie, I can live comfortably by relying on it."

Feng Jin Huang shook her head, softening her tone: "Fang Yuan, you aren't that short-sighted. Still, I know you won't wager Hu Immortal blessed land, nor can I force you. Let us be practical. If I lose, I provide the revival method. But if you lose, we trade."

Noticing her confident smile, Fang Yuan narrowed his eyes: "What transactions?"

"If you lose, you must supply guts Gu long-term to Spirit Affinity House punctually and sufficiently. We will sell you souls below market price, but our orders take priority over Immortal Crane Sect's. Regardless of your guts Gu output, Spirit Affinity House must be supplied first."

Hearing this, Fang Yuan looked at Feng Jin Huang in a new light, re-evaluating the young girl before him.

Exploring dream realms injured Feng Jin Huang's soul, making guts Gu an urgent necessity for her.

Structuring this wager around practical reality and mutual benefits was a mature move.

To Fang Yuan, selling guts Gu to Spirit Affinity House naturally had its benefits.

First, increasing sales volume would net him far more immortal essence stones.

Second, establishing ties with Spirit Affinity House gave him an alternative route if he ever fell out with Immortal Crane Sect.

"Regardless of victory or loss, this duel is beneficial to me. Anyway, the result of the duel has nothing to do with the competition. Eh? Something is wrong, her request is also to lower my will to fight."

Fang Yuan suddenly realized another layer of intent behind Feng Jin Huang's proposal.

"Let us begin; the final winner will be me!" Fang Yuan laughed heartily, his eyes shining brightly.

Feng Jin Huang's gaze flashed: "That is not for certain."

With wagers settled, both sides began discussing the duel's rules.

After further discussion, they settled on refining the rank five fire path five orifices fire pagoda Gu in a martial duel.

Rather than private, the duel would be conducted openly like the convention itself.

Identical materials and recipes were provided to both contestants.

The first to successfully refine five orifices fire pagoda Gu would be the victor.

In this martial duel format, both refiners could attack each other once upon reaching specific refinement stages.

Under everyone's gaze, Fang Yuan and Feng Jin Huang sat at opposite ends of the stage, separated by roughly two hundred and sixty paces.

The duel began, Fang Yuan immediately inspected the refinement materials.

The convention supplied nearly a thousand raw materials, without a single pre-existing Gu worm.

There were five sequential recipes: rank one single aperture charcoal Gu, rank two double orifice stove Gu, rank three three orifices fire hut Gu, rank four four orifices fire tower Gu, and rank five five orifices fire pagoda Gu.

Refining five orifices fire pagoda Gu began with mass-refining rank one single orifice charcoal Gu, which then served as primary materials for rank two double orifice stove Gu.

Using wisdom path methods, Fang Yuan could modify the recipes to streamline steps or refine five orifices fire pagoda Gu directly from the provided materials.

However, Fang Yuan reconsidered and decided to proceed step by step.

Without Wisdom Gu available, modifying recipes on the spot brought more risk than reward. With five disruptive attacks permitted in this martial duel, proceeding step by step was far safer.

While Fang Yuan inspected materials, Feng Jin Huang checked recipes; when he reviewed recipes, she meticulously examined materials.

Though their preparation order differed, both commenced refinement almost simultaneously.

In the audience, Spirit Affinity House disciples glared at grim-faced Immortal Crane Sect elders. Fang Yuan had wagered guts Gu without consulting Immortal Crane Sect's higher-ups, leaving them deeply disgruntled.

Initially, Fang Yuan and Feng Jin Huang employed identical refinement techniques.

Through seasoned technique, Fang Yuan gradually pulled ahead and gained a slight lead.

Fang Yuan possessed vast practical experience, whereas Feng Jin Huang lacked hands-on seasoning.

To catch up, Feng Jin Huang unleashed a refinement path killer move.

Double action!

Her flame split into two distinct fireballs.

Refinement path killer move — small wishful hand!

Two compact hands forged of pure will emerged from Feng Jin Huang's mind, glowing with a jade luster.

Her hands regulated flame temperatures while the will hands tossed in materials.

# Chapter 854: Dueling Feng Jin Huang (2/4)

Under his mask, Fang Yuan's gaze turned razor-sharp.

Yet he promptly refocused on the fire in his hands.

'He didn't attack? Pity...' Feng Jin Huang sighed inwardly as one of her two flames abruptly extinguished.

Fang Yuan saw through the feint; only Small Wishful Hand was genuine.

Aided by the hands of will, Feng Jin Huang's refinement speed edged past Fang Yuan's, gradually widening the gap.

Relying purely on standard techniques, Fang Yuan maintained rhythm and processed his materials.

The duel had barely begun, and both remained at the stage of refining rank one single orifice charcoal Gu.

"My quasi-grandmaster attainment still falls short of his. What should I do?" Feng Jin Huang strategized rapidly as she refined.

"Killer moves drain my mind rapidly; Fang Yuan's steady advantage will only grow over time. Yet my base techniques cannot match his. I must rely on my prepared killer moves!"

# Chapter 855: Dueling Feng Jin Huang (3/4)

While attacks were permitted, any soul-strengthening or mind-refreshing techniques were strictly prohibited.

Feng Jin Huang flicked her pinky, shooting out a speck of golden light.

The golden light reached Fang Yuan in a blink, targeting the refinement flames in his hands.

Ding!

A crisp sound echoed as the golden light struck a formless barrier three inches from the fire and stopped.

Fang Yuan blocked Feng Jin Huang's attack without batting an eyelid.

'Attacking my vitals to safely activate another killer move?' Fang Yuan observed her with an inward smile.

Feng Jin Huang used an attack chance on Fang Yuan's refinement flames, seizing the opening to activate a second refinement path killer move.

With two killer moves active, her refinement speed surged, gradually leaving Fang Yuan behind.

In this duel, Fang Yuan and Feng Jin Huang each had five attack chances.

Because this was a duel, attack power was strictly restricted each time.

The first attack permitted only rank one Gu, the second rank two, continuing up to rank five on the fifth.

Defenses were likewise restricted to Gu of corresponding ranks.

Time passed and Fang Yuan fell further behind, yet he remained unhurried, seemingly with no intention to overtake her.

Feng Jin Huang activated a third refinement path killer move, boosting her speed again.

An hour later, Feng Jin Huang attacked again to activate her fourth killer move.

'Mm... time to attack.' Sensing the moment was ripe, Fang Yuan sent out a Gu worm from his immortal aperture.

Fang Yuan chuckled: "Feng Jin Huang, be careful. This is rank one ghost fire Gu."

Activated, the Gu became a small eerie ghost fire that drifted slowly toward Feng Jin Huang.

Yet the ghost fire suddenly halted near Feng Jin Huang.

It then circled her slowly, swaying to either side.

Since defenders could only act within one meter, Feng Jin Huang could not intercept the circling flame.

'He's using rank one ghost fire to divert my attention!' Astute as ever, Feng Jin Huang quickly saw through his intent.

'Ghost fires injure the soul,' Feng Jin Huang thought in cold sweat. 'If struck, my refinement will fail. Yet tracking it will tie down my mind and slow my refinement speed.'

Using a rank three attack chance to negate a rank one ghost fire would be a loss.

'He wants to bait out my precious attack chance!' Feng Jin Huang gritted her teeth, glaring at Fang Yuan.

Having relied purely on basic refinement techniques, Fang Yuan had plenty of mental energy to direct it.

"Not destroying my ghost fire? How patient," Fang Yuan laughed. "Then how about another?"

"Feng Jin Huang, look closely—rank two ghost fire Gu," Fang Yuan announced calmly.

The second ghost fire drifted slowly toward Feng Jin Huang, stopping a meter away.

As two ghost fires circled her, the pressure on Feng Jin Huang instantly doubled!

# Chapter 856: Dueling Feng Jin Huang (4/4)

The two ghost fires drifted erratically near and far; Feng Jin Huang had to stay vigilant against them while focusing on her refinement.

A soft explosion resounded as one of her refinement flames extinguished; the partially refined Gu inside was completely lost!

Onstage, Feng Jin Huang wondered: 'Should I dispel a refinement path killer move? Is this Fang Yuan's intention?'

'No, I can use my third attack to release a sonic wave and destroy both ghost fires at once!' Proud to her bones, Feng Jin Huang refused to concede.

While she hesitated, another refinement flame she was controlling exploded.

"Hehehe." Fang Yuan laughed again.

She looked up to see Fang Yuan produce a third Gu. "Look closely, this is a rank three ghost fire Gu."

The three ghost fires circled her, occasionally breaching the one-meter mark before retreating, clearly manipulated to taunt her.

Shortly after Feng Jin Huang began refining four orifices fire tower Gu, Fang Yuan started on it as well.

Feng Jin Huang was startled: "When did he close the gap? Impossible—he hasn't used a single refinement path killer move!"

Fang Yuan pulled level with Feng Jin Huang and gradually overtook her.

"I cannot lose—I will win! Time for my trump card: refinement path killer move—Ink Transformation!"

Feng Jin Huang shouted inwardly, launching three consecutive attacks at Fang Yuan.

"Paltry trick." Fang Yuan blocked every attack while sending the three ghost fires to disrupt her.

The interference achieved little; Feng Jin Huang destroyed the ghost fires, bringing her killer move close to completion.

"Revealing light Gu, go." Fang Yuan sneered inwardly, flicking out a rank four Gu.

Simultaneously, he launched a rank five attack that reached Feng Jin Huang first.

Feng Jin Huang blocked the rank five attack, but revealing light Gu neared her and suddenly detonated.

'How does he know ink transformation's weakness?!' Under her incredulous gaze, ink transformation was forcefully interrupted.

The failed activation brought severe backlash, damaging her internal organs.

Feng Jin Huang spat blood and collapsed to the ground, losing consciousness.

Fang Yuan could not lose; steadily refining five orifices fire pagoda Gu would secure his victory.

Yet just as Fang Yuan was about to succeed, the unfinished Gu in his hand suddenly detonated.

Fang Yuan was startled: "This?!"

# Chapter 857: Fang Zheng's Death

Despite his absolute advantage, Fang Yuan hit the failure rate of rank five Gu refinement, ruining his efforts.

Lacking materials for a second attempt, neither could continue.

Thus, this duel ended in a draw.

Feng Jin Huang personally handed Fang Yuan an information path Gu containing the revival method for immortal zombies.

As an Immortal Crane Sect subsidiary, Fang Yuan agreed to trade guts Gu with Spirit Affinity House. Fang Yuan would prioritize Spirit Affinity House over Immortal Crane Sect in future guts Gu sales.

"Lord Fang Yuan, Lord He Feng Yang wishes to speak with you," an Immortal Crane Sect elder said humbly after the duel.

On a deserted mountain peak, he met He Feng Yang again.

"It wasn't easy to draw this duel, was it?" He Feng Yang asked with a profound gaze.

Fang Yuan smiled: "It couldn't be helped; I met the natural failure rate."

He Feng Yang sized him up seriously: "It is a pity you became a zombie with such refinement talent. To revive, you need not approach others. Immortal Crane Sect has an excellent method to rid you of your zombie status."

It was obviously the possession technique.

"If I must lose my freedom, I'd rather remain a zombie," Fang Yuan said.

He Feng Yang shook his head: "Let's discuss business. You must hand over your brother, or the consequences will be unbearable."

"Oh? Is this a threat?" Fang Yuan's tone became deeper.

Fang Zheng was a backup revival option and the best choice for creating a blood deity—how could Fang Yuan hand him over?

He Feng Yang nodded: "Call it a warning. In truth, eliminating Fang Zheng is Heavenly Court's order. You only need to know that no force in Central Continent can defy Heavenly Court."

"I know of Heavenly Court. But why target a mortal? Your excuse is absurd—how can you convince me?" Fang Yuan spread his arms.

He Feng Yang sighed: "If you keep Fang Zheng alive, Heavenly Court will seize Hu Immortal blessed land. Immortal Crane Sect does not want to see that. Consider it, but time is short. If you agree, hand Fang Zheng over in three days."

Unaware of fate Gu, Fang Yuan struggled to link Heavenly Court with Fang Zheng.

Searching He Feng Yang's face for flaws, Fang Yuan asked: "Do you take me for a fool? Handing Fang Zheng over gives you the key to Hu Immortal blessed land!"

"Haha!" He Feng Yang laughed. "Scheming as ever, Fang Yuan! No need to test me; you already believe it. I'm just as curious as you are! Yet we must curb our curiosity regarding Heavenly Court. In three days, I will execute Fang Zheng before you; in exchange, bring Lord Sky Crane's intact soul. He is a rather capable subordinate of mine."

With He Feng Yang gone, Fang Yuan used Fixed Immortal Travel to return to Hu Immortal blessed land.

Fang Yuan prioritized researching the revival method Feng Jin Huang gave him.

"If I advance blood skull Gu to an Immortal Gu, I could elevate my first aperture into a Desolate Ancient Moon aperture and revive through immortal ascension. Even with a ten extreme physique, the ascension tribulation would be extremely perilous."

Finding the ten extreme ascension method impractical for his current state, Weighing costs and benefits, Fang Yuan shelved the method.

Entering the prison cell of Dang Hun Palace, he saw Fang Zheng locked inside.

"Fang Yuan, what are you doing?" Fang Zheng screamed, his gaze filled with hatred.

"Still so stubborn, my beloved brother. In that case..." Fang Yuan reached toward him.

Fang Yuan searched Fang Zheng's soul repeatedly, finding nothing of value.

"Why would Heavenly Court order the elimination of an ordinary Gu Master like Fang Zheng?" Fang Yuan pondered, inclined to believe He Feng Yang spoke the truth.

Though unafraid of He Feng Yang, Fang Yuan remained wary of Immortal Crane Sect and Heavenly Court.

Three days later, Fang Yuan handed over Fang Zheng and the spirit incubating flea holding Lord Sky Crane's soul.

Fang Zheng had clearly endured terrible torture, his skin torn, flesh mangled, and deep wounds exposing bone.

One severed arm had been replaced with a dog's limb that Fang Zheng could actually feel and move.

He Feng Yang merely glanced over before saying to Fang Yuan: "You made a wise choice."

"Now, hold up your end of the agreement." Fang Yuan's gaze was shining.

"Watch closely!" Under Fang Yuan's watch, He Feng Yang incinerated Fang Zheng on the spot until no trace remained.

"Lord He Feng Yang, why? You promised me!" Lord Sky Crane's voice came from the spirit incubating flea.

"This is Heavenly Court's order; Immortal Crane Sect needs Fang Zheng's sacrifice! Sky Crane, you wanted to possess him at first, but relented to guide his cultivation. Now he is dead without a trace of soul left. To compensate you, I will find a suitable body for your revival," He Feng Yang said slowly.

He Feng Yang swept the spirit incubating flea into his sleeve and looked at Fang Yuan before leaving: "When free, come visit Fei He Mountain."

# Chapter 858: Second Place

Fang Yuan realized: "He Feng Yang is clearly extending goodwill to me."

The duel opened trade between Fang Yuan and Spirit Affinity House, giving them guts Gu priority over Immortal Crane Sect.

Because it occurred publicly under the Refinement Path Convention, Immortal Crane Sect had no excuse to block the transactions.

This contact with Spirit Affinity House made Immortal Crane Sect feel deeply threatened.

Having failed to retake Hu Immortal blessed land and seeing Fang Yuan's refinement prowess, Immortal Crane Sect opted for gentler persuasion.

"Fang Yuan, now that matters are settled, I will take my leave," Tai Bai Yun Sheng said in farewell.

He had been scouting Northern Plains for a suitable place to anchor his blessed land.

"Thank you for your help. Go ahead and blend your heaven and earth qi; I will aid you when the calamity strikes," Fang Yuan said.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng nodded and departed for Northern Plains via stargate.

Fang Yuan returned to the cell, seeing Gu Yue Fang Zheng again.

Fang Yuan had kept the severed arm here, allowing Tai Bai Yun Sheng to revive Fang Zheng using Man as Before Immortal Gu.

He Feng Yang suspected nothing, having no idea an Immortal Gu like Man as Before existed.

Fang Yuan tossed an information path Gu worm to Fang Zheng, sneering: "Take a good look. This is the Immortal Crane Sect and kind master you are so grateful towards; without me, you would already be dead."

"Impossible! I won't believe your lies!" Fang Zheng screamed, yet still held the information path Gu worm.

After viewing it, an enraged Fang Zheng shattered the Gu worm. His face contorted as he pointed at Fang Yuan, screaming: "Impossible! This is all fake, you made it up! I'll never believe it! You're lying! Not unless I see and hear it for myself, and get master's reply!"

"You will witness it all. But... not yet." Fang Yuan turned and left the room.

With Fang Zheng settled, Fang Yuan progressed smoothly through the Refinement Path Convention.

Eventually, Feng Jin Huang got sixth place, while Fang Yuan reached the finals.

He faced the strongest competitor in this competition — Yu Mu Chun.

In this battle, Fang Yuan lost completely.

Although the task matched his previous life, giving Fang Yuan the advantage of advance knowledge, his opponent, Yu Mu Chun, was a true refinement path quasi-great grandmaster.

Regardless, by taking second place, Fang Yuan achieved his goal of obtaining a success dao mark.

Regardless of the price the ten great ancient sects offered, Fang Yuan rejected them all.

Back in Hu Immortal blessed land, he prepared to refine change form Immortal Gu.

With the success dao mark, he needed only a single set of materials, drastically reducing the cost.

Assembling the ingredients had required selling most of his immortal materials from the Northern Plains auction.

# Chapter 859: Refining Immortal Gu

Central Continent, True Yang mountain range.

On a perilous peak, a hairy man climbed enthusiastically.

"Master, master! Wait for me!" The hairy man climbed as he shouted.

Unlike most hairy men, he possessed intelligent eyes and spoke like ordinary humans.

He had been observing Yu Mu Chun throughout the convention and was now pursuing him across the mountain range.

Anxious as the gap widened again, the hairy man rushed down the mountain, only to misstep and tumble down the slope.

Suddenly, a pair of legs appeared before him.

The hairy man quickly knelt: "Master, you finally stopped for me!"

Yu Mu Chun sighed gravely: "Ben Duo Yi, I only gave you casual pointers years ago. We lack the fate to be master and disciple."

Ben Duo Yi wept. Lunging forward, he hugged Yu Mu Chun's leg: "Master, oh master! Even if you won't acknowledge me, your guidance enlightened me, breaking my limits and elevating my refinement attainment to unforeseen heights! Though you only spoke a few words, your kindness changed my fate. In my heart, you will forever be my master!"

Yu Mu Chun patted Ben Duo Yi's head: "Hehe, I only advised you back then because your intelligence far exceeded ordinary hairy men. Yet refusing you as a disciple is for your own good. I have escaped fate; associating with me will only bring you harm. Never tell anyone I guided you, or you will surely die a gruesome death. Remember this well."

"Crossing thirty mountains to pursue me shows rare determination. Your greatest strength is your unique intellect. Humans are the spirit of all living beings, yet your intellect rivals theirs. But do not over-rely on cleverness—careless swimmers easily drown. Treasure your sincerity and perseverance instead. Now, get up."

Suddenly, a formless force pushed Ben Duo Yi away, leaving his arms clutching empty air as Yu Mu Chun floated skyward.

"Ben Duo Yi, our chance affinity ends today. As a parting gift, here is your final lesson. Watch closely."

Central Continent, Earth Abyss, inside Star Form blessed land.

Fang Yuan looked down from the sky toward the massive turtle shell before him.

The inverted shell formed a basin filled with poisonous blood.

Collected during Hu Immortal's calamity, this poisonous blood would serve to refine change form Immortal Gu.

"I can finally begin refining change form Immortal Gu." Fang Yuan exhaled misty air.

With the success dao mark, the failure rate was reduced to zero.

Even so, he spent half a day conditioning his mind and body beforehand.

His eyes shone brilliantly as countless ghost fires ignited beneath the turtle shell.

Central Continent, True Yang mountain range.

Ben Duo Yi looked up, only to be stunned.

# Chapter 869: Freedom of the Feathermen

Fang Yuan sighed: "Wisdom path methods are exceedingly hard to defend against. We must take measures against them. Don't rush to Eastern Sea yet, Old Bai. Let me place wisdom path protections on you against other wisdom path immortals."

Deeply moved, Tai Bai Yun Sheng bowed: "Then I shall trouble you!"

Back when Fang Yuan was still a mortal Gu Master, this featherman assassin had tried to kill him repeatedly.

"A featherman with severed wings? How pitiful," Fang Yuan had taunted.

"Hehehe, I severed them myself," the featherman assassin laughed sinisterly. "Do you want to know why?"

"The village chief praised me as a once-in-a-century genius. It was truly annoying! He always warned that I belonged to the village. When I wanted to explore the world, the chief and all the villagers stopped me. They feared I would attract human slave hunters. So one day, I could not withstand it any longer, cut off my wings, and killed everyone in the village."

"What?!" Fang Yuan was shocked.

The featherman assassin shrugged: "Feathermen revere freedom, but my desire was fiercer. My featherman identity bound me, so I cut off my wings. The village and villagers constrained me, so I killed them. In this world, no one can restrict my freedom."

On full alert before he had tread the demonic path, Fang Yuan snapped: "You lunatic!"

"Hahaha." The featherman assassin laughed loudly: "Thanks for the compliment!"

# Chapter 870: Freedom Gu

The Legends of Ren Zu states that after parting with the hairy man leader along his road of life, Ren Zu encountered feathermen in green heaven.

Ren Zu pleaded with them: "Feathermen, please help me rescue my daughter trapped in Ordinary Abyss so we may reunite."

Despite Ren Zu's persistent pleading, the feathermen simply kept flying, savoring the joy of freedom.

Self Gu said proudly: "Having bitten strength Gu, I possess immense strength of my own. Human, remember: what is most reliable is your own strength. Without strength, freedom is just an illusion."

Self Gu complained: "Human, how could you release them so easily? Don't you want to rescue your fourth child?"

One cold night, several feathermen sheltered under his eaves to escape the blizzard, greedily absorbing the warmth seeping through the door crack.

Wearing attitude Gu, Ren Zu opened the door and invited the feathermen inside to share his food.

The feathermen grew accustomed to this life until Ren Zu removed attitude Gu, revealing his cold expression.

He shut the house and stored the food, no longer providing anything to the feathermen for free.

Soon, all the feathermen faced death from hunger and cold.

When most feathermen had died, Ren Zu raised the matter again: "Feathermen, as long as you fly to ordinary abyss and rescue my daughter, I will provide ample food and warm houses."

However, the remaining feathermen still shook their heads.

From the corpses, many tiny, multicolored motes of light flew out. Ren Zu tried to grab these creatures, but failed.

"It is no use," Cognition Gu told him. "Wild freedom Gu cannot be caught. These feathermen chased freedom all their lives, but could only find it in death."

Central Continent, Hu Immortal blessed land, Dang Hun palace.

As for Zheng Ling, attacked only by Fang Yuan's poison and strength path killer moves, his soul was preserved even as his body perished.

This modification allowed the giant hand to capture an enemy's injured soul upon killing them.

Fang Yuan had just ended his first soul search.

"Living for generations in a green heaven fragment world, they held ancient customs, choosing suicide over enslavement. Peace and plentiful resources corroded their minds."

"White Sea Shatuo... who is this person?"

# Chapter 871: Rock Dragon Eye

# Chapter 872: Joining Lang Ya's Defensive Battle

"I know. Only five buildings remain; two are held by Inkman City's Gu Immortals. You guard this one, while I hold another. The last is for Tai Bai Yun Sheng," the land spirit assigned.

Sweeping the blood into his sleeves, Fang Yuan stood within the star cloud grindstone, smiling at the wolf outside: "Sir He Lang Zi's agility is remarkable. Care to spar inside?"

Inside the grindstone, Fang Yuan moved freely while the swirling forces constantly ground down his enemy.

Instead, the fragrant sorcerer yin statue wolf wheeled around and pounced directly at the cloud building.

Seeing the wolf charge the cloud building, Fang Yuan remained calm inside the grindstone, smiling faintly.

Immortal killer move — Star Snake Rope!

Six thin ropes of condensed starlight shot from the grindstone's edge, their tips glowing blue in the shape of snake heads.

Slithering like agile vipers, the six ropes tightly coiled around the wolf's body.

"Where are you going, Sir He Lang Zi? Come fight inside," Fang Yuan chuckled, pulling the snared wolf into the star cloud grindstone.

"Complementary immortal killer moves—a fine tactic," Hui Feng Zi commended, eyes gleaming.

# Chapter 877: Six Illusion Star Bodies, Position Star Swap

Trapped within the star cloud grindstone, He Lang Zi strained under mounting pressure as countless starlight specks ground against his body.

Unfazed, He Lang Zi analyzed: "This form grants speed, but lacks defense and strength. This person has a deep soul foundation; earlier my scratch did nothing! My wolf's soul-rending attacks clearly have little effect on him."

Despite his muzzled jaws, He Lang Zi could still activate Gu, growling furiously: "Since you court death, I'll grant it!"

As he said that, lightning burst out.

Engulfed in lightning, Fang Yuan's six star snake ropes snapped and disintegrated.

In the fragrant sorcerer yin statue wolf's place stood a lightning flash giant wolf!

With a roar, a lightning pillar erupted skyward, shattering the star cloud grindstone beyond maintenance.

Fang Yuan's robe was shredded, his body riddled with injuries.

The lightning flash giant wolf scoffed in human speech: "Trapping me without a battlefield killer move? Naive fool, die!"

With that, he opened his maw and fired a beam of lightning.

Facing the surging lightning pillar, Fang Yuan's eyes gleamed calmly beneath the blue glow: "Hehe, killing me won't be that simple."

Fang Yuan split into six figures and scattered, evading the lightning blast.

Star path immortal killer move — Six Illusion Star Bodies!

"Six clones—which is real?" Observing from afar, Hui Feng Zi held back, wary of the lurking strength path Gu Immortal.

Trailing blue starlight, the six bodies encircled and simultaneously assaulted the lightning flash giant wolf.

He Lang Zi killed eight illusion bodies in rapid succession, but they regenerated endlessly without pause.

While He Lang Zi burned rank seven immortal essence maintaining immortal defenses, Fang Yuan merely expended primeval essence sustaining mortal killer moves.

"Damn it, this lightning flash giant wolf has great attacking power, but lacks speed and investigation. Even if I attack the cloud building, the enemy will obstruct me. Must I transform back into the fragrant sorcerer yin statue wolf?"

While He Lang Zi was hesitant, Hui Feng Zi struck.

Fang Yuan halted his attacks, surprised to find a green feather on his head.

"When was I hit? What immortal killer move can expose my true body?" Fang Yuan was shocked.

Hui Feng Zi had activated an investigative killer move the moment Fang Yuan used the clones, marking his true body.

With his true body exposed, the lightning flash giant wolf struck at Fang Yuan with precision.

Left with no choice, Fang Yuan deployed star cloud grindstone before him.

Fang Yuan was forced into a passive position as the grindstone crumbled beneath the lightning pillar and the wolf charged.

Immortal killer move — Position Star Swap!

Shining with starlight, Fang Yuan vanished and instantly replaced one of the six illusion star bodies.

Just as Fang Yuan and He Lang Zi reached a deadlock, Hui Feng Zi struck.

Immortal killer move — Wind Escape!

He turned into a gust of wind, vanishing on the spot.

At the next moment, he appeared outside the cloud building, opening his mouth wide.

Immortal killer move — Death Wind Flying Blade!

A wind blade flew from Hui Feng Zi's mouth, slashing at the cloud building's top floor.

The cloud building lasted barely a breath before the sharp wind blade sliced it in two!

"Wind escape? A top-tier Northern Plains movement killer move! He is Hui Feng Zi!" Recognizing his identity, Fang Yuan immediately called for Lang Ya land spirit.

Lang Ya land spirit appeared instantly, grabbing Fang Yuan's arm as they vanished with a swoosh.

# Chapter 878: Moment of Crisis

When Fang Yuan's vision cleared, he was already in another cloud building.

Fang Yuan exhaled turbid air; retreating without Lang Ya land spirit's help would have been difficult.

"We only had five cloud buildings to begin with, and now we've lost two while barely delaying them. The enemy is attacking again—this time, the three of us strike together!" Lang Ya land spirit instructed grimly.

As the land spirit spoke, Fang Yuan noticed an inkman Gu Immortal in the cloud building alongside them.

The inkman Gu Immortal merely nodded at Fang Yuan in silence, seemingly averse to interaction.

Frowning anxiously out the window, Lang Ya land spirit blurted: "They arrived so fast! Charging straight for this cloud building—it looks bad. They must have an investigative method targeting my twelve wave cloud confusion formation."

Sure enough, breaths later, surging winds dispelled the thick fog to reveal a clear space.

Two enemy Gu Immortals were proudly standing in the air.

One was Hei Cheng, while the other was the formidable rank seven Gu Immortal, Qin Bai Sheng.

The land spirit clearly recognized Qin Bai Sheng's strength as well, frowning deeply: "Damn it, I'm so close. Given enough time, these tigers would all become sick cats!"

Turning to the inkman Gu Immortal in the corner, the land spirit ordered: "Old Mo, engage them first and stall for as much time as you can."

"Yes, Lord Lang Ya." The inkman Gu Immortal slightly bowed before flying out of the cloud building.

"Fang Yuan, prepare to move," Lang Ya land spirit instructed.

Just then, an overwhelming suppressive pressure surged from ahead.

"What is this?!" The terrifying pressure caused Fang Yuan and Lang Ya land spirit to turn pale.

They quickly looked over, brilliant golden light filled their sight.

As the golden light faded, Qin Bai Sheng stood aloft, while Hei Cheng stared at his back as if looking at a monster.

And in Qin Bai Sheng's hands, was a head.

It was the head of that inkman Gu Immortal!

Qin Bai Sheng had slain a rank six Gu Immortal in a single breath!

"Terrifying! Qin Bai Sheng's battle strength surpasses Shi Lei and matches Feng Jiu Ge. Retreat!" Fang Yuan bellowed to Lang Ya land spirit.

Snapping to his senses, Lang Ya land spirit seized Fang Yuan's arm and vanished instantly.

"What happened?" In another cloud building, the guarding Mo Tan Sang was startled by their sudden appearance.

Panicking, Lang Ya land spirit looked around: "What do we do?"

Shuddering, he stared northwest as if peering through the walls, terrified: "They're heading straight for us! What can we do?!"

Fang Yuan answered Mo Tan Sang, his voice heavy with apprehension: "That inkman Gu Immortal is dead—decapitated by Qin Bai Sheng in a single move! Such battle strength rivals rank eight; only a massive disparity in power could produce such an overwhelming result!"

"What? Elder Mo was killed in one move?!" Mo Tan Sang shook violently in disbelief and shock.

Stepping forward, he pressed Lang Ya land spirit: "Lord land spirit, what do we do? We can't stall any longer! Can't you activate your rank eight Immortal Gu House, Refinement Cauldron, early to forcibly refine their Immortal Gu?"

'The land spirit's trump card is an Immortal Gu House that can forcibly refine others' Immortal Gu?' Fang Yuan was shaken by this revelation.

With Refinement Cauldron, given enough time, the land spirit could refine the invaders' Immortal Gu, neutralizing their threat entirely.

"If I could refine them now, I would have! What do I do? There isn't enough time!!" Lang Ya land spirit raved, pacing in panic.

# Chapter 879: Long Hair Ancestor's Secret

Heavenly Court.

Inside Heaven Overseeing Tower, four rank eight Gu Immortals—Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord, Bai Cang Shui, Lian Jiu Sheng, and Bi Chen Tian—stationed themselves in the cardinal directions.

The massive Gu formation projected a grand image into the sky.

By now, they had consumed half of the success dao marks obtained from the Infallible inheritance.

Bai Cang Shui gazed admiringly at the refinement path formation; this was her first time participating in fate Gu's restoration.

Noticing her expression, Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord remarked: "Fairy Cang Shui, if you want this refinement path formation, it costs only thirty thousand contribution points."

Bai Cang Shui understood the warning: repairing fate Gu was at a crucial stage, and she must not be distracted.

"I am ashamed," Bai Cang Shui bowed, sighing. "This formation is truly magnificent. Even without cultivating refinement path, I can tell it touches upon the path's fundamental essence. Yet it feels incomplete, as though it could be elevated into an Immortal Gu House!"

"Hehehe, Fairy Cang Shui is perceptive, but elevating this formation into an Immortal Gu House is impossible," Lian Jiu Sheng, appearing as a white-haired youth, chuckled.

"Oh? Why is that?" Bai Cang Shui asked with curious, flickering eyes.

"Mainly because we lack the most crucial core Immortal Gu. Fairy Cang Shui, this refinement path formation is merely a mimicry of Long Hair Ancestor's rank eight Immortal Gu House, Refinement Cauldron, deduced by Heavenly Court predecessors from historical records." Lian Jiu Sheng revealed: "And that Refinement Cauldron is still inside Lang Ya blessed land, complete with all its core Immortal Gu."

"Naturally, we could modify the formation to substitute other Immortal Gu as cores for a similar effect. Yet that is exceptionally difficult. When Long Hair Ancestor created Eighty-Eight True Yang Building and Refinement Cauldron, he was not only a refinement path supreme grandmaster, but also aided by his friend, the wisdom path great grandmaster Immortal Yi Yan."

"Immortal Yi Yan, Long Hair Ancestor..." Bai Cang Shui murmured, before asking, "Why didn't Heavenly Court recruit Long Hair Ancestor back then? Even as a Northern Plains immortal, Heavenly Court has methods to assimilate his regional aura to Central Continent."

Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord chuckled coldly: "Because Long Hair Ancestor was no human, but a hairy man! He could never enter Heavenly Court. Heavenly Court is humanity's sanctuary—how could we allow lowly variant humans in?"

"Long Hair Ancestor was a hairy man?" The other three Gu Immortals exchanged glances, hearing this secret for the first time.

Northern Plains, Lang Ya blessed land.

Displaying unstoppable might, Qin Bai Sheng charged toward the cloud building guarded by Fang Yuan, Mo Tan Sang, and the pacing land spirit.

"No, if I let him out, I'll be trapped inside. Who knows when I could reemerge?"

"That maniac's ambition is too wild; he'll bring ruin to Lang Ya blessed land!"

"Lord land spirit, stay calm! Long Hair Ancestor stood on equal terms with Demon Venerables—think carefully, there must be a way!" Mo Tan Sang urged.

"Don't force me, don't force me!" Lang Ya land spirit clutched his hair, shaking his head frantically.

Growing more anxious, Mo Tan Sang seized and shook the land spirit's arm: "Lang Ya land spirit, get a hold of yourself!"

Ah——!

Pushed to his limit, Lang Ya land spirit threw his head back and screamed.

Boom!

A tremendous force erupted from Lang Ya land spirit's body.

Caught off guard, Mo Tan Sang coughed up blood and slammed violently into the wall.

"You... you aren't Lang Ya land spirit?!" Mo Tan Sang stared wide-eyed, shouting in disbelief.

The land spirit's sagely demeanor was gone. Now muscular and burly, standing as tall as Fang Yuan's zombie form, his bulging muscles radiated terrifying power.

Most noticeably, thick brown fur sprouted over almost his entire body.

With bloodshot eyes and exposed fangs, his lips curled into a sinister grin.

In an instant, Lang Ya land spirit had shifted from an elderly human into a burly hairy man!

Fang Yuan was equally startled by the land spirit's transformation.

He immediately stepped back, watching Lang Ya land spirit warily.

Lang Ya land spirit looked down at Mo Tan Sang, sneering: "How am I not Lang Ya land spirit? Ever since that myriad tribulation severely weakened me, that spineless fellow took control."

Inhaling deeply with a ruthless sneer, he clenched his massive fists: "I am finally back!"

"Hehehe, no need for suspicion, I am the authentic Lang Ya land spirit!" Raising his head, he fixed a dagger-sharp gaze on Fang Yuan and Mo Tan Sang.

"My main body left two obsessions upon death. With neither able to overpower the other, we merged into Lang Ya land spirit. The one you know was merely the obsession over Space Escape Immortal Gu," he snorted in explanation.

Reacting much faster, Fang Yuan asked: "Then what is your condition for acknowledging a master?"

"Hmph! You are far from qualified to make me acknowledge you!" The hairy man land spirit glared at Fang Yuan with far greater arrogance than before.

"Why not?" Fang Yuan asked calmly, keeping his temper in check.

Lang Ya land spirit laughed arrogantly: "My ambition is for hairy men to rule the world! All humans must bow at our feet! You will become our slaves! Whichever hairy man accomplishes this will become my new master!"

Mo Tan Sang was stunned.

Fang Yuan was speechless.

No wonder Fang Yuan was unqualified—he was not a hairy man and could not even attempt it.

Their past rapport was now useless. What attitude would this land spirit take toward the human Fang Yuan?

# Chapter 880: Fearsome! Lang Ya Land Spirit versus Qin Bai Sheng!

"Don't be nervous, lad, I won't attack you," Lang Ya land spirit said playfully, eyeing Fang Yuan like a tiger. "Even though you've taken advantage of me plenty of times."

"Those were all fair transactions!" Fang Yuan denied plainly.

"You profited greatly from that weakling. But no matter—we can still cooperate," Lang Ya land spirit said coldly.

Squinting in apparent disbelief, Fang Yuan asked: "Don't you plan to overthrow humanity and establish hairy man supremacy?"

"Of course I do!" Lang Ya land spirit answered without hesitation. "But success takes time and realistic steps. Even my main body had to disguise himself as a human in life. To achieve hairy man hegemony, cooperating with humans is necessary."

Surprise flashed across Fang Yuan's eyes.

Despite his wild obsession, this new land spirit possessed a clear grasp of reality.

"My plan is flawless!" Lang Ya land spirit's eyes gleamed as he declared profoundly: "First, I will entice human Gu Immortals with benefits, using humans against humans to destroy them from within. I'll turn these human immortals into hunting dogs for hairy men. And you are one of my targets, hahaha!"

He pointed at Fang Yuan and threw his head back in laughter.

Incapable of lying, the land spirit had completely exposed his own schemes!

Realizing his slip, he abruptly stopped laughing and stroked his chin in regret: "Ahhh! I got too excited and blurted out my whole plan!"

Turning to Mo Tan Sang, the land spirit said: "As for you, inkman Gu Immortal—I'm not that weakling who turned down cooperation out of fear of exposure. Work with us hairy men, and Inkman City will grow far faster and stronger!"

"Hahaha!" Lang Ya land spirit laughed again at another thought. "Stupid inkmen! To establish hairy man supremacy, we must exploit these inkmen, feathermen, and the rest. I can turn their king into a puppet—haha, brilliant plan!"

Fang Yuan felt relieved; how could someone like Lang Ya land spirit ever achieve hairy man supremacy?!

As Qin Bai Sheng drew closer, the cloud building entered his attack range.

"The land spirit and two Gu Immortals are inside." Qin Bai Sheng's impressive investigative killer move revealed many details of Fang Yuan's side.

Qin Bai Sheng squinted and slowed down, waving his right hand.

Bam!

Golden light burst forth as a huge golden hammer formed instantly, hurtling toward the cloud building.

Fierce air currents raged around the menacing golden hammer, which dwarfed the fragile cloud building.

Metal path immortal killer move — City Crushing Hammer!

"What audacity!" A figure charged out of the cloud building, shouting fiercely.

It was Lang Ya land spirit!

The land spirit did not dodge, facing the giant hammer directly.

As his thick arms met City Crushing Hammer, dozens of Gu worms flew out and circled him.

Rule path immortal killer move — Cleanse Sky!

Instantly, the giant golden hammer vanished without a trace, as if it had never existed.

Only the hammer's residual air currents remained, whipping up unceasing winds.

"Lang Ya land spirit?" Seeing this transformed figure, Qin Bai Sheng showed a peculiar expression, asking uncertainly.

"It is me, your grandfather!" Lang Ya land spirit roared, charging directly at Qin Bai Sheng.

He was the polar opposite of the previous land spirit, bold and brimming with battle intent.

Representing the world, the land spirit was the most crucial factor when attacking a blessed land.

Yet this hairy man version of Lang Ya land spirit charged right into battle.

Qin Bai Sheng's fearsome display of battle strength did not deter Lang Ya land spirit at all.

"Heh." Hei Cheng who was at the side laughed.

He believed that against Qin Bai Sheng's strength, the land spirit was simply courting doom.

But as the target, Qin Bai Sheng had a serious expression.

For the first time since invading Lang Ya blessed land, he unexpectedly stepped back and retreated.

He primarily cultivated soul path and secondarily metal path; his signature killer move, soul suppression, was useless against Lang Ya land spirit.

Lang Ya land spirit was a special existence with no soul!

Formed from obsession fused with heavenly power, he was a spirit neither real nor fake, possessing neither physical body nor soul.

Aware of this and wary of the land spirit's strange behavior, Qin Bai Sheng chose to retreat and observe.

As Qin Bai Sheng retreated, Lang Ya land spirit grew more vigorous and relentlessly pressed on.

Immortal killer move — Great Thousand Spears!

Immortal killer move — Triple Desolation!

Immortal killer move — Lightning Chaotic Starfire!

Countless golden spears shot out like a dense forest, converging on Qin Bai Sheng from all directions.

Qin Bai Sheng quickly defended himself as a huge pillar appeared, enveloped by a coiling five-clawed golden dragon.

The golden dragon pillar temporarily blocked Great Thousand Spears, but white hair spread across Qin Bai Sheng's head as his lifespan shortened.

This was the power of the time path killer move triple desolation!

Great Thousand Spears rained down while Triple Desolation aged him; lightning starfires slipped past the golden dragon pillar, scorching Qin Bai Sheng's flesh.

Ice, space, and dark path killer moves followed in succession, forcing Qin Bai Sheng to defend and retreat again.

Lang Ya land spirit pressed forward with surging aura, unleashing killer moves like a flash flood and continuously driving Qin Bai Sheng back.

Advancing and retreating, the two clashed until they were tens of li away.

Hei Cheng, Fang Yuan, and Mo Tan Sang watched, dumbfounded.

Lang Ya blessed land possessed a profound foundation—countless Immortal Gu, Long Hair Ancestor's killer moves, and immense immortal essence accumulated over millennia.

Backed by such foundation, the land spirit could sustain this frenzied offensive without worrying about expenditure.

Even Fang Yuan suspected Lang Ya land spirit could maintain this insane onslaught for three days and nights without stopping.

In fact, it was the first time Fang Yuan had ever seen a land spirit with such tremendous strength and ruthlessness.

# Chapter 881: Five Finger Fist Heart Sword

"Are you done fooling around?!" Qin Bai Sheng suddenly shouted.

In the air, golden light resembling a sun burst out.

The golden light was simply too bright to look at directly.

Intense heat and radiation burst forth with the light, rapidly raising temperatures as if roasting the world.

Soul path and metal path — dual immortal killer move — burning soul supreme gold!

Though the land spirit was immune to soul burning, Burning Soul Supreme Gold combined formidable offense and defense.

Qin Bai Sheng became like a miniature sun, his radiance suppressing the surrounding battlefield.

Lang Ya land spirit's attacks were all disrupted or resisted.

Withstanding the barrage of killer moves, Qin Bai Sheng caught his breath and found an opening to attack.

As he struck back, Lang Ya land spirit's offensive faltered under an intense counterattack.

Despite his vast foundation, the land spirit lacked true combat wisdom.

His killer moves lacked coordination, interfering with each other and wasting much of their power.

Ultimately, a land spirit was merely an obsession left by a deceased Gu Immortal, fused with heavenly power.

Unlike Fang Yuan, the land spirit soon left openings for Qin Bai Sheng to exploit.

Lang Ya land spirit was forced to retreat, suppressed by Qin Bai Sheng's attacks.

Qin Bai Sheng attacked with perfect coordination, steadily restraining Lang Ya land spirit and leaving him sinking deeper with no hope of turning the tide.

"What do we do? The land spirit is definitely going to lose!" Mo Tan Sang looked anxiously at Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan did not answer, he was hesitant.

By charging out recklessly and endangering himself, Lang Ya land spirit was simply being foolish!

While the land spirit was immune to Qin Bai Sheng's soul suppression, Fang Yuan and Mo Tan Sang were highly vulnerable.

If the land spirit perished, Mo Tan Sang would be trapped and forced to fight.

With Fixed Immortal Travel, Fang Yuan could leave at any moment, choosing to sit back and observe.

Boom!

Struck directly by Qin Bai Sheng, Lang Ya land spirit flew like a tossed rubber ball, crashing violently into the cloud soil.

The soft cloud soil gave way, and the land spirit sank deep inside, forming a massive pit.

He tried to teleport, only to find a golden chain coiling tightly around him.

The land spirit struggled intensely, but he could not move.

"It is over." Looking stern and cold, Qin Bai Sheng hovered above the land spirit.

Retracting his aura, Qin Bai Sheng pressed his palms together before his chest like a monk, closing his eyes.

Fang Yuan stared fixedly at Qin Bai Sheng, inwardly shocked: "This posture, is it that legendary move?"

Slowly, Qin Bai Sheng pulled his right hand away as if drawing something precious, clenching it into a fist.

Keeping his left hand in place, he raised his clenched right fist high overhead.

Sensing immense danger, Lang Ya land spirit struggled violently, fracturing the golden chains wrapped around him.

"Sword Immortal Bo Qing's legendary move! How does Qin Bai Sheng possess it?" Fang Yuan watched with a heavy heart, not daring to intervene.

Sword path immortal killer move — Five Finger Fist Heart Sword!

First finger!

Qin Bai Sheng raised the thumb of his right hand.

A sword light shot out from his raised right fist.

The speed of the sword light was beyond belief.

The moment it fired, it pierced Lang Ya land spirit's forehead.

His movements froze; like a statue, he stared blankly at Qin Bai Sheng in the sky.

The next moment, the land spirit thrashed violently as if struck by lightning.

An immortal zombie body would have perished from this blow, but the land spirit lacked fatal physical weaknesses.

Yet the strike dealt severe damage, causing his once distinct, compact head to blur.

Second finger!

Qin Bai Sheng raised his index finger.

The second sword light shot out with equal swiftness.

Piercing his right arm, the sword light made the land spirit howl as the limb blurred.

Third finger!

The third sword light pierced his left arm, making him cry in agony as it faded.

"Quick, save him! If the land spirit dies, we are finished!" Mo Tan Sang yelled in panic.

With a grave gaze, Fang Yuan stood motionless as a mountain, making no move to help.

Fourth finger!

Qin Bai Sheng raised the ring finger of his right hand.

"Save me!!" Lang Ya land spirit shouted in sheer panic.

"Let's risk it!" Mo Tan Sang yelled, charging out with a ranged killer move.

But the fourth sword light had already shot out.

Clang!

A sharp metallic collision rang out from within the pit.

A figure materialized before Lang Ya land spirit, blocking the fourth sword light.

"A rank seven Gu Immortal..." Sensing the unfamiliar aura, Fang Yuan's eyes flashed.

This was the change.

As expected, Lang Ya blessed land still held hidden trump cards.

Eight more figures suddenly appeared, landing around the pit to protect Lang Ya land spirit.

Mo Tan Sang skidded to a halt and gasped in disbelief: "So many hairy man Gu Immortals?!"

The nine Gu Immortals that came were all hairy men.

The hairy man who saved the land spirit was the sole rank seven; the rest were rank six.

But Fang Yuan frowned.

"So many hairy man Gu Immortals..." Qin Bai Sheng opened his eyes and lowered his arms, dispelling Five Finger Fist Heart Sword. His lips curled into a confident smile of victory.

He never intended to kill Lang Ya land spirit; he only wanted to draw out these hairy man Gu Immortals.

"Something's wrong!" Fang Yuan's forehead was wrinkled from his frown.

"The previous land spirit wouldn't ignore such strength and seek outside help without a reason."

Inspiration struck Fang Yuan: "Unless their true goal was never Lang Ya blessed land to begin with?!"

# Chapter 882: The Real Lang Ya Blessed Land

Why hadn't the previous land spirit deployed these concealed hairy man Gu Immortals even during such dire crises?

Fang Yuan guessed the reason was the rank eight Immortal Gu House, Refinement Cauldron!

The elderly human land spirit had likely stationed all the hairy man Gu Immortals inside Refinement Cauldron.

The land spirit cherished these hairy men like his own children, keeping them in Refinement Cauldron to shield them from danger.

With more hairy man Gu Immortals inside Refinement Cauldron, its power grew, refining enemy Immortal Gu much faster.

During previous invasions, the land spirit had used stationed hairy men to refine enemy Immortal Gu and capture invaders alive.

'Yet this hairy man land spirit is equally flawed, battling recklessly and only summoning reinforcements at death's door.' Fang Yuan shook his head inwardly.

Qin Bai Sheng, Hei Cheng, and the hairy man Gu Immortals entered a stalemate.

Suddenly, the rank seven hairy man Gu Immortal who had blocked Five Finger Fist Heart Sword collapsed to the ground.

"First Hair, what's wrong with you?!" A female hairy man knelt, only to find him already dead from sword energy.

"First Hair, you can't die!" The female hairy man Gu Immortal broke down in tears, completely hysterical.

Fang Yuan and Mo Tan Sang were dazed.

They finally understood why the land spirit kept these hairy men inside Refinement Cauldron instead of deploying them in battle.

Their combat capability was completely abysmal.

Raised purely as refinement assistants, they were supreme masters of Gu refinement but completely inept in battle.

With an ashen face, Lang Ya land spirit inspected the fallen rank seven hairy man with a bitter sigh, gently closing his eyes.

Others wept innocently, accusing Qin Bai Sheng: "Heavens, why are you so cruel? We had no grievance, why attack and take innocent lives? Isn't peaceful coexistence a good thing?"

"Hand over the Immortal Gu House, Refinement Cauldron, and I'll spare you," Qin Bai Sheng sneered.

"Impossible! Don't even think of it!" Lang Ya land spirit glared furiously, rejecting him flatly without hesitation.

"Hmph, trying to use Refinement Cauldron to forcibly refine our Immortal Gu? Don't be naive—I won't give you the time."

Qin Bai Sheng scoffed, then paused as if sensing something.

He muttered, then raised his voice: "So you're ready? Then let's begin! I shall break this hindrance first!"

His gaze shifted toward the cloud building.

Immortal killer move — City Crushing Hammer!

As the giant hammer smashed down, Fang Yuan reacted quickly, dodging away to avoid drawing attention.

Rumble!

The cloud building shattered under City Crushing Hammer.

Fang Yuan flew out looking battered, his appearance already disguised once more.

Qin Bai Sheng snorted, giving a meaningful look at Fang Yuan before looking elsewhere.

Twelve wave cloud confusion formation was broken!

Clawing at the sky, he cried out yearningly: "Come, Refinement Cauldron!"

Simultaneously, the mysterious black-robed immortal and Fairy Jiang Yu clawed at the cloud soil elsewhere.

Crackle!

The sky erupted with thunder, lightning flashed, clouds surged, and space broke apart.

A thunderous roar echoed, as if an invisible colossal monster was clawing through the cloud soil!

A massive fissure tore through the thick cloud soil like parting cotton.

The crack spanned east to west, stretching beyond the horizon of the immortals' vision.

"This is?!" Mo Tan Sang's pupils contracted.

"So this is the true Lang Ya blessed land... everything before was merely the surface?" Fang Yuan was thoroughly shocked.

Gazing down the giant crack, the immortals saw a boundless ocean beneath the cloud soil.

The ocean actually had three enormous continents!

On these three continents, hairy men were the sole rulers, occupying the dominant position.

Countless villages and cities spread across mountains and riverbanks, while hairy men explored the ocean and its islands.

Here, hairy men lived and refined Gu, standing unchallenged at the top of the food chain.

"How is this possible? With such vast space, is this still a blessed land? Even ordinary grotto-heavens aren't this large! Lang Ya blessed land has surpassed most grotto-heavens!" Hei Cheng was utterly shocked.

"How did he achieve this? Lang Ya blessed land... is simply another world, far surpassing blessed lands and ordinary grotto-heavens." Fang Yuan was full of doubt.

"This population..." Fang Yuan's eyes widened. "What a massive fortune! Truly breathtaking. This is a complete hairy man empire! No wonder there are so many hairy man Gu Immortals—they must have been chosen from these endless masses!"

Rumble!

In the howling wind, Qin Bai Sheng stood straight as a spear, his clothes fluttering like a battle flag.

The space ruptured, and Gu worms showed up in the rupture.

They were the constituent parts of Refinement Cauldron.

Seeing this, Lang Ya land spirit knew he could delay no longer, shouting decisively: "Want to seize Refinement Cauldron? Dream on! Assemble the battle formation!"

"Yes, lord land spirit!" The hairy man Gu Immortals replied together.

Meanwhile, Lang Ya land spirit transmitted: "Mo Tan Sang, Fang Yuan, enter the formation quickly! We three are the main force. Hold on for a while, and these invaders will die!"

# Chapter 883: Ancient Battle Formation, Heavenly Giant Solor

"Assemble the battle formation—Heavenly Giant Solor!" Lang Ya land spirit shouted as countless Gu worms engulfed him and the hairy man Gu Immortals.

Soon after, the tens of thousands of Gu worms erupted with brilliant silver light.

Seeing the hill of silver light, Mo Tan Sang stepped inside without hesitation.

Fang Yuan went in after him.

Inside, Lang Ya land spirit directed Fang Yuan and Mo Tan Sang to the center.

Mo Tan Sang quickly pledged his loyalty: "Lord land spirit, don't worry. Representing Inkman City, I will fight with everything I have and stand by you no matter what!"

Fang Yuan remained silent, merely nodding back at Lang Ya land spirit.

"There is no time to chat; the three of us will be the main fighting force ahead," Lang Ya land spirit said.

Before he finished speaking, the silver light condensed to its limit, transforming into liquid silver metal.

The surrounding silver liquid expanded to form a courtyard-sized space.

In the air, lines of light of all sizes converged into a three-dimensional giant Gu formation.

Lang Ya land spirit assigned every Gu Immortal to their respective formation core.

From outside, Hei Cheng saw silver light erupt and churn into surging liquid.

The liquid solidified into a metallic giant with three heads, six arms, and a silver body.

When the giant opened its eyes like an awakening demonic god, a formless aura erupted, blanketing the sky.

"This... is an ancient battle formation!" Inside the silver giant's space, Fang Yuan's vision synchronized with the giant.

At the central core, Lang Ya land spirit laughed: "Heavenly Giant Solor was the second strongest battle formation even in the Olden Antiquity Era! Our soul foundations stack, immortal essence is interchangeable, and we communicate instantaneously through shared thoughts."

This way, they would not fear Qin Bai Sheng's immortal killer move, soul suppression!

"Interesting. To think Heavenly Giant Solor was in Long Hair Ancestor's hands," Qin Bai Sheng observed.

"Stop sighing; go deal with it," Qin Bai Sheng ordered Hei Cheng after exhaling deeply.

Hei Cheng froze, staring at Qin Bai Sheng in disbelief: "You want me to block this giant alone? Over ten Gu Immortals created it with their collective power!"

Qin Bai Sheng snorted: "I'm currently claiming Refinement Cauldron and cannot strike. Now is the time to prove your worth. I'm not asking you to defeat it, just stall it. With Dark Prison, this shouldn't be hard. If we succeed, I'll heal your injuries and resolve your lifespan crisis!"

Qin Bai Sheng's tone carried heavy threats, paired with a benefit Hei Cheng could not resist.

"Channel your immortal essence into the formation!" Lang Ya land spirit commanded. "Heavenly Giant Solor, attack!"

The silver giant moved soundlessly, crashing directly toward Qin Bai Sheng.

Unable to move freely while seizing the rank eight Immortal Gu House Refinement Cauldron, Qin Bai Sheng held his ground.

Just as the silver giant was about to strike, Hei Cheng appeared before Qin Bai Sheng.

Out came the sharp tusk boar, an ancient desolate beast with rank seven battle strength, alongside a black pearl—Hei tribe's rank six Immortal Gu House, Dark Prison!

After releasing the sharp tusk boar, Hei Cheng entered the Immortal Gu House Dark Prison.

Boom!

The silver giant collided with the sharp tusk boar, detonating air into sweeping shockwaves.

The sharp tusk boar squealed in agony, its head drenched in blood and one tusk shattered.

The silver giant merely stepped back, fluctuating silver light quickly repairing its dented chest.

Fang Yuan and the immortals manipulating the giant felt several beads of immortal essence consumed in the exchange.

"Mo Tan Sang, you attack this time!" Lang Ya land spirit shouted ruthlessly. "Use your signature killer move!"

"Understood," Mo Tan Sang replied, activating his offensive method within the formation.

Qi path immortal killer move — Blasting Qi Roar!

In Hei Cheng's sight, the silver giant turned its neck, aiming one head straight at the sharp tusk boar.

Silver ripples transformed the giant's right head into ink-black.

Seeing this head, Hei Cheng felt a sharp spike of danger.

Just as Hei Cheng tried to recall the sharp tusk boar, the black head opened its mouth.

Roar—!!!

Bam.

The sharp tusk boar lasted only three breaths against the sonic wave before exploding.

"Such power!" Hei Cheng's expression changed.

Fang Yuan was shaken: "Incredible, amplifying an immortal killer move to such an extent!"

After their initial shock, Mo Tan Sang and the hairy man Gu Immortals were overjoyed.

Hei Cheng's heart chilled; against this silver giant, even his dark arrow Immortal Gu would achieve little.

"I still have Dark Prison!" Hei Cheng snarled, hurtling the Immortal Gu House toward the giant.

Immortal killer move — Star Cloud Grindstone.

Immortal killer move — Forceful Mountain Shield.

Immortal killer move — Heavenly Stem Earth Veil.

Inside the silver giant, three Gu Immortals simultaneously unleashed three defensive killer moves.

Immediately, three of the silver giant's arms transformed!

# Chapter 884: Fatal Undercover Agents

Dark Prison bore down on the silver giant like a meteor.

One hand opened with a spiraling star cloud far larger and faster than normal.

Another arm folded across its chest, the forearm morphing into a massive navy-blue shield.

A loud bang erupted from Dark Prison, as it was sucked into the star cloud grindstone.

After penetrating both defenses, Dark Prison retained less than thirty percent of its power.

Though Dark Prison was an Immortal Gu House, Hei Cheng was its sole operator.

Fang Yuan was star path, Mo Tan Sang qi path, and the remaining hairy men refinement path.

This prevented peak power, but the numerous hairy men anchored the disparate paths together.

Qin Bai Sheng focused almost all his attention on the sky.

Thunder rumbled as the shattered sky exposed hidden Gu worms drawn straight into Qin Bai Sheng's hands.

Two others assisted him from different locations: Fairy Jiang Yu and the mysterious black-robed Gu Immortal.

Qin Bai Sheng seized the Immortal Gu, easily storing it away despite Lang Ya's ownership.

Lang Ya blessed land shook violently as towering waves battered the three continents.

As more Immortal Gu were claimed, catastrophic tsunamis and floods battered the blessed land.

He thought: "Lang Ya land spirit must have a method to fuse Immortal Gu into the immortal aperture. The Gu's dao mark fragments become part of the world, expanding the aperture tremendously."

"Now that Qin Bai Sheng is plundering Refinement Cauldron, losing those Immortal Gu strips away dao marks, causing the environment to collapse and the space to shrink."

"You're right!" Lang Ya land spirit agreed.

Hei Cheng stared blankly, before his expression changed.

He discovered Lang Ya land spirit had forcefully refined two of Dark Prison's Immortal Gu.

Even weakened, so long as Refinement Cauldron's core remained intact, it could still refine enemy Gu worms.

"Fifteen minutes are up! Refinement Cauldron still has two hairy man Gu Immortals guarding it!" crowed the land spirit.

Qin Bai Sheng sneered: "Are you sure about that?"

Before he finished speaking, two hairy man Gu Immortals descended and bowed to Qin Bai Sheng: "Greetings, Lord Vice Envoy."

The two guarding Gu Immortals were actually Shadow Sect's undercover agents!

Attacking from both within and without, the loss of the rank eight Immortal Gu House Refinement Cauldron was sealed.

# Chapter 885: Anti-climatic Battle of Offense and Defense

Lang Ya land spirit stared at the scene in utter disbelief.

Amidst the fierce combat, the immortals grew more familiar with controlling the giant, developing better coordination.
