He immediately added: "Without good grass, no horse runs. Even dogs need bones to show enthusiasm. Oh no, why did I speak my mind aloud again..."

# Chapter 886: Crying Miniman

Northern Plains, in a certain secluded area, Luo Po valley.

Returning from Lang Ya, Shadow Sect defended the valley: Qin Bai Sheng, Jiang Yu, Hui Feng Zi, and He Lang Zi.

Immortal killer move — Soul Suppression!

Immortal killer move — Green Jade Song!

He Lang Zi and Hui Feng Zi suffered heavy damage and retreated.

"Correct." Qin Bai Sheng replied: "Are you prepared to die?"

"The stance is peculiar: facing heaven and earth, the user lowers their head and closes their eyes. Though seemingly admitting defeat, they actually marshal all their physical and mental strength to unleash the sharpest attack. The raised fist reveals Bo Qing's incomparable boldness. As the saying goes: I decide my fate, not heaven; with a sword at my heart, I advance along the sword path."

Facing the legendary killer move, Feng Jiu Ge was not the least bit nervous, speaking with complete confidence.

Feng Jiu Ge shook his head with a bright smile: "Coincidentally, I once created an inspired sound path killer move. Feeling nature's vastness and human insignificance, I named my own piece 'heaven and earth song'! This song borrows the strength of heaven and earth, wielding incomparable might to suppress all resistance!"

A peculiar look crossed Qin Bai Sheng's face. With eyes still closed, he spoke: "Oh? Then this fight will be interesting. Take this—first finger!"

"Good, the first stage is finished and all materials processed. The second stage is drawing in heaven's will!" Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord said after inspecting the work.

Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord explained: "Heaven's will is the will of heaven and earth, towering above mortal ants. Heaven's will is the vital immortal material to restore fate Gu. Managing this refinement path Gu formation will now be an arduous and lengthy process. We must resist boundless heaven's will without letting it corrupt our minds, or we will be severely injured or killed! Heavenly Court has lost several rank eight Gu Immortals to this process. Preparation will quicken our work; now we take turns resting and recovering."

Central Continent, Hu Immortal blessed land.

Sitting on the ground, Fang Yuan tore off a piece of meat and ate it.

"I am a strength path Gu Immortal after all, strength path dao marks are my foundation."

Fang Yuan mentally reviewed Lang Ya blessed land's defense.

During the battle, Fang Yuan had tested vaguely familiar face, deceiving nearly everyone to his satisfaction.

With three star path Immortal Gu, he rotated them as cores for four killer moves.

"These star path moves are useful for now; no need to waste energy deducing new strength path moves."

"With star path killer moves, my battle strength is firmly at peak rank six. Offensively, myriad self allows me to match rank seven. Yet I remain far from fighting veteran rank seven Gu Immortals, able only to pester and stall them. As for Qin Bai Sheng, I cannot match him—he is a quasi-rank eight expert on par with Feng Jiu Ge!"

Thus, Fang Yuan held back, only unleashing myriad self giant hand at the end.

Throughout, Fang Yuan kept part of his attention on Fixed Immortal Travel, ready to retreat immediately if anything went wrong.

"Who is this Qin Bai Sheng? With experts like Hei Cheng following him, Hei Lou Lan's revenge looks hopeless. Now that I think about it, the secrets behind Lang Ya blessed land run far deeper than meet the eye."

In Fang Yuan's previous life, Lang Ya blessed land had resisted seven waves of attacks.

Yet now, on only the fourth wave, it was already failing to resist.

What was the truth of history? Had Fang Yuan's influence altered Lang Ya blessed land's fate?

Fang Yuan gazed down at his bloodstained hand.

Nature was boundless; the stronger one became, the weaker they realized they were.

The Legends of Ren Zu had an interesting account.

Waking and sitting up, she saw a miniman climbing on her body.

"Who are you?" Seeing someone smaller than her finger, Boundless Forest Samsara asked in curiosity.

The miniman stared in stupefaction at the giant Boundless Forest Samsara before raising his head and bawling loudly.

"Hey, little person, I'm not crying, so what are you crying for?" Boundless Forest Samsara asked, puzzled.

The miniman sobbed: "I was the proudest in my tribe. Today I meant to climb a mountain, but found a person! To think such giants exist! Seeing someone like you for the first time, I couldn't help but cry!"

"In my past life, I too cried at how distant eternal life seemed to my insignificant self."

After a long while, he smiled, revealing sharp fangs.

"Still too weak. In past life and present, I am like that miniman trying to climb the mountain."

"Yet... my insignificance will never be an excuse to stop chasing greatness."

"Even covered in tears and snot, I will keep climbing the mountain—this is the joy of life."

With that, Fang Yuan ripped off another piece of bloody meat and bit into it.

# Chapter 887: Short Break

Half a month later.

Inside Fang Yuan's dead immortal aperture, two wills clashed fiercely.

Fang Yuan sent a fresh portion of will, immediately crushing the fake will.

"I have made huge progress; though I still lose to Mo Yao one-on-one, she barely scrapes by with difficult victories."

"Spring dream fruit tree?" Fang Yuan's mind jolted.

Mo Yao's memories revealed a spring dream fruit tree near a nameless hamlet.

Afterward, he would lend these Immortal Gu to Fang Yuan to move his own blessed lands.

# Chapter 888: Entering Eastern Sea

Two months later.

At a certain place in Eastern Sea.

Fang Yuan and Tai Bai Yun Sheng stood quietly on a cloud, waiting for Shark Demon and others.

"Whenever I see such beauty, I must pause to immerse myself and marvel at nature's wonders." Tai Bai Yun Sheng looked into the distance and sighed: "Even having achieved immortal ascension, this world remains so grand that it makes one feel like an insignificant insect, struck by inferiority. Compared to heaven, mankind is truly negligible. Perhaps only rank nine Gu Venerables can contest heaven and earth; I harbor no such hope."

Fang Yuan chuckled: "Brother Tai Bai, do not belittle yourself. Remember the miniman from The Legends of Ren Zu? Once we recognize our insignificance, we must strive all the harder to grow stronger. We are small, but shedding ignorance for wisdom brings pain because it means you are growing."

"Xing Xiang Zi, your ambitions remain as grand as ever. Hahaha..." Tai Bai Yun Sheng chuckled after a brief pause.

As they spoke, a Gu Immortal emerged from the sea beneath them.

"Who is this?" Fang Yuan shouted.

"Lords, ease your minds. I am Sha Nan Jiang, sent by Lord Shark Demon to invite you both," the man smiled and introduced himself.

He was a rank six immortal zombie.

Fang Yuan twiddled his fingers, suddenly asking: "Scenic blue travel immortal zombie body?"

Sha Nan Jiang's smile froze. Staring at Fang Yuan, he cupped his fists: "Sir must be the wisdom path Gu Immortal Xing Xiang Zi? Impressive! I self-created this scenic blue travel immortal zombie body, just left seclusion, and told no one. Yet Sir uncovered its name with a simple deduction."

No longer daring to be careless, Sha Nan Jiang turned serious.

Nodding respectfully to Fang Yuan, he turned to Tai Bai Yun Sheng: "Please follow me. Lord Shark Demon and the others are already attacking Yu Lu blessed land."

Soon, the three dived into the sea, seeing a door at the bottom.

The circular, pale door resembled porcelain or jade. Chains of water crystal pearls hung from its top, forming a veil that blocked the entrance.

This was the entrance connecting Yu Lu blessed land with the outside world.

Arriving before the light jade door, Sha Nan Jiang activated his Gu worms, parting the crystal veil as the door opened.

"Sirs, please enter." Sha Nan Jiang invited.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng smiled: "Your alliance has formidable methods to already control the entrance."

Sha Nan Jiang smiled: "Sir Tai Bai, after failing two months ago, Lord Shark Demon hired a rank seven wisdom path immortal zombie from Zombie Alliance headquarters. We have already passed the vanishing immortal essence dissipation rain and pushed deeper, bringing this entrance under our alliance's control a month ago."

Fang Yuan and Tai Bai Yun Sheng nodded, they stepped into Yu Lu blessed land.

Upon entering, instead of Yu Lu blessed land's true appearance, they found a completely white, frozen world.

"This third round is a battlefield killer move called freezing rain frozen earth," Sha Nan Jiang explained. "Every hour brings intense freezing rain and snow monster attacks. Lord Shark Demon and the others are just ahead."

"Freezing rain frozen earth..." Fang Yuan muttered, surveying the battlefield killer move with keen interest.

What Fang Yuan lacked now was a battlefield killer move.

Thus, disguised as ordinary star path Gu Immortal Xing Xiang Zi, he accompanied Tai Bai Yun Sheng to Eastern Sea, intentionally approaching Shark Demon's group.

"Brother Tai Bai, we meet again. Hahaha!" Shark Demon greeted them enthusiastically when they met.

Patting Tai Bai Yun Sheng's shoulder, he looked at Fang Yuan: "Sir must be brother Tai Bai's best friend, Xing Xiang Zi? Any friend of his is a friend of mine."

"I am but a wandering lone cultivator, I would not dare to." Fang Yuan smiled humbly.

Shark Demon's wife, Su Bai Man, asked: "Don't be so humble, Xing Xiang Zi. I heard you have impressive wisdom path attainment—could you give us a demonstration?"

Fang Yuan replied without hesitation: "Then I will give it a try, please forgive me if I fail."

"Just go for it, Sir Xing Xiang Zi. Even if you fail, nobody will blame you." Shark Demon replied.

Fang Yuan raised his head and observed the surroundings.

The world of pure white snow and ice before him was indeed a battlefield killer move, often known as a quasi-blessed land.

Activating wisdom path Gu worms in his immortal aperture, Fang Yuan unleashed several investigative killer moves before everyone.

Fang Yuan remained patient; though he had studied wisdom path techniques diligently for two months, this battlefield killer move had been created by Fairy Yu Lu and was far from simple.

She was a disciple of Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable, the creator of the greatest battlefield killer move inheritance in human history.

"Impressive! This battlefield killer move is completely fused with Yu Lu blessed land, seemingly created from its dao marks. This is far more advanced than Lang Ya blessed land."

Fang Yuan was full of admiration and anticipation: "If only I could obtain Fairy Yu Lu's inheritance. Even a single suitable battlefield killer move would be wonderful!"

# Chapter 889: Freezing Rain Frozen Earth

Inside freezing rain frozen earth, Fang Yuan used successive wisdom path techniques to make continuous deductions.

Formed from Yu Lu blessed land's permanent dao marks rather than temporary ones, freezing rain frozen earth was exceptionally troublesome to handle.

Shark Demon and the others could not break it forcefully; destroying the battlefield killer move would destroy Yu Lu blessed land's dao marks, causing irreparable damage.

Fortunately, Yu Lu blessed land was ownerless, and it was unclear if a land spirit existed. Protected by the surrounding Gu Immortals, Fang Yuan had ample freedom to decipher it.

Fang Yuan squinted his eyes as starlight shot out of his pupils.

Countless star thoughts moved and clashed in his mind as he deduced rapidly.

"Time is almost up, the freezing rain will start and snow monsters will attack. How much longer does Sir Xing Xiang Zi need?" an accompanying Gu Immortal asked impatiently.

His name was Bo Dan, a Gu Immortal member of Eastern Sea Zombie Alliance.

Having some wisdom path attainment, he had been brought along by Shark Demon to assist in the invasion.

If Fang Yuan succeeded, would it not prove Bo Dan useless?

Seeing Fang Yuan stall, Bo Dan could no longer hold back and subtly exerted pressure on him.

Fang Yuan laughed lightly without trying to save face: "I am ashamed! This battlefield killer move is profound; after deducing for so long, I have made only minor progress."

Fang Yuan was unwilling to give up this chance: "Give me a bit more time, I will continue to deduce."

Shark Demon nodded: "Go ahead and deduce, Xing Xiang Zi, we will block this attack for you."

Meanwhile, Shark Demon thought to himself: "Xing Xiang Zi was highly recommended by Tai Bai Yun Sheng, but he seems less impressive than claimed. If this Xing Xiang Zi can really unravel this battlefield killer move, that would be the best outcome."

As expected, a light drizzle of freezing rain soon began falling from the sky.

Like falling needles, the icy rain pierced the air and shot toward Fang Yuan's group.

Fang Yuan willed, using star cloud grindstone and entering it.

He was not going to place his safety in the hands of others.

Seeing Fang Yuan's defensive immortal killer move, the other Gu Immortals' gazes shined, their attitudes changed slightly.

"This battlefield changed with its new attack, revealing a tiny flaw I can exploit—unlike before when I had no clue at all!" Fang Yuan's heart shook with joy.

He unleashed mortal killer moves alongside wisdom path mortal Gu.

The ice dart rain had turned into an icicle storm.

Roar!

With a loud roar, a massive snow monster charged through the blinding icy rain.

"Try not to kill them," Su Bai Man warned. "Even if these snow monsters die, they will endlessly revive."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng's expression changed: "Endlessly reviving snow monsters? How can we fight them like this?"

"Don't worry, once time is up, these snow monsters vanish on their own. They only reappear with the next freezing rain," Shark Demon explained.

The snow monsters' emergence revealed even more flaws in the battlefield killer move.

Seizing upon this flaw, Fang Yuan worked his hands faster and faster.

Eventually, under his deductions, he found a Gu worm.

"Go!" Fang Yuan willed and a star snake rope flew out, coiling around this mortal Gu rapidly.

Just as Fang Yuan went to retrieve the mortal Gu for study, it self-detonated.

Because this mortal Gu was destroyed, the freezing rain became significantly weaker.

"He actually found a flaw?" Bo Dan was shocked; he had searched for flaws during previous attacks to no avail.

"Good!" Shark Demon praised.

Yet right as he spoke, the overhead storm intensified threefold!

"Xing Xiang Zi, what in the world did you do?" Bo Dan grabbed onto this great opportunity and chided.

Fang Yuan's heart jumped—destroying a component Gu worm blindly had only provoked a fiercer backlash.

Destroying that mortal Gu had exposed two more flaws in freezing rain frozen earth.

# Chapter 890: Framing

Using star thoughts in his mind to deduce, Fang Yuan soon located several more Gu worms.

"One, two, three, four—four spots in total. Mortal Gu are hiding there, concealed so well that even my star path investigative immortal killer move could not find them."

Further deductions revealed a problem: while eliminating the Gu would weaken the current attack, the next wave would strike much sooner at three times the strength!

"At triple the strength, ancient desolate snow monsters might appear!" Fang Yuan was shocked; unraveling this battlefield killer move was so perilous that a single misstep would bring severe consequences.

Time passed quickly, but Fang Yuan made no progress.

"This is already the fourth wave. Sigh... how much longer do we have to endure?" an immortal zombie sighed, feeling the sting of the immortal essence he had expended.

"What is the point of burning so much immortal essence if we see no results?" Bo Dan provoked.

Bo Dan nodded, showing a smile: "Lord Tai Bai Yun Sheng is right, I was too rash earlier."

Pretending to make a major breakthrough, Fang Yuan announced: "Hehehe, I finally cleared an important node. With this discovery, I have greater confidence in unraveling this battlefield killer move!"

A immortal zombie shouted: "Quickly look, the freezing rain has weakened, many desolate beast snow monsters are disintegrating on their own!"

Destroying that mortal Gu had parted a veil, exposing six or seven flaws in the freezing rain frozen earth battlefield killer move.

While Shark Demon and the others remained oblivious for now, the next wave of attacks would bring immense pain.

Fang Yuan had good progress, but he did not act.

Refraining from further probing, he sat in midair with closed eyes, giving the impression of deducing with all his might.

In truth, he was contemplating: "Deploying a battlefield killer move to defend a blessed land has pros and cons. Its greatest drawback is forming a temporary pseudo-blessed land. Even if mortal killer moves are permitted, invading Gu Immortals must still spend vast immortal essence, forced by the battlefield killer move to defend or attack with immortal methods."

"If I can obtain Yu Lu blessed land's battlefield killer moves and use my own dao marks to construct layered defenses, it would be ideal. Hu Immortal blessed land could also use this; if attacked one day, these defensive battlefield killer moves would stall for time while I relocate its resources."

As Fang Yuan remained idle, Bo Dan spotted a hidden mortal Gu and moved to destroy it.

"Lord Shark Demon, I have made progress! Look!" Bo Dan exclaimed, moving his hands to destroy the hidden mortal Gu.

Just then, Fang Yuan opened his eyes with an ugly expression: "Oh no!"

# Chapter 891: Distorting The Truth

Fang Yuan spoke quickly as eight or nine starlight specks floated in the air.

Shark Demon then spoke politely: "I am deeply enlightened by Brother Xing Xiang's words. How should we proceed from here?"

Sigh, the saying goes, a strong dragon cannot suppress a local snake, I am just a weak snake, while everyone here are expert dragons."

Thinking thus, Fang Yuan glanced at Bo Dan and told Shark Demon: "Little time remains before the next wave, and with this disruption, my earlier efforts have gone to waste. # Chapter 894: Purposely Getting Discovered

Plotting secretly for half a month, Fang Yuan reached a small island.

"Who is there?!" Turning pale, Song Yi Shi shouted, glaring furiously at Fang Yuan's hiding spot.

# Chapter 895: Happy About Being Chased Down

"Of course, there is another reason. Centuries later, rank eight Gu Immortal Song Qi Yuan died when his lifespan expired, drastically altering Eastern Sea's power structure. You do not need to worry about my matter, but just uncle Song Xia Qi isn't enough, I want uncle Song Jia Dan to help me once, to deduce the location of that old lecher."

"Haha, my dear granddaughter. Take this token to twin polar sea strait and find your uncle Song Jia Dan." Song Qi Yuan tossed her a token.

Song Yi Shi and Song Xia Qi navigated the tunnel into twin polar sea strait, meeting Song Jia Dan.

He usually stayed on the cliff of twin polar sea strait. His upper body was aged and frail, while his petrified lower half seemed fused with the strait itself.

Song Jia Dan had sacrificed his freedom for the clan. Since becoming a wisdom path Gu Immortal, he sat here using a unique inheritance to fuse with the world, granting him brilliant deductive abilities.

"Uncle Jia Dan, please deduce an enemy's location. Here are his appearance and collected aura." Song Yi Shi passed him two Gu worms.

After verifying the token, Song Jia Dan opened his mouth and sucked in both of Song Yi Shi's Gu worms.

A long while later, he opened his eyes in perplexity: "I could not deduce anything."

"Little Shi, don't worry." Song Xia Qi's expression turned grave: "Cousin Jia Dan, the target is merely a Northern Plains rank six lone cultivator. Even with your wisdom path attainment, you found nothing?"

Song Jia Dan fell silent before replying, "There are two possibilities. Either the target is not in Eastern Sea, or they possess wisdom path methods to conceal themselves from my deductions. Or maybe they could find other wisdom path Gu Immortals to help them evade my deductions."

Song Jia Dan flatly refused: "No. The clan must secure Old Eccentric Tian Nan's inheritance. I must preserve my strength and prepare methods to deduce for that in a few days."

Central Continent, Hu Immortal blessed land, an underground cave.

Bathed in the light of wisdom with eyes closed, Fang Yuan shone with star thoughts as he quietly deduced important matters.

Just then, a moving perspective cup Gu appeared in Fang Yuan's immortal aperture.

Its message came from Lang Ya land spirit.

"Lang Ya land spirit has finally relocated Lang Ya blessed land and can lend me that set of Immortal Gu!"

He had returned from Eastern Sea to Central Continent specifically to await Lang Ya land spirit's news and relocate Star Form blessed land.

Once his role as the Northern Plains culprit was exposed, he would have to flee for his life.

Hu Immortal blessed land would face disaster. If he remained an immortal zombie unable to produce immortal essence, Star Form blessed land would be his sole secret base.

However, Hei Lou Lan knew Star Form blessed land's location, meaning Fairy Li Shan knew as well.

Being vigilant, as Star Form blessed land's new owner, Fang Yuan naturally had to relocate it to a location only he knew.

# Chapter 900: Borrowing Gu from Lang Ya Land Spirit

Fang Yuan did not hesitate, he immediately used Fixed Immortal Travel to go to Lang Ya blessed land.

Three continents faced one another in the vast sea, beneath a fourth continent of cloud soil floating in the sky.

"I intend to build twelve cloud cities around the twelve cloud buildings. This sky continent will house elite hairy men," Lang Ya land spirit explained upon seeing Fang Yuan.

"I have also established Lang Ya Sect modeled after Central Continent. I will serve as first supreme elder, with the hairy man Gu Immortals as the other supreme elders. My previous self was too foolish, he used these precious Gu Immortals for Gu refinement. Hmph! To fulfill the dominance of hairy men, bloodshed is necessary."

"Furthermore, under my guidance, the three sea continents will erupt into war! Three kings will emerge to establish kingdoms on their respective continents. Furthermore, I will choose a rank five peak stage hairy man Gu Master as the sect leader of Lang Ya Sect!"

Slightly shocked, Lang Ya land spirit asked, "Oh? You want to borrow my Immortal Gu set to relocate your blessed land now? As I recall, I told you it wouldn't be cheap. Even on the basis that you fought against strong enemies for us, I told you that you will still need to pay two thousand immortal essence stones?"

Fang Yuan handed over two thousand immortal essence stones: "Look, I've prepared them already."

After paying two thousand immortal essence stones, Fang Yuan and Lang Ya land spirit used an information path immortal killer move to form an agreement.

Finally, Fang Yuan provided two Immortal Gu as collateral to borrow the sixteen-piece Immortal Gu set used to relocate blessed lands.

Without resting, Fang Yuan used Fixed Immortal Travel to return to Star Form blessed land.

Star Form blessed land had three desolate beast spinefin star dragonfish; having seen them before, Fang Yuan unhesitatingly chose the strongest.

Taking a deep breath, Fang Yuan channeled immortal essence into the borrowed wisdom path Immortal Gu and began deducing per the land spirit's method.

One day, two days, three days... after seven days and six nights in Star Form blessed land, an exhausted Fang Yuan slowly opened his eyes.

At this huge price, Fang Yuan obtained two sets of Gu formation charts.

The larger Gu formation chart covered Star Form blessed land with eight cores, while the smaller chart covered the spinefin star dragonfish with four cores. Each core required a specific Immortal Gu, demanding twelve Immortal Gu in total.

# Chapter 901: Transplanting Immortal Aperture, Relocating Blessed Land

Guided by Star Form land spirit, he located the eight formation cores across the blessed land and placed the corresponding Immortal Gu into each per the chart.

Confirming no issues, Fang Yuan returned to his spot and stored the spinefin star dragonfish into his immortal aperture.

Under his orders, Star Form land spirit opened the blessed land's entrance.

Fang Yuan walked out into Earth Abyss.

Wasting no time, Fang Yuan released the spinefin star dragonfish.

Following the smaller chart, Fang Yuan placed four Immortal Gu onto the spinefin star dragonfish's body.

Following the method closely, Fang Yuan activated the remaining four Immortal Gu.

Star Form blessed land's doors slowly closed, vanishing into thin air.

After seventeen breaths of time, the fading light gathered into Fang Yuan's eyes.

A faint yellow light beam shot from his right eye, striking the whale-sized spinefin star dragonfish.

Breathing heavily, Fang Yuan shot another yellow beam from his left eye, directly piercing Star Form blessed land's hidden location.

Under the light pillar's influence, Star Form blessed land was drawn out, turning into a blue light lump.

As Star Form blessed land was absorbed, green grape immortal essence in Fang Yuan's aperture was consumed at a terrifying speed!

Fang Yuan turned his left eye with difficulty, slowly moving the yellow light pillar while pulling the blue light lump.

The statue-like spinefin star dragonfish also moved along with his right eye, slowly approaching the blessed land.

Relocating a blessed land violently stirred heaven and earth qi, triggering a powerful earthquake deep in the abyss.

The moment Star Form blessed land touched the spinefin star dragonfish, Fang Yuan relaxed as though unburdened of an immense weight.

Like a wanderer returning home or a swallow to its nest, Star Form blessed land settled into the spinefin star dragonfish, turning into an internal immortal aperture!

The blessed land had to be transplanted as an internal aperture into a desolate or ancient desolate beast.

However, this transferral process had strict time limits. The beast housing the immortal aperture could not take in another aperture or use any Immortal Gu, lest it disrupt the Immortal Gu formation on its body.

He could only rely on the spinefin star dragonfish's physical strength to float and relocate.

Due to the flaws of the immortal aperture transplantation method, the spinefin star dragonfish's speed dropped by over half, moving under immense pressure as if bearing a mountain.

"Fortunately, Earth Abyss is well hidden; it will be a long time before this layer is exposed and developed. I can use Star Form blessed land as a reliable camp to replenish and recuperate."

"Moreover, while I know this method's flaws, others do not. Failing to find Star Form blessed land, Hei Lou Lan might assume it was destroyed. After all, relocating a blessed land defies common Gu Immortal knowledge!"

He pushed deeper into Earth Abyss, avoiding desolate beasts and slipping through the territorial gaps between desolate and ancient desolate beasts alongside the spinefin star dragonfish.

Fang Yuan's destination was three layers below Star Form blessed land's original location.

However, after descending two layers, his luck ran out as he encountered a desolate beast one-eyed giant ape.

Fang Yuan fought fiercely with the one-eyed giant ape, struggling to protect the spinefin star dragonfish.

Lacking a battlefield killer move, Fang Yuan could not effectively restrict the one-eyed giant ape's movement, and the beast heavily injured the spinefin star dragonfish.

Fang Yuan finally drove off the damned ape, but the heavily injured spinefin star dragonfish could no longer move.

"Fortunately, the Immortal Gu are unharmed. Otherwise, compensating Lang Ya would bankrupt me!" After checking them, Fang Yuan's heavy mood eased.

With no other choice, Fang Yuan settled for the second-best option and placed Star Form blessed land nearby.

The moment the immortal aperture was removed, the spinefin star dragonfish crumbled into a pool of flesh and blood, its beast soul dispersing.

Star Form blessed land was successfully relocated, hidden in a completely new area.

# Chapter 902: Heavily Developing Star Form Blessed Land

Fang Yuan entered Star Form blessed land.

Gazing across the vast landscape, Fang Yuan saw deep crevices everywhere, with dark smoke rising from burning flames.

He first inspected its four revenue sources: the arrow bamboo forest, broken star lake, meteorite pit, and star fragment grass fields.

Broken star lake's water was flowing down a huge crack; seaweed piled at the lake bottom, though some water still remained.

Landscape as Before!

Immediately, the ground beneath broken star lake mended and the water refilled, returning to its original state. However, the lost seaweed would still affect star river Gu production for a while.

He did not repair everything, leaving some cracks in the ground untouched.

An idea struck him: "Perhaps I can turn these ground cracks into river channels, creating a network across the entirety of Star Form blessed land. But Star Form blessed land has a unique terrain, as for how I can make this a reality, I will need to use the light of wisdom and think over it."

Next, Fang Yuan used Fixed Immortal Travel to visit Lang Ya land spirit and return the borrowed Immortal Gu.

Returning Fang Yuan's collateral Immortal Gu, Lang Ya land spirit said, "If you need to relocate anything else, come find me again."

Next, Fang Yuan used Fixed Immortal Travel to enter Tai Bai Yun Sheng's immortal aperture and return Landscape as Before.

Hu Immortal blessed land, tens of days later.

Bathed in the light of wisdom, Fang Yuan opened his eyes and exhaled turbid air.

"I still failed after all." He muttered, standing up slowly.

Over the past days, Fang Yuan had forgone sleep and rest, pouring all his effort into developing Star Form blessed land.

Fang Yuan had already used the light of wisdom dozens of days earlier to devise his development plan.

Based on his initial inspiration, his properly deduced plan was even grander: he would create a vast three-dimensional river system in Star Form blessed land, encompassing both the ground and the sky.

Fang Yuan's plan was beautiful, but reality was cruel.

Meanwhile, the dragonfish, eerie fire dragon pythons, regretful spiders, and Dang Hun Mountain in Hu Immortal blessed land had not yet been moved over.

Secondly, Star Form blessed land was facing its heavenly tribulation soon!

Fang Yuan still hesitated over whether to relocate these resources before the heavenly tribulation struck.

# Chapter 903: Joining Eastern Sea Zombie Alliance

Fang Yuan then entered another secret room and inspected Dong Fang Chang Fan's soul.

After the soul search, Dong Fang Chang Fan's soul spoke: "You have searched my memories countless times, but lately you only examine the methods for dismantling battlefield killer moves. It seems that you have encountered an inheritance, or have faced a strong foe that requires you to unravel a battlefield killer move."

Dong Fang Chang Fan's soul smiled. "Have you considered letting me help? You are just a wisdom path novice; no matter how much you review, your gains will be limited. Meanwhile, my wisdom path attainment is much higher, as long as you give me a body, I will be able to make deductions for you and help you think of solutions. Isn't this a good idea? You can use information path methods to restrict me, I will be your most capable assistant."

As long as you did not defile Song Yi Shi, we can back you up in this matter, and support you as we negotiate with Song clan."

"Then I thank Lord Shark Demon in advance." Fang Yuan put on a helpless, bitter expression. "Rest assured, I only stumbled into the volcanic cavern and caught Fairy Yi Shi bathing. That was the whole cause, sigh..."

Even if I prepare adequately, if I am unlucky, and encounter the failure rate, I would fail to refine star thought Immortal Gu."

# Chapter 905: Pitiful Victory

Not daring to act recklessly, Fang Yuan was personally welcomed by He Feng Yang and led into the valley.

Over ten Gu Immortals from the ten ancient sects guarded the valley.

"Are you Fang Yuan?" A white-clothed female immortal stepped forward from the group.

"You are Fairy Bai Qing." Fang Yuan focused his gaze and bowed placidly.

Fairy Bai Qing nodded, speaking warmly: "My daughter often mentions you. In this contest over the grotto-heaven fragment, please show mercy; we will certainly repay you later."

With his own plans, Fang Yuan agreed unhesitatingly: "Our cooperation has been pleasant; Lady Bai Qing may rest assured."

Fairy Bai Qing nodded in satisfaction.

"Go in. The others have entered; with the highest cultivation, you are last," He Feng Yang said heavily.

Fang Yuan nodded and moved forward.

Watching Fang Yuan step inside, an uneasy He Feng Yang reminded him: "Don't forget the place I mentioned—you must occupy it!"

"No worries." Fang Yuan waved without looking back, stepping fully into the grotto-heaven fragment under everyone's gaze.

# Chapter 909: Advantage of Having Lower Cultivation Level

Entering the Starry Sky grotto-heaven fragment world, he landed in the blue lake.

Below him, the blue lake suddenly shattered like a mirror, its surface fracturing completely.

Through this mirror, Fang Yuan could see the nameless Central Continent valley outside, where Gu Immortals watched him with complex expressions.

Sneering internally, Fang Yuan turned and leaped away from the lake, flying off.

"After Combat Immortal Sect's looting and Starry Sky grotto-heaven's shattering, this fragment holds only two desolate beasts and one desolate plant."

Flying through the sky, Fang Yuan recalled the information He Feng Yang had shared.

These were a desolate beast dragonfish, a hidden essence turtle, and nether grass.

"Capturing all three alive would be best. By our agreement, you receive one-third of what you obtain," He Feng Yang told him.

Though merely a bottom-tier rank six immortal zombie, Fang Yuan held a massive advantage over these desolate targets.

For he possessed not only his own Immortal Gu, but also those lent by Immortal Crane Sect.

"According to the map, the dragonfish is in this blue lake, near the central island."

"To think I would gain a second desolate beast dragonfish so soon. Since I take one-third of the gains, I'll choose the dragonfish," Fang Yuan thought with inward satisfaction.

Meanwhile, on an island in the blue lake, a group of Heaven's Envy Manor Gu Masters glared at the water in frustration.

The five-person group consisted almost entirely of rank five Gu Masters, save for one young rank four peak stage cultivator.

This youngster was Wei Wu Shang, leader of Heaven's Envy Manor's elite disciples.

Seven Star Child had ruthlessly self-detonated Starry Sky grotto-heaven with precise control, leaving fragments inaccessible to almost all Gu Immortals—only their disciples could explore them.

Fang Yuan had bottom-tier immortal cultivation, few strength path dao marks, and continually expended strength path dao marks to maintain Vaguely Familiar Face.

Most importantly, his identity allowed Immortal Crane Sect to deploy him.

In this competition among the ten ancient sects, Fang Yuan would have been barred as an outsider had he not been affiliated with Immortal Crane Sect.

# Chapter 910: Grabbing the Dragonfish

"Damn Ancient Soul Sect, agitating the desolate beast dragonfish just to obstruct us!"

On the central island, the Heaven's Envy Manor group was currently trapped, unable to advance.

Through the water, they vaguely saw a huge monster circling in the lake's depths.

"Ancient Soul Sect must have used an immortal technique to affect the dragonfish! As one of the ten ancient sects, Heaven's Envy Manor cannot lose to them. Elder Zhu Ning, let's use our immortal method too!"

Elder Zhu Ning frowned and sighed bitterly: "If I could use it, would I have waited until now?"

Before this trip, a supreme elder had entrusted Zhu Ning with an Immortal Gu and immortal essence.

However, this Immortal Gu was defensive and useless for handling the dragonfish.

Zhu Ning warned solemnly: "Regardless of what happens, there are two people we must not offend: Spirit Affinity House's Feng Jin Huang and Immortal Crane Sect's Fang Yuan."

"Why? They are geniuses of our generation, but they're alone. All ten sects sent five members equipped with mysterious immortal methods—why fear just those two?" Wei Wu Shang asked skeptically.

"Because you don't know the inside story," Zhu Ning said with a heavy gaze, looking around. "The sect revealed shocking news before we departed. Feng Jin Huang has noble lineage—both her parents are mighty Gu Immortals. What terrifying immortal methods do you think she holds?"

Zhu Ning continued: "Yet compared to Feng Jin Huang, Fang Yuan is even scarier!"

"Does he have an even greater background than Feng Jin Huang?" someone asked suspiciously.

Zhu Ning shook his head: "Immortal Crane Sect sent Fang Yuan alone. Think about what that implies."

"Immortal Crane Sect must be confident he can handle all of us on his own!"

Right then, a shrill sound echoed from the sky.

Looking up, the five Gu Masters saw a figure tearing across the sky.

"Looking at the person, it seems to be... Fang Yuan?"

Fang Yuan stood in the air as he looked around.

Seeing the surging waves, island, dragonfish, and Gu Masters, Fang Yuan grasped the situation instantly.

"This dragonfish must be rampaging under some soul path or wisdom path technique," Fang Yuan deduced, reaching out with a grabbing motion.

Boom!

Under their stunned gazes, a strength path giant hand plunged grandly into the water.

The lake water parted before the descending giant hand, as if actively cooperating with Fang Yuan.

This was the effect of Pulling Water Immortal Gu fused into the strength path giant hand.

Roar!

The fish struggled violently, but the strength path giant hand remained unyielding as Mount Tai.

Controlled by Fang Yuan, the giant hand gripped the dragonfish and hoisted it from the water.

Unsatisfied with just the desolate beast dragonfish, Fang Yuan turned toward the ordinary dragonfish.

Activating Pulling Water Immortal Gu, Fang Yuan drew up large masses of water, sweeping countless dragonfish into his immortal aperture.

Only after Fang Yuan finished harvesting and flew away did the Gu Masters regain their senses.

Drenched in sweat, Wei Wu Shang sat limp and stunned on the ground.

"Dealing with such a person is beyond our abilities."

"Such overwhelming might, did he become an immortal already?!"

# Chapter 911: Contest of Dream Realm

"About six hundred thousand ordinary dragonfish, and a desolate beast dragonfish."

Flying rapidly, Fang Yuan tallied the profits in his immortal aperture.

This haul exceeded half of what he had seized from Dong Fang tribe, far too many for Hu Immortal blessed land's dragon scale lake.

"Once Eighty-Eight True Yang Building's collapse is exposed, I must abandon Hu Immortal blessed land. After returning, I should remodel Star Form blessed land to raise them."

"The ten ancient sects sent disciples to contest resources within seven days and seven nights. So now, I only need to get the desolate beast dragonfish, hidden essence turtle and that nether grass. Most of my energy and time should be used to search for that dream realm in the central region!"

Thinking of the dream realm, Fang Yuan's eyes shone with inner fire.

At the fragment world's center lay an externally manifested dream realm.

Due to Great Dream Immortal Venerable's prophecy, the ten ancient sects had begun research, with Spirit Affinity House leading thanks to Feng Jin Huang's Dream Wings Immortal Gu.

It was Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's dream realm!

Though lacking a dream path Immortal Gu, Fang Yuan had the wisdom path Immortal Gu Unravel Mystery and its derivative dream path killer move, Unravel Dream!

Inviting Fang Yuan to represent Immortal Crane Sect was like letting a thief inside or bringing a weasel into a chicken coop.

"Immortal Crane Sect lacked sufficient strength and sent me despite strong resistance from the other nine sects. Though they succeeded, my entry was delayed far past the others. I must hurry to occupy the central region—delays breed trouble."

Yet when Fang Yuan arrived, someone was already there.

"Fang Yuan, I've waited quite a while." Feng Jin Huang led four Spirit Affinity House Gu Masters guarding the magnificent dream realm behind them.

Looking upon her strongest rival, she appeared strikingly beautiful with snow-white skin, a lovely smile, and absolute confidence.

Unperturbed, Fang Yuan smiled back: "By the ten sects' rules, for Spirit Affinity House to fully claim this area, you must face challenges from other sects. Only after winning two out of three challenges can you strip away the opponent's right to occupy this area."

Feng Jin Huang shook her head: "Even with mother's Immortal Gu and immortal essence, I cannot defeat you. I waited here to make a transaction."

"Oh?" Raising his brows, Fang Yuan said coldly, "Another transaction? You scammed me badly at the Refinement Path Convention, offering an immortal zombie revival method through ten extreme physique ascension! You still want to trade?"

Feng Jin Huang replied quickly: "This transaction is mutually beneficial. You've profited plenty from Spirit Affinity House, and I assure you that you won't suffer a loss here."

"Alright, then speak." Fang Yuan nodded.

Feng Jin Huang proposed her offer: another method to shed the immortal zombie status!

Confirming her method was new to him, Fang Yuan agreed to the transaction.

In exchange, Fang Yuan would occupy this dream realm.

However, Feng Jin Huang was granted three days to explore the manifested dream realm before departing.

"This is a dream realm's external manifestation?" Fang Yuan muttered, looking ahead with feigned curiosity, serious yet burning with greed and passion as if seeing one for the first time.

The dream realm before them resembled a condensed star cloud, ringed with dark purple light and filled with countless twinkling stars.

Snorting inwardly, Feng Jin Huang turned to her four companions: "Three days is short; I must explore immediately. Guard my physical body well, make no mistakes."

Feng Jin Huang nodded, and stepped towards the dream realm.

Halting about twenty steps away, she reached her limit—her current ability still could not immerse her fully into the dream realm.

Casting a final glance at Fang Yuan, she sat cross-legged, closed her eyes, and activated Dream Wings Immortal Gu, sinking into a deep sleep.

"Dream Wings Immortal Gu..." Fang Yuan eyed her with envy.

"This Feng Jin Huang is maturing rapidly. First, she traded control of this dream realm to make me her shield against competitors while exploring it freely. Then she gave no warnings, hoping I would make a fool of myself. But you'd never imagine I possess Unravel Dream."

Sneering, Fang Yuan released the desolate beast shark fin wolf from his immortal aperture.

Seeing the desolate beast, the four Spirit Affinity House Gu Masters froze in terror, nearly waking Feng Jin Huang.

Fang Yuan warned them: "Don't panic—this desolate beast is guarding this place. If you haven't left in three days, it will eat you alive."

Leaving that warning, Fang Yuan flew into the sky and vanished from their sight.

# Chapter 912: Beastman

After setting up a facade, Fang Yuan returned. Stealthily circling to the back, Fang Yuan slipped into the dream realm.

Entering deliberately this time with the killer move Unravel Dream, he possessed far greater strength than before.

Fang Yuan entered Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's dream realm!

Countless burly beastmen danced around a roaring fire.

"This is... the beastman race that went extinct in the Olden Antiquity Era?" Regaining his bearings, Fang Yuan recognized their origin.

"Star Constellation Immortal Venerable was a rank nine Gu Immortal from the Remote Antiquity Era, when humans fought variant humans for control of the world. This is indeed her dream realm!"

Looking around, he found he was a human boy in this dream.

He was bound by a rope tied tightly to a tree trunk.

Over a dozen human children were tied up alongside Fang Yuan.

"Oh no! Beastmen are bloodthirsty man-eaters whose favorite food is the flesh and blood of human children. Beastmen tribes treat surrounding humans as food and hunt them occasionally. When their hunts succeed, they hold a huge bonfire celebration."

At the bonfire's climax, the beastman leader shouted: "Come, bring up our most delectable food!"

A six-meter-tall elephantman rose to his feet.

With his long, powerful trunk, he uprooted the entire tree tethering the children.

As the beastmen cheered, the elephantman laughed and released his trunk, slamming the tree onto the ground.

Trapped, the children fell with it, several crushed to death under the trunk.

An intense smell of blood spread out.

Unable to control their bloodlust, several beastmen rushed forward to grab the children's corpses and stuff them into their mouths.

Yet Fang Yuan noticed one pale, shivering girl remained expressionless, biting her lip without making a sound.

"Could she be..." Fang Yuan's heart leapt as inspiration struck.

Before he could process the thought, the beastman leader approached with a ferocious aura, glaring down arrogantly at the weak children.

Under the flickering light, the black-faced, sharp-fanged beastman leader spoke slowly to the terrified children: "By tribal tradition, whoever unties the wind knot grass is blessed by heaven and spared from death. Those who fail, hehehe, have the honor of becoming food for us noble beastmen!"

The ropes were cut, the human children obtained temporary freedom in movement.

Wind knot grass?

Seeing the pile of dried grass that the beastmen brought over, Fang Yuan was curious.

The wind knot grass resembled a spherical grass lantern, extremely rare in modern times.

It did not exist in the five regions, growing only in green heaven of the immemorial nine heavens.

Worshipping heavenly deities, the beastmen believed anyone who could untie the wind knot grass was blessed by heaven and could not be harmed.

"So untying the wind knot grass spares me from death?" Fang Yuan's mind raced.

Transformed into an unawakened child under thirteen without power, he could only survive by following tribal rules and untying the grass alone.

Soon, each child received their wind knot grass.

Knowing it was their sole chance of survival, the children desperately tried to untie the wind knot grass.

Fang Yuan observed carefully.

His composure drew the attention of the beastmen, as well as Feng Jin Huang.

Feng Jin Huang was also inside the dream realm as a child.

Seeing Fang Yuan calm, confident, and covered in grime that obscured his gender, Feng Jin Huang wondered: "What is with this child? Is she Star Constellation Immortal Venerable?"

Roar!

Just then, a tiger-headed beastman roared with excitement.

He swiftly snatched a boy and threw him into his mouth.

"What are you looking at! He ruined the wind knot grass and failed—of course I can eat him!" the tiger-headed beastman growled, flesh and blood caught in his teeth.

Stirred by this, the beastmen eyed the remaining children with ruthless hunger.

With ill intent, they intentionally growled, snarled, and huffed to disrupt the children.

"Scoundrel, get away from me, you stink!" Feng Jin Huang snapped at a crocodile-tailed beastman.

The crocodile-tailed beastman growled angrily, glaring bloodshot eyes at this surprisingly arrogant food.

Fearless, Feng Jin Huang barked: "Quit growling, you bastard, it's annoying!"

Bam.

Enraged, the beastman swept its iron tail, instantly crushing Feng Jin Huang's skull!

# Chapter 913: Dream Wings, Unravel Dream

Once dead, Feng Jin Huang's soul floated into the night sky, giggling softly.

A pair of rainbow-colored feathered wings unfolded across her soul's back.

"With dream wings Immortal Gu, I can enter and exit dream realms freely. Failing once means nothing—I'll just try again next time," Feng Jin Huang thought smugly.

As she prepared to flap her wings and escape, an eagle-bodied beastman swooped down from the sky.

Feng Jin Huang shrieked in fear, she wanted to dodge.

Yet the wings that normally flapped with incredible speed moved sluggishly within this dream realm.

Underestimating the Venerable's dream realm, her soul was crushed by the eagle-bodied beastman before she could escape!

That single blow heavily injured Feng Jin Huang's soul.

Ejected from the dream realm, her soul returned to her body.

She opened her eyes and spat out a mouthful of blood.

"What a formidable dream realm! Another strike like that would truly kill me." Lingering fear flashed in Feng Jin Huang's eyes as cold sweat drenched her back.

"I was careless! Even with dream wings Immortal Gu, I'm not safe in an Immortal Venerable's dream realm. Fortunately, I brought plenty of guts Gu to heal my soul quickly. I will fully heal in half a day." Wiping cold sweat from her forehead, Feng Jin Huang promptly began healing herself.

Inside the dream realm, Fang Yuan focused back on the wind knot grass.

"This small scene is only the outer layer, yet even rank six dream wings Immortal Gu failed to escape an Immortal Venerable's dream immediately. The crux clearly lies in the wind knot grass in my hands."

Having finished observing, he began untying the wind knot grass.

Glancing around, Fang Yuan noticed the girl he suspected was Star Constellation Immortal Venerable had already reached the seventh layer.

The wind knot grass had shrunken in half in her hands.

"Reaching this point on pure intellect without any wisdom path Gu?" Fang Yuan was shocked.

Yet Fang Yuan was confident he would not only succeed, but surpass everyone to finish first.

His confidence stemmed from none other than the dream path immortal killer move—Unravel Dream!

Unravel dream activated.

The intertwined strands before him dissolved and untied themselves.

This was the mystical power of unravel dream.

Not purely an offensive move, its effect adapted to the surrounding dream.

Here, where the dream's rules required untying wind knot grass, unravel dream adapted to untie it for him.

To the onlookers, Fang Yuan appeared to be legitimately solving the third layer with pure intellect.

Maintaining momentum, Fang Yuan rapidly unraveled the wind knot grass to its center.

At the core of the wind knot grass lay a seed.

Fang Yuan stood, holding the extracted seed high.

"You're free, little thing. You have three days to run—now scram!" The beastman leader snorted, kicking Fang Yuan away.

Fang Yuan hesitated slightly, before turning around and leaving.

Leaving the bonfire, he walked into the dark forest.

A dozen steps in, a bright light shone through the dark.

As the light faded, reality reappeared before him.

Fang Yuan opened his eyes to find his physical body had walked a dozen steps away from the dream realm.

Looking back at the dream realm, Fang Yuan frowned in confusion: "What happened? I left just like that?"

This exploration of the dream realm did not fail.

His wisdom path attainment level had risen slightly.

"This cannot be right. A dream realm of this scale should have three scenes. Why didn't I enter the second after clearing the first?"

He walked forwards and let the dream realm engulf him.

His vision shifted as he re-entered Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's dream realm.

Relying on unravel dream, Fang Yuan again finished untying the wind knot grass first.

Instead of leaving, he went over to help the girl he suspected was Star Constellation untie her wind knot grass.

The beastman leader did not object: "Little rascal, you want to help others? Hehe, fail and you lose your life!"

"My guess was right." Overjoyed, Fang Yuan untied the grass in time and escaped with the girl.

"What? I still left?" Fang Yuan looked back in surprise.

His second attempt also failed to reach the second scene, ejecting him just like before.

"Saving the girl boosted my wisdom path attainment even more than before..." Fang Yuan muttered.

According to this situation, there were two possibilities.

First, the girl he saved was not the real Star Constellation Immortal Venerable.

Second, he needed to save a certain number of children to advance.

Before entering a third time, Fang Yuan took a brief rest.

Using guts Gu, he restored his weakened soul to its prime.

"Third time!" Spurring himself on inwardly, Fang Yuan entered the dream realm again.

Everything restarted again in the dream.

As soon as the grass was distributed, Fang Yuan used unravel dream several times, untying his grass in a few breaths.

Holding up the seed in his right hand, Fang Yuan shouted: "I succeeded!"

Beastmen and children alike stared at Fang Yuan in wide-eyed shock.

The noisy scene turned into creepy silence.

# Chapter 914: Huge Growth in Attainment Level

"I'll help you!" Having untied his grass, Fang Yuan moved to the nearest child.

Breaking from convention, Fang Yuan used unravel dream continuously at an incredible pace!

All of the captured children were saved one after another.

"I saved them all, I succeeded." Fang Yuan spoke calmly at the beastman leader.

The beastman leader stared speechlessly with bloodshot eyes, while the surrounding beastmen growled and bared their fangs, itching to strike.

As expected, the furious beastmen could only watch their food walk away.

Fang Yuan led the children through the dark forest, far away from the bonfire.

In the darkness, a speck of light expanded, until light filled his vision.

Fang Yuan's soul returned to his body, he opened his eyes.

Turning to the dream realm behind him, Fang Yuan was full of questions: "How can this be? I saved all the children, pushing this to the limit. Why was I still thrown out instead of entering the second scene?"

"What clues did I neglect?"

"In that case, I'll go subdue the hidden essence turtle first."

Changing his train of thought, Fang Yuan departed for the other location.

Two hours later, color returned to Feng Jin Huang's pale face.

"Dream wings Immortal Gu worked wonders for my refinement path attainment, but an Immortal Venerable's dream realm is on a completely different level—I cannot repeat that mistake. Eh? Why does the dream realm look smaller?"

Once the dream realm was successfully explored, it would vanish.

Though Fang Yuan had not cleared it, his wisdom path attainment had still risen significantly.

Shaking her head to dismiss her suspicion, she re-entered the dream realm.

As Feng Jin Huang entered the dream, Fang Yuan reached the hidden essence turtle's location following He Feng Yang's information.

This wisdom path desolate beast was as massive as a mound.

"Having only started wisdom path cultivation recently, my attainment was ordinary, but now it has reached quasi-master level. Star Constellation's dream realm is incredible!"

Fang Yuan spent a day and night subduing the hidden essence turtle and storing it into his aperture.

"Thirty-sixth failure..."

Feng Jin Huang opened her eyes in fatigue.

Ever since her severe injury, she had grown cautious, but lacking unravel dream and prior knowledge of wind knot grass, she failed thirty-six times without untying it once.

Meanwhile, Fang Yuan quietly approached the dream realm again.

Having captured the hidden essence turtle and nether grass, he dedicated his remaining time to the Immortal Venerable's dream realm.

Through rigorous deductions, Fang Yuan devised a new idea.

As Feng Jin Huang wallowed in dejection, Fang Yuan smiled confidently and slipped back into the dream realm.

# Chapter 915: The Biggest Winner

Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's dream realm unfolded before Fang Yuan once again.

He was again a bound child surrounded by captive boys and girls.

Fang Yuan's eyes flashed sharply as he stood up and shouted: "I want wind knot grass!"

The beastman leader grunted furiously, ordering with surging killing intent: "Give it to him!"

"Little rascal, break even a single strand and my trunk will roll you into meat paste," an elephant beastman threatened, handing Fang Yuan a ball of wind knot grass.

Fang Yuan glanced at the grass in his hand and scoffed: "One? Not enough. Give me a ball for every captive here. I will untie them all and save everyone!"

Soon, all the wind knot grass was laid before Fang Yuan.

Unravel dream.

"I have finally entered the second round of the dream realm!" Fang Yuan felt satisfied inwardly.

As it turned out, clearing the first round required saving every child.

Realizing this key point while hunting outside, Fang Yuan acted immediately and advanced to the second round.

"After passing the first round, my wisdom path attainment has probably reached master level!"

"The first round likely stemmed from Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's childhood regret. Saving all the children made up for that regret, allowing me to pass."

It was a mountain.

"If we take six steps across the astrolabe chessboard, we can claim Lord Immortal Venerable's legacy!"

"Historical records state that the first rank nine Gu Immortal in human history was Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable. Aware of the clan system's drawbacks, he set an example to initiate a sect system by placing astrolabes in many locations. Fang Yuan recalled, following his companions toward the peak.

There, he saw the famous astrolabe chessboard.

Fang Yuan concentrated and walked to the giant rock, slowly placing his palm on its surface.

The thin starry lines expanded into paths beneath him, and Fang Yuan blossomed with starry radiance, becoming a star chess piece stopped within this web of starry paths.

The next moment, his soul was expelled from the dream realm back into his physical body.

His soul was heavily injured!

Fang Yuan swayed, almost collapsing. His soul injury was far more severe than Feng Jin Huang's, nearly costing him half his life!

"But I have passed the first round with great gains. My wisdom path attainment has indeed reached master level."

"There is still time, no rush. I will use guts Gu to recuperate first, then explore slowly."

While Fang Yuan healed, across from him behind the dream realm's external manifestation, Feng Jin Huang finished recovering, opened her eyes, and stood up to try again.

"Eh, why has the dream realm shrunk again?"

"Moreover, it shrank much more this time, almost by a third!"

Fang Yuan had passed the first round with huge gains, causing the first round's external manifestation to disappear.

"This is clearly a deeper layer of the dream realm—great, I finally don't have to face that damned wind knot grass!" Feng Jin Huang rejoiced inside the dream realm.

However, after a while, Feng Jin Huang returned, utterly defeated.

"There is no more wind knot grass, but now there is this even more complex astrolabe chessboard..." She looked bitterly at the dream realm before her, its external manifestation glowing with gorgeous, mysterious colors.

"Star Constellation Immortal Venerable, I will remember you..." Gritting her teeth, Feng Jin Huang fainted, her eyes rolling back as she finally could not endure the injuries.

Time passed quickly; it was soon the agreement's final day.

All Gu Masters who entered the fragment world returned to their respective sects' Gu Immortals to report their findings.

Soon, all the immortals' gazes gathered on Fang Yuan and He Feng Yang.

In this contest, Immortal Crane Sect unquestionably dominated, devouring the meat without even leaving soup for the others.

In such a situation, Fang Yuan naturally did not linger.

He completed the handover to He Feng Yang on the spot and departed the valley with his dragonfish.

Fang Yuan kept quiet about his gains, fully aware that he was the contest's biggest winner!

# Chapter 916: Dual Grandmaster!

Hu Immortal blessed land.

After the blood poison kerria earthly calamity, Hu Immortal blessed land gained blood path dao marks; the drastic environmental shift made the entire area suitable for blood path life forms.

Fang Yuan sat on a giant blood lingzhi.

Recalling his earlier thoughts, Fang Yuan exhaled foggy air and sighed softly: "The gains this time are simply too much."

From exploring this dream realm, Fang Yuan's star path and wisdom path attainments had reached grandmaster level!

"My gains this time will allow me to grow immensely and even break out of my predicament!"

"Attainment levels are like mathematics problems. By solving numerous questions and getting correct answers, one accumulates experience, eventually grasping the crux, gaining enlightenment, and raising their attainment level. With this understanding, one can easily solve related questions and reach the right answers. Even when encountering unfamiliar problems, one can use existing knowledge to solve portions of them."

As a wisdom path grandmaster, he could employ wisdom Gu far more efficiently using supplementary Gu worms.

Even battlefield killer moves, which Fang Yuan had long failed to find, could now be created from his own foundation!

Half a month passed in five regions' time.

Two wills were intertwined, battling intensely.

Fang Yuan's will held the complete advantage, suppressing Mo Yao's will.

"How can this be, how can your capabilities rise by so much?!" Mo Yao's will screamed in shocked anger.

Fang Yuan needed only a third of his will to overwhelm Mo Yao's will.

"Earlier, I used Mo Yao's will as a training dummy to learn techniques through battle. Now that I far surpass her and execute those techniques effortlessly, she has lost all value as a dummy."

He directed his full attention to the battlefield killer move before him, eight doors labyrinth.

Ten days ago, Fang Yuan left Hu Immortal blessed land for Eastern Sea, joining Shark Demon and the others to explore Yu Lu blessed land.

The stubborn barrier of Eight Doors Labyrinth was now solvable by Fang Yuan as a wisdom path grandmaster.

After dozens of days, Fang Yuan guided Shark Demon's group to the verge of unraveling the labyrinth.

With a thunderous sound, Fang Yuan thoroughly unraveled eight doors labyrinth.

Yu Lu blessed land's true appearance emerged before the immortals!

# Chapter 917: Unmoving Troops

With eight doors labyrinth dismantled, everyone's vision widened to reveal Yu Lu blessed land's true appearance.

Uniquely, Yu Lu blessed land was a vast expanse without sky or ground, containing no living beings and none of the resources Gu Immortals typically accumulated.

"Perhaps this uniqueness allows Yu Lu blessed land to accommodate battlefield killer moves from countless paths," Fang Yuan realized.

"Fairy Yu Lu was Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable's disciple. It is hardly surprising her immortal aperture blessed land is like this," Su Bai Man remarked with an exhale.

An accompanying Gu Immortal pointed in a direction and shouted: "Quickly look, Immortal Gu!"

Indeed, a peculiar Gu worm hovered ahead: long and slim as a twig, with numerous delicate golden wings fluttering in the air.

This Gu worm quickly drilled into a nearby flashing light and vanished.

With a thought, he turned into a flash of light and tore through space, shooting toward the golden willow branch-like Immortal Gu.

Just as Shark Demon rapidly approached the Immortal Gu, space rippled and he vanished.

The next moment, he reappeared beside everyone with a shocked expression.

"What happened?" Su Bai Man asked in suspicion.

Shark Demon shook his head, sounding uncertain: "It seems to be another battlefield killer move?"

The others also tried and failed to move, confirming Shark Demon's guess.

"Such an ability, this has to be the legendary unmoving troops."

Battlefield killer move—Unmoving Troops. This final battlefield killer move obstructed everyone.

This move possessed a grand origin, personally created by Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable.

Anyone entering the unmoving troops formation with battle intent, malice, or lust was rendered completely unable to move or advance.
