Having previously invited a wisdom path Gu Immortal only to lose an Immortal Gu to her, Shark Demon disliked this idea.

Shark Demon turned to Fang Yuan, who was now one of their own in Eastern Sea Zombie Alliance.

Shark Demon asked: "Xing Xiang Zi, do you have any methods? If so, use them—your compensation won't be small."

Fang Yuan smiled faintly: "Unraveling this battlefield killer move can be called both easy and difficult."

"Oh? What do you mean?"

Fang Yuan said slowly: "Do not fear unmoving troops' reputation. That legendary defeat occurred under Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable's active control. Now, we face an unmanned battlefield killer move. It is far easier to deal with."

Fang Yuan added: "Yet for me to unravel this battlefield killer move alone, there is almost no hope."

Fang Yuan bowed solemnly: "I am restricted by a lack of resources. If I can refine a wisdom path Immortal Gu, I will be fully confident in unraveling it."

# Chapter 918: Blazing Heaven Demoness

Shark sea, underwater palace.

Having hit a barrier in Yu Lu blessed land and knowing further effort was futile, Shark Demon's group sensibly retreated.

Downing his fine wine, Shark Demon set his cup down and looked at Fang Yuan: "Xing Xiang Zi, how much assurance do you truly have in unraveling unmoving troops?"

Fang Yuan thought inwardly: 'The time has come.'

Fang Yuan replied: "Lord Shark Demon, you know my situation. My wisdom path inheritance is complete, and having comprehended many mysteries recently, I was able to unravel eight doors labyrinth. Yet I lack a suitable wisdom path Immortal Gu, leaving my methods limited. If I can refine this wisdom path Immortal Gu, I can certainly unravel the unmanned unmoving troops."

Su Bai Man pressed Fang Yuan directly: "If you have the wisdom path Immortal Gu, can you guarantee you will unravel that battlefield killer move?"

Fang Yuan retreated to advance, offering a bitter smile: "How could I have complete certainty? This involves Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable, one of history's ten supreme experts! Any unexpected complication would be completely normal. Yet judging by what has been revealed so far, I am quite confident in unraveling it with the aid of that wisdom path Immortal Gu."

Shark Demon and Su Bai Man exchanged glances; though irritated by Fang Yuan's evasiveness, they were undeniably tempted.

Shark Demon and Su Bai Man swiftly concluded their secret discussion.

They decided to fund Fang Yuan's refinement of the wisdom path Immortal Gu.

Just as Shark Demon was about to reply, an abrupt change occurred.

The sea shook violently as thunder crackled and chaotic currents surged toward the underwater palace.

A piercing pillar of fire shot down from above, striking Shark Demon's underwater palace with shocking might.

Momentarily dazed, Shark Demon leapt to his feet and glared above, roaring in fury: "Such audacity! Who dares to attack my sea area?"

"Hahaha," a voice rang in everyone's ears right after Shark Demon's roar. "This is just an appetizer. Not only will I destroy your palace, I'll beat you lowlife lovers until you can't even stand!"

A bright red figure plunged from the sky, diving through the sea toward the four on the seabed.

Fang Yuan looked up at the descending female immortal, her body blazing with flames that obscured her appearance.

"This surging aura... a rank eight Gu Immortal!" Tai Bai Yun Sheng blurted.

Fang Yuan narrowed his eyes, adding inwardly: 'More precisely, a rank eight female immortal zombie.'

"Blazing Heaven Demoness, have you gone mad? Attacking a fellow Zombie Alliance member challenges its authority; you will surely be severely punished!"

Blazing Heaven Demoness was a rank eight Gu Immortal from Northern Plains, leading its Zombie Alliance branch!

Shrouded in fire, Blazing Heaven Demoness laughed loudly: "Shark Demon, stop talking nonsense. This is purely an internal conflict between members. Speak! Why did you steal my immortal material?"

Shark Demon shouted: "Absurd! When did I steal your immortal material? If you want to frame me, find a better excuse! Lately, I have focused entirely on Zombie Alliance's mission to invade Yu Lu blessed land. When would I have time to steal your immortal material? You are just picking a fight!"

Unflustered, Blazing Heaven Demoness laughed confidently: "Hahaha, I brought a witness. Shark Demon, you won't be able to deny it!"

Shark Demon laughed out of sheer fury: "Good, let me see what witness you have."

# Chapter 919: Angry Bird

Fang Yuan looked at Tai Bai Yun Sheng, who transmitted: "Blazing Heaven Demoness is a rank eight expert; we cannot fight her."

Fang Yuan nodded discreetly, understanding Tai Bai Yun Sheng meant to sit back and watch.

Blazing Heaven Demoness smiled with triumphant confidence: "Shark Demon, isn't justifying my actions simple?"

"Bo Dan, come out!" Blazing Heaven Demoness called.

Bo Dan stepped out from behind Blazing Heaven Demoness.

Lowering his head with a bitter expression, he bowed deeply: "Lord Shark Demon, Lady Su Bai Man, I was forced!"

Right on cue, Blazing Heaven Demoness shouted: "Shark Demon, Su Bai Man, you instructed Bo Dan to steal my rank eight immortal material, medicine ice! I was careless during closed cultivation, allowing you to succeed. Today, I demand justice!"

Suppressing his rage, Shark Demon sneered at Blazing Heaven Demoness: "If you want to reap the fruits, just say so—why frame an innocent person?"

Su Bai Man added: "Lady Blazing Heaven Demoness, as a rank eight great expert, aren't your actions too disgraceful?"

Blazing Heaven Demoness's laughter ceased. Her eyes flashed brightly as she stared toward the sea, declaring: "Three moves."

"What?" Su Bai Man was shocked.

"I will defeat you in three moves. If you can block them, I will act as if I was never here," Blazing Heaven Demoness stated sternly.

Shark Demon exchanged a look with Su Bai Man, exhaled turbid air, and agreed: "Alright! Let the four of us witness your might!"

Tai Bai Yun Sheng frowned, unwilling to fight, but Shark Demon had craftily roped him and Fang Yuan into standing against Blazing Heaven Demoness.

Su Bai Man transmitted to them: "If we survive this ordeal, we will owe you a favor and pay a sum that will surely satisfy you. Please support us!"

"Don't worry, we will do our best." Fang Yuan transmitted in return.

Fang Yuan stepped forward with Tai Bai Yun Sheng, resolving to merely feign effort alongside the couple.

She stretched out her hand, opening her five fingers.

Though seemingly cute, the fire bird possessed terrifying power, capable of incinerating the palace and vast stretches of sea in a single blow.

"Lady Blazing Heaven Demoness, may I ask the name of this move?" Shark Demon asked after a pause, his voice dispirited and hoarse.

Blazing Heaven Demoness smiled lightly: "Centuries ago, careless cultivation let anger burn my heart, nearly killing me. While recovering, inspiration struck and I created this rank eight killer move: Angry Bird."

Before Fang Yuan's group replied, Shark Demon stepped forward: "Angry bird, a fine move. Lady Blazing Heaven Demoness, please attack!"

Blazing Heaven Demoness squinted in surprise and suspicion: "Are you sure you want to face this move?"

"Let's retreat," Su Bai Man said to Fang Yuan and Tai Bai Yun Sheng, eyes shining brightly.

"Alright, let's see what gives you such courage!" Without hesitation, Blazing Heaven Demoness willed the angry bird to tear through the water toward Shark Demon.

At the seafloor, a powerful aura erupted, contesting Blazing Heaven Demoness on equal footing!

Shark Demon smiled as though his plan had succeeded.

In the distance, Su Bai Man sighed in relief and explained to Fang Yuan and Tai Bai Yun Sheng: "We naturally had our reasons for building our underwater palace here."

# Chapter 920: Immemorial Desolate Beast, One Finger Flow Shark

A surging, vast aura!

"This is?" Tai Bai Yun Sheng was startled.

"Immemorial desolate beast!" Fang Yuan's eyes brightened.

Immemorial desolate beasts were mighty existences comparable to rank eight Gu Immortals!

Shark Demon and Su Bai Man stared at the aura's center as the immemorial desolate beast gradually revealed its form.

With the enemy unknown, Blazing Heaven Demoness halted her attacks and recalled the small fire bird to her side.

This formidable immemorial desolate beast appeared unimaginably small and dainty.

Ignoring Fang Yuan's group behind it, the small shark fixed its eyes on Blazing Heaven Demoness with intense enmity.

Shark Demon exhaled and transmitted to Fang Yuan and Tai Bai Yun Sheng: "Fortunately, my plan succeeded... don't underestimate this small shark. It is a one finger flow shark."

As a rank eight time path desolate beast packed with time path dao marks, it could swim physically in the River of Time!

Shark Demon explained: "The one finger flow shark normally hides in the River of Time. We found its tracks by chance, then requested this sea area and built Shark Sea."

Blazing Heaven Demoness chuckled: "So that was it. No wonder you spared no expense to trade for enslavement path grandmaster Hundred and Eighty Slaves' killer move, Lower Controls Higher, from Zombie Alliance. You wanted to subdue this one finger flow shark, right?"

Shark Demon nodded frankly at her guess: "You guessed right. I have been managing the shark groups in this sea area precisely to use them to subdue the one finger flow shark. Unfortunately, my enslavement path attainment is insufficient and I lack the Immortal Gu for Lower Controls Higher, so I haven't succeeded yet."

Shark Demon continued: "Moreover, this immemorial desolate beast houses several time path Immortal Gu!"

Tai Bai Yun Sheng whispered to Fang Yuan: "Countless time path Gu worms inhabit the River of Time. Since the one finger flow shark moves freely there, possessing Immortal Gu isn't strange."

Fang Yuan thought of Red Lotus Demon Venerable's inheritance.

Blazing Heaven Demoness laughed heartily: "Hearing that only strengthens my urge to strike. Shark Demon! Relying on outside force to make me retreat without fighting? Wishful thinking!"

With that, Blazing Heaven Demoness pointed her finger.

The small fire bird on her shoulder flew straight toward Shark Demon.

Like a silver firefly, the one finger flow shark darted forward, pouncing at the fire bird.

Blindingly fast, the two collided in the sea within the blink of an eye!

The shark then gracefully leaped over the small fire bird and darted swiftly ahead.

Having bypassed the fire bird, it charged straight toward Blazing Heaven Demoness.

Just as Fang Yuan was about to retreat, the small fire bird flapped its wings, arcing around to chase the one finger flow shark.

'This small fire bird responds fluidly to the controller's thoughts. It isn't a simple fire path killer move; wisdom path methods are definitely mixed in,' Fang Yuan analyzed rapidly.

"That happened because a time path Immortal Gu in the one finger flow shark activated, drastically slowing the flow of time in that area. They seemed to freeze from extreme speed, but their actual speed hadn't changed," Tai Bai Yun Sheng quickly explained.

Blazing Heaven Demoness's expression shifted as the fire bird chasing the shark suddenly detonated.

Flames accompanied the surging blast, spreading ferociously.

In a disheveled state, Fang Yuan's group flew out of the sea to observe from the air.

The one finger flow shark shot like a silver arrow directly at Blazing Heaven Demoness's face.

Blazing Heaven Demoness turned serious, not daring to take it head-on.

Though small, the immemorial desolate beast concealed terrifying brute strength in its tiny body!

# Chapter 921: Big Fish Eat Small Fish

The one finger flow shark shot forward.

Cultivating fire path rather than strength path, Blazing Heaven Demoness knew resisting it head-on would be difficult.

Fire path killer move — Five Fingers Blazing Chains!

Retreating, her five fingers became flame whips, coiling out to bind the one finger flow shark.

Time around the one finger flow shark slowed to an extreme.

As the five fire chains coiled, the one finger flow shark dodged nimbly through tiny gaps, slipping past them impossibly.

It charged at Blazing Heaven Demoness, piercing directly through her forehead.

'If the four of us strike now...' Just as Shark Demon thought this, the one finger flow shark reversed direction, piercing through Blazing Heaven Demoness's chest.

Dark fire burned, restoring the holes in Blazing Heaven Demoness's head and chest in the blink of an eye.

Fang Yuan was amazed: "Such a formidable killer move, enabling such rapid recovery!"

Clutching her chest and staring at the shark, Blazing Heaven Demoness smiled despite her injuries: "Hehehe, interesting! It possesses three time path Immortal Gu: one slows time, one speeds up time, and one alters time perception."

As Shark Demon expected, Blazing Heaven Demoness shifted tactics as the fight continued.

She split into five or six lifelike clones. The one finger flow shark dashed about frantically, its impressive offensive running in circles as the clones toyed with it.

"Sirs, please help! If you have a method, break this deception and point out her true body to the shark. This will turn the situation around," Su Bai Man suddenly transmitted earnestly.

Shark Demon added: "If you succeed, we will reward you heavily—you won't regret it!"

Fang Yuan refused with a wry smile: "You two are established rank seven experts; if even you cannot solve this, how could we help?"

Tai Bai Yun Sheng likewise shook his head: "I only specialize in healing; investigative matters are beyond my ability."

Su Bai Man said no more, while Shark Demon glared displeasedly at Fang Yuan and Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

As the battle progressed, Shark Demon and Su Bai Man grew increasingly gloomy.

They had secretly requested reinforcements from Zombie Alliance headquarters at the battle's start.

Shark Demon sighed and lowered his head: "Enough, Lady Blazing Heaven Demoness, please stop. We lack the ability; for Zombie Alliance's sake, it is better that you lead us to conquer Yu Lu blessed land."

"Hehehe, Shark Demon, you know when to yield, very good," Blazing Heaven Demoness laughed from above the battlefield.

As her laughter stopped, the fake bodies on the battlefield burned away to nothing.

Shark Demon sighed again, pursing his lips to emit hooting sounds.

Revealing her true body, Blazing Heaven Demoness looked deeply at Shark Demon before turning her gaze toward Fang Yuan.

"You are Xing Xiang Zi?"

"I am."

Blazing Heaven Demoness announced imperiously: "You are enlisted. In the upcoming invasion of Yu Lu blessed land, use your full capabilities—I won't tolerate any slacking!"

# Chapter 922: Conclusion of the Hundred Days Battle

Fang Yuan felt no anger at Blazing Heaven Demoness's overbearing command.

"Blazing Heaven Demoness is astute and calculating, but with her wealth, perhaps she can subsidize refining Star Thought Immortal Gu? Another advantage: getting close to her improves my chances of returning to Northern Plains Zombie Alliance and entering Earth Trench for that treasure."

As Blazing Heaven Demoness finished speaking, Fang Yuan cupped his fists with a wry smile: "I dare not defy Lady's orders, but I have my difficulties. I had just mentioned this to Lord Shark Demon earlier, in order to unravel the final battlefield killer move, I will need to refine a rank six wisdom path Immortal Gu first."

Shark Demon snorted coldly.

Meeting his straightforward gaze, Blazing Heaven Demoness rubbed her chin and smiled meaningfully: "Refining Immortal Gu... hehehe, easy enough, I will fund you!"

Northern Plains, Luo Po valley.

Another earth-shaking intense battle had just reached its end.

Central Continent's Gu Immortals bore various injuries, all focusing their attention on Feng Jiu Ge.

Central Continent's group had assaulted Luo Po Valley for over three months against stubborn resistance from Shadow Sect's Qin Bai Sheng and his allies.

Over recent days, Feng Jiu Ge's strength surged through grueling combat until he finally defeated Qin Bai Sheng.

Shadow Sect's members slowly retreated into the deepest part of Luo Po Valley.

"A desperate foe should not be pursued," Feng Jiu Ge spoke calmly from the front, watching the enemy retreat into the valley.

Pale and bearing a dozen wounds, blood dripped from his eyebrows and the corners of his mouth.

After retreating into the valley, Qin Bai Sheng coughed uncontrollably.

Pale as paper, he coughed up blood with every breath.

"Your injuries are worsening!" Fairy Jiang Yu supported him, frowning with deep worry.

"Feng Jiu Ge is despicable!" growled the one-armed He Lang Zi. "He fights you one-on-one while having his allies threaten our defenses to distract you. Otherwise, why would you lose consecutively?"

Qin Bai Sheng replied grimly: "Say no more. Winner takes all; a loss is a loss, no excuses needed."

"Feng Jiu Ge is immensely talented to reach this stage—even as an enemy, I admire his mastery. Using his advantages to scheme and gather superiority is the way of fighting; had he not, I would have looked down on him."

After the hundred-day battle, only five remained: Hui Feng Zi, Hei Cheng, Jiang Yu, He Lang Zi, and the mysterious black-robed Gu Immortal.

Qin Bai Sheng rallied them: "Though defeated, it isn't over yet. Feng Jiu Ge's group lacks unity and cannot fight wholeheartedly; I stalled enough time. We only need one more night for that Immortal Gu to mature. Tomorrow, all five of you charge out while I hold off Central Continent's forces."

"Lord Qin Bai Sheng!" Everyone was shocked.

"It is settled. Rest now; tomorrow, your performance decides whether you break out." Qin Bai Sheng waved weakly, dismissing them.

Late that night, Qin Bai Sheng summoned the three.

# Chapter 923: Breaking Out

Late at night, in Luo Po valley.

Qin Bai Sheng and the other five immortals gathered.

Qin Bai Sheng openly handed an Immortal Gu to the mysterious black-robed Gu Immortal: "This Immortal Gu is crucial; I entrust it to you now!"

Turning around, Qin Bai Sheng instructed Jiang Yu seriously: "You or I can die, but the plan requires him—we cannot lose him!"

Fairy Jiang Yu nodded solemnly: "I promise that before I die, he will not perish!"

Hei Cheng and the others listened in astonishment.

Moments later, silent Luo Po Valley erupted into thunderous explosions.

At the same time, a shrill warning echoed: "Enemy attack!"

Fairy Ling Mei, who was warning them, retreated continuously.

Before her, Jiang Yu, Hui Feng Zi, He Lang Zi, Hei Cheng, and the mysterious black-robed Gu Immortal attacked together!

Fairy Ling Mei and Fairy Ao Xue controlled Crescent Moon Gu, able to unleash Peerless Crescent Moon Slash in unison.

Caught off guard by Shadow Sect's sudden breakout, Fairy Ling Mei fought alone in extreme danger.

"Kill her!" Fairy Jiang Yu charged fiercely, radiating intense killing intent.

In a life-or-death crisis, Fairy Ling Mei resolutely destroyed an Immortal Gu to stall three breaths of time.

During this time, Fairy Ling Mei activated a Gu formation and vanished into safety.

Gu Immortal Hong Chi Ming had painstakingly set up this Gu formation.

"Since we can't kill her, keep charging out!" Fairy Jiang Yu shouted.

She moved with determination and resolution.

"Ling Mei, are you alright?!" Clad in white, Fairy Ao Xue rushed over in shock and fury.

"Isn't it too late to leave now?" Bu Fei Yan sneered.

A wall of light appeared, blocking the five immortals.

Hong Chi Ming's voice echoed from the formation: "Lord Feng Jiu Ge foresaw your breakout. Surrender and be spared!"

An immensely powerful aura surged closer to them like a charging dragon.

Shadow Sect's members recognized this magnificent aura—it was Feng Jiu Ge. Cold sweat broke out.

Just as the five immortals neared despair, a golden arrow shot over, piercing the obstructing wall of light.

In the distance, Hong Chi Ming jolted as if electrocuted, coughing up blood from heavy injuries.

The one who shot the golden arrow was Qin Bai Sheng.

Refusing to watch them fail, he forced his wounded body forward, intercepting the Central Continent immortals.

Feng Jiu Ge's eyes shone, having already discerned Qin Bai Sheng's injuries.

He smiled elegantly: "In such a rush to leave without saying goodbye? At least listen to my parting song before you go."

Immortal killer move — Green Jade Song!

Struck by Green Jade Song, the five immortals watched their bodies slowly petrify into jade.

Being resolute figures, the five immortals immediately shattered or gouged out their contaminated flesh.

Immortal killer move — Soul Suppression!

Qin Bai Sheng struck next, aiming a potent soul path technique at Feng Jiu Ge.

Feng Jiu Ge's expression changed, he quickly defended himself.

With Feng Jiu Ge distracted, Green Jade Song halted, allowing the five immortals to flee.

Qin Bai Sheng used a metal path killer move again.

Golden chains coiled around Feng Jiu Ge's limbs, binding him tightly.

Yet Qin Bai Sheng smiled wryly: "I'll show you Luo Po Valley's true secret now."

Saying this, he used his method and activated something.

Countless mystical lights shot from the valley, one striking Feng Jiu Ge.

"This is?!" Feng Jiu Ge shattered the chains, but failed to dodge the mystical light.

"The power of space path!"

"Don't struggle. This light is harmless!" Feng Jiu Ge understood immediately and shouted a reminder.

Qin Bai Sheng smiled wider, approaching a mystical light to be dragged into the valley as well.

Ao Xue and Ling Mei gritted their teeth, trusting Feng Jiu Ge and letting the light draw them in.

"Where is this?" Ao Xue and Ling Mei looked around in shock and suspicion.

"So this was it." Feng Jiu Ge, having entered first, retracted his gaze: "This is actually a hidden Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable true inheritance!"

# Chapter 924: Discarding this Ruined Body to Exchange for a Clear Breeze

In the mystical area, warm light shone; devoid of mountains, rivers, wind, or land, it was completely blank.

Qin Bai Sheng appeared before them, smiling at the Central Continent immortals: "Without Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's arrangement, how could I lure Brother Feng here?"

"This really is Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's inheritance?" Fairy Ling Mei asked excitedly.

Feng Jiu Ge quickly discouraged them: "Don't even think about it. Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's inheritance is not something you can obtain."

Feng Jiu Ge added: "Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's inheritance has a strict requirement. Neither of you, nor I, nor even Brother Qin qualifies to inherit it."

Shocked, Ling Mei and Ao Xue asked, "There is such a thing?"

Qin Bai Sheng laughed: "Spirit Affinity House possesses one of Thieving Heaven's true inheritances and has researched it for years without gain."

Feng Jiu Ge replied: "Indeed, my sect controls a Thieving Heaven true inheritance, and through years of research, we have uncovered some secrets."

"Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable was an otherworldly demon from outside. Thus, his inheritances have only one requirement: the inheritor must be an otherworldly demon! I am not one, nor is Brother Qin—otherwise he would have inherited it long ago. Are either of you otherworldly demons?"

"Otherworldly demons? Do they really exist? I have never seen one in my life."

Feng Jiu Ge nodded: "Though rare, they exist. Since they come from beyond, other worlds must exist outside the five regions and nine heavens. Unfortunately, no one has ever ventured beyond the Gu world."

Qin Bai Sheng sneered: "Even as a rank nine, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable returned empty-handed after finding a Thieving Heaven true inheritance. Hehehe... Otherwise, why would Giant Sun Immortal Venerable hate otherworldly demons so much? Do you two truly think you can claim this inheritance?"

Feng Jiu Ge did not refute him, saying solemnly: "Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's space path attainment surpassed human imagination. Giant Sun Immortal Venerable tried to claim the true inheritance, but wary of the implications, he failed, suffered losses, and was left helpless."

"If even Giant Sun Immortal Venerable was helpless here, how can we get out?"

"Don't worry, as long as we do not move, in fifteen minutes, we will be teleported out." Feng Jiu Ge replied confidently.

Qin Bai Sheng threw back his head and laughed: "Feng Jiu Ge! Having gone through such trouble to lure you here, how could I let you leave? Stay here for good."

Feng Jiu Ge warned: "Don't move! He is trying to lure you into attacking—once you do, this space shifts against the attacker. The stronger the attack, the greater the backlash and the longer you are trapped. Do not fall into his trap!"

Qin Bai Sheng smiled strangely: "Your sect has not researched Thieving Heaven deeply enough. Let us see how you face my next move."

They only heard Qin Bai Sheng recite —

Through fifty-four tribulations, the sky remains filled with tribulation clouds.

Soul light in my chest pressures all, sword qi in my fist dominates Northern Plains.

Four hundred years passed rapidly, how can there be life without death?

Discarding this ruined body for a clear breeze, I shall sweep the heavens for countless light-years!

He closed his eyes as all life drained from his body!

Qin Bai Sheng had actually ended his own life!!

The next moment, a clear breeze stirred from within Qin Bai Sheng's body.

Behind Feng Jiu Ge, Ling Mei and Ao Xue paled, screaming in trembling terror: "Winds of assimilation!"

As the winds of assimilation blew, the entire mystical space shook, rippling endlessly like boiling lake water.

Feng Jiu Ge had a solemn expression.

Facing Qin Bai Sheng's desperate move, Feng Jiu Ge had to give his all; carelessness meant death.

Behind him, Ling Mei and Ao Xue activated their Gu worms to protect themselves.

# Chapter 925: Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance

Fairy Jiang Yu was even more heartless, directly ordering them to abandon Hei Cheng regardless of his fate.

# Chapter 926: Refining Star Thought Immortal Gu

Hu Immortal blessed land, underground cave.

Bathed in the halo of the light of wisdom, Fang Yuan sat in concentration.

His mind worked at high speed as countless thoughts collided, ignited, and vanished like meteor showers.

Two streams of blood slowly flowed down from his nose.

Indifferently wiping away his nosebleed, Fang Yuan evaluated: "It seems my newly created Gu formation still has many flaws."

Becoming a wisdom path grandmaster gave him endless inspiration on utilizing wisdom Gu more efficiently.

"The Gu formation still needs modification... but that is not the crux. The real difficulty lies in modifying the star thought Immortal Gu recipe."

When Blazing Heaven Demoness recruited him a few days ago, Fang Yuan seized the chance to request funding to refine star thought Immortal Gu.

Blazing Heaven Demoness agreed to fund the refinement, dispatching Bo Dan to deliver the immortal materials.

But he had tried three times consecutively and failed them all.

Without a success dao mark from the Refinement Path Convention, he had to rely solely on skill and luck.

His elevated star path attainment also enabled him to modify the star thought Immortal Gu recipe.

Counting this deduction, he had already modified many aspects of the original recipe.

"By now, Blazing Heaven Demoness should be sending over the fourth batch of refinement materials."

Aiming to attack Yu Lu blessed land, Blazing Heaven Demoness generously sponsored his refinement of star thought Immortal Gu.

However, their agreement made all funded materials Fang Yuan's debt, which he was obligated to repay.

"I can only make seven attempts in total. With three failures, I have four chances left. In terms of refinement skill, I have reached my limit; I can only seek breakthrough through luck."

Possessing Connect Luck Immortal Gu, he could forcefully link with others to bolster his own luck.

But there was a drawback with this.

Though Fang Yuan had Connect Luck, he lacked Break Luck.

If the target suffered misfortune, Fang Yuan would be implicated.

Thus, his previously chosen targets all had immense, enduring luck that would not wane over time.

# Chapter 927: Fang Yuan's Opportunity

"Unfortunately, Fairy Black Moon was masked and mysterious; I never knew her true identity. In my previous life, she rose like a dazzling sun, leaving behind no biography. She could be an ordinary disciple or a Gu Immortal's descendant in Spirit Affinity House. With so little information, I have no way to search for her."

Several days later, Blazing Heaven Demoness sent enough immortal materials for him to refine Gu again.

But Fang Yuan was no longer in the mood to refine Gu.

He had just heard some shocking news.

Recently, Old Ancestor Xue Hu had infiltrated Earth Trench to plunder precious Immortal Gu and materials.

However, an intense battle exposed Old Ancestor Xue Hu's tracks, forcing Zombie Alliance to respond.

Moreover, just now, Old Ancestor Xue Hu was found in the immortal zombie graveyard.

Rich in dao marks, immortal zombie bodies were excellent refinement materials, making their graveyard sacred to Zombie Alliance.

The immortal zombie graveyard was a place in Zombie Alliance that could not be defiled.

"Old Ancestor Xue Hu went too far, actually stooping to stealing immortal zombie corpses," Fang Yuan assessed.

"In my past life, Ma Hong Yun was fine and Old Ancestor Xue Hu never captured him to refine Fortune Rivalling Heaven. My rebirth has changed things, and Old Ancestor Xue Hu was implicated by me."

Old Ancestor Xue Hu's plight was good news to Fang Yuan.

Unable to ignore this, the three immortal zombies could only seek help from Zombie Alliance headquarters.

Enraged, Eastern Sea Zombie Alliance dispatched three rank eight and ten rank seven immortal zombies to punish Old Ancestor Xue Hu and defend their reputation.

Among the rank eights was Blazing Heaven Demoness, whose presence was required.

Refining star thought Immortal Gu was merely icing on the cake, far less vital than entering Northern Plains Zombie Alliance.

Fang Yuan had long coveted Northern Plains Zombie Alliance's inheritance to aid his revival. In his previous life, Northern Plains Zombie Alliance obtained this inheritance and surged in strength, temporarily surpassing Eastern Sea Zombie Alliance!

Fang Yuan had disguised himself as immortal zombie Sha Huang to enter Earth Trench and obtain the inheritance.

It was a pity he failed.

Feng Jiu Ge and the others ruined his plans.

Now was his best chance to enter Northern Plains Zombie Alliance.

Before Fang Yuan even asked, Blazing Heaven Demoness requested he accompany her back to Northern Plains.

Northern Plains Zombie Alliance held abundant materials, allowing her to grant Fang Yuan more attempts at refining star thought Gu.

Meanwhile, the wisdom path Gu Immortal Xing Xiang Zi could assist Blazing Heaven Demoness against Old Ancestor Xue Hu.

In short, the opportunity Fang Yuan had sought and awaited had finally arrived.

Northern Plains, in the deepest parts of Luo Po valley.

The five Central Continent Gu Immortals wore solemn expressions as they looked at this inconspicuous place.

After the battle had ended, only two people from Shadow Sect escaped.

"To think a Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable true inheritance was hidden deep within Luo Po valley!" Bu Fei Yan sighed.

Having secured Luo Po valley, they attempted to rescue Feng Jiu Ge, Ling Mei, and Ao Xue.

Ultimately, they confirmed the Thieving Heaven true inheritance's existence, but could not enter.

"Pity my sect knows nothing about Thieving Heaven true inheritances. It is too difficult; we cannot break in for at least two to three years," Hong Chi Ming said.

With Ancient Soul Sect's Old Oracle dead, Hong Chi Ming was best suited to speak.

Let alone three years, the Central Continent immortals could not even wait three months. In fact, remaining in Luo Po valley had already grown perilous.

"Lord Feng Jiu Ge is so strong, yet remains trapped without a sound. It must be perilous inside; if we enter, we might not survive."

"Qin Bai Sheng planned meticulously to trap Feng Jiu Ge. If we rashly try to save him, perhaps..."

"Though we took Luo Po valley, Old Oracle died and Feng Jiu Ge is trapped; we must stop here."

"Indeed. Don't forget, we captured Hui Feng Zi and the Immortal Gu House Dark Prison. These valuable gains must be handled properly."

Having concocted sufficient excuses, the five Central Continent immortals unanimously agreed to return home as soon as possible.

# Chapter 928: Luck Path Backlash

After traversing the regional wall, the Eastern Sea group finally reached Northern Plains.

"I am finally back," Fang Yuan sighed, stepping onto the grassland disguised as Xing Xiang Zi.

Ahead, Blazing Heaven Demoness's gaze flickered as she muttered softly, "Yes, I'm finally back."

Two immortal zombies among them radiated the strongest auras—both were rank eight.

The Eastern Sea force totaled three rank eights, six rank sevens, and four rank sixes, mostly immortal zombies.

Old Ancestor Xue Hu had truly infuriated Eastern Sea Zombie Alliance, which dispatched this sizable force to Northern Plains for revenge.

However, all of the Gu Immortals were injured now. The rank six Gu Immortals were lightly injured, the rank sevens had more severe injuries and were in pathetic states, while the three rank eight Gu Immortals were weak and had damaged bodies, some were missing arms while others were missing legs. They swayed in the breeze as if ready to collapse at any moment.

Furthermore, regional walls posed greater resistance to stronger life forms.

A rank eight Gu Immortal faced exponentially greater difficulty traversing a regional wall than a rank six!

The Eastern Sea immortal zombies had to go from Eastern Sea to Northern Plains, they had to pass two regional walls, the three rank eights were heavily injured, while four of the rank seven immortal zombies died in the regional walls. In contrast, the rank six Gu Immortals faced less pressure.

Among all of them, Fang Yuan had the easiest time.

He possessed the lowest cultivation at bottom-tier rank six, and was also a Northern Plains Gu Immortal.

Crossing into Northern Plains from Eastern Sea, the Eastern Sea regional wall repelled him while Northern Plains' wall drew him in.

Using the same logic, among the three rank eight immortal zombies, Blazing Heaven Demoness had the lightest injuries.

Before departure, dozens of immortal zombies at headquarters had activated a Gu formation to induce an earth tide.

Remarkably, Eastern Sea Zombie Alliance headquarters possessed a method to create artificial earth tides, temporarily weakening a section of the Eastern Sea regional wall.

"What do we do now?" After resting a while, a rank eight immortal zombie broke the silence.

As the strongest rank eight and leader of Northern Plains Zombie Alliance, Blazing Heaven Demoness directed the group.

Blazing Heaven Demoness smiled: "Old Ancestor Xue Hu has returned to Snowy Mountain. Resting to recover our strength is best."

Blazing Heaven Demoness bypassed Dark Flow Giant City, selecting a secluded hiding spot instead.

The Eastern Sea Gu Immortals went into hiding to recuperate.

In Snowy Mountain blessed land, snow was falling.

Among the peaks, the towering first main peak was Old Ancestor Xue Hu's residence.

Presently, in a room on the first peak, a giant Gu formation flickered with golden light.

It was Old Ancestor Xue Hu.

Yet at this moment, a female immortal controlled the Gu formation instead.

Looking to be in her late twenties with beauty and elegance, she was Snowy Mountain's second leader, Lady Wan Shou.

Lady Wan Shou was Old Ancestor Xue Hu's wife; though appearing far younger, she was actually much older than him.

Lady Wan Shou was a refinement path quasi-great grandmaster, renowned as one of Northern Plains' four refinement experts.

Now, however, Lady Wan Shou was using this Gu formation to temper an immortal material rather than refine Gu.

Old Ancestor Xue Hu had excavated this immortal material from the deepest part of Zombie Alliance's graveyard within Earth Trench.

Palm-sized and shining with purple-gold light, it looked like a rock.

Moments later, the Gu formation settled and the light dissipated. The purple-gold rock, which had turned glowing red, cooled rapidly back to its original state.

Lady Wan Shou frowned slightly, she shook her head.

"Even you cannot identify this purple-gold rock?" Old Ancestor Xue Hu asked in surprise.

"This immortal material is extraordinary; even pushing my Gu formation to its limits, I failed to temper it."

Lady Wan Shou warned: "Husband, you were too careless. Stealing immortal zombies guarantees Zombie Alliance's revenge."

Old Ancestor Xue Hu nodded, saying heavily, "I was overconfident. My plan went smoothly and I had almost looted the entire graveyard when a Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance immortal zombie suddenly appeared. As superb material for refining fortune rivalling heaven Gu, I grew excited and tried to capture him. Unbeknownst to me, he had arranged a Gu formation in the graveyard; my carelessness leaked the battle commotion, alerting Northern Plains Zombie Alliance."

Old Ancestor Xue Hu sighed deeply: "Looking back, it was likely the interference of fortune rivalling heaven Immortal Gu."

Lady Wan Shou replied heavily: "Fortune rivalling heaven Immortal Gu is rank eight, the core Immortal Gu of Giant Sun Immortal Venerable; being influenced is only natural. My recent refinement failures are likely also its doing. But husband, obtaining so many immortal zombie bodies has drastically accelerated our material collection. As long as we refine fortune rivalling heaven Immortal Gu, it will all be worth it."

"The harder it is to refine fortune rivalling heaven Gu, the clearer its power becomes, and the more determined I am to refine it! Don't worry, I have placed Dark Flow Giant City under close watch; I'll know instantly if anything happens. We'll repel whoever comes—let us see if Zombie Alliance truly dares commit so much!"

Old Ancestor Xue Hu laughed, exuding the dominance and ambition of a demonic overlord.

# Chapter 929: Plotting Against Old Ancestor Xue Hu

Ever since Old Ancestor Xue Hu ransacked the graveyard, Dragon Commander Ye Cha and the two other leaders had locked down Dark Flow Giant City in full defense.

At nightfall, Blazing Heaven Demoness led the Eastern Sea immortal zombies back into Dark Flow Giant City in secret.

"Subordinates Yin Liu Gong, Dragon Commander Ye Cha, and Huang Quan Weng welcome the leader and both lords; greetings to all." The three Northern Plains leaders bowed, unable to hide their anxiety and agitation.

"Rise. Facing Old Ancestor Xue Hu was beyond your fault," Blazing Heaven Demoness stated.

Yin Liu Gong and the others sighed in relief, their worries eased.

"Old Ancestor Xue Hu is too arrogant; he must pay. Zombie Alliance is not to be trifled with," another rank eight immortal zombie declared.

Unflustered, Blazing Heaven Demoness said leisurely: "This matter is grave; let us examine the scene first to gather evidence."

"Indeed. Traces there may reveal some of Old Ancestor Xue Hu's methods," another rank eight immortal zombie, Pu Wan Dao, agreed.

Without pause, the immortal zombies secretly traveled to Earth Trench to inspect the battlefield.

The graveyard lay in shambles, coated in thick frost while residual flames still burned in crevices.

"How can I obtain this treasure secretly? This inheritance will surely help me immensely; perhaps I must rely on it to shed my immortal zombie body and revive."

Unfortunately unable to leave the group, he could only follow them out of Earth Trench and back to Dark Flow Giant City.

"Who is this person? A rank seven immortal zombie with outstanding battle strength, who had even preset a Gu formation in the graveyard—why are his details missing from my roster?" Blazing Heaven Demoness frowned deeply, questioning Yin Liu Gong and the others.

Yin Liu Gong, Dragon Commander Ye Cha, and Huang Quan Weng smiled bitterly, admitting fault: "We failed our duties; we had no knowledge of someone hiding in Earth Trench."

Blazing Heaven Demoness snorted coldly: "Investigate thoroughly; this is not simple! Old Ancestor Xue Hu's intrusion is explainable since he lacks immortal materials for fortune rivalling heaven Gu. But why was a mysterious immortal zombie stationed in our graveyard? From the looks of it, he had been there for quite some time!"

"No need to investigate," the rank eight Corpse Detonation King interjected. "He is a member of Zombie Alliance, and we are here to rescue him."

Beside him, Pu Wan Dao added: "Lady Blazing Heaven Demoness, forgive us. This person is extraordinary—a Ten Extreme immortal zombie with outstanding battle strength. Concealed for safety while on a secret mission, headquarters has issued a top-priority order for us to rescue this Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance immortal zombie."

Dragon Commander Ye Cha cupped his fists to the Eastern Sea group: "What secret mission required this Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance immortal zombie to enter our alliance's vital graveyard?"

Corpse Detonation King replied coldly: "You are not qualified to know."

"Enough." Blazing Heaven Demoness stood to defuse the tension. "Our enemy is Old Ancestor Xue Hu. Since that immortal zombie is one of our own, we will rescue him."

Fang Yuan watched coldly from the side.

Shrewd as ever, she concealed any displeasure, stating: "Next, let us discuss how to punish Old Ancestor Xue Hu and rescue the Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance immortal zombie."

Corpse Detonation King immediately said: "His body has abundant fire and lightning path dao marks, making him ideal for refining Gu. We cannot waste time; we should attack directly."

"Charging in head-on is a brute's folly," Blazing Heaven Demoness retorted without sparing his feelings.

As Corpse Detonation King glared, about to argue, Pu Wan Dao backed Blazing Heaven Demoness: "She is right. The enemy holds the Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance immortal zombie as a hostage. A direct assault will only let Xue Hu threaten us with the hostage, restricting our moves and forfeiting all our advantage."

Blazing Heaven Demoness snorted: "Countless scouts lurk outside Dark Flow Giant City, surely sent by Snowy Mountain blessed land. Given Xue Hu's vigilance, Snowy Mountain is bound to be heavily guarded. Sneaking in is unrealistic—it's walking right into a trap. Of course, Corpse Detonation King, you are mighty; feel free to go alone. I'm sure you will succeed."

"What do you propose then?" Pu Wan Dao asked with a sharp gaze, placing a hand on Corpse Detonation King's shoulder.

Blazing Heaven Demoness smiled proudly: "Strong as Xue Hu is and tightly guarded as Snowy Mountain may be, his greatest weakness remains exposed."

Someone asked: "Oh? What weakness?"

Blazing Heaven Demoness surveyed the room: "Fortune rivalling heaven Immortal Gu."

Uninterested in plotting against Old Ancestor Xue Hu, Fang Yuan focused entirely on reaching the treasure deep inside Earth Trench while the others debated.

As tasks were assigned, Blazing Heaven Demoness exempted Fang Yuan from the expedition, tasking him solely with continuing to refine star thought Immortal Gu.

She even gave Fang Yuan a token granting him her full authority.

With it, Fang Yuan could freely enter and leave Dark Flow Giant City and Northern Plains Zombie Alliance's resource points, even drawing precious immortal materials from the treasury.

"Once I possess star thought Immortal Gu, paired with my wisdom path attainment, I can deduce many secrets. Perhaps Blazing Heaven Demoness hopes to leverage this ability against Old Ancestor Xue Hu?"

# Chapter 930: Creating a Chance to Enter Earth Trench

Boom!

Despite the loud noise, the explosion's power was surprisingly minor.

Endless starlight drifted through the secret room like fluttering butterflies.

Gazing upon the beautiful scene, Fang Yuan wore an unsightly expression.

"Failed again. Refinement didn't even reach one-third this time..." Fang Yuan exhaled and waved his sleeve, instantly clearing the starlight and restoring peace to the secret room.

"Using the immortal killer move time assist luck before each attempt helps little, and Connect Luck lacks suitable targets. Regardless, I've shown enough effort publicly; it's time to delve into Earth Trench for the inheritance."

Rushing into Earth Trench without attempting to refine star thought Immortal Gu would have blatantly exposed his intentions.

Though Fang Yuan had entered Northern Plains Zombie Alliance, he lacked freedom, strictly guarded by two immortal zombies.

During these days in Dark Flow Giant City, Fang Yuan feigned refining star thought Immortal Gu to reassure Blazing Heaven Demoness, while secretly gathering intel and preparing for his move.

With an ashen expression, Fang Yuan opened the secret room door.

Two rank six immortal zombies stood guard at the entrance.

Seeing Fang Yuan, an immortal zombie called Doctor Yin Xuan immediately bowed: "Sir, you have come out. I wonder if this refinement...."

Fang Yuan grunted, waving his hand in irritation: "Don't bother me!"

Saying this, he walked away.

"Hmph, who does he think he is, acting so arrogant in our base!" The other immortal zombie, Landlord Lei Yu, glared with malice at Fang Yuan's receding back.

Doctor Yin Xuan disregarded the snub, following closely behind Fang Yuan with a bright smile.

This was Dark Flow Giant City's largest immortal material warehouse, guarded personally by an immortal zombie.

Seeing Fang Yuan with Doctor Yin Xuan and Landlord Lei Yu, the manager nodded familiarly, knowing he needed materials, and handed him an information path Gu worm.

Holding the Gu worm, Fang Yuan feigned inspecting the material list while plotting inwardly.

'Blazing Heaven Demoness, Corpse Detonation King and Pu Wan Dao have already left Dark Flow Giant City two days ago to target the demonic path Gu Immortals of Snowy Mountain blessed land, and have not returned until now. This is an opportunity, I need to take advantage of it...'

Just then, the managing immortal zombie said enthusiastically: "Sir Xing Xiang Zi, you may take whatever immortal materials you need. Leader informed us; you only need to register them without worry."

Yet immediately, Fang Yuan glared fiercely at him: "What worries would I have? Why would I have worries? I am fine!"

Fang Yuan appeared disheveled and deeply agitated, his hair and robes in disarray.

From this sight, the manager immediately knew Fang Yuan had failed the refinement.

He crushed the information path Gu worm and walked away with lowered head, hands behind his back.

He grumbled: "Damn it, why won't it work? Why do I keep failing! Four failures already, why is it like this, why..."

Growing increasingly restless, Fang Yuan clenched his fists and swore vulgarities, occasionally mumbling incomprehensible words.

Watching indifferently, the three immortal zombies saw Fang Yuan's agitation, and their disdain and hatred softened into a trace of pity.

Fang Yuan suddenly halted and turned to Doctor Yin Xuan and Landlord Lei Yu.

"I've decided—you two pack up and follow me into Earth Trench!"

His words shocked the three immortal zombies.

"Entering Earth Trench?" Doctor Yin Xuan's expression changed.

Landlord Lei Yu refused firmly as well: "We will gather whatever materials you require, sir, no need to risk yourself."

"Leader commanded us to ensure your safety, sir. If anything happens to you in Earth Trench, how do we explain it? Please do not make things difficult for us," Doctor Yin Xuan pleaded bitterly.

Ignoring his sincerity, Fang Yuan raised an arm and roared: "What do your difficulties matter to me? I only care about refining Gu, and I need earth shell snail star night mucus!"

"Earth shell snail star night mucus? Sir, please wait, I'll check," Doctor Yin Xuan said quickly.

Soon, Doctor Yin Xuan withdrew his consciousness with a look of joy: "Earth shell snail mucus is the fluid left by the desolate beast as it crawls. We have it in stock! Warehouse six currently has two or three portions—is that enough? If not, we can immediately issue a task for immortal zombies to gather more."

Fang Yuan bellowed, pointing at Doctor Yin Xuan's nose: "Are you deaf or brainless? Didn't you hear me?! Earth shell snail star night mucus. Star. Night. Mucus! Not ordinary mucus, understand?!"

He added urgently: "Earth shell snail mucus dries up and loses efficacy unless sealed within ten breaths. Star night mucus requires my special method to process the fresh mucus on the spot! Processing takes seven breaths, and once finished, the complicated sealing must be completed within three breaths. I must enter Earth Trench—can any of you do it without me? If you can do it, I will eat my hat!"

"Uh..." Doctor Yin Xuan and the others were momentarily left speechless by Fang Yuan's scolding.

# Chapter 931: Finally Entering Earth Trench

"I must enter Earth Trench. Since Lady Blazing Heaven Demoness assigned you two to protect me, I will rely on you. Even if you die, I must survive, understand?" Fang Yuan commanded matter-of-factly.

Though furious, Landlord Lei Yu and Doctor Yin Xuan could do nothing to him.

After conferring, Doctor Yin Xuan told Fang Yuan grimly: "This is too important; we cannot decide on our own and must report to Lady Blazing Heaven Demoness first!"

Thus, he waved his sleeves, urging them: "Then go!"

The truth was, star night mucus was a real thing.

Doctor Yin Xuan remained with Fang Yuan, while the disgruntled Landlord Lei Yu anxiously went to an information path Gu formation in Dark Flow Giant City to relay the message to Blazing Heaven Demoness.

Fang Yuan was not worried Blazing Heaven Demoness would refuse.

After all, refining star thought Immortal Gu benefited her as well. With Fang Yuan heavily indebted to her, she might even send more immortal zombies to protect him.

"If Blazing Heaven Demoness does that, it works in my favor. The more guards, the safer the descent into Earth Trench. Once I reach the inheritance, I can ditch them—whether they are few or many."

Just as Fang Yuan anticipated, Blazing Heaven Demoness agreed and assigned five immortal zombies to accompany him.

Among them, two were rank seven, and three were rank six. This was slightly beyond Fang Yuan's expectations, he could see Blazing Heaven Demoness' sincerity from this.

Three days later, the five immortal zombies gathered.

After making ample preparations, the group set off.

At nightfall, Fang Yuan and the group entered Earth Trench.

Having planned thoroughly, Fang Yuan had no need to sneak in; flanked by five immortal zombies, he entered openly and boldly.

The massive trench resembled a bloodthirsty beast slowly parting its maw in the darkness.

As Fang Yuan and the others descended, the trench's expanse widened dozens, then hundreds of times.

Fang Yuan looked around silently, covertly watching the immortal zombies through his peripheral vision.

The rank seven immortal zombies were Dragon Commander Ye Cha and Granny Yuan.

The three rank sixes included Doctor Yin Xuan, Landlord Lei Yu, and an enslavement path immortal zombie named Lin Da Niao.

As a vice-leader, Dragon Commander Ye Cha was renowned for rearing vast numbers of yaksha octopuses in his immortal aperture.

Though immortal zombies had dead apertures, Ye Cha successfully raised numerous yaksha octopuses—a feat that intrigued and baffled many fellow zombies.

Birds flew continuously from Lin Da Niao's immortal aperture to scout the surroundings.

Showing the convenience of enslavement path, Lin Da Niao had handled scouting since they entered Earth Trench.

"The inheritance is that way, but heading straight there would arouse suspicion." Fang Yuan showed great patience, doing nothing out of the ordinary.

After traveling further, Lin Da Niao reported: "There is an injured yaksha octopus ahead to the left."

Dragon Commander Ye Cha remained impassive: "Ignore it, we'll detour around it."

# Chapter 932: Yaksha Octopuses, Mouth Earthworm

Silently, Fang Yuan and the immortal zombies descended over one hundred and thirty kilometers into Earth Trench.

"We can't go deeper," Dragon Commander Ye Cha said. "We've reached the earth shell snails' habitat range; let's search the area."

Perhaps because Fang Yuan had used time assist luck before the trip to raise his fortune, they soon encountered an earth shell snail.

Investigating thoroughly, the immortals found a sizable group of yaksha octopuses guarding the area.

"Processing the mucus requires starlight, which will certainly alert these yaksha octopuses," Fang Yuan said with a troubled look toward Dragon Commander Ye Cha.

"Why didn't you say that earlier?" Landlord Lei Yu asked unhappily.

Fang Yuan shook his head: "Concealing the commotion is beyond my ability. We must eliminate these yaksha octopuses first."

The immortal zombies exchanged glances before Dragon Commander Ye Cha relented: "Then we'll clear this group of yaksha octopuses before Xing Xiang Zi begins."

Caught off guard by the scheming immortal zombies, the unfortunate yaksha octopuses suffered heavy blows and fell into chaos.

The immortal zombies swiftly pressed their advantage.

Soon, the battle ended with nearly all octopuses slaughtered, leaving only two.

Next, Fang Yuan started collecting star night mucus.

Continuing onward, they encountered three more earth shell snails.

Fang Yuan successfully extracted abundant star night mucus from two of them, while the last crawled toward the territory of an ancient desolate red flame snake.

Under Fang Yuan's deliberate guidance, the group neared his true destination.

"A large group of yaksha octopuses ahead! Halt—there are around thirty!" Lin Da Niao reported anxiously.

"Then we bypass them in another direction," Dragon Commander Ye Cha ordered immediately.

Though unwilling, Fang Yuan could not object publicly, simply memorizing the location for now.

The immortal zombies took a detour towards the south-east direction.

Soon, they found a fourth earth shell snail.

Though appearing safe, the area was packed with earth path dao marks that pulled nearby entities toward the wall.

He flew forward, screaming as he feigned being pulled in.

"Oh no, it is the gravity soil zone!"

With a thud, Fang Yuan slammed into the wall, his legs deeply embedded as he put on a terrified look.

"Don't fly!" Dragon Commander Ye Cha roared.

With a loud bang, a huge mouth earthworm emerged from the soil.

Fang Yuan screamed: "Someone save me!"

Once he said that, the mouth earthworm swallowed him.

They attacked fiercely, forcing the mouth earthworm back into the gravity soil zone immediately.

Inside the worm, Fang Yuan used a star path killer move to halt its constricting body.

Next, he activated Fixed Immortal Travel.

Having memorized the nearby spot earlier, Fixed Immortal Travel teleported him away within three breaths, escaping danger.

Believing Fang Yuan remained trapped inside the mouth earthworm, Dragon Commander Ye Cha and the others attacked it furiously.

Though free of the zombies, the commotion from Fixed Immortal Travel drew the large pack of yaksha octopuses.

Fang Yuan smiled, turning into a yaksha octopus and attacking furiously.

Moments later, he lured the enraged yaksha octopuses toward Ye Cha's group.

Unable to see through Fang Yuan's transformation, Dragon Commander Ye Cha and the others assumed the yaksha octopuses were infighting and driving out the weakest.

Lamenting their foul luck, they could not retreat while Xing Xiang Zi was still inside the mouth earthworm.

Thus, the yaksha octopuses, Northern Plains immortal zombies, and mouth earthworm clashed in a chaotic melee.

# Chapter 933: Wild Immortal Gu, Traces of Gu Formation

In the chaotic battle, Fang Yuan managed to escape.

Returning to the yaksha octopuses' lair, he found about half of them remained.

Repeating the tactic, he lured the remaining yaksha octopuses away.

"Damn it! Another ancient yaksha octopus and ten desolate beast octopuses—they've mobilized together!" Entangled in chaotic combat, Dragon Commander Ye Cha cried out bitterly at the octopus reinforcements.

"Hold on!" Dragon Commander Ye Cha shouted, expending his immortal essence lavishly.

Meanwhile, the culprit Fang Yuan covertly infiltrated the yaksha octopuses' territory.

Fang Yuan sneaked inside, drilling into a bigger entrance.

Fang Yuan entered the hole and a thick smell of oil assailed him.

The tunnel walls were coated in thick, sticky black oil.

Deep in the yaksha octopus cave, the black oil was seven to eight inches thick, with fierce beasts inhabiting the crevices.

These wild beasts mostly consisted of black stomach hounds.

Learning the relationship between black stomach hounds and yaksha octopuses, Fang Yuan disguised himself as one and ventured in.

"If there is no other way, I must give up. Time is limited; once the battle ends and the mouth earthworm is dissected, I won't be able to explain my absence to Dragon Commander Ye Cha and the others."

Pressed for time, Fang Yuan increased his speed.

Eventually, he came to the deepest part of the cave.

Here, there was a yaksha octopus king resting.

He sensed a wild Immortal Gu's aura from this yaksha octopus king.

After hesitating, Fang Yuan decided to take a gamble.

Disguised as a black stomach hound, he carefully approached the yaksha octopus king.

The yaksha octopus king's coiled tentacles loosened as it opened its eyes, its topaz-like pupils gazing at the transformed Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan's mind was energized: "It is here! Exposed dao marks... traces of a Gu formation..."

Activating countless Gu in his immortal aperture, he rapidly expended immortal essence to unravel the Gu formation.

Soon, Fang Yuan realized this giant space path Gu formation only showed a flaw due to long-term neglect.

"The treasure I seek is likely inside this giant Gu formation. But unraveling it requires activating Gu, creating massive disturbance. I must take a risk..."

Making up his mind, Fang Yuan grabbed a bone and left the yaksha octopus king.

Returning swiftly, he reached a certain spot and used his Immortal Gu to attack a nearby desolate beast yaksha octopus.

An intense battle erupted as the defending yaksha octopuses charged over.

Fang Yuan fought while retreating, activating Fixed Immortal Travel upon reaching the exit.

Within three breaths, he teleported to the cave's deepest depths.

With the yaksha octopus king still at the cave exit, Fang Yuan raced against time to unravel the space path Gu formation.

Worse, once he began unraveling it, Fang Yuan felt the immense complexity and profoundness of this giant Gu formation.

To completely deduce it would require months of effort!

# Chapter 934: Sea of Immortal Material Remains

"This is it." Fang Yuan's eyes brightened as a hazy glow radiated from the air before him.

With the yaksha octopus king returning, Fang Yuan retreated to the nest's upper half. "This place should do." After a while, Fang Yuan chose an inconspicuous corner among several underground burrows.

Hesitating briefly, he still decided to activate Fixed Immortal Travel.

The Immortal Gu was activated, green light blossomed.

The next moment, Fang Yuan vanished, reappearing inside the giant Gu formation.

The yaksha octopus king was just outside, but the Gu formation's isolating effect kept it completely oblivious.

"I am finally in." Highly vigilant, Fang Yuan surveyed his surroundings; this was indeed the place he had inspected earlier.

This giant formation primarily utilized space path methods, creating a unique space.

This vast space had a yellow sky and ground paved with purple sand.

The purple sand appeared remarkably fertile, supporting dense vegetation across Fang Yuan's sight like a tropical rainforest.

"Scribe grass, nutrient peaches, immortal beans, blood tide flowers..." A brief glance revealed dozens of immortal materials to Fang Yuan.

"These immortal materials come from all five regions, not just the Earth Trench and Northern Plains. What background did the immortal zombie expert who created this place have?"

He had thought this was an immortal zombie expert's inheritance, but such immense handiwork could hardly be achieved alone; it required an organization.

"But compared to these countless immortal materials, this enormous Gu formation has even higher value!" Fang Yuan's eyes twinkled.

Fang Yuan bent down, grabbing a handful of purple sand.

"Where is the revival method I came for?" Fang Yuan tossed aside the purple sand, recalling his main objective.

Not rushing to collect the immortal materials, he flew gently around to search the area.

As time passed, Fang Yuan's joyful look faded as a growing unease intensified.

"Something is wrong!" He stopped abruptly, looking down at the endless immortal materials.

"It is too peaceful. Without a trace of wind or sound, it is quieter than even my dead aperture."

"Many other things feel suspicious. Immortal beans should grow in spring water, yet they grow on purple sand here. Nutrient peaches are usually accompanied by snake-tail monkey groups. Every immortal material requires a harsh environment, yet only these plants exist here—not even an insect is in sight."

Landing on the ground, he tried picking a strand of scribe grass.

The scribe grass remained intact on the sand, but the moment Fang Yuan plucked it, it withered into fine purple sand.

And it was identical to the purple sand beneath his feet!

"Strange! Strange!! Immortal materials are defined by their abundant dao marks. When these materials wither into purple sand, their dao marks should be destroyed, yet there isn't even the slightest disturbance..."

If even immortal materials suffered this fate, would an immortal zombie body bearing dao marks also be treated as immortal material and absorbed by this vast purple sand field?

"Something is definitely strange about this Gu formation; merely staying off the purple sand likely isn't enough. The alteration of these immortal materials must be tied to the entire formation. Before finding out what's happening, I should quickly find the revival method for immortal zombies and leave immediately!"

# Chapter 935: Surprising Gains

Suddenly, Fang Yuan's gaze focused.

On the flat ground below, he saw a desolate beast.

Sprawled motionless on the ground like a small hill, this desolate beast was a hidden essence turtle.

Drawing close, he realized the hidden essence turtle had died long ago.

"A desolate beast corpse among countless 'dead' immortal materials, huh..."

Fang Yuan tried to collect the hidden essence turtle's body.

Moments later, his heart sank as a shell fragment turned into purple sand in his grasp, scattering in the wind.

Next, Fang Yuan found more desolate and ancient desolate beast corpses lying among red, purple, and green plant immortal materials.

Northern Plains' coiling mountain goat king, Southern Border's phoenix feather lava crocodile, Central Continent's diamond bear, Eastern Sea's grand smoke sea turtle—desolate and ancient desolate beasts from all five regions littered the area.

"This space is so vast; despite flying for so long at my speed, I haven't seen the formation's edge."

This was out of Fang Yuan's expectations.

"Who created this? It's unheard of! Such countless immortal materials—could this be the work of an Immortal Venerable or Demon Venerable?"

Fang Yuan saw a shade of purple in front of him.

This was a desolate land.

Surrounded by soft purple sand, the sea of immortal materials had vanished.

This circular expanse of barren sand spanned at least two square kilometers!

Fang Yuan was inwardly shocked: "This is the formation's center—a terrifying explosion must have occurred here!"

Nearing the edge of the desolate land, a bright light in the sand caught Fang Yuan's attention.

Landing, Fang Yuan saw thin wings protruding from the sand.

These cicada-like wings emitted an aura that made him gulp.

An immemorial desolate beast aura!

"This is the light of metal path dao marks; these cicada wings must have belonged to a creature with a terrifying dao mark foundation! Only a quasi-rank nine foundation produces dao marks visible to the naked eye. That is dao mark radiance!"

"Wait, maybe this is... the wings of the tiger-striped honey bee!"

"Each honey bee was the size of a leopard, golden with black tiger-like stripes. They were exceedingly powerful; even Verdant Great Sun could not defeat one. The honey wine they brew is delightfully sweet and among the finest in the world."

He tried to take out these bee wings.

Removed from the purple sand, the bee wings remained undamaged, unlike the other disintegrating immortal materials.

This came from an immemorial desolate beast—a rank eight Gu refinement immortal material!

# Chapter 936: Multi-layered Gu Formation

This immortal material was of exceptional quality; even in his past life, he had never owned one.

"Of course, this tiger-striped honey bee wing mainly contains metal path dao marks. It would be invaluable for refining a metal path Immortal Gu, but useless for star thought Immortal Gu."

Fang Yuan collected this precious immortal material properly.

Rather than rushing to the center, he began exploring this purple sand wasteland.

He continued exploring and soon circled the purple desert, reaping huge gains.

In total, he collected eighteen such materials covering most Gu paths. Three contained abundant star path or wisdom path dao marks, highly helpful in refining star thought Immortal Gu.

"Precious as they are, these materials are merely fragments of beast corpses. The Gu Immortal behind this used so many treasures—were they trying to refine a rank nine Immortal Gu?"

"Whoever or whatever organization it was, they likely perished in the blast. Otherwise, this Gu formation wouldn't have gone unmaintained for so long, nor would these immortal material fragments remain scattered and unclaimed."

Since this mysterious entity was gone, this trip was far less dangerous now.

Setting aside these thoughts, Fang Yuan reached the center of the purple sand wasteland.

Despite obtaining many immortal materials, Fang Yuan felt disappointed—past-life rumors claimed a method existed here to shed the immortal zombie body and revive, yet he had found no sign of it.

Using investigative methods, Fang Yuan discovered remnants of the Gu formation buried deep beneath the purple sand.

"This is indeed the central control area!"

"Incredible—a multi-layered Gu formation with such masterful design must be the work of a formation path great grandmaster!"

The entire space was centered around the refinement path Gu formation; the space path formation that created it was merely an outer supplementary layer.

Besides the space path formation, Fang Yuan found numerous defensive, food path, and phantom path Gu formations.

"Two or three food path Gu formations are still active. It's astonishing that any formation here survived the massive explosion."

"Perhaps that's why the outermost space path Gu formation still functions."

"Refinement path Gu Immortals of this caliber create their own refinement formations supplemented by many auxiliary formations. For example, Snowy Mountain blessed land possesses the finest refinement path Gu formation in Northern Plains' demonic path, said to be a multi-layered formation utilizing twelve distinct Gu formations."

# Chapter 937: Life-and-death Immortal Aperture!

"Based on these remains, this Gu formation had at least thirty layers! Sun Ming Lu became Northern Plains' recognized number one formation path Gu Immortal from just a twelve-layered formation. The Gu Immortal behind this must be a great grandmaster—or perhaps even a supreme grandmaster!"

"Food path, phantom path, metal path, strength path..." Fang Yuan's eyes shone as his gaze pierced the purple sand, inspecting traces of all the Gu formations.

At the deepest level, Fang Yuan found an extremely tattered wisdom path Gu formation.

Some thoughts remained within this tattered Gu formation.

Taking a deep breath, Fang Yuan mustered his strength to deduce this wisdom path Gu formation.

Moments later, he deciphered this relatively simple wisdom path Gu formation, invading and controlling it.

He then sent thoughts into the Gu formation to interact with the resting thoughts.

"After over eighty years, this Gu formation is finally complete! For the next few hundred or thousand years, I shall refine Gu here. Heh, becoming an immortal zombie freed me from lifespan limits, but dulled my thoughts. So I asked 'Yellow' to add this small Gu formation to store thoughts and aid my thinking."

"This Gu formation is invaluable, aiding my Gu refinement while concealing us from heaven's will. In just two hundred years, I successfully refined eight soul path Immortal Gu—six rank seven and two rank eight."

"An unexpected surprise occurred during refinement today! In trying to complete the recipe for devour soul Immortal Gu, I refined an Immortal Gu with unknown effects. Though it is of the soul path, I'll let others test its effects."

"My Gu refinement failed! Three defensive formations and my main refinement formation were damaged. That deceitful merchant in treasure yellow heaven dared to sell me tampered immortal materials! I will tear out his tendons and skin him alive to vent my hatred!"

"That unscrupulous merchant was punished—'Azure' is truly amazing. 'Yellow' arrived and repaired all the Gu formations, so I can refine Gu again."

"'Purple' warned me to be careful; 'Azure' is in trouble. That unscrupulous merchant Gu Immortal who deceived me was Heavenly Court's pawn. Fate still exists—Red Lotus Demon Venerable failed to destroy it thoroughly. It is accursed heaven's assistant, but it will be destroyed one day!"

"'Azure's' problem is worsening. Sacrificing any of us seven is a huge loss. Sigh, I harmed him, but his mind is made up. Maybe I can try that now.., before leaving, he took that soul path Immortal Gu. So its effect is like this... I hope it helps him."

"'Azure' failed. Pitifully, he is one step from complete annihilation. 'Yellow' barely preserved his life, but his injuries require hundreds or thousands of years to heal. Our greatest battle strength is lost!"

"'Azure's' failure proved our previous methods won't work. We are born flawed, intolerable to heaven and earth. As 'Green', I must comprehend the profound meaning of life and death; no one is more suited than me. We can only restart if I find a way to truly revive and obtain an immortal aperture full of vitality."

"It seems this is a strong, mysterious organization. Members use codenames like Yellow, Green, Purple, Azure... If there are seven members, they probably use rainbow colors—red, orange, yellow, green, azure, blue, purple? I'll call them 'Seven Rainbows' for now."

"'Blue' obtained Central Continent's Old Immortal Kong Jue's Gu Immortal inheritance. He researched deeply into the ten extreme physiques; I have gained immensely from this!"

"'Yellow' and 'Purple' cooperated to obtain Limitless Demon Venerable's inheritance. Hahaha, truly worthy of him! His rule path achievements are unprecedented and perhaps unsurpassable; even I am vastly inferior!"

"Limitless Demon Venerable is correct: there is life in death, and death in life—they can be interchanged! Normally, shifting from life to death is a natural, smooth process. Yet turning from death to life is extremely difficult, like moving upstream. Meanwhile, immortal zombies are stuck between life and death, manifesting their profound mysteries."

"Limitless Demon Venerable was immensely talented, only steps away from success. An immortal zombie's dead aperture is extremely precious and useful. Hehehe, exposing this result would shake the entire Gu Immortal world! Even I was deeply shocked..."

According to these thoughts, a Gu Immortal should first become an immortal zombie with a dead aperture, then revive to obtain a life-and-death immortal aperture.

This immortal aperture had two layers, one of life and one of death, where life and death coexisted interchangeably. It would immensely help a Gu Immortal in cultivating and undergoing tribulations!

The immortal aperture Fang Yuan gained upon ascending had already disintegrated by more than half.

"According to this method, I can use the dead aperture as the core to fuse life and death during revival, condensing them into a life-and-death immortal aperture to control life and death to a certain degree!"

"With this life-and-death immortal aperture, the power of my future heavenly tribulations and earthly calamities will be halved, yet the dao marks gained won't be reduced at all!"

# Chapter 938: Successfully Returning to the City

In a nook of the yaksha octopuses' cave, bright green light shone, repelling the darkness.

Fang Yuan quickly erased these traces with his methods.

Soon, he heard desolate beast growls and the rustle of yaksha octopuses in the cave.

He soon returned to the mouth earthworm's battlefield, which lay in shambles.

Most yaksha octopuses had retreated, and the Northern Plains immortal zombies were nowhere to be found.

A huge gorge, like a long scar along the Earth Trench, stretched before Fang Yuan.

"The mouth earthworm swallowed me, but I escaped using Fixed Immortal Travel inside it. Failing its hunt, it would furiously battle the Northern Plains immortal zombies. Once injured enough, it would burrow into the soil and flee the battle."

Following the gorge where the mouth earthworm had fled, Fang Yuan pursued the immortal zombies. The Northern Plains immortal zombies were flying dejectedly.

Heavily injured, they were in pathetic states with ashen expressions.

"What can we do? Xing Xiang Zi died, how can we explain this to Lady Blazing Heaven Demoness?"

"Sigh, we did our best. Pursuing the mouth earthworm, we crossed five fierce beasts' territories, three being ancient desolate beasts! In the Earth Trench, no less! I've never acted so crazily."

"Unfortunately, our efforts failed. The mouth earthworm fell into the acid bog and dissolved completely. Xing Xiang Zi couldn't have survived, and we couldn't sacrifice our lives for him."

"Everyone, we meet again." Transformed into Xing Xiang Zi, Fang Yuan appeared before the immortal zombies.

"Eh?" At once, the Northern Plains immortal zombies were stunned.

"Xing Xiang Zi?!" Doctor Yin Xuan called out, his gaze filled with joy.

Prepared, Fang Yuan explained: "Alas! Inside the mouth earthworm's stomach, flesh squeezed me and rotating teeth closed in. In that peril, I used my Immortal Gu for an immortal killer move, sealing myself in star ice. This strongest defense of mine blocked the teeth, but with a drawback: neither my body nor thoughts could move, leaving me unable to think. The star ice lasted only briefly, but trusting you would save me, I waited until it melted. Upon regaining freedom, I found myself buried under rubble!"

"So that's it!" Doctor Yin Xuan realized.

"Xing Xiang Zi must have fallen out when our pursuit and chaotic battle tore the mouth earthworm's flesh open."

Dragon Commander Ye Cha sighed in relief: "Good. Do you still need to collect star night mucus?"

Fang Yuan's expression shifted to hesitation: "Forget it! I was unlucky. Let's return and rest first, then discuss it later."

A few days later.

Dark Flow Giant City.

Inside the secret room, the refinement path Gu formation shone dazzlingly.

The light illuminated Fang Yuan's face, but his mind was elsewhere.

"Possible, this is totally possible!" Fang Yuan said internally.

While ostensibly processing refinement materials with the formation, he was secretly inside his dead aperture, directing Gu worms in an experiment.

Vigilant as always, Fang Yuan tested the Earth Trench revival method through experiments to verify if its dubious origins were sound.

The results all proved that this revival method was usable!

Yet determination paid off; after immense turmoil, Fang Yuan had finally found the most suitable revival method in Northern Plains Zombie Alliance's Earth Trench!
