# Chapter 939: Dual Ten Extreme Physique Rank Nine Demon Venerable?

Since its creator left it unnamed, Fang Yuan tentatively dubbed it the life-and-death immortal aperture revival method.

The contents of the life-and-death immortal aperture revival method were intricate and complex.

Subdividing every cultivation path into distinct methods, it required refining specific Gu worms accordingly.

For Fang Yuan's strength path, creating the multi-layered Gu formation required vast quantities of exert strength Gu, countless disappointment Gu, and various supplementary Gu worms.

Fang Yuan planned inwardly: "Disappointment Gu and exert strength Gu are merely mortal Gu, easy to gather. With the recipes here, I can order the hairy men to refine them non-stop. Even with such large quantities, I can finish within three months. Then I can immediately revive and gain a life-and-death immortal aperture! Except..."

Except that the life-and-death immortal aperture obtained this way would be somewhat unsatisfactory.

Since Fang Yuan's strength path immortal aperture was largely disintegrated, using the remaining dead aperture as a base would yield an inferior life-and-death immortal aperture—lacking in size, environment, and foundation.

His original strength path aperture was merely a medium grade blessed land. Reviving with his shrunken blessed land now would yield a low grade blessed land, likely at the very bottom tier.

However, another section of the life-and-death revival method excited Fang Yuan greatly.

During refinement, he could use other strength path immortal zombie corpses as immortal materials in the Gu formation. This would elevate the created life-and-death aperture's grade, restoring a low grade blessed land to medium grade, or even raising it to high grade with enough strength path immortal zombies!

When immortal zombies die, their apertures dissipate while their dao marks settle into their bodies, making the corpses rich with dao marks and special immortal materials.

The final part of this segment clearly recorded:

If one used a Great Strength True Martial Physique immortal zombie body during revival, the resulting life-and-death immortal aperture would surpass high grade to become a super grade blessed land!

Upon revival, the immortal zombie would possess the Great Strength True Martial Physique!!

Since Hei Lou Lan had ascended with the Great Strength True Martial Physique, owning a super grade blessed land, Fang Yuan understood much about it.

"A super grade blessed land spans over six thousand seven hundred square kilometers and produces over fifty immortal essence beads yearly! With its faster time flow, precious resources mature in extremely short intervals! Furthermore, the Great Strength True Martial Physique can multiply my battle strength!" Fang Yuan's heart thumped with excitement.

Evidently, the life-and-death immortal aperture method was also an exceptional way to raise a Gu Immortal's aptitude!

"Gathering ordinary strength path immortal zombie bodies can yield a high grade blessed land at most. But if I can gather the body of an immortal zombie of one of the ten extreme physiques, I can possess the Great Strength True Martial Physique and own a super grade blessed land, moreover the calamities and tribulations would have their might reduced by half. With enough time to cultivate, my strength will keep growing, giving me a chance to vie for the supreme throne of rank nine!"

Fang Yuan's eyes burned with the flames of passion.

"I still have my first mortal aperture. If revival succeeds, I can use this method again to cultivate time path and turn it into a super grade blessed land. Then, I'll possess both the Great Strength True Martial Physique and the Desolate Ancient Moon Physique!"

Dual Ten Extreme Physique!

Thinking of this, Fang Yuan almost shed tears.

Across five hundred years of his previous life and this one, he had drifted, braved hardships, and risked death. Finally, he had found a hopeful path toward his grand ambition of immortality!

"Strength path immortal zombies are rare, and having joined Zombie Alliance, I cannot target alliance members. Where can I find a Great Strength True Martial immortal zombie? Hmph. Currently, there is only one optimal target—Hei Lou Lan!!"

At that instant, Fang Yuan's eyes shone with ferocious light.

"Although I cooperated with you to escape Imperial Court blessed land and gained many benefits afterward, for my grand ambition, you must be sacrificed."

A faint smile appeared on Fang Yuan's face.

# Chapter 940: Fang Yuan's Plans

Though the life-and-death aperture revival method was enticing, obtaining a Great Strength True Martial immortal zombie was extremely difficult.

Thus, Hei Lou Lan was his easiest, most appropriate, and realistic target.

Yet the problems before Fang Yuan were numerous.

First, Hei Lou Lan possessed both brains and brawn; capable of fighting all out and scheming deeply, she was not easily handled.

Second, she was backed by rank seven Fairy Li Shan; bound by close ties, dealing with Hei Lou Lan meant confronting both.

Thirdly, Fairy Li Shan, Hei Lou Lan, and Fang Yuan had an alliance agreement.

Finally, and Fang Yuan's greatest problem, Hei Lou Lan knew the truth of Imperial Court blessed land. If mishandled, she would expose it to the world. Fang Yuan would then be hunted by the world's Gu Immortals, drowned by a tsunami of greed for Giant Sun's inheritance.

On one hand, he needed a viable way to target Hei Lou Lan.

On the other, he refined star thought Immortal Gu while corresponding with Fairy Li Shan on how to breach agreements.

Since realizing her flaws, Hei Lou Lan focused on managing her blessed land; unable to stay in Snowy Mountain blessed land, she hid outside and vanished.

Fang Yuan revisited Earth Trench to gather star night mucus, but his subsequent attempt to refine star thought Immortal Gu failed again.

Possessing Mountain Pledge Immortal Gu, Fairy Li Shan's information path attainment far surpassed Fang Yuan's.

Although Fang Yuan, Fairy Li Shan, and Hei Lou Lan shared an agreement, its approaching deadline meant it posed little trouble.

Fang Yuan's pretext to Fairy Li Shan was needing to resolve his Zombie Alliance agreement.

Guarding against his rapid growth, Fairy Li Shan felt threatened and used searching for immortal materials to reject his offers.

On this day, Fang Yuan operated the refinement path Gu formation to process an immortal material.

Inside his dead aperture, moving perspective cup Gu activated, bringing a letter from Fairy Li Shan.

Fang Yuan found it odd that Fairy Li Shan was reaching out to him.

Opening it, it was a letter requesting for help.

As it turned out, Fairy Li Shan found traces of Hei Cheng.

Hei Cheng was Hei Lou Lan's father, a man she had to kill to avenge her mother.

Fairy Li Shan's letter asked Fang Yuan to come along and kill Hei Cheng!

After vanishing during the hundred days battle, the former Hei tribe power-holder had reappeared in a pathetic state, secretly hunted by his own tribe.

In fact, to save his life, Hei Cheng had sacrificed the rank six Immortal Gu House Dark Prison.

Learning of Hei Cheng's narrow escapes, Fairy Li Shan and Hei Lou Lan agreed this was the best time to enact revenge.

Fairy Li Shan immediately contacted Fang Yuan; before their alliance expired, they had an excellent chance to make use of him.

Though Fairy Li Shan offered profitable compensation, Fang Yuan also had his own motives and saw this as a good opportunity.

Hei Lou Lan had stayed hidden all this time; only during a chaotic battle could Fang Yuan find a chance to act.

# Chapter 941: Third Battle With Hei Cheng

A shadowy figure moved rapidly in the tall grass, like a flying snake.

A moment later, the shadow vanished with a soft sound, and Hei Cheng crashed into the nearby grass.

"I am already at my limits, huh..." Hei Cheng felt grim. Gritting his teeth, he tried to stand, smiling bitterly at his reflection in the water.

Once charming and gentlemanly, he was now pale, blood-soaked, and fleeing for his life.

Suddenly, Hei Cheng's pupils shrank to pinpricks as he curled up like a threatened venomous snake.

"Who is it?!" Hei Cheng shouted at a nearby bush, eyes shining with sharp light.

The next moment, with a loud bang, bursting air currents uprooted the grass, carving out a wide path.

Hei Lou Lan wore a mask as she stepped forward.

Her dark, eerie eyes burned with deep-seated flames of hatred.

"It is you!" Hei Cheng was shocked. Dizziness overcame him as he tried to stand, his body shaking violently as he collapsed helplessly.

"Hei Cheng, to think that you would end up like this!" Hei Lou Lan walked forward, straight as a spear, looking down at him arrogantly across a small stream.

With revenge within reach, she felt a trace of pity alongside her deep hatred.

"Don't look at me with that gaze!!!" Hei Cheng screamed, struggling to get up.

Ripples appeared in the stream as Fairy Li Shan's voice carried on the wind: "Nice wind, nice scenery, this nameless location is a good place for you to die, Hei Cheng."

Turning his head with difficulty, he surveyed the surroundings: "A tiger without power gets bullied by dogs, isn't there someone else? Why are you not coming out?"

Concealed nearby, Fang Yuan remained motionless without leaking any aura, as if deaf to Hei Cheng's words.

"You, a tiger? You are just a dog struggling on the verge of death. Prepare to lose your life!" Hei Lou Lan stepped forward and punched.

In an instant, the air exploded as shockwaves burst forth from her punch.

Fang Yuan felt a stir of desire: "A mere mortal killer move reaches such power under the amplification of the Great Strength True Martial Physique's dao marks."

Hei Cheng gritted his teeth, activating countless Gu worms.

With a swoosh, he turned into a shadowy snake again, fleeing to the left.

Hei Lou Lan's punch missed, she quickly chased him.

"Hei Cheng, stay here." Fairy Li Shan took action, the surrounding grass grew wildly as flowers grew out of nowhere.

Battlefield killer move — Pear Orchard!

Hei Cheng froze, but immediately broke out of the pear orchard and fled west.

Countless strength path phantoms emerged from the grass, blocking Hei Cheng.

Using wisdom path techniques, Fang Yuan had deduced three possible escape routes and quietly stationed his strength path phantoms there to ambush him.

Seeing Hei Cheng about to escape, Fairy Li Shan transmitted anxiously: "Quickly stop him!"

Fang Yuan revealed his form, flying toward Hei Cheng with the true solid bat wings on his back.

Clearing the obstacles, Hei Cheng sneered at Fang Yuan: "You finally came out? It is a pity you cannot catch me!"

Just then, an eagle's cry resounded, nearly tearing his eardrums.

A giant iron crown eagle phantom appeared behind Fang Yuan!

His iron crown eagle strength activated; Fang Yuan's speed surged as he flew like lightning, closing the gap to Hei Cheng.

Shocked, Hei Cheng did not dare slow down and fled frantically.

Fang Yuan's iron crown eagle strength came from an Immortal Gu and only triggered by chance.

"Using time assist luck beforehand was a mistake! Had I known Hei Cheng was in such condition, I would have realized my plan was impossible."

With Fang Yuan's interference, Hei Cheng could no longer escape, allowing Fairy Li Shan and Hei Lou Lan to close in within breaths.

With disheveled hair and a dark expression, Hei Cheng screamed: "You want me dead? Don't think you will leave unscathed!"

Hei Cheng was heavily suppressed under their joint assault.

Under their joint assault, Hei Cheng suffered another severe injury, spitting blood on the verge of defeat.

"Stop!"

Suddenly, an angry shout could be heard in the sky.

A blinding green light filled the entire battlefield.

Space tore open as a green hand grabbed at Hei Cheng imposingly.

Though Fang Yuan and the others reacted quickly, the green hand could affect time, snatching Hei Cheng before anyone could react.

"Green City Rampage!" Hei Cheng could not move, he screamed while being captured.

Hei Lou Lan and the others rapidly retreated.

Green City Rampage meant the four strongest supreme elders of Hei tribe had arrived together.

"We of Hei tribe will deal with our own members; how can we allow you to kill him casually?"

"Hei Lou Lan, the tribe nurtured you, yet you betrayed us for the demonic path. You are guilty of heinous crimes—surrender now!"

At the next moment, a green giant tore through space, standing on the ground.

A mysterious light shot from its forehead toward Hei Lou Lan.

At that moment, Hei Lou Lan was unable to move!

Strength path giant hand!

The strength path giant hand collided with the green hand and disintegrated immediately.

The next moment, a fire bird crashed into the green giant's chest out of nowhere.

With an intense explosion, the green giant was knocked back, nearly falling.

"Blazing Heaven Demoness?!" the four supreme elders of Hei tribe shouted in shock and anger from within the green giant.

Angry bird was Blazing Heaven Demoness' signature killer move, widely known among Northern Plains Gu Immortals.

At this time and place, why was Blazing Heaven Demoness here?

# Chapter 942: Little Aunt, Elder Aunt

Bathed in flames, Blazing Heaven Demoness crossed her arms and stood arrogantly in midair.

Blazing Heaven Demoness shouted: "Hei tribe elders, your ancient battle formation Green City Rampage is so incomplete, yet you have the face to use it? A hundred years ago, to use this battle formation, you had to stay within three meters of each other. Coming here together this time, who is guarding your main blessed land camp?"

An elderly voice sounded from the green giant: "Blazing Heaven Demoness! Since you know this is the ancient battle formation Green City Rampage, you should know its power rivals rank eights. Hei Lou Lan and Hei Cheng are members of Hei tribe; this is our internal family matter that an outsider should not interfere in. Don't forget that Zombie Alliance belongs to the righteous path. As leader of Northern Plains Zombie Alliance, you have heavy responsibilities—be careful."

"Join in the chaos? Hahahahaha..." Blazing Heaven Demoness raised her head and laughed.

Fairy Li Shan spoke up: "Hei tribe elders, you say this is your family matter, but isn't it our family matter as well?"

"What do you mean?" the four Hei tribe elders asked in shock from within the green giant.

At this moment, Fang Yuan sensed that something was terribly amiss.

"Big sister!" Fairy Li Shan called out.

Blazing Heaven Demoness stopped laughing, eyes flashing like lightning as she flew toward the green giant.

A ball of fire ignited spontaneously on the green giant, instantly engulfing it in blazing flames.

Immortal killer move — Fire Prison!

With their rich battle experience, the four elders were only shocked for breaths before understanding.

This was a combo immortal killer move!

"To design a combo killer move, her fire path attainment must be at great grandmaster!" Fang Yuan's heart shook.

The green giant roared loudly, spewing dense green fog from its body.

Blazing Heaven Demoness' combo killer move disintegrated within ten breaths.

During this time, Fairy Li Shan had finished preparing her trump card.

Battlefield immortal killer move — Orchard Garden in Mountain!

A rising mountain chain encircled the green giant in all directions.

Surrounding the green giant like a giant bowl or prison, the mountain chain blocked all escape routes.

"Could it be because of Miniscule Mountain?" Fang Yuan guessed.

"Fairy Li Shan's orchard garden in mountain is tremendously powerful, but at the steep cost of permanently expending the user's own dao marks. Thus, in historical records, Fairy Li Shan rarely used this battlefield immortal killer move."

Placing Miniscule Mountain in her aperture allowed Fairy Li Shan to expend its rich dao marks instead of her own foundation.

A pair of thick, massive green wings sprouted behind the green giant.

The four Hei tribe elders tried to fly out of the cage, but countless vines coiled around the giant's legs.

As if burning from within, its moss-like green body turned dark red.

Dark path and fire path — dual immortal killer move — Dark Ember!

Everywhere the shockwave passed, the entangled vines burned to ash like paper.

The terrifying aura made Fairy Li Shan reflexively take a step back.

Seemingly oblivious, Hei Lou Lan stared fixedly at the green giant's hand, where her father, Hei Cheng, was held.

Today's situation was orchestrated by them not only to kill Hei Cheng, but also to target Fang Yuan.

"I was scheming against Hei Lou Lan, yet they struck first!" Fang Yuan had never expected the leader of Northern Plains Zombie Alliance to be so closely tied to them.

Sensing Fang Yuan's gaze, Blazing Heaven Demoness cast him a seemingly smiling look.

If he tried to escape, Hei Lou Lan and Fairy Li Shan would only be disturbances, but Blazing Heaven Demoness was an impassable barrier!

"Since they haven't attacked, there is still room to talk. Escaping is pointless anyway—Blazing Heaven Demoness leads Northern Plains Zombie Alliance, and Fairy Li Shan is an information path expert..."

"My Xing Xiang Zi identity must already be exposed. Astute as Hei Lou Lan is, knowing my star path cultivation means she knows I obtained Star Form blessed land!"

"I assumed calling Fairy Li Shan 'little aunt' was merely affectionate. To think Hei Lou Lan had an elder aunt, and one so formidable!"

# Chapter 943: Afraid of Death

Blazing Heaven Demoness was actually Hei Lou Lan's elder aunt, Fang Yuan did not expect this.

Against Blazing Heaven Demoness, the disparity was despair-inducing; his rank six cultivation gave him no chance against a rank eight Gu Immortal.

'Right now, the only thing that I can rely on is the alliance agreement I made with Fairy Li Shan and Hei Lou Lan previously. Allies are not allowed to kill each other.'

'Against an information path expert, this agreement might not be foolproof. Yet Blazing Heaven Demoness suppresses me completely and hasn't struck; if they wanted me dead, they wouldn't have waited. Also, knowing my true identity, why did Blazing Heaven Demoness help me refine star thought Immortal Gu? This means they are not after my life, but have other objectives.'

Just as Fang Yuan weighed his safety, the green giant trapped by orchard garden in mountain roared and raised its head.

Flapping its three pairs of wings, the green giant bent its knees and leaped into the sky.

Unrestricted by vines, the green giant soared upward, only for immense suction to drag it back down.

With another loud bang, the green giant crashed into the ground.

Unable to break out, the green giant landed in the valley, where countless tough snake-like vines coiled around and restricted it again.

Three angry birds fused in midair into a medium-sized fire phoenix.

Singing loudly, the phoenix flapped its wings at extreme speed, tracing a rainbow arc before crashing into the giant's arm and vanishing.

Standing arrogantly in midair, she pointed at the green giant below and slashed downward!

Fire path killer move — Phoenix Feather Triple Wing Blade!

Together with the previous angry bird, this combo move severed the green giant's arm.

Freed from restraint, the captured Hei Cheng plummeted.

Hei Cheng tried to flee, but inside orchard garden in mountain, countless vines and roots immediately bound him tightly, delivering him to Fairy Li Shan.

"Let him go!" the four Hei tribe elders roared in fury.

Dragon marks surfaced on the green giant's chest and back, transforming into circling green dragons.

This was the signature killer move of Hei tribe's first supreme elder — Nine Dragon Body Protection!

Fairy Li Shan's expression changed: "Hurry, I can't hold on much longer!"

"Go!" Blazing Heaven Demoness acted without hesitation, shooting out a flame chain to seize Fairy Li Shan, Hei Lou Lan, Fang Yuan, and Hei Cheng.

She then activated a killer move, turning into a rainbow and dragging everyone into the air with her.

Moving at incredible speed, Blazing Heaven Demoness vanished with everyone over the horizon in the blink of an eye.

Just as the green giant prepared to pursue, an emergency distress letter appeared beside the four Hei tribe elders.

"What? Our blessed land base was infiltrated, most of our resources stolen, and we suffered catastrophic losses!"

"The invader is extremely powerful, bearing undeniable rank eight aura!"

Roaring loudly, the green giant tore open a massive dark hole in space before it.

"Hei tribe did not pursue; we are safe now." Blazing Heaven Demoness landed with everyone.

She casually waved her hand, covering the surrounding ten li in dark red barriers.

He moved his shoulders and arms, saying calmly to Fairy Li Shan: "So you are all family, you have truly kept me in the dark."

"The same goes for you." Fairy Li Shan smiled meaningfully.

"Spare me! Spare my life! I am willing to become your subordinate and serve faithfully—keeping me alive will benefit you!" Hei Cheng struggled up, shouting anxiously.

Fairy Li Shan glared furiously, pointing at Hei Cheng: "Dog thief, my little sister loved you so deeply, yet you took her life. Worse, you even tried to lay hands on your own daughter!"

Hei Cheng knelt, looking up to plead: "I am willing to be your dog or horse, I will reveal all of Hei tribe's secrets! Including the time path inheritance of our rank eight ancestor Hei Fan. Didn't Su Xian Er approach me for this inheritance? Don't you all want it! I will tell you everything I know without concealing any secrets!"

Fairy Li Shan was unmoved, so Hei Cheng turned to Blazing Heaven Demoness: "Had I known you backed Su Xian Er, I would never have killed her! This is all a misunderstanding!!"

Blazing Heaven Demoness snickered, telling Hei Lou Lan gently: "Only Little Lan decides your fate. Go ahead—I have restricted Hei Cheng to be as fragile as a mortal."

"Little Lan, Little Lan, listen to me!" Hei Cheng dropped to his knees and crawled frantically toward Hei Lou Lan.

"You are my daughter, I am your father. Hei tribe blood gives you a huge advantage in inheriting Hei Fan's inheritance. Were your mother alive, she wouldn't want to see us in conflict, right? Next, she kicked Hei Cheng away ruthlessly.

Hei Cheng was stunned.

A gust of wind blew through Hei Cheng's muddy hair, his eyes reddening as loving memories of Su Xian Er surfaced.

He started choking, before wailing.

"I... of course I knew your mother loved me... but I was afraid of dying... afraid of dying! Sob, sob, sob..."

Having answered her, Hei Cheng lost all strength and collapsed to the ground.

Like an old dog or a rotting prawn, he curled up and wept in the mud.

Hei Lou Lan and the others fell into deep silence.

Death was truly a terrifying thing.

Facing death, even an invincible rank nine venerable was fragile beyond belief.

Eternal life.

Was it possible?

Fang Yuan only knew: From ancient times until the present, nobody had reached such a stage.

"Let him go." A lump of emotion emerged from Hei Lou Lan, forming the translucent figure of a female immortal.

'Su Xian Er, Hei Lou Lan's mother.' Fang Yuan's gaze flickered.

"Little sister!" Seeing this familial emotion, tears welled in Fairy Li Shan's eyes.

Su Xian Er embraced Hei Lou Lan gently from behind: "Let him go; see how pitiful he is now. After killing me, he has lived in misery and regret—is he truly happy to be alive? No, he merely scrapes through life, living in terror and guilt, drifting aimlessly out of fear. Though alive, he died long ago."

"Let him go, and let yourself off too. Little Lan, do not live in hatred or dwell in the past; live your own life. Do not bear the heavy burden of killing your father. Trust me, revenge brings destruction, not salvation. I want you to live a better life!"

"Mother, I know you say this for my sake," Hei Lou Lan said, stepping toward Hei Cheng.

Suddenly, she raised her leg.

And she stomped!

Under her foot, his head burst like a watermelon, scattering blood, brain matter, skull, and teeth in a heap.

The high and mighty Hei Cheng, a rank seven Gu Immortal, a generation's hero, had died.

Su Xian Er's familial emotion was dazed.

Hei Lou Lan turned to face her: "There is nothing I cannot bear, mother! Just as you made your choice back then, I have my own resolution. Will this lead to destruction? Hmph, I am not so fragile."

"Little Lan." Fairy Li Shan stepped forward, anxiously holding Hei Lou Lan's hand.

"Little Lan..." Blazing Heaven Demoness murmured, wanting to step toward Hei Lou Lan, but ultimately holding back.

Northern Plains.

Blazing Heaven Demoness said, handing the fire pearl to Hei Lou Lan.

"I am Feng Jiu Ge, hurry, come here." The voice was exceedingly weak, like a dying man on his last breath.

Zhao Lian Yun hesitated.

"Don't worry. As an otherworldly demon accepted by Thieving Heaven's will, the winds of assimilation cannot harm you."

Feng Jiu Ge paused, struggling to speak: "Didn't you come to save me? As long as I remain, you cannot claim this Thieving Heaven inheritance."

Zhao Lian Yun approached a tornado cautiously; its power was so concentrated that she felt only a gentle breeze beside it.

With trembling hands, she reached into the tornado.

Just as Feng Jiu Ge said, the terrifying winds were harmless to her. At her touch, the tornado rapidly vanished.

Zhao Lian Yun was overjoyed: "Lord Feng Jiu Ge, I will save you now!"

She charged into the storm, the winds of assimilation dispersing wherever she went.

Reaching the center, the largest wind pillar trapping Feng Jiu Ge dispersed.

Before her, Feng Jiu Ge sat cross-legged three meters in the air. His face was rosy and his robes clean, but his eyes remained shut tight.

"Lord Feng Jiu Ge..." Zhao Lian Yun called out lightly.

Feng Jiu Ge opened his eyes, his expression clear as jade.

Without a word, he opened his right palm to Zhao Lian Yun.

There were two words written with blood on his palm.

Zhao Lian Yun looked at it in confusion, then glanced back up at him.

Feng Jiu Ge smiled faintly before his body disintegrated into the wind, vanishing completely.

Zhao Lian Yun was left staring blankly.

The greatest genius of a generation, Feng Jiu Ge, was dead!

# Chapter 952: Fang Yuan's First Entry into Luo Po Valley

Hu Immortal blessed land.

Because the rate of time was different, half a month had already passed here.

In the underground cave, Fang Yuan bathed in the light of wisdom, quietly deducing as usual.

"Puff..." Exhaling deeply, he opened his eyes with an expression of deep fatigue.

He stood up with difficulty; the prolonged intense thinking left his mind aching and dizzy.

Though a wisdom path grandmaster, his low fire path attainment limited each deduction session to seven days and nights.

"Even with the light of wisdom, I've only modified twenty percent. Alone, this would have taken countless years."

Leaving the cave, Fang Yuan returned to Dang Hun Palace to rest.

Just as he prepared to rest before resuming his deductions, Hei Lou Lan requested his help.

"You will never imagine what I found in Hei Cheng's soul!" Hei Lou Lan arrived excitedly before Fang Yuan via stargate.

Hei Lou Lan had captured Hei Cheng's soul after his death.

From Hei Cheng's soul, Hei Lou Lan had extracted shocking details regarding the battle in Luo Po valley.

"Fang Yuan, you have the ability to move mountains—I need you to retrieve Luo Po valley for me! I'll compensate you amply! We must act quickly before complications arise!" Hei Lou Lan urged.

Luo Po valley...

Fang Yuan remained silent, thinking of his open door Gu and close door Gu.

He had possessed the clue to Luo Po valley for a long time, but other matters had prevented him from going.

Hearing Hei Lou Lan's report, he felt privately glad for his earlier caution.

Luo Po valley was Shadow Sect's stronghold; going there earlier would have led to certain capture by their overwhelming forces.

"Now is our chance!" Hei Lou Lan's eyes shone brightly.

Fang Yuan nodded. "Shadow Sect failed, and Central Continent Gu Immortals now control Luo Po valley. But being from another region, they cannot stay long. Leaking information will easily force their retreat."

Fang Yuan pondered, "I'm more concerned about the Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance immortal zombie. As a Shadow Sect member, why was he saved by Zombie Alliance?"

"Enough of that. Luo Po valley is right before us—I'm inviting you and my aunts to explore it. We will split the gains per our agreement," Hei Lou Lan urged.

Still possessing open door Gu and close door Gu, Fang Yuan wondered if they would grant him special advantages in Luo Po valley.

But before going, some things had to be said.

"I disagree with you taking Luo Po valley entirely for yourself," Fang Yuan said firmly.

Hei Lou Lan glared furiously, a ruthless light in her eyes. "What do you mean? I obtained the information on Luo Po valley!"

Fang Yuan laughed, stating Luo Po valley's location.

Hei Lou Lan stared at Fang Yuan in shocked suspicion.

She had withheld that crucial piece of information from him!

Fang Yuan produced open door Gu and close door Gu, openly explaining them since they could no longer remain hidden.

Hei Lou Lan snorted disdainfully. "Would you have dared go without my information? By the time you worked up the nerve, the opportunity would be gone."

Fang Yuan smiled: "Don't be so agitated, I am just saying your information is not as important as you think."

The ownership of Luo Po valley was divided up.

Blazing Heaven Demoness took fifty percent, Fairy Li Shan twenty, while Hei Lou Lan and Fang Yuan each took ten percent.

Busy refining Gu, Blazing Heaven Demoness promised to reinforce them via Fang Yuan's Fixed Immortal Travel if danger arose.

In the end, only Fang Yuan, Fairy Li Shan and Hei Lou Lan went.

"Someone has entered Luo Po valley!" Guarding the entrance outside, Hui Feng Zi spotted them and immediately reported the intrusion.

Soon, Prince Feng Xian was informed of it!

# Chapter 953: Late By One Step

Having surrendered, Hui Feng Zi was stationed by the Central Continent sects to guard Luo Po valley.

Spotting Hei Lou Lan's group, he immediately sent an information path message to Prince Feng Xian inside the valley.

Receiving the report, Prince Feng Xian's hand was still slightly trembling.

Unfortunately, Feng Jiu Ge was already dead!

With Feng Jiu Ge dead, Zhao Lian Yun alone claimed the inheritance—Ghostly Concealment.

She immediately returned to Prince Feng Xian's side and reported Feng Jiu Ge's demise.

"Sigh, we were late." Prince Feng Xian sighed inwardly.

He then grabbed Zhao Lian Yun's shoulder and flew away.

Breaking the outer concealment seal, they entered Luo Po valley and surveyed the area.

Luo Po valley lay ravaged after the hundred days battle, littered with residual Gu formations.

The trio began searching through Luo Po valley.

Under Hei Lou Lan and Fairy Li Shan's attentive gazes, Fang Yuan used open door Gu and close door Gu.

No response!

Fang Yuan sighed, realizing the Thieving Heaven inheritance had already been taken, likely by Shadow Sect.

"After so many years, it's normal for Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's inheritance to be claimed. The real prize is still Luo Po valley!" Hei Lou Lan smiled, patting his shoulder.

Fang Yuan nodded and activated his Immortal Gu, slowly uprooting all of Luo Po valley.

Fairy Li Shan assisted from the other side, deploying countless flying Gu worms.

"They're actually taking Luo Po valley!" Watching from outside, Hui Feng Zi was utterly shocked.

After an hour, Fang Yuan successfully stored Luo Po valley inside his immortal aperture.

"To be safe, we should leave immediately," Hei Lou Lan urged, having grown far more cautious.

Though severely damaged, Luo Po valley could easily be restored using Tai Bai Yun Sheng's Landscape as Before.

Having secured Luo Po valley, Fang Yuan's group quickly retreated.

"This is Xiao Hun blessed land," Hei Lou Lan said, leading them to Hei Cheng's former blessed land.

After selecting a location, boom, Fang Yuan placed down Luo Po valley.

Fairy Li Shan smiled at the completed task: "Fang Yuan, you have Dang Hun Mountain, I have Miniscule Mountain, and Little Lan has Luo Po valley. Haha, how interesting—we actually possess three secluded domains of heaven and earth!"

Gazing down at Luo Po valley, Fang Yuan could not help feeling expectant.

Spectral Soul Demon Venerable had proclaimed Dang Hun Mountain and Luo Po valley the two treasures of soul path cultivation. Profiting endlessly from Dang Hun Mountain, Fang Yuan wondered how Luo Po valley would elevate him.

# Chapter 954: Blue

Central Continent, Spirit Affinity House, discussion hall.

"We gathered everyone today to announce important news," Spirit Affinity House's first supreme elder spoke solemnly from the main seat, looking around.

"It is confirmed: Feng Jiu Ge died in Northern Plains within the winds of assimilation, leaving behind only two words written in blood."

All of the immortals' hearts sank.

Fairy Bai Qing, attending in person, paled as her head spun.

The immortals in the hall began discussing Feng Jiu Ge's final action.

"Before dying, Feng Jiu Ge wrote 'Bo Qing' on his palm—what was he trying to say?"

"Feng Jiu Ge was investigating Eighty-Eight True Yang Building's collapse—what does that have to do with Bo Qing?"

A Gu Immortal broke the silence: "Reports state Qin Bai Sheng used five finger fist heart sword—Bo Qing's signature killer move against Feng Jiu Ge."

First supreme elder raised her hand, silencing the hall.

"Regardless, we must investigate Bo Qing. Bai Qing, I entrust this mission to you."

Hearing her name called, Fairy Bai Qing looked at first supreme elder and agreed.

"Feng Jiu Ge's death remains strictly between us—conceal it completely. Whoever leaks this will be tried as a traitor!" First supreme elder declared coldly. "Next, regarding the forces under our sect's control in Central Continent..."

Feng Jiu Ge's death created many problems for Spirit Affinity House.

Only when Zhao Lian Yun was mentioned did Fairy Bai Qing's eyes show deep concern.

She heard the Gu Immortals discuss:

"Zhao Lian Yun inherited two Thieving Heaven true inheritances, did anything change in her?"

"Divine concealment and ghostly concealment are unfathomable defensive killer moves, forming two permanent layers of dao marks cloaking Zhao Lian Yun's soul!"

"We failed to deduce her through numerous methods. Gu Immortals failing to deduce a mortal is truly unbelievable."

"Did you notice? Divine concealment and ghostly concealment expend no immortal essence, much like fortune rivalling heaven Gu. The power of venerables is truly incomprehensible."

"Masking from deductions of thoughts, wills, and emotions is divine concealment's defense. What about ghostly concealment?"

"That is still unclear despite our tests. Zhao Lian Yun was very cooperative throughout. Even though she is an otherworldly demon, she knows how to behave and can be nurtured."

First supreme elder concluded the meeting: "Continue researching, and deepen Zhao Lian Yun's attachment to our sect. I look forward to her future!"

At the same time, in a nameless forest.

Seven Star Child immortal zombie looked at a mirror to communicate with someone.

There was a vague elderly figure in the mirror.

He spoke slowly: "All preparations are set. But Heavenly Court has finished repairing fate Gu's final stage—you must act in advance."

"Understood." Seven Star Child immortal zombie said solemnly.

"Be careful, Vice Envoy Blue." The figure in the mirror spoke again.

Seven Star Child remained silent, deactivating the information path immortal killer move as the mirror vanished.

Next, he turned around and entered deep into the forest without looking back.

# Chapter 955: Swords Traverse Central Continent

Feng Jin Huang lay in bed, pale and weak without a trace of color.

Looking at Fairy Bai Qing seated at the bedside, she apologized: "Mother, I made a mistake, I won't do it again..."

Fairy Bai Qing said gravely: "Huang Er, I know what you are thinking. You cultivate so desperately that you've injured yourself five or six times these past weeks. I have warned you when you began cultivating, you need to be act according to what is natural and be in control. But what you are doing is going for more haste, which is instead causing you to progress slowly, you might even collapse and endanger your life as well!"

Feng Jin Huang lowered her eyelids, speaking quietly: "Mother, I am sorry."

"I have placed Gu in your body. As punishment, you cannot cultivate for seven days and nights, restricted to this valley. If hungry, forage wild fruits; if thirsty, drink from the spring. Think properly over these days." Fairy Bai Qing said in a heavy voice.

"Mother, don't!" Feng Jin Huang was very anxious.

However, Fairy Bai Qing brushed her sleeves at Feng Jin Huang's cheek.

Seeing her sleeping daughter still frowning slightly, Fairy Bai Qing felt sorrow and worry.

Fairy Bai Qing had not informed Feng Jin Huang of Feng Jiu Ge's death.

As dawn broke, Fairy Bai Qing knew she had to set out.

She rose slowly, walked outside, and carefully closed the door.

Gazing deeply at the valley cabin, she murmured: "Huang Er, wait seven days for mother. Take care of yourself and calm your mind."

Fairy Bai Qing stepped onto cloud and mist, flying northwest.

Her destination was the source of Falling Heavenly River.

She had received the sect mission to investigate Feng Jiu Ge's clue regarding Bo Qing.

Reviewing sect records, Fairy Bai Qing studied Bo Qing, a former Spirit Affinity House Gu Immortal.

Fairy Bai Qing discovered Bo Qing's life mirrored Feng Jiu Ge's in many ways. Even more intriguing was Bo Qing's lover, Mo Yao.

"Bo Qing never entered Northern Plains, but Mo Yao did, even infiltrating Imperial Court blessed land. Could Mo Yao have been involved in destroying Eighty-Eight True Yang Building?"

Mo Yao had risked entering Imperial Court blessed land solely to help her husband, Bo Qing, survive his tribulation.

Back then, peak rank eight Bo Qing attempted to advance to rank nine, drawing attention across all five regions.

Ultimately, Bo Qing perished in the terrifying tribulation, and Mo Yao died alongside him.

Fairy Bai Qing racked her brains investigating with little progress. However, clues in sect records all pointed to one place—the source of Falling Heavenly River.

With no breakthroughs elsewhere, Fairy Bai Qing decisively headed for Falling Heavenly River to search for clues.

The source of Falling Heavenly River was where Bo Qing had perished.

She flew rapidly, using Spirit Affinity House's teleportation Gu formations to travel over a hundred thousand li at a time, saving immense time.

A day and night later, a fatigued Fairy Bai Qing was only a thousand li from Falling Heavenly River's source.

Ahead stood an enormous waterfall plunging from an endless height.

She recalled what Feng Jiu Ge had told her back then.

It concerned the origin of Falling Heavenly River.

One theory held that Falling Heavenly River was itself a calamity or tribulation, while another claimed Bo Qing's sword light was so sharp that it pierced through white heaven into black heaven.

Feng Jiu Ge had smiled: "I am unsure, but the second theory explains the water flow. By day, Falling Heavenly River rushes with such momentum that even rank eight Gu Immortals cannot withstand it. And during night, the flow of Falling Heavenly River slows down to the extent rank seven Gu Immortals can just barely resist it."

Ending her recollection, Fairy Bai Qing's gaze focused.

She had borrowed multiple water path Immortal Gu to help her enter Falling Heavenly River.

Entering by day was impossible; as a rank seven Gu Immortal, her only chance to search for clues was at night.

Suddenly, she looked toward distant Falling Heavenly River in astonishment.

Roar!

Water gurgled as a giant beast raised its head from the river, revealing horned tips.

"Immemorial desolate beast myriad eyes clear bull!" Fairy Bai Qing paled upon recognizing the fierce beast.

"Why surface now?" Puzzled, Fairy Bai Qing quickly retreated to maintain her distance.

As she moved further from the myriad eyes clear bull, a sword light suddenly erupted from the riverbed.

Like a thunderbolt, it pierced through the myriad eyes clear bull.

The sturdy immemorial desolate beast was instantly cut in two.

Blood and internal organs splattered everywhere, dyeing the river blood red.

Whoosh!

Before Fairy Bai Qing could react, another sword light slashed across the riverbank.

A massive gash sliced open the riverbank, and water rushed into the chasm.

Whoosh whoosh whoosh!

Countless sword lights shot from beneath Falling Heavenly River.

Like fireworks, sword lights scattered in all directions, rapidly disappearing from Fairy Bai Qing's sight.

Swords traverse Central Continent!

# Chapter 956: World Shaking Might

Central Continent, centipede valley.

A terrifying chase unfolded in the narrow mountain ravine.

"Run, quickly run!" a miniman clinging to Hong Yi's head shouted anxiously.

"It hurts! Don't pull my hair!" Hong Yi cried in pain.

Ignoring him, the miniman gripped Hong Yi's hair and looked back in terror.

"Damn it! It's already here—run faster or we'll be eaten!" the miniman cried frantically.

"I'm trying..." Hong Yi gritted his teeth, pushing his movement Gu to the limit. Unfortunately, his cultivation was merely rank two upper stage.

A rank two cultivation was useless against the wild rank five golden horn centipede pursuing him.

Python-sized with a sharp horn, the massive centipede twisted forward rapidly on hundreds of stomping legs.

"We're finished! It's right behind you!" the miniman cried, pale with terror.

"I'll risk it!" Feeling the golden horn centipede closing in, Hong Yi bristled with fear and prepared to unleash his only killer move.

"It's catching up, it's catching up!" the miniman shrieked in fear, watching the golden horn centipede fiercely shorten the gap.

The massive, heavy centipede snapped its jaws, spraying saliva as it bit toward Hong Yi.

Seeing it could not bite Hong Yi, the golden horn centipede switched tactics and attacked with its horn.

The centipede pounced, driving its golden horn straight toward Hong Yi's butt.

"Fool, run!" The miniman shuddered in fear at the sight, nearly losing its grip on his hair.

"You're still calling me a fool—agh!" Hong Yi shrieked like a strangled rooster, his voice full of shock and agony.

The golden horn had already stabbed into Hong Yi's buttocks.

Yet at that moment, Hong Yi's speed suddenly surged.

He shot out like a cannonball!

As he screamed, the intense pain sparked a moment of inspiration, instantly activating his killer move.

"Oh no, my primeval essence is running out!" Hong Yi paled.

Death approached as Hong Yi was forced into a desperate situation with no way out.

But suddenly, sword light that shook the world flashed!

In an instant, the world turned white, everything turned silent.

Hong Yi ran on before realizing something was amiss.

Looking back, he was shocked.

The rank five golden horn centipede Gu had vanished completely.

Along with it, half of centipede valley had vanished!

Before him lay a vast trench with mirror-smooth sides.

"What... what is going on?" Hong Yi was speechless in disbelief.

"Just, just that sword light..." The miniman was completely stunned.

Central Continent, east coast.

Waves crashed relentlessly as frost energy permeated the surrounding area.

"Youngsters, we have arrived at profound ice island, where Flying Frost Sect resides. Here you will live and change your destiny," the leading Gu Master introduced proudly, pointing ahead.

Swoosh!

Sword light flashed, momentarily blinding everyone as they shut their eyes.

When they opened their eyes, everyone froze like statues, mouths agape in stunned disbelief.

The massive profound ice island was gone, replaced by a deep trench in their vision.

A five-li corridor through the sea lay emptied of water, suppressed by overbearing sword path dao marks.

Heavenly Court.

Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord stood shakily with his walking stick beneath Heaven Overseeing Tower.

With his other wrinkled hand, he gently rubbed fate Gu.

Fate Gu had been significantly repaired, filling Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord with excitement and joy.

His fellow restorers—Bai Cang Shui, Lian Jiu Sheng, and Bi Chen Tian—had already departed Heavenly Court for the mortal realm.

"After this restoration, fate Gu can unleash half its might. Through Heaven Overseeing Tower, we can locate more fate escapers. Eliminating them will aid in repairing fate Gu, creating a virtuous cycle until Heaven Overseeing Tower regains its former glory!"

Filled with anticipation, Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord prepared to enter Heaven Overseeing Tower again.

Rumble!

A sword light struck like lightning, instantly slicing through Heaven Overseeing Tower.

Shocked, he watched Heaven Overseeing Tower's upper half tilt and crash down.

"Heaven Overseeing Tower!!" After a momentary stun, Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord screamed.

---

# Chapter 957: Rising Commotion

"It finally stopped." Fairy Bai Qing looked at the tranquil river surface, pale with lingering fear.

Closest to the source during the rampage, she had witnessed the world-shaking spectacle firsthand.

Mutilated remains of ancient and immemorial desolate beasts bobbed everywhere.

The surging white heavenly river water was now dyed blood red.

Fairy Bai Qing waited for some moments, no more sword lights appeared.

Rushing to the river, she gathered beast corpses and desolate plant remains.

Forced to retreat, Fairy Bai Qing looked back regretfully at the prime refinement materials.

"The sword lights erupted so suddenly—what happened in Falling Heavenly River? Should I enter to investigate?"

Yet clues regarding Bo Qing lay in the riverbed.

Gritting her teeth, Fairy Bai Qing turned into white light and shot into Falling Heavenly River.

From Falling Heavenly River's source, peerless sword lights had erupted across the entirety of Central Continent.

Heavenly Court.

His face ashen, Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord moved ceaselessly to restore the tower.

He had already urgently recalled Bi Chen Tian, Bai Cang Shui, and Lian Jiu Sheng.

The corrosive sword path dao marks threatened to rapidly destroy what remained of the tower.

"We succeeded in restoring fate Immortal Gu, but just as I was about to use it, Heaven Overseeing Tower was split apart. Is this a coincidence? Or..."

Soon, Bi Chen Tian returned first, followed by Bai Cang Shui, and finally Lian Jiu Sheng.

Lian Jiu Sheng had paused en route and brought concrete news: "I investigated it; the sword light originated from the source of Falling Heavenly River. Central Continent is in an uproar."

"Falling Heavenly River's source, isn't that where Bo Qing died?" Bai Cang Shui exclaimed in shock.

Back then, they had tried recruiting him, but Bo Qing's ideals did not align with theirs, and he refused to join Heavenly Court.

"Bo Qing..." Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord's gaze darkened. "Investigate—we must clarify this. Fairy Cang Shui, as a water path specialist, please make the trip. The three of us will stay to restore Heaven Overseeing Tower. I have a very bad feeling about this."

The other three immortals grew solemn. Bi Chen Tian said: "Tower Lord, you oversee Heaven Overseeing Tower and fate Gu. If you are uneasy, we cannot disregard it—we must act quickly!"

From Central Continent's ten great ancient righteous sects to demonic and lone cultivators like Jian Yi Sheng, everyone began making their moves.

Bo Qing, a pseudo-Immortal Venerable at the pinnacle beneath venerables—this long-dormant reputation resurfaced once more.

But in Southern Border, it was calm and tranquil.

On a mountain peak, in a stone pavilion.

Old Man Yan Shi sat inside the pavilion, playing chess.

Before him lay a rock carved with dazzling star path dao marks.

Beneath Old Man Yan Shi was history's famous astrolabe chessboard.

A figure descended from the sky, instantly filling the stone pavilion with chilly air.

"Why did you call me?" Bai Ning Bing coldly stared at Old Man Yan Shi's back.

Bai Ning Bing continued icily: "Although you helped me become a Gu Immortal, I am not your subordinate to be ordered around."

Old Man Yan Shi smiled softly: "Do you know that Fang Yuan is returning?"

Bai Ning Bing's eyes flashed, before squinting to conceal the sharp glint.

With a cold snort, he said: "Explain it clearly."

---

# Chapter 958: Pawn Bai Ning Bing

Looking at Old Man Yan Shi, Bai Ning Bing was very vigilant.

Ever since advancing to Gu Immortal, he had realized how unfathomable Old Man Yan Shi was.

Facing Bai Ning Bing's query, Old Man Yan Shi leisurely took out an Immortal Gu: "Follow my instructions, and I guarantee Fang Yuan will return to Southern Border."

Bai Ning Bing's eyes glinted coldly: "You seem to know Fang Yuan's whereabouts clearly. Yet when I was advancing to Gu Immortal and asked, you claimed not to know."

Ignoring the question, he continued: "South of Namei peak, east of Li Qiu, and not far from rock dragon cave, lies a nameless mountain peak. Go to its summit and activate this Gu. Once successful, leave quickly. This mountain will become a forbidden zone for immortals, any Gu Immortals that enter this area will be met with fatal killing intent."

Without taking the Immortal Gu, Bai Ning Bing glared at Old Man Yan Shi and said coldly: "You still haven't answered my question."

"I have no need to answer. You only need to know that once this is done, Fang Yuan will return. Didn't your agreement with Shadow Sect state that only after Fang Yuan dies will you regain your freedom?" Old Man Yan Shi smiled faintly.

After a brief silence, Bai Ning Bing took the Immortal Gu.

Snorting coldly, he flew away and disappeared into the horizon.

Traveling swiftly, two days later he located the mountain Old Man Yan Shi had described.

"This mountain is completely ordinary, why did he choose it?" Bai Ning Bing was puzzled.

Suspecting Old Man Yan Shi's motives, Bai Ning Bing decided to stall and probe his patience.

Bai Ning Bing bided his time without moving, and indeed, someone from Shadow Sect grew anxious.

A black-robed Gu Immortal appeared in the stone pavilion and rasped: "Yan Shi, Bai Ning Bing has been gone nearly half a month without word or action. Did he flee with the Gu, or run into trouble?"

Old Man Yan Shi calmly studied the astrolabe chessboard.

Pinching his fingers to deduce chess moves, Old Man Yan Shi said to the black-robed Gu Immortal: "Bai Ning Bing is still there, just holding back. He suspected this trip might harm him, so his reaction is completely normal."

Seeing Old Man Yan Shi's leisurely attitude, the black-robed Gu Immortal spoke urgently: "Central Continent's situation cannot be delayed any longer! Not only Central Continent's ten great ancient sects, but many lone and demonic cultivators have entered Falling Heavenly River's riverbed. Vice Envoy Blue's group can only hold out for three more days. After three days, Heavenly Court will realize this was arranged, potentially disrupting our true plan."

Old Man Yan Shi nodded in agreement: "You have a point. The current state has diverged from our original plan; progress is indeed too slow."

"Hehehe, why do you think I am using him?" Chuckling, Old Man Yan Shi flicked his wide sleeve, instantly erasing a star mark from the astrolabe chessboard.

Erasing it so effortlessly revealed Old Man Yan Shi's great grandmaster wisdom attainment.

A large hood concealed the black-robed Gu Immortal's face, but his voice was laden with doubt: "Yan Shi, didn't you choose Bai Ning Bing for his ten extreme physique's battle strength?"

"No, that is only what makes him special on the surface," Old Man Yan Shi laughed. "His true significance is that he, too, is an escapee of fate!"

"What? He is one too?" The black-robed Gu Immortal was shocked.

Old Man Yan Shi explained: "Our grand plan has been prepared for a hundred thousand years! Our true enemy is not Heavenly Court or the four regions, but heaven itself. That is why I entrusted this crucial final step to Bai Ning Bing. He is an escapee of fate, from a certain perspective, he could be said to have escaped the grasp of heaven's will as well. Only this kind of person is qualified to become our pawn."

Old Man Yan Shi continued: "Because heaven's will cannot fully control a fate escapee like Bai Ning Bing, he is our sharpest weapon. After he left, I did not contact him and let him act freely. Rest assured, given his nature, he will not wait much longer."

"In that case, I will return to sleep." The black-robed Gu Immortal cupped his fists and departed.

Bai Ning Bing waited two more days on the nameless peak, occasionally looking toward Old Man Yan Shi's stone pavilion.

Sighing, Bai Ning Bing hovered in midair, gazing down at the ordinary mountain.

"Go." With a thought, he expended immortal essence and activated the mysterious Immortal Gu.

Soon, sweat dripped from Bai Ning Bing's forehead as he grew anxious: "I've spent hundreds of beads of immortal essence, yet it still hasn't activated? So this was where the task's difficulty lay!"

Just as his bewilderment peaked, the Immortal Gu buzzed and transformed into a ray of light that shot into the sky.

Reaching its zenith, the expanding light plunged toward the nameless mountain.

Boom!

It crashed onto the peak, erupting in blinding radiance.

Amidst the intense radiance, the mountain remained undamaged as phantom images materialized over its forests.

It showed a surging river filled with ineffable mystical wonder and boundless profundity.

"This scene... could it be the river of time?!"

Bai Ning Bing's eyes suddenly enlarged, filled with extreme surprise.

As the River of Time's phantom faded, two humanoid figures seemed to leap out from the waters, their features and attire growing distinct.

These two people were fighting!

As both sides traded fierce moves, the battle's intensity shook Bai Ning Bing to the core.

One was a burly rank eight Gu Immortal rampaging with beast-like momentum!

The other was a rank seven Gu Immortal shrouded in fog, distinguishable only by a red lotus mark on his forehead.

---

# Chapter 959: Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage

Their battle shook the phantom scenery, shattering boulders and making the river roar.

As the clash peaked, the burly rank eight Gu Immortal held the advantage and laughed wildly: "With rank eight cultivation and the Great Strength True Martial Physique, how dare a mere rank seven challenge me?!"

The mysterious Gu Immortal with the red lotus mark chuckled calmly: "Martial Duel Heavenly King, your defeat is sealed. Take this!"

With a flick of his right hand, the rank seven Gu Immortal sent a high platform flying out.

Contempt vanished from the rank eight Martial Duel Heavenly King's face, replaced by shock: "An Immortal Gu House! What Immortal Gu House is this?"

The rank seven Gu Immortal smiled proudly: "Behold my original creation—Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage!"

"Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage?" Bai Ning Bing frowned. To his knowledge, no such Immortal Gu House existed in Southern Border's present immortal world.

Whatever attacks Martial Duel Heavenly King unleashed, all were absorbed and sealed.

The rank seven Gu Immortal then reflected those attacks back!

The images shifted continuously as the battle grew increasingly fierce.

Aided by the stage, the rank seven Gu Immortal defeated rank eight Martial Duel Heavenly King!

However, the rank seven Gu Immortal paid a heavy price.

Desperate, Martial Duel Heavenly King became an unkillable immortal zombie, forcing his foe to sacrifice Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage to suppress him underground.

The victor sighed toward his buried Immortal Gu House, then flew off.

Once the phantom image faded completely, reality returned to normal.

Bai Ning Bing realized Yan Shi had given him a time path investigative Immortal Gu.

The site of that colossal clash was now this ordinary, inconspicuous mountain.

"An Immortal Gu House is buried here!" Bai Ning Bing stared beneath the mountain, heart pounding with excitement.

"If I can obtain Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage, it will greatly aid me in dealing with Shadow Sect and leaving! Yet the Immortal Gu's aura has leaked, and its activation caused a massive commotion that will surely draw other Gu Immortals. Time is short—I must hurry!"

Bai Ning Bing was about to dive deep underground to claim the Immortal Gu House when he hesitated.

Approaching the mountain, intense weakness struck him; his immortal aura drained and thoughts slowed.

Shocked, Bai Ning Bing retreated, recalling Old Man Yan Shi's words.

"Go to the mountain summit and activate this Gu. Once successful, leave quickly. This mountain will become an immortal forbidden zone where any entering Gu Immortal faces fatal killing intent."

Bai Ning Bing frowned in thought—was this the forbidden zone for immortals?

If this was truly a forbidden zone, how could he seize Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage?

He noticed that the phantom image replayed periodically.

He also discovered: the forbidden zone was expanding.

Initially, he could approach within three li of the nameless mountain. Now, even ten li away, he felt utterly drained, warned by an innate sense that forcing his way in meant certain death.

He suddenly realized that this Immortal Gu and arrangement were all part of Shadow Sect's scheme.

"With an ancient battle and the Immortal Gu House Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage exposed, all of Southern Border will be thrown into turmoil. Righteous, demonic, and lone immortals alike will go mad over it. None will yield an inch over an Immortal Gu House; immense bloodshed is inevitable. Is Shadow Sect aiming to plunge Southern Border into chaos? But how does that benefit them?"

Bai Ning Bing slapped his forehead hard, replacing his anxiety with clear-headed calm.

"What was I doing these past days?! Greed completely blinded me. This is beyond my reach; this nameless mountain will soon become the storm center drawing almost every Gu Immortal in Southern Border. As a mere rank six Gu Immortal with limited methods, I must leave immediately. I should return and probe Old Man Yan Shi's intentions. Is he using this to lure Fang Yuan?"

Bai Ning Bing hurried back, but Old Man Yan Shi was no longer in the pavilion.

He rushed to Shadow Sect's blessed land, but could reach no one; the entire sect had vanished.

A sense of abandonment surged in Bai Ning Bing; recent events boded ill.

Central Continent, Falling Heavenly River.

Light filled the riverbed at the source of Falling Heavenly River.

Countless Central Continent Gu Immortals stared fervently at the riverbed's sole source of light.

Within the light floated a lifelike immortal zombie with sharp brows and jade-green hair—it was Bo Qing!

"Who would have thought Bo Qing became an immortal zombie?"

"Back then, Spirit Affinity House's fairy Mo Yao underwent the tribulation with him. Yet only Bo Qing remains here; Mo Yao must have perished entirely."

Meanwhile, lone and demonic cultivators like Jian Yi Sheng focused on the Immortal Gu on Bo Qing's corpse.

"The auras of so many Immortal Gu remain on his body—unbelievable that they endured until now! These are a pseudo-Immortal Venerable's sword path Immortal Gu; I'd be satisfied with just one!"

# Chapter 960: Bo Qing Awakens

At least thirty Gu Immortals had gathered at the source of Falling Heavenly River.

The immortals stared fervently at Bo Qing's radiant shroud while warily watching competitors.

Jin Lie Yang, Hong Chi Ming, Qi Yun Tian and others.

Among the ten ancient sects' representatives, Fairy Bai Qing posed the greatest threat.

Seeing the stalemate, Qi Yun Tian said slowly: "Fairy Bai Qing, the situation is clear. Though Bo Qing's soul was destroyed in the tribulation, residual wills and emotions in his immortal zombie body still enable him to defend himself."

"Thus, whenever we draw near, he activates his Immortal Gu to unleash piercing sword lights in all directions. To weaken his animosity, we need something with Bo Qing's aura, a Gu he refined, or wills and emotions he left behind. With these, we can get close and gain the upper hand."

Fairy Bai Qing smiled bitterly: "If I had such things, I would have acted long ago."

Regardless of immortal zombie Bo Qing's condition, recovering his body and sword path Immortal Gu was vital for Spirit Affinity House.

Just as the immortals deadlocked, a vast rank eight aura surged.

"All immortals stand back, Heavenly Court is taking charge."

Gasping, everyone looked toward the voice and saw a female immortal descending.

It was rank eight water path Gu Immortal Bai Cang Shui.

The situation changed at once!

Central Continent, Heavenly Court.

Light shone upon Heaven Overseeing Tower, fully rebuilt before the three immortals.

The three Heavenly Court immortals sighed in relief as the weight lifted.

Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord took a deep breath, approaching the tower holding fate Gu.

Lian Jiu Sheng could not help asking: "Tower Lord, won't you rest? Why the rush to activate Heaven Overseeing Tower?"

"Thank you for your concern, it is fine." Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord smiled, declining.

Ever since the sword light struck, he had felt ominous foreboding.

"Go." With a thought, fate Gu turned into mystical light and entered the tower's peak toward the formation core.

Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord moved his aged body slowly up the stairs.

After sixty steps, the image on the wall became clear.

The scene on Southern Border's nameless peak unfolded vividly.

The battle between Martial Duel Heavenly King and the mysterious rank seven Gu Immortal entered Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord's vision.

This old man frowned unconsciously.

"Rank eight Great Strength True Martial immortal zombie... Immortal Gu House Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage... and this!"

On the mysterious rank seven Gu Immortal's forehead, the bright red lotus mark was strikingly vivid.

"An inheritor of Red Lotus' true inheritance!"

Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord's eyes flashed with sharpness.

The damage Red Lotus Demon Venerable dealt to fate Gu had tormented Heavenly Court for a million years!

Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord stopped on this step, thinking deeply.

"Red Lotus' true inheritance must be destroyed! No traces can remain!"

"The Great Strength True Martial immortal zombie is less concerning... but Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage should belong to Heavenly Court. Despite Southern Border's regional wall, Heavenly Court must make an attempt."

"Unconcealed, this scene will surely stir Southern Border's Gu Immortal world, drawing countless competitors. If Heavenly Court is to cross regions and compete, we must choose suitable candidates and precise numbers."

At step eighty-three, the image shifted.

This time, it was the scene of Central Continent.

In Falling Heavenly River, Bai Cang Shui led the immortals, singlehandedly controlling the situation.

In the image, Bai Cang Shui smiled and spoke to Fairy Bai Qing.

Yet after Fairy Bai Qing replied, Bai Cang Shui's expression turned to deep disappointment.

Moving her fingers, she set up a Gu formation to seal the area.

Suddenly, starlight shot over, piercing the incomplete Gu formation toward immortal zombie Bo Qing.

As starlight shined brightly, immortal zombie Bo Qing opened his eyes!

Instantly, countless flashes of sword light burst out, turning the world white.

Even Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord shut his eyes in response.

Dismembered corpses lay everywhere, while Bai Cang Shui's severed head rolled away streaming blood.

Her eyes were opened wide, she had died!

"How can this be?" Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord, who saw this, was anguished.

Three figures landed immediately.

Seven Star Child landed first, followed by Song Zi Xing and Yu Mu Chun.

"Azure, you are finally awake," Seven Star Child laughed loudly, radiating a powerful rank eight aura.

He walked forward, getting close to immortal zombie Bo Qing.

Bo Qing's eyes shined with ruthlessness, sword light shot out.

Seven Star Child was shocked, never expecting Bo Qing to attack him!

Sword light sliced him in half, destroying his zombie body.

"What is going on? Envoy Azure killed Vice Envoy Blue!"

"No, he is not Envoy Azure! His mind is filled with heaven's will, and another's remnant soul lives inside his body!"

Shock and fury gripped Song Zi Xing and Yu Mu Chun.

Expressionless, immortal zombie Bo Qing turned to look at them.

Song Zi Xing and Yu Mu Chun felt a deep chill, sinking into despair.

Only the unfeeling heavenly way stared back.

Engulfed in deathly aura before the pseudo-Immortal Venerable, they could neither dodge nor flee.

# Chapter 961: Unprecedented Contest

"Hahaha, I finally succeeded!"

Emerging from the underground cave, Fang Yuan's face was filled with joy.

Having poured all his effort into deducing this immortal killer move, he finally achieved results today.

This new killer move used eat strength Immortal Gu, Pulling Mountain, and Pulling Water as cores, with three hundred and thirty thousand supplementary mortal Gu forming an extravagant combination.

Activating it required two hours of wholehearted concentration operating the Gu worms.

Then, over three days and nights without rest, he could gradually transform his living body into an immortal zombie, or vice versa.

Though not as convenient as nirvana fire, achieving this was already Fang Yuan's limit.

"Next, I must use those strength path immortal zombies and exert strength Gu to form my high grade life-and-death blessed land and revive," Fang Yuan sighed internally.

After searching for so long, he had finally reached this stage.

Just as he was about to start, he received Blazing Heaven Demoness' letter.

The contents caused his revival plan to pause.

"Rank eight Great Strength True Martial immortal zombie?" Reading this line, Fang Yuan's heart pounded.

Blazing Heaven Demoness' intelligence concerned the nameless mountain in Southern Border.

Concerning an Immortal Gu House, this matter was immense and had spread across Southern Border's entire Gu Immortal world.

In Southern Border, there was a Zombie Alliance branch as well.

Thus, as leader of the Northern Plains Zombie Alliance branch, Blazing Heaven Demoness quickly obtained the news.

"Blazing Heaven Demoness has great ambitions, and as a Zombie Alliance higher-up, gathers information far more easily than Fairy Li Shan."

Three days later, Fang Yuan went alone to Southern Border, approaching the nameless mountain.

Blazing Heaven Demoness remained in Dark Flow Giant City refining Gu and setting up the formation, promising to act when necessary.

Hei Lou Lan and Fairy Li Shan stayed behind in Luo Po valley, barred from roaming Southern Border by their Northern Plains aura.

Fang Yuan came here to obtain intelligence.

Though he became an immortal in Northern Plains, Vaguely Familiar Face concealed him, preventing ordinary Gu Immortals from exposing him.

On the nameless mountain, phantom images reappeared periodically.

Bai Ning Bing was nowhere to be found.

After watching three cycles and pondering, Fang Yuan moved closer to the nameless mountain.

As Blazing Heaven Demoness' letter noted, a formless force pressured his immortal aperture the deeper he ventured into this immortal forbidden zone.

Fang Yuan stopped, knowing that continuing another fifty or sixty steps would destroy his immortal aperture.

Fang Yuan had to retreat.

At this time, he heard a tender laughter from behind him.

Fang Yuan's pupils shrunk, he immediately turned around.

A beautiful woman in pink and red stood nearby looking at him with alluring, watery eyes.

Fang Yuan did not dare to be careless.

Exuding Gu Immortal aura, she was a rank six Gu Immortal.

Meeting Fang Yuan's gaze, the woman introduced herself: "I am Li Mei Hua, known as Granny Mei Hua. Handsome lad, you look unfamiliar, where do you cultivate?"

Fang Yuan smiled, he thought: "So she is Granny Mei Hua."

Fang Yuan wore a green robe with wide sleeves that fluttered like a war banner in the wind.

His disguise gave him a rank six aura, middle-aged and skinny, with pupils radiating faint jade light. He gave off an eerie, formidable aura; though not handsome, he carried a striking disposition.

"Granny Mei Hua, I have long heard of you. I am Sheng Ying, merely a wanderer," Fang Yuan replied.

"Sheng Ying..." Li Mei Hua memorized the name, unable to recall such a person in Southern Border.

When Li Mei Hua invited him to travel together, Fang Yuan considered and agreed.

Following Li Mei Hua a thousand li to Headless Mountain, Fang Yuan found many demonic and lone immortals already gathered there.

After speaking with everyone, Li Mei Hua introduced him: "This is Brother Sheng Ying, a lone immortal."

Li Mei Hua could not stay long, needing to return to the nameless mountain for more people. Pointing into the distance, she told Fang Yuan: "Pine Tail Mountain over there is the base camp of the righteous path Gu Immortals."

Even without her pointing it out, the intense Gu Immortal aura on that mountain had already informed Fang Yuan.

After separating from Li Mei Hua, Fang Yuan stayed on Headless Mountain.

He rarely went out, staying mostly in his cave since Vaguely Familiar Face was not an invincible disguise.

Over the next ten days, immortals from both righteous and demonic factions continually arrived.

Most were rank six; rank seven arrivals caused commotions, and eventually, four rank eight Gu Immortals arrived as well!

One demonic path, one lone cultivator, and two of the righteous path.

The rank eight Gu Immortals stayed uninvolved while chosen representatives conducted difficult negotiations.

After seven days and nights of negotiation, they finally reached an agreement.

Righteous and demonic Gu Immortals agreed to hold an unprecedented grand contest around the nameless mountain.

The victor would claim the opportunity on the nameless mountain, while the other Gu Immortals were forbidden from attacking them for three years.
