# Chapter 962: Xiao Shan, Xiao Mang

At the bottom of Falling Heavenly River, immortal zombie Bo Qing looked emotionlessly at Song Zi Xing and Yu Mu Chun.

Though turned into an immortal zombie with a destroyed aperture, he still possessed ample rank eight immortal essence and intact sword path dao marks.

Bo Qing raised his finger, pointing at Song Zi Xing.

A thin sword light flashed.

Song Zi Xing did not even attempt to flee, facing death with a bitter smile.

Bo Qing pointed at Yu Mu Chun.

"No—! I cannot die!" Yu Mu Chun shouted, taking out an Immortal Gu in desperation.

Immortal zombie Bo Qing's movements froze.

Looking at his hand and the gory surroundings, he finally turned to Yu Mu Chun, asking hesitantly: "You are..."

Drenched in cold sweat, Yu Mu Chun replied weakly: "You are finally awake, Mo Yao. My gamble worked."

Yu Mu Chun's Immortal Gu awakened Mo Yao's remnant soul, expelling the heaven's will from the immortal zombie's mind.

Taking deep breaths, Yu Mu Chun continued: "Remember our agreement back then, to revive Bo Qing..."

"Bo Qing!"

Controlling the immortal zombie body, she nodded and interrupted: "Then what should I do now?"

Yu Mu Chun looked at Seven Star Child and Song Zi Xing's corpses, sighing.

With Seven Star Child and Song Zi Xing dead, Yu Mu Chun had to settle for attacking Combat Immortal Sect, abandoning Heavenly Lotus Sect.

"I hope they can be stalled!" Yu Mu Chun glanced in Heavenly Court's direction with deep worry.

Heavenly Court, Heaven Overseeing Tower.

Watching the projection as Bo Qing prepared to attack Combat Immortal Sect, Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord could no longer stand idly by.

Summoning Lian Jiu Sheng and Bi Chen Tian, he ordered: "Bai Cang Shui is dead, and Bo Qing has revived to attack Combat Immortal Sect. We must reinforce them immediately!"

The three immortals promptly used Heavenly Court's teleportation Gu formation, appearing at Combat Immortal Sect's base in an instant.

To the northwest, a grand sword light flew rapidly across the clear sky.

Southern Border's Xiao clan was once a super force, but with its supreme elder—its sole Gu Immortal—unseen for a century, it had declined into a large-scale clan.

Xiao clan's leader, Xiao Shan, stood on a slope, gazing at the mountainside headquarters with dejection and hatred in his eyes.

A figure ran up rapidly and bowed to Xiao Shan: "Xiao Zi Feng greets Lord Clan Leader."

He waved to Xiao Zi Feng: "Forget it, I will lay low at the back of the mountain for now."

At this moment, a voice suddenly resounded in his mind.

"Come here, my descendant!"

"Who is it?" Xiao Shan was suspicious and uncertain.

The voice was very familiar. Following its direction, Xiao Shan entered deep into the rear mountain until reaching Xiao clan's forbidden area.

"This is Xiao clan's forbidden area; even as clan leader, I have no authority to enter!" Xiao Shan hesitated, deeply troubled.

The voice rang again: "Why be timid, descendant? I am Xiao clan's Gu Immortal ancestor. Come receive my inheritance and strengthen our clan."

He hesitated no longer, he walked into the forbidden area.

Guided by the voice, he reached a cave and saw an Immortal Gu inside.

Before he reacted, the Immortal Gu became mystical light and fused into his body.

Yet upon inspecting his body, the Immortal Gu was nowhere to be seen.

Filled with trepidation and deep suspicion, Xiao Shan walked out of the forbidden area.

"Brother, while foreign enemies cause trouble, you violated clan rules and sneaked into the forbidden area!" Xiao Mang shouted, appearing with the elders. "You are unfit to lead!"

"Your explanations are mere excuses! According to clan rules, you are no longer a member of Xiao clan, and the position of clan leader is mine!" Xiao Mang shouted with furious, ruthless excitement and ambition in his eyes.

# Chapter 963: Yi Tian Mountain!

The sword light cut through the air with unbelievable speed.

"Hmm?" The sword light dissipated, revealing immortal zombie Bo Qing and Yu Mu Chun.

Controlled by Mo Yao's remnant soul, immortal zombie Bo Qing frowned with a sharp gaze, sweeping the surroundings with sword light.

Peerlessly sharp, the sword light rippled space and shattered illusions everywhere it passed, revealing the true scene.

A breath later, layers of illusions covered the true scenery again.

"This is Heavenly Lotus Sect's Immortal Gu House, Illusion Garden," Yu Mu Chun explained.

Just then, Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord, Bi Chen Tian, and Lian Jiu Sheng appeared.

"Escaping fate is a great sin. Attacking sects under Heavenly Court is unpardonable!" Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord shouted.

"You talk too much!" Bo Qing slashed a terrifying wave of sword light.

The unstoppable sword light shattered the three immortals' killer moves; though largely weakened, it still charged toward them.

Controlling the Immortal Gu House Illusion Garden, the three Heavenly Court rank eights combined their strength to trap Bo Qing's immortal zombie body and Yu Mu Chun inside.

Time passed, several days later.

Southern Border, on the nameless mountain.

Xiao Mang was sent flying, coughing up blood in midair.

Pale as paper, Xiao Mang stared wide-eyed at Xiao Shan with hatred and fury.

Behind Xiao Shan stood two rank five demonic path Gu Masters—one tall and fat, the other short and thin.

Cornered on this nameless peak, Xiao Shan had been on the verge of death when the two demonic Gu Masters intervened.

Xiao Mang shoved aside the elders supporting him and shouted: "Xiao Shan, you harbored evil intentions all along! As a clan leader of the righteous path, you were secretly colluding with demonic path Gu Masters!!"

Xiao Shan laughed loudly in grief and indignation: "I truly misjudged you—for power, you were actually willing to kill me! I treated you as my closest kin, yet you would kill me for power. Distort the facts as you like, others will see the truth!"

Dark light flickering in his eyes, Xiao Mang pondered: "I already hold the upper hand and righteousness. There is no need to go all out—after returning to Light Mountain, I can inherit the clan leader position! It will be wiser if I bide my time and kill him in the future."

"Xiao Shan, you righteous traitor, you will die like a dog. I'll spare your life for now, but just wait—I will come to take it! Let's go!"

Leaving behind these harsh words, Xiao Mang and the elders cautiously retreated.

"Brother Xiao, we meet again!" Seeing Xiao Mang leave, the tall, fat rank five demonic Gu Master, Sun Pang Hu, looked at Xiao Shan with tearful eyes.

The short, thin rank five Gu Master, Zhou Xing Xing, supported Xiao Shan's shoulder while activating a healing Gu: "Talk later, let's heal Brother Xiao first!"

Under the two Gu Masters' efforts, Xiao Shan's heavy injuries were quickly stabilized.

Xiao Shan sighed with an ashen expression: "Fortunately you two helped, otherwise I would have died! But my younger brother is ruthless and will definitely pursue me again. He won't rest until he kills me, I can heal these injuries myself, both of you leave, I don't want to implicate you two!"

"You saved my life back then, Brother Xiao!" Sun Pang Hu said boldly. "Since the righteous path rejects you, let us band together as demonic cultivators!"

The ancestor's voice spoke again: "Fool! Having inherited my Immortal Gu, build your own Xiao clan. Listen carefully to your task..."

The voice told him only passing this test would grant him the true inheritance, Immortal Gu, and the method to become a Gu Immortal.

"Hold this mountain for a hundred days against the righteous path to pass my test, claim the true inheritance, and become a Gu Immortal!"

"Good, let's go all out! Let these righteous hypocrites see our might!" Xiao Shan declared boldly.

Seeing the timing was right, Xiao Shan proposed becoming sworn brothers.

They decapitated a chicken, dripped its blood into a bowl of wine, drank together, and used Gu to swear an oath.

Xiao Shan sighed: "Yesterday's righteous Xiao Shan is dead; today, only demonic Xiao Shan stands here. We will build a village on this mountain and welcome all demonic cultivators to resist the righteous path!"

Xiao Shan grasped their arms: "To succeed, we must trust each other in brotherhood and loyalty. Our village shall be called Yi Tian Village! This mountain shall be called Yi Tian Mountain!"

Far away, Fang Yuan sighed as he watched.

Indeed, this mountain hiding the Immortal Gu House Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage and the rank eight Great Strength True Martial immortal zombie was Yi Tian Mountain.

He just hadn't expected this to be the true reason behind his previous life's battle of Yi Tian Mountain.

His gaze pierced through the soil again, inspecting the Immortal Gu House deep underground.

Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage suppressed the rank eight immortal zombie, its leaking power forming the forbidden zone while food path profundities kept its Gu worms fed.

Though possessing the Great Strength True Martial Physique, the rank eight immortal zombie mainly cultivated wisdom path.

Unwilling to be suppressed, he had used a killer move, attempting to refine the Immortal Gu House with his battle will.

His soul perished completely, leaving only an empty shell.

Vast amounts of his battle will remained in the Immortal Gu House, purified by its power into ownerless battle will.

When battles erupted on Yi Tian Mountain, Gu Masters' fighting intent formed battle will that resonated with the Immortal Gu House, gradually converting the pure battle will into their own.

Whoever converted all the battle will would finish refining Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage, becoming its true owner.

The Southern Border Gu Immortals' gambling contest revolved around this point.

Because the immortal forbidden zone had expanded to ten thousand li, Gu Immortals could not act personally and had to choose mortals as representatives.

Xiao Shan was the representative chosen by Xiao clan's supreme elder.

He carried the supreme elder's Immortal Gu, immortal essence, and battle will.

Naturally, Xiao Mang was likewise a pawn of Xiao clan's supreme elder.

# Chapter 964: Gua Lao Borrows Money

After naming Yi Tian Mountain, Xiao Shan invited demonic cultivators from all over to gather.

When news of his fortified village spread, many responded immediately.

Moreover, Southern Border Gu Immortals secretly fueled the situation to easily place their pawns on the battlefield.

Thus, more demonic Gu Masters and lone cultivators joined Yi Tian Village.

In just six to seven days, Yi Tian Village gained over thirty members, astonishing even Xiao Shan.

Possessing the highest strength and reputation, Xiao Shan was chosen by all as Yi Tian Village's leader, firmly holding the top seat.

His sworn brothers Sun Pang Hu and Zhou Xing Xing took second and third rank respectively, being rank five experts with strength second only to him.

In a cave, Fang Yuan drank wine with a Gu Immortal.

This demonic rank six Gu Immortal was a short old man with a large head named Gua Lao.

"Brother Sheng Ying, take a sip—how is my melon wine?" Gua Lao enthusiastically urged Fang Yuan.

Knowing Gua Lao's purpose, Fang Yuan drank a mouthful and nodded: "Not bad, not bad."

Observing him, Gua Lao chuckled and pointed outside: "What does Brother Sheng Ying think of Southern Border's grand contest?"

Fang Yuan calmly replied: "With Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage at stake, all factions have placed wagers and bound themselves to the agreement."

Participating Gu Immortals placed wagers; higher bets allowed deploying higher-cultivation pawns earlier.

Gu Immortals would be ranked by the battle will refined, determining their share of the redistributed wagers.

Whoever refined over fifty percent would claim ownership of the Immortal Gu House.

As the contest progressed, Gu Immortals could raise their bets if desired.

The demonic immortal Gua Lao before Fang Yuan was precisely looking to raise his bet.

"The contest has just begun, yet Xiao clan's supreme elder already leads. Using Xiao Shan, Xiao clan's supreme elder was first to refine the battle will after clashing with Xiao Mang. As long as Xiao Shan lives, his lead grows."

Fang Yuan glanced at him: "As a rank five Gu Master entering first, Xiao Shan naturally gives Xiao clan's supreme elder a massive advantage. But, he has also paid a large price for this, although he is only a rank seven Gu Immortal, his wagers are the highest, to the extent that even rank eight Gu Immortals cannot match it."

Gua Lao nodded repeatedly, grinning with yellow teeth: "Yes, the earlier we place pawns on Yi Tian Mountain, the greater the benefit. Brother Sheng Ying, I won't conceal it from you, I really hate not being able to put myself as a wager! I am a bit short on funds right now, brother Sheng Ying, could you lend me some immortal materials? Wait till this is over, and I will return double the amount!"

Fang Yuan smiled: "Sure."

Delighted, Gua Lao was about to offer thanks when Fang Yuan added: "But we must make a vow."

Gua Lao's expression stiffened: "Brother Sheng Ying, are you joking? If I had an Immortal Gu, why would I pursue this Immortal Gu House?"

Fang Yuan's face turned cold: "Without even one Immortal Gu, you dare scheme for an Immortal Gu House? Too greedy!"

"Sheng Ying, you—" Gua Lao was about to flare up when he sensed an unconcealed Immortal Gu aura from Fang Yuan.

"He actually has Immortal Gu!" Gua Lao's heart immediately sank.

Terrified, Gua Lao swallowed his anger and bowed: "I was too rash, Brother Sheng Ying, please forgive me!"

Fang Yuan gave a cold snort: "You can leave."

"Leaving, leaving now! Farewell!" Smiling, Gua Lao retreated several steps and hurried away, not daring to linger.

Inside the cave, Fang Yuan was thinking.

Gua Lao's visit revealed the gambling mindset of many bottom-tier Gu Immortals.

Lacking Immortal Gu, they thirsted for the Immortal Gu House, dreaming of soaring to the sky in a single leap.

Fang Yuan then thought of Xiao clan's supreme elder.

The rank seven elder faced impending doom: barely surviving his last tribulation, an even deadlier one was approaching before he could recover.

Obtaining the Immortal Gu House would give him immense assurance in surviving it.

Thus, he went all-in on this gamble with the highest wagers, earning the right to select two pawns.

With Xiao Shan leading the demonic side and Xiao Mang in the righteous camp, the supreme elder was covered regardless of who triumphed.

"I intentionally leaked an Immortal Gu aura so other Gu Immortals would be wary and not view me as weak."

"I must participate in this contest. It is an invaluable chance to probe Southern Border's Gu Immortal world."

"As for this gamble, perhaps I can act personally..." A sharp light flashed in Fang Yuan's eyes.

# Chapter 965: Battle of Yi Tian Mountain (1/2)

An immortal forbidden zone—such was the power of Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage.

Covering thousands of li around Yi Tian Mountain, the zone heavily suppressed any entering Gu Immortal; going too deep risked their lives.

Under the external pressure of numerous competitors, this grand gambling contest was established.

Yet Fang Yuan keenly sensed a loophole in this forbidden zone.

This loophole was Immortal Gu.

Immortal Gu functioned inside despite diminished power; Xiao clan's supreme elder had even hidden an Immortal Gu in Xiao Shan for protection.

"Immortal Gu work inside, yet Gu Immortals cannot enter. Does the forbidden zone only target a Gu Immortal's physical body?"

Dao marks were not the answer: Immortal Gu carried dao marks, just as Gu Immortals' bodies did.

Fang Yuan quickly thought of an answer — immortal apertures!

Maybe immortal apertures were the most crucial difference.

Without apertures, Immortal Gu functioned freely. If the restriction targeted apertures, Fang Yuan could exploit this to attend in person.

"I differ from others by having two apertures. Spring Autumn Cicada is sealed in my first, mortal aperture, while my second, dead aperture stores most of my Gu."

"If I seal my immortal aperture and become a mortal rank five again, can I enter the forbidden zone?"

The more Fang Yuan considered it, the more hopeful he grew.

Though lacking a method to seal an immortal aperture, with Wisdom Gu and wisdom path grandmaster attainment, he could deduce one himself!

"Right, I could also draw inspiration from Blazing Heaven Demoness' fire path aperture-taking method. No, I needn't focus on that method itself. She created it from Old Immortal Kong Jue's inheritance—perhaps I can obtain his research directly from her."

Obtaining part of that inheritance would crucially aid Fang Yuan's deduction of the aperture-sealing method.

Fang Yuan did not invest much into this gambling contest.

Under the contest's terms, he could only select a rank three upper stage Gu Master to ascend Yi Tian Mountain after three months.

The rank eight Great Strength True Martial immortal zombie was crucial to his plans, and Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage enticed him as well.

This was an Immortal Gu House after all!

Furthermore, it contained food path secrets—after countless years, not one Gu worm had starved.

Fang Yuan quietly left Yi Tian Mountain's vicinity, using Fixed Immortal Travel to secretly return to Hu Immortal blessed land.

In the days ahead, he monitored Yi Tian Mountain while actively deducing the immortal aperture sealing method.

The deduction progressed rapidly. Worthy of a rank nine Immortal Gu, even just using the light of wisdom provided immense help.

Over a month later.

The first attack since Xiao Shan established Yi Tian Village arrived, led by an expert from Wu clan, the closest super force.

Wu Shen Tong.

Wu clan elder, rank four peak stage, enslavement path Gu Master.

After several inconclusive clashes, the righteous and demonic forces reached an uneasy deadlock. "It seems Yi Tian Mountain's battle has changed because of me," Fang Yuan observed, comparing it to his previous life.

In his previous life, Wang Xiao had joined Yi Tian Mountain and slain many righteous experts, even attempting to usurp Xiao Shan's leadership.

However, Fang Yuan had killed Wang Xiao on San Cha Mountain, preventing him from joining and leaving the demonic faction at an early disadvantage.

While battles raged on Yi Tian Mountain, Fang Yuan struggled with deducing the immortal aperture sealing method.

Stuck at a crucial point, he needed to build upon another's foundation to quickly break through.

Fang Yuan sought help from Blazing Heaven Demoness.

Blazing Heaven Demoness possessed part of Old Immortal Kong Jue's inheritance, sufficient for Fang Yuan to overcome the bottleneck.

However, Blazing Heaven Demoness seized the opportunity to demand borrowing Fang Yuan's immortal killer move, vaguely familiar face.

Hei Lou Lan and the others sought a share, but Southern Border's Gu Immortals barred outside interference.

As Northern Plains Gu Immortals, showing up would invite a joint assault from Southern Border.

Thus, to interfere, Hei Lou Lan and the others needed Fang Yuan's vaguely familiar face.

Fang Yuan was unwilling to lend it, of course.

Lending the immortal killer move was different from lending Immortal Gu.

With no other choice, Fang Yuan could only agree.

Lending vaguely familiar face secured him Blazing Heaven Demoness's portion of Old Immortal Kong Jue's inheritance.

Though the price was steep, the returns were immediate.

With the bottleneck cleared, his deduction speed surged once more in smooth progress.

# Chapter 966: Battle of Yi Tian Mountain (2/2)

Central Continent.

The eight rank eight Gu Immortals from Heavenly Court gradually revealed their figures.

Forming a circle while heavily injured, they stared grimly at the aloof figure in their center.

Immortal zombie Bo Qing was standing upright and proud like a spear.

He slowly moved his eyes, a sword light suddenly flickered from them.

Yet the sword light extinguished in an instant.

The light in his eyes completely dissipated, leaving his body motionless as a stone statue.

"Success!"

"We finally killed the remnant soul within Bo Qing..."

Heavenly Court's Gu Immortals breathed sighs of relief, victorious at last.

Though renowned as a pseudo-Immortal Venerable, Bo Qing was merely a corpse inhabited by Mo Yao's remnant soul.

# Chapter 970: Rebirth, Ghost Face, Red Lotus!

With Spring Autumn Cicada shattered in the River of Time, Fang Yuan's will was like a drowning baby that had lost its boat.

The surging River of Time would instantly engulf and destroy his will without a trace.

The ghost face looked at Fang Yuan's will and pulled faces in silent mockery.

# Chapter 973: Spring Dream Fruit Tree

Such an achievement proved him qualified to attack Yu Lu blessed land even in vast Eastern Sea.

"This should be enough. At a hundred and eight steps away, I am already among the closest; moving further would only invite trouble," Fang Yuan assessed.

Thus, Fang Yuan stopped, looking at Blazing Heaven Demoness.

Blazing Heaven Demoness laughed internally; Fang Yuan truly understood the situation.

But leaving without fighting would cause trouble.

Soon, rank eight Gu Immortals from the three clans arrived in a loose alliance to confront Blazing Heaven Demoness.

Though alone, Blazing Heaven Demoness maintained a fierce stance, proposing a fight.

The four immortals flew into white heaven, fighting beyond everyone's sight.

Afterward, Blazing Heaven Demoness descended, laughing loudly as she left with Fang Yuan.

# Chapter 987: Star Fog Conceals Traces

Eastern Sea, Twin Polar Sea Strait.

Song Jia Dan rested beside the cliff with his eyes shut.

His lower body was encased in grey stone, while his heavily wrinkled upper body appeared extremely aged.

His eyelids fluttered as he sensed Song clan's first supreme elder, rank eight Song Qi Yuan, activate his token.

His unique wisdom path cultivation allowed him to fuse with the world and make highly accurate deductions.

Yet at the cost of his freedom, his lower body had petrified and fused into Twin Polar Sea Strait; once his lifespan expired, he would turn entirely to stone and perish.

Song Xia Qi spoke: "We have come for the Tian Nan inheritance in Ascending Heaven Plain."

Song Jia Dan pondered: "Ascending Heaven Plain's space path dao marks are ever-changing. Unable to go personally, I cannot deduce paths spontaneously. However, since the Ruo Lai and Cai clans lack strong wisdom path experts, you can succeed using my wisdom path Immortal Gu."

Song Yi Shi smiled faintly: "Uncle Jia Dan, circumstances in Ascending Heaven Plain have changed."

"Oh?"

Song Yi Shi recounted how Blazing Heaven Demoness and Fang Yuan had entered Ascending Heaven Plain.

Grasping their intention, Song Jia Dan said: "So you wish to hire Wisdom Star to help Song clan obtain the inheritance."

"Indeed. Wisdom Star is merely Tai Bai Yun Sheng's friend from Northern Plains who arrived with the earth tide, not a Zombie Alliance member. If Zombie Alliance can hire him, so can Song clan. His wisdom path attainment is formidable; if the other clans take action first, we will be at a disadvantage," Song Xia Qi said.

Song Yi Shi nodded: "Nothing escapes you, Uncle. To employ Wisdom Star, we must first investigate his background since he is an outsider. Thus, we need you to use your methods to test this Northern Plains wisdom path expert."

Song Jia Dan lowered his eyes with hesitation: "Wisdom Star Chen Dao unraveled my method on Shark Demon and achieved remarkable results in Ascending Heaven Plain, proving he possesses both wisdom path attainment and wisdom path Immortal Gu. Abruptly deducing such an expert violates the etiquette of wisdom path Gu Immortals. If I am careless, we risk provoking his animosity and creating a formidable enemy for our clan."

Song Yi Shi and Song Xia Qi exchanged glances before the latter said: "Every choice has risks and rewards. We have already consulted the first and second supreme elders—Cousin Jia Dan, please proceed."

After preparing for a while, he took action.

A long while later, a fatigued Song Jia Dan opened his eyes: "I could deduce nothing."

"What? Uncle, as one of Eastern Sea's three greatest wisdom path Gu Immortals, how could you fail?"

Song Jia Dan shook his head: "Human effort is limited, while heaven's will is unpredictable. Either Chen Dao blocked my methods, or he is not in Eastern Sea."

Central Continent, Hu Immortal blessed land.

"Star fog concealment!"

Starlight fog immediately billowed from his second immortal aperture.

The star fog soon shrouded Fang Yuan, blurring his features until only a vague silhouette remained visible.

"I finally succeeded in deducing the modified star fog concealment!"

This star fog concealment defended him against external deductions.

After negotiating with Blazing Heaven Demoness, he returned to Hu Immortal blessed land and used the light of wisdom to modify star fog concealment.

The modified star fog concealment retained two core Immortal Gu: Star Thought and the newly substituted Unravel Mystery.

With wisdom path grandmaster attainment level, Fang Yuan could finally unleash the power of Unravel Mystery Immortal Gu.

"My display at Ascending Heaven Plain will spread Wisdom Star's fame throughout Eastern Sea's Gu Immortal world. Soon, many will attempt deductions to gather information on me. Familiar face disguises me but cannot block deductions. With star fog concealment, I am far safer in Eastern Sea," Fang Yuan thought.

"This star fog is filled with fragmented star path and wisdom path dao marks, creating a jumble that blocks outside deductions. Even if Song Jia Dan deduces me, the fog will stall him briefly and alert me, allowing me to flee into a blessed land via Fixed Immortal Travel."

For now, he had to focus on refining rank six all-out effort Immortal Gu while patiently awaiting Blazing Heaven Demoness's move.

"In my previous life, Blazing Heaven Demoness successfully ousted Shark Demon and Su Bai Man, but poor timing forced her back to Northern Plains. Now, my involvement has accelerated progress in Yu Lu blessed land, giving her ample time to strike early. I hope Yu Lu blessed land's rewards prove less disappointing than the Starry Sky grotto-heaven fragment's dream realm."

Blazing Heaven Demoness settled matters in Eastern Sea Zombie Alliance, using Bo Dan as an excuse to oust Shark Demon and Su Bai Man just as before.

He would only take action when Blazing Heaven Demoness was attacking Yu Lu blessed land.

As expected, though mystical, the battlefield killer move unmoving troops lacked a controller and acted like an empty formation. Expending immense mental energy and immortal essence, Fang Yuan unraveled the final layer, capturing Yu Lu blessed land completely.

"The sole strength path Immortal Gu is a gift for Little Lan, so forget it. Per our agreement, you may take two rank six Immortal Gu. However, this rank six star path Immortal Gu ranks among the top ten mystical Gu and holds immense value. Choosing it forfeits your second pick," Blazing Heaven Demoness told Fang Yuan.

# Chapter 988: Star Eyes Immortal Gu

Central Continent, Star Form blessed land.

Fang Yuan focused single-mindedly on refining all-out effort Gu.

At his command, his second vital Gu, all-out effort Gu, plunged into the liquid.

Rumbling loudly, the surrounding rocks enveloped the liquid into a large muddy ball.

After days of painstaking refinement, inhaling deeply, Fang Yuan activated a special Gu worm against the golden ball.

With a bang, the golden ball exploded, scattering gold powder across three li.

"Failed!" Fang Yuan's expression turned grim, his expectant gaze dimming.

His invested immortal materials were wasted, leaving only refinement experience for the next attempt.

Sighing, Fang Yuan quickly composed himself.

After a brief rest, he activated Fixed Immortal Travel, leaving the blessed land for Southern Border.

Star Eyes!

It was his reward in Yu Lu blessed land.

As he activated the Immortal Gu, his pupils transformed into endlessly spinning whirlpools.

A formless attraction drew the night sky's starlight directly into his eyes.

Rank six Immortal Gu Star Eyes, tenth among the top ten mystical Gu!

Using Star Eyes, Fang Yuan could temporarily turn night sky stars into his own eyes for observation.

Black heaven's starlight shone over all five regions; anywhere it reached could be seen and investigated by Fang Yuan.

"It is a pity. Without this weakness, its position would rise by two or three places."

Star Eyes Immortal Gu could not be used immediately; it first required connecting with the stars.

These two starlight traces connected respectively to Fang Yuan's pupils and a star in black heaven.

With Star Eyes Immortal Gu's continued activation, he gradually discerned a faint blue speck in the darkness.

"In time, this blue light will expand, regaining its star form. Hopefully the star I chose is dim, otherwise utilizing it will require immense time and effort!"

The sky turned bright, Fang Yuan finally stopped.

He calculated: over one night, activating Star Eyes had consumed eight beads of immortal essence!

"Star Eyes ranks tenth partly because its expenditure is so high. Refining a star costs around ten rank six Immortal Gu refinement attempts. Thankfully, I can bear it."

"With my grandmaster star path attainment and the light of wisdom, Star Eyes can form powerful immortal killer moves. Most importantly, if I combine Star Eyes with Fixed Immortal Travel..."

In the following days, Fang Yuan attempted refining all-out effort Gu while deciphering Fairy Yu Lu's method to establish a battlefield killer move inside an immortal aperture.

Fang Yuan was most concerned about Luo Po valley.

He knew that Luo Po valley was undergoing the hundred days battle!

Central Continent's immortals under Feng Jiu Ge battled Shadow Sect under Qin Bai Sheng, but Fang Yuan could find no information.

He could only place investigative Gu about a hundred li from Luo Po valley.

"Unlike my previous life, I deliberately kept Xue Song Zi alive to bolster Shadow Sect's strength. The hundred days battle's overall situation will likely change."

Before a victor emerged, he refrained from interfering; having lost Self Strength and failed to refine all-out effort Gu, he lacked confidence.

Time passed; three days had now elapsed past when the hundred days battle had ended in his previous life.

Deducing with his fingers, Fang Yuan waited patiently in Northern Plains.

There was finally a reaction from Luo Po valley!

# Chapter 989: Chasing Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance

Two figures emerged from Luo Po valley, one after the other.

They were the Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance immortal zombie and Hei Cheng!

Fang Yuan deduced: "Sparing Xue Song Zi only stalled the outcome by three days. Shadow Sect still lost, and apparently only the Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance immortal zombie and Hei Cheng escaped."

The Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance immortal zombie flew at high speed, streaking forward through the air like a black line.

"Who is it?!" The Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance immortal zombie stopped abruptly, eyes burning with fire.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng appeared, smiling coldly: "You are finally here; you die today!"

"Merely rank six, hmph!" Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance erupted with killing intent, pouncing at lightning speed.

Boom!

He struck Tai Bai Yun Sheng hard, but the figure dissipated into bubbles.

"An illusion!" Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance's heart skipped. "A mere rank six dares obstruct a rank seven? How did he know my location? Is he Central Continent's Northern Plains pawn? Did he avoid the hundred days battle due to weak battle strength, or did he just arrive? Or do Central Continent's Gu Immortals distrust him?"

"He is no match for me and carries Northern Plains aura; he must simply be stalling my escape!"

Unconcerned after discerning Tai Bai Yun Sheng's intent, Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance focused solely on escaping.

"Where do you think you're going? Stay." Fang Yuan finally caught up.

Using Fixed Immortal Travel, Tai Bai Yun Sheng's stalling, and information path tracking, Fang Yuan easily caught up to Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance.

Seeing Fang Yuan, the Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance immortal zombie shuddered in terror.

"Feng Jiu Ge!" He screamed.

In truth, Fang Yuan had used familiar face to assume Feng Jiu Ge's appearance.

Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance was only rank seven; after enduring the hundred days battle and breaking out, less than half his battle strength remained.

Forcing him into star soul battlefield to drain his remaining strength made victory likely for Fang Yuan.

"Forget Hei Cheng for now; like a stray dog, he is in worse shape than in my previous life after losing his Immortal Gu House in Luo Po valley. Otherwise, why would Central Continent's immortals ignore him? He is heavily injured with only dark arrow Immortal Gu—he is no concern."

"This Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance immortal zombie is crucial; at Yi Tian Mountain, he served as a formation core in the ten extreme immortal zombie lifeless formation!"

"In my previous life, Old Ancestor Xue Hu captured him alive. My chances of capturing him are high."

"Capturing him will let me soul search him and expose Shadow Sect's secrets. Of course, if his soul was tampered with, it will be like Xue Song Zi in my previous life. Even then, killing him would be a huge loss to the execution of Shadow Sect's plans."

"Is it really Feng Jiu Ge?" thought the Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance immortal zombie as Fang Yuan approached.

As a core Shadow Sect member, Qin Bai Sheng's plan was not hidden from him.

Before breaking out, he had seen Qin Bai Sheng drag Feng Jiu Ge, Ao Xue, and Ling Mei into the Thieving Heaven true inheritance space to eliminate them with winds of assimilation.

"Unless Feng Jiu Ge, Ao Xue, or Ling Mei is an otherworldly demon! But we investigated that beforehand!"

Thus, he decided to use his investigative immortal killer move.

After investigating, he broke out in cold sweat.

"This is the real Feng Jiu Ge!" Instantly, the Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance immortal zombie wished for a hundred pairs of wings to fly away faster.

"My familiar face can fool even rank eight Gu Immortals; how could you see through it? Protected by star fog concealment, even wisdom path methods would take long to deduce my identity."

Fang Yuan's flying speed could not match the Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance immortal zombie.

Fang Yuan had already thoroughly scouted the surrounding area using wisdom path methods.

As long as he knew the Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance immortal zombie's heading, Fang Yuan teleported ahead to block his path.

Chasing and intercepting him repeatedly, Fang Yuan gradually herded the Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance immortal zombie toward the area of his arrangements.

There, Fang Yuan had placed numerous Gu worms to prepare most of star soul battlefield. Once within range, activating his Immortal Gu would complete the battlefield within breaths.

Just as he was herded toward Fang Yuan's trap, the Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance immortal zombie suddenly turned and struck back with an immortal killer move!

The blazing red flames shot towards Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan's eyes flashed sharply, he had to retreat!

The Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance immortal zombie laughed heartily: "Lowly rat, you actually dared deceive me!"

Fang Yuan sighed secretly; no plan was perfect. His biggest flaw was his slow flying speed.

The Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance immortal zombie flew far faster than Fang Yuan, whose condition was already strained from enslaving the featherman Gu Immortal.

Enraged by Fang Yuan's deception, the Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance immortal zombie charged furiously at this fake 'Feng Jiu Ge'.

Fang Yuan suddenly smiled, laughing: "Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance immortal zombie, you fell for it! Everyone, my mission is complete, I leave the rest to you."

Shocked, the Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance immortal zombie instinctively spun around and fled for his life.

# Chapter 990: Fang Yuan's Second Entry into Luo Po Valley

Seeing the Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance immortal zombie fly off, Fang Yuan relaxed and promptly departed in the opposite direction.

Fang Yuan flew toward the area where he had prepared the battlefield killer move, arriving shortly after.

There, Tai Bai Yun Sheng had been waiting already.

"The strategy to force the Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance immortal zombie here failed." Fang Yuan said solemnly.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng sighed in relief: "That may be for the best. With just the two of us, dealing with a rank seven Gu Immortal is very dangerous. Actually, Fang Yuan, you do not need to be so anxious, Central Continent still hasn't found us, right? Even if they found us, master would not leave us in the lurch. Don't forget, we have Fixed Immortal Travel, where can we not go in this world? We can develop peacefully now and accumulate our strength. Why must we constantly place ourselves in danger?"

Fang Yuan did not tell Tai Bai Yun Sheng about the Immortal Gu House.

It was not that he shunned peaceful development, but circumstances forbade it. Unlike Fang Yuan, Tai Bai Yun Sheng lacked five hundred years of rebirth experience to grasp how deep the Gu Immortal world's secrets ran.

"I have my considerations." Fang Yuan glanced at Tai Bai Yun Sheng, then gazed into the horizon: "Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance hasn't pursued us all this time; he is truly cool-headed! With his intelligence, he must have realized I was lying quickly, yet rather than succumbing to rage, he seized the chance to flee."

"Oh, you." Tai Bai Yun Sheng sighed: "Still, this Gu formation you set up is remarkable. Was it obtained from Yu Lu blessed land as well?"

Fang Yuan said: "Tens of thousands of li is nothing compared to Eighty-Eight True Yang Building, which covered all Northern Plains! Continuously weakened by star soul battlefield, the pitiful Hei Cheng had no choice but to scream surrender.

Fang Yuan spared his life, capturing him alive instead.

Hei Cheng held great value; selling him to Hei Lou Lan would allow Fang Yuan to extort a massive sum.

Before that, however, Fang Yuan needed to thoroughly soul search Hei Cheng.

"My next target is Luo Po valley. Combined with Dang Hun Mountain, my soul foundation will rapidly grow, eliminating the slavery backlash!" Fang Yuan strongly coveted the valley.

"Qin Bai Sheng trapped Feng Jiu Ge by unknown means. Central Continent's Gu Immortals have occupied Luo Po valley; it is not yet time to strike."

The Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance immortal zombie fled into Earth Trench, discovering Old Ancestor Xue Hu stealing immortal zombie corpses.

Together, Blazing Heaven Demoness, Hei Lou Lan, and Fairy Li Shan placed immense pressure on Fang Yuan.

Eastern Sea Zombie Alliance ordered Blazing Heaven Demoness back to Northern Plains to defend Dark Flow Giant City.

As leader of Northern Plains Zombie Alliance's branch, Blazing Heaven Demoness could not refuse.

Fang Yuan presented Blazing Heaven Demoness a plan, claiming he had deduced it using wisdom path methods.

Blazing Heaven Demoness praised him: "This plan is brilliant. Old Ancestor Xue Hu is difficult to deal with, but lacks immortal materials to refine fortune rivalling heaven Immortal Gu. Knowing your personality, what do you want in return for this plan?"

Fang Yuan told her he wanted strength path immortal zombie bodies.

Blazing Heaven Demoness hesitated, but considering Fang Yuan's deep background, she agreed.

This provided a fallback should he fail to obtain the Immortal Gu House and the rank eight Great Strength True Martial immortal zombie.

Investigating Central Continent, Fang Yuan learned their Gu Immortals had begun departing Northern Plains.

"It is time to take Luo Po valley."

Mobilizing Tai Bai Yun Sheng and Zhou Zhong, Fang Yuan used Fixed Immortal Travel to reach Luo Po valley's deepest part.

Hui Feng Zi, who had surrendered to Central Continent, was guarding against anyone entering Luo Po valley, unaware Fang Yuan was already inside.

Immortal Gu Pulling Mountain!

Just as Fang Yuan activated this Immortal Gu to store Luo Po valley into his immortal aperture, a change occurred.

In his ears, a voice could be heard.

It was the song Star Constellation Immortal Venerable had once sung in the dream realm—

"Fallen songs and despondent heroes, difficulty in resisting the trials of fate."

"Bent swords sink in the sand, rising and falling from ancient times, the rumbling of an unceasing heavenly river."

"Alas..."

"Spectral night carries a soul into endless dreams, where can one rest in peace?"

"During spring and autumn body and mind shifts, only heaven's will remains vast and boundless."

This time, Fang Yuan heard it clearly as a wave of information entered his mind.

"Luo Po valley actually has a Thieving Heaven true inheritance?!"

# Chapter 991: Inheriting the Thieving Heaven True Inheritance!

"Could this be a Central Continent trap—with no true inheritance, but rather a wisdom path method designed to sway the rationality of intruders entering the valley?"

Fang Yuan quickly calmed down and thoroughly inspected himself and the surrounding environment.

Pondering with lowered head, he felt that despite its strangeness, credibility was high!

First was Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's song, and second was the instruction directing Fang Yuan to use open door Gu to access the Thieving Heaven true inheritance.

"As a wisdom path grandmaster, ordinary methods cannot sway me. Verifying this is simple; I just need to test it myself."

Fang Yuan made a decision and cautiously neared the location.

He bypassed four Gu formations and unraveled three.

After a while, he reached the location indicated by Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's song.

After confirming repeatedly, his eyes flashed and he decisively used open door Gu.

An entrance of light suddenly appeared in the air.

Shortly, a beam of light shined on the prepared Fang Yuan.

Shocked, Fang Yuan thought briefly before letting the beam of light engulf him.

The next moment, Fang Yuan entered the Thieving Heaven true inheritance space.

This space was vast, extremely vast.

Hearing wind nearby, Fang Yuan looked toward the source and was immediately shaken.

"Winds of assimilation!"

Dozens of huge tornadoes of winds of assimilation moved slowly through the true inheritance space.

Fang Yuan quickly retreated, distancing himself from the winds of assimilation.

Only after retreating hundreds of steps did he feel slightly relieved, carefully surveying the true inheritance space.

"To think there truly was a space here! Was that mysterious information real?" Cautious, Fang Yuan still doubted the clues from Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's song.

"According to the information, these winds of assimilation are genuine yet harmless to me. I can only claim the true inheritance after dispelling them."

Carefully approaching a tornado of winds of assimilation, Fang Yuan revealed his true form and extended his eight large arms.

He slowly moved one of his hands towards the tornado.

Suddenly, the roaring winds of assimilation completely dissipated.

He mumbled: "Incredible! Winds of assimilation assimilate everything, yet they are so restrained here. This method alone proves they are a peerless expert!"

One after another, the tornadoes of winds of assimilation vanished through Fang Yuan's efforts.

He extended a finger and touched the dark green tornado.

The winds of assimilation suddenly disappeared, revealing a person!

Sitting cross-legged in mid-air in a red and white robe, this person exuded a faint rank seven aura.

"Feng Jiu Ge!" Fang Yuan exclaimed softly, subconsciously retreating.

Yet Feng Jiu Ge was faster, snapping his eyes open with a sharp gaze.

That sharp gaze swept over Fang Yuan before Feng Jiu Ge transformed into a rainbow light, flying past him at lightning speed into the entrance of light!

Reacting quickly, Fang Yuan immediately activated close door Gu.

The entrance of light closed and Fang Yuan finally relaxed.

"Why is Feng Jiu Ge here?! Was he trapped in this true inheritance space? Since he was here, what about Qin Bai Sheng, Ao Xue, and Ling Mei?"

Fang Yuan inspected quickly, but the true inheritance space was empty except for an information path mortal Gu hovering before him.

"Fang Yuan, so you are an otherworldly demon; I will keep this secret for you. Wondering how I recognized you? I am Feng Jin Huang's father. You saved my life today; in the future, I will save yours. After I leave, only you will remain in the true inheritance space to inherit Thieving Heaven's legacy. We shall meet again someday!"

"Feng Jiu Ge...." Fang Yuan grasped this letter Gu with a complex expression.

He sighed before storing the Gu into his immortal aperture.

At this moment, the true inheritance space began to dim.

A charming masculine voice came from the darkness.

"Traveler from far away."

"You and I are the same, both pitiful souls unable to return home."

"My true name is Ben Jie Sun, though this world calls me Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable. In truth, I am just a vagrant longing to return home."

"If you also want to return home, accept my gift."

"I believe it will aid you, but returning home still requires your own efforts!"

"This gift's name is — Ghostly Concealment."

The next moment, Fang Yuan appeared in Luo Po valley.

A layer of grey light enveloped his entire body.

Ignoring the grey light, Fang Yuan deployed investigative and defensive methods, staying vigilant of his surroundings.

"His injuries seem severe, leaving him with less than half his strength. Otherwise, he might have struck against me in the true inheritance space."

"Yet he clearly distinguishes kindness and hatred, repaying both in kind, as his posthumous biography explained. His promise to repay me for saving his life is likely... true."

Having Feng Jiu Ge owe him a favor was a massive connection that would likely prove invaluable in the future.

"Feng Jiu Ge has likely left Luo Po valley; now is the best time to take it." Thinking this, Fang Yuan decisively took action.

"What's going on?!" Hui Feng Zi, guarding the valley, widened his eyes in shock and shouted incredulously: "Someone is taking away Luo Po valley?!"

# Chapter 992: Fang Yuan Outwits Hui Feng Zi

Hui Feng Zi was startled and furious.

Seeing Fang Yuan, the startled and furious Hui Feng Zi shuddered intensely, calling out in fear: "Feng Jiu Ge!"

Having returned home, the Central Continent Gu Immortals would naturally leave arrangements behind in Northern Plains. How could the astute Fang Yuan fail to guess this?

Thus, while taking Luo Po valley, he turned into Feng Jiu Ge.

"So Central Continent arranged Hui Feng Zi to guard this place... Judging by his expression, did he not see Feng Jiu Ge leave earlier? Thus, he did not speak to me inside the true inheritance space."

"He is real!" After using investigative methods to confirm Feng Jiu Ge's identity, Hui Feng Zi sighed in relief.

"This subordinate greets Lord Feng Jiu Ge." Subservient, Hui Feng Zi flew forward and paid respects to Fang Yuan.

"Mm." Fang Yuan nodded. "I understand the situation. Guard me—I must not be interrupted while taking Luo Po valley."

"Yes, lord!" Hui Feng Zi quickly replied.

"Even with Luo Po valley gone, many blessed lands remain. Stay guard here and prevent any mishaps," Fang Yuan told Hui Feng Zi gravely before leaving.

"Feng Jiu Ge's escape confirms Qin Bai Sheng is dead." Watching him leave, Hui Feng Zi sighed at Feng Jiu Ge's immense strength.

Hui Feng Zi thought: "Oh no. The ten great ancient sects have internal rivalries. As Feng Jiu Ge belongs to Spirit Affinity House, I cannot stop him from taking Luo Po valley, but I must notify the other nine sects."

Prince Feng Xian quickly received his letter.

"Oh? Feng Jiu Ge is alive? Not only did he emerge, he even claimed Luo Po valley!" Prince Feng Xian laughed in great joy.

Leaving Hui Feng Zi, Fang Yuan flew to a safe location to meet Tai Bai Yun Sheng and the featherman Gu Immortal Zhou Zhong.

Returning to Star Form blessed land, Fang Yuan placed Luo Po valley there.

Hei Lou Lan frequently visited Hu Immortal blessed land, making Star Form blessed land the wiser choice.

In the Thieving Heaven true inheritance, Fang Yuan obtained ghostly concealment.

Inspecting his body, Fang Yuan found his soul covered in a layer of dao marks.

Thus, Fang Yuan visited Lang Ya blessed land to ask about Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable.

Without concealing anything or making demands, Lang Ya land spirit shared plenty of information.

"Thieving Heaven left many inheritances, but only ten true inheritances. The one you got earlier to have me refine three Gu was not a true inheritance. Every Thieving Heaven true inheritance is an unparalleled treasure containing the essence of his cultivation, granting immense potential to anyone who obtains it. The sole requirement: the inheritor must be an otherworldly demon!"

"Legend says Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable possessed two defensive killer moves: divine concealment and ghostly concealment. Divine concealment concealed one from deductions by thoughts, wills, and emotions. Ghostly concealment is mysterious; I know little except that it relates to the soul. Ah? Why are you suddenly asking about Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable? Did you find a clue to a true inheritance?"

Fang Yuan laughed: "You guessed correctly."

"Divine concealment, ghostly concealment..." Lang Ya land spirit sighed in awe. "With divine concealment, Lang Ya blessed land would become a true paradise, never facing heavenly tribulations or earthly calamities again. It's a pity his ten true inheritances are so elusive; I haven't heard of anyone obtaining them. They come in pairs—divine concealment and ghostly concealment form a pair, where getting one grants clues to the other. Fang Yuan, if you obtain divine concealment and contribute it to Lang Ya Sect, I'll make you second supreme elder. Second only to me, you'll wield immense authority across the sect! In fact, you can take a rank seven Immortal Gu from my inventory. No, at least two rank seven Immortal Gu!"

Returning to Hu Immortal blessed land, Fang Yuan sank into deep thought, his gaze flickering.

"As a transmigrator, though my body is native, my soul comes from outside. Thus, as an otherworldly demon, I qualify for Thieving Heaven's true inheritances."

"Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's earlier words indicated that he was also an otherworldly demon."

"Yet after obtaining ghostly concealment, I found no trace of divine concealment. Has someone already taken it?"

# Chapter 993: Immortal Zombie Bo Qing Appears

"Actually, I am more curious about that song than ghostly concealment!"

Logically, a song from a dream realm should bear no connection to reality. Yet Fang Yuan's experience in Luo Po valley proved it held immense prophetic significance.

"Prophecy has always been the specialty of wisdom path experts, like Immortal Yi Yan's Prophecy of Three Venerables. Could this dream realm be a prophecy left by Star Constellation Immortal Venerable?" Fang Yuan guessed.

"Fallen songs and despondent heroes, difficulty in resisting the trials of fate... the first verse referred to Luo Po valley's Thieving Heaven true inheritance and Feng Jiu Ge. What about the second verse?"

"Bent swords sink in the sand, rising and falling from ancient times, the rumbling of an unceasing heavenly river."

His deductions made him increasingly certain the second verse pointed to Sword Immortal Bo Qing.

Coupled with previous life memories, Fang Yuan grew even more determined to explore Falling Heavenly River.

Though filled with danger, the corpses of ancient and immemorial desolate beasts and desolate plants in Falling Heavenly River were superior immortal materials.

"Sword Immortal Bo Qing's appearance offers much to reap, but it is not yet the optimal time to explore. First, erratic sword lights inflict lethal wounds with the slightest graze. Second, Falling Heavenly River is fraught with ancient and immemorial desolate beasts, desolate plants, hidden undercurrents, and whirlpools."

Once Bo Qing's sword lights finished erupting, Falling Heavenly River would be cleansed—the beasts and dangerous plants temporarily cleared, and natural traps mostly destroyed. That would be the optimal time to enter.

Rank eight Gu Immortal Prince Feng Xian was one of Northern Plains' peak experts, but his true identity was a Central Continent mole planted by Spirit Affinity House when he was still a Gu Master.

Deeply worried during Feng Jiu Ge's disappearance, Prince Feng Xian was overjoyed to learn from Hui Feng Zi's message that he had reappeared.

Little did he know that the 'Feng Jiu Ge' in the message was actually Fang Yuan in disguise.

He waited several days, but Feng Jiu Ge never arrived at his residence.

While Prince Feng Xian harbored doubts, a letter arrived from Spirit Affinity House.

The letter stated that Zhao Lian Yun had obtained divine concealment days ago, and that ghostly concealment lay in Luo Po valley's Thieving Heaven true inheritance.

Merely considering the time when Zhao Lian Yun obtained divine concealment, Prince Feng Xian knew someone had intentionally delayed matters.

He immediately grasped Feng Jiu Ge's plan: "Feng Jiu Ge is keeping a low profile to see who in the sect harbors ill intent. Or perhaps he already knew, and is using this chance to drag them into the abyss!"

"Yet he is safest in my residence, and he needs my aid to return to Central Continent. He is no fool, but a champion who plans and schemes! So if I am to search, I should check the surrounding areas first."

Prince Feng Xian's eyes gleamed sharply as he immediately took action.

Soon, Prince Feng Xian discovered Feng Jiu Ge.

"Hahaha, Brother Jiu Ge, I had to search for a while." He laughed heartily as he patted Feng Jiu Ge's shoulder.

"I hope Brother Prince doesn't blame me." Feng Jiu Ge looked slightly pale.

"I understand." Prince Feng Xian nodded, "Let's go. My grotto-heaven is the safest place for you to recuperate."

Entering the grotto-heaven, the two conversed about Luo Po valley.

Prince Feng Xian was disgruntled: "Hui Feng Zi was negligent and deserves punishment. As for the Gu Immortal who took Luo Po valley, he might be from Shadow Sect."

Fang Yuan's image flashed in Feng Jiu Ge's mind, but he remained silent.

Prince Feng Xian continued: "I messaged the sect after seeing you. Your survival is great news—I couldn't let your wife and daughter grieve in sorrow any longer. When your injuries heal, I'll host a celebration for seven days and seven nights before letting you return to Central Continent. Us brothers must drink until we're drunk!"

When the news reached Spirit Affinity House, the higher-ups rejoiced greatly.

Because news of Feng Jiu Ge arrived early, the leadership held no emergency meeting, and Fairy Bai Qing did not go investigate Bo Qing.

However, the immortal zombie Bo Qing still appeared.

Swords roam unhindered over Central Continent!

Countless sword lights shocked immortals and mortals.

When the sword lights ceased, countless Gu Immortals surged toward Falling Heavenly River.

Fang Yuan, however, had already arrived before them.

Before him, Falling Heavenly River was dyed blood-red, filled with floating immortal materials!

# Chapter 994: Stealing Bo Qing's Immortal Gu

Amid the floating corpses in Falling Heavenly River, Fang Yuan gathered valuable immortal materials. "This seems to be a life and death kun-peng!" Fang Yuan gasped in surprise.

"The life and death kun-peng is a unique law path immemorial desolate beast filled with life and death dao marks. It has two forms: fish and bird. It lives as a fish for eight thousand years, turns into a bird upon dying, and dies permanently after another eight thousand years. This one seems close to becoming a bird, likely over seven thousand years old."

The kun-peng corpse was well-preserved; aside from a partially severed head, its entire body remained intact.

"This life and death kun-peng is probably my greatest harvest this trip." Storing it in his aperture, Fang Yuan sighed inwardly.

At this moment, bloody water frothed across Falling Heavenly River.

Hordes of fierce beasts and immemorial aquatic plants fought over the severed limbs and corpses.

Lacking sufficient battle strength, Fang Yuan worked quickly to collect the immortal materials floating on the surface.

He hesitated, wanting to leave while safe yet eager to explore the riverbed.

After all, Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's second line seemed to refer to Bo Qing's immortal zombie body.

Just then, Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's singing echoed in his mind once more.

"Spectral night carries a soul into endless dreams, where can one rest in peace?"

"During spring and autumn body and mind shifts, only heaven's will remains vast and boundless."

As the voice faded, a second wave of mysterious information entered his mind.

"Sword Immortal Bo Qing, Mo Yao's remnant soul!" Shocked, Fang Yuan's eyes shone with brilliant light.

"So what if I take another risk? Obtaining Sword Immortal Bo Qing's sword path Immortal Gu, even without displaying their true power, could rival part of an Immortal Gu House."

Resolute, Fang Yuan immediately left the surface, diving deep into the river at a distant location.

Reaching the location indicated by the mysterious information, Fang Yuan stopped.

He took out Mo Yao's fake will.

Under Fang Yuan's control, Mo Yao's fake will slowly dissipated, spreading an intense aura.

Sensing this aura, a beam of light appeared as incomparable sword qi burst into the sky.

Startled, Fang Yuan almost retreated, but the sword qi did not attack; it merely cleared the surroundings, acting gently toward him.

In the beam of light, Sword Immortal Bo Qing's immortal zombie body slowly appeared.

Fang Yuan held his breath, looking at Bo Qing's immortal zombie body tightly.

The body's eyes remained closed, meaning Mo Yao's remnant soul inside was still in a semi-conscious state.

Sensing a familiar aura, the remnant soul had been drawn over early by Fang Yuan's methods.

Surrounded by sword light, Fang Yuan could only advance three steps.

"All my other methods are unusable. Only Mo Yao's will can disguise my aura and lure out the Immortal Gu in Bo Qing's immortal zombie body."

Fang Yuan moved cautiously, afraid any disturbance might wake the other party.

Following the mysterious information, Fang Yuan applied his method and soon lured out an Immortal Gu.

This translucent Immortal Gu resembled a swan's egg glowing with inner jade light. Up close, Fang Yuan felt a bone-chilling coldness emitting from it.

Though he knew neither its name nor its use, its aura revealed it to be a rank seven Immortal Gu!

Enveloping the Immortal Gu in Mo Yao's aura, Fang Yuan completely sealed it using wisdom path methods.

Soon, he repeated the method on Bo Qing.

After a long while, Fang Yuan drew out a second Immortal Gu.

# Chapter 995: Rank Eight Wisdom Sword Gu

This finger-sized Immortal Gu shone with bright silver and blue light. It resembled a centipede, but had soft, thin hair instead of multiple legs.

Bo Qing possessed the rank seven Sword Eyebrows Gu; rather than an attack type, it assisted sword path cultivation.

"This Immortal Gu is extremely valuable, but since I don't cultivate sword path, it is merely better than nothing." Wrapping it in Mo Yao's aura, Fang Yuan stored it carefully.

Soon, a third Immortal Gu appeared before Fang Yuan.

It lacked a fixed form, shifting between a snake and a sword. Pale blue and translucent, its entire body resembled water.

Based on his information, Fang Yuan deduced this was rank seven Wave Sword Gu.

The fourth Immortal Gu, Flying Sword, resembled a silver-winged dragonfly.

The fifth Immortal Gu was a movement-type Gu called Sword Escape.

Shaped like a golden bee, activating it turned the user into a sharp sword that pierced through space.

After collecting these five Immortal Gu, Fang Yuan refused to stop, continuing his method on the slumbering Bo Qing.

Two hours passed, Fang Yuan had barely any of Mo Yao's fake will left.

Large numbers of the investigative mortal Gu and Gu formations he had placed near Falling Heavenly River were suddenly uprooted.

Fang Yuan feared not the Gu Immortals, but immortal zombie Bo Qing. Lacking Mo Yao's fake will, if newcomers accidentally awakened Bo Qing, how would he react to seeing Fang Yuan stealing his Immortal Gu?

However, just as Fang Yuan was about to leave.

The sixth Immortal Gu finally appeared in front of him.

But its aura made Fang Yuan's eyes turn wide.

This was a rank eight sword path Immortal Gu!

No wonder it took so long to lure it out.

Using his earlier method, he took it into his immortal aperture.

Fang Yuan left Falling Heavenly River, relaxing himself.

Just as he prepared to use Fixed Immortal Travel, he shuddered.

"I remember now! This rank eight Immortal Gu is likely the legendary Wisdom Sword Gu!" Fang Yuan's eyes shone with immense joy.

"Bo Qing created this Immortal Gu. Despite his supreme battle strength, he once suffered greatly against wisdom path Gu Immortals, creating Wisdom Sword Immortal Gu specifically to counter them. This Immortal Gu is not just a sword path Immortal Gu, it also contains the ingenuity of wisdom path."

Fang Yuan decided that when subduing these Immortal Gu, he would prioritize this one!

His wisdom path grandmaster attainment gave him a keen intuition: mastering Wisdom Sword Immortal Gu would grant him far more than a rank eight Gu. His wisdom path methods would advance by leaps and bounds, undergoing a qualitative change!

Safely returning to Hu Immortal blessed land, Fang Yuan realized: "Dong Fang Chang Fan's wisdom path inheritance, wisdom path grandmaster attainment, rank six star thought Gu, rank eight wisdom sword Gu, and rank nine wisdom Gu... Without specific intention, my wisdom path prospects seem to have become the brightest. With my current state, strength path and time path seem to be more helpful to me, but in terms of prospects, wisdom path is far greater."

He produced abundant amounts of Mo Yao's fake will as expendable tools to seal the Immortal Gu.

"Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's dream realm prophecy is truly formidable! What do the remaining lines mean?"

# Chapter 996: Fang Yuan Cultivates His Soul

Central Continent, Heavenly Court.

Suddenly cultivating soul path would arouse Fairy Li Shan and Hei Lou Lan's suspicions, and Fang Yuan refused to leave them any clues.

Cultivating with guts Gu reduced their supply, so he secretly fed in extra souls to make up the difference.

After consuming immense amounts of guts Gu, Fang Yuan's soul reached its limit, risking collapse if pushed any further.

# Chapter 997: Refining Bo Qing's Immortal Gu

"I do not cultivate soul path; soul path Gu Immortals possess dao marks that let their bodies house stronger souls." Having reached his limit, Fang Yuan moved from Hu Immortal blessed land to Star Form blessed land.

Luo Po valley was placed here.

He directly let his soul leave his body.

Shrouded by the bewilderment fog, Fang Yuan's soul gradually diffused.

His soul had condensed by at least double, coated in an oily sheen that emitted a faint, eerie glow.

His soul's impurities had been purged in Luo Po valley, like iron hammered and smelted into steel, elevating its quality to a new level.

Meanwhile, Dang Hun Mountain's guts Gu strengthened his soul at an incredible speed, steadily increasing its quantitative strength.

"Beyond the soul, refining Bo Qing's sword path Immortal Gu would drastically boost my battle strength. That would be even better!"

Central Continent.

Flying out of the tower, Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord summoned Lian Jiu Sheng and Bi Chen Tian: "Bo Qing has revived as an immortal zombie and is attacking Heavenly Lotus Sect. We must reinforce them immediately!"

Reacting quickly, the three immortals used Heavenly Court's teleportation Gu formation, appearing instantly at Heavenly Lotus Sect's base.

Bo Qing and his companions had also just arrived, the residual light of their teleportation killer move still lingering on them.

A battle of rank eights suddenly erupted...

Central Continent, Hu Immortal blessed land, an underground cave.

"Success!" Fang Yuan looked at the Gu formation before him, his eyes shining with both joy and regret.

Deducing continuously under the light of wisdom for days, he had devised a powerful Gu formation to refine Bo Qing's sword path Immortal Gu.

Centered on the light of wisdom, this Gu formation utilized Mo Yao's fake will alongside poison path Immortal Gu Woman's Heart and wisdom path Immortal Gu Unravel Mystery to refine Bo Qing's Immortal Gu.

"Unfortunately, running this Gu formation for three days only refined one Immortal Gu, whose use remains unknown. I cannot wait any longer—the battle of Yi Tian Mountain has already begun. The sooner I claim the Immortal Gu House, the better; delay invites trouble!"

# Chapter 998: Prematurely Joining Yi Tian Mountain

Southern Border, Yi Tian Mountain.

His appearance had changed drastically: bulging muscles, bare chest, and thick hair covering his head, beard, chest, and legs.

After rebirth, Fang Yuan secretly killed this person.

Taking his place, Fang Yuan arrived at Yi Tian Mountain.

The battle between righteous and demonic factions had not even started its first wave.

But this time, Fang Yuan had arrived here several months early.

Xiao Shan had just been expelled from his clan, joining Zhou Xing Xing and Sun Pang Hu to establish Yi Tian Village.

In his previous life, vaguely familiar face had avoided exposure by these Southern Border Gu Immortals. Now using the immortal killer move Familiar Face with attitude Gu as the core, exposure was even more impossible!

It was a rank three demonic path Gu Master. Disguised as a rank three himself, Fang Yuan did not dare be careless, asking seriously: "You are?"

Fang Yuan cupped his fists, saying boorishly: "I am Huang Sha. I heard about Hero Xiao and came to join you."

"Keep it down, why shout? Since you know our leader's reputation, come meet him." The rank three Gu Master rubbed his ears and turned around.

Overjoyed, Xiao Shan turned around to see Fang Yuan.

He stepped forward, patting Fang Yuan's shoulders: "What a strong man!"

Fang Yuan laughed and cupped his fists: "You are Hero Xiao? I came to join you—you are truly brave to oppose the righteous path!"

Giving a thumbs-up, Fang Yuan added: "For that alone, I admire you and will follow you, but you must feed me three meals a day."

Hiding his thoughts, Xiao Shan praised Fang Yuan and assigned him a mission.

After Fang Yuan left, Xiao Shan summoned Zhou Xing Xing, asking: "What is Huang Sha's background? I know little about him."

Zhou Xing Xing chuckled: "Brother, given your stature, how could such a minor character amid so many people catch your attention? Later, he and a water path Gu Master held territory as the 'Bai Sha Twin Generals'. Tie clan Gu Masters eventually defeated them; Bai Jiang died while Huang Sha escaped. To think he came here after hearing Brother's name."

"Joining Yi Tian Mountain and being sent to build the village shows Xiao Shan isn't paying attention to me. Good, that was my goal. Everything has gone smoothly so far."

Yi Tian Mountain's forbidden zone targeted only immortal apertures, leaving Immortal Gu unaffected.

Having deduced how to seal immortal apertures in his past life and prepared the method in advance, Fang Yuan could join Yi Tian Village months earlier.

By day, he breezed through construction labor. At night, while everyone slept, he stayed awake to secretly refine Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage.

Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage was suppressing the Great Strength True Martial immortal zombie, not allowing any freedom.

Rather than probing the Great Strength True Martial immortal zombie, he concentrated on refining battle will.

To refine the battle will into their own, the gambling Southern Border Gu Immortals needed their mortal Gu Master pawns to fight fiercely, generating battle will that resonated with the Immortal Gu House.

Present in person and a wisdom path grandmaster, Fang Yuan had no need for such methods.

Even without fierce combat, he could generate battle will in his mind and convert the Immortal Gu House's battle will far more efficiently than ordinary Gu Immortals.

Turning all the battle will in the Immortal Gu House into one's own would complete the rank eight immortal zombie's final step: refining the Immortal Gu House to become its true owner!

"As a wisdom path grandmaster, I hold a massive advantage in battle will clashes. Furthermore, I will take the lead and refine battle will far faster than others. The more battle will I convert, the greater my advantage in the contest. Following my plan practically guarantees obtaining the Immortal Gu House, barring unforeseen surprises..."

While Fang Yuan pondered, the other Southern Border Gu Immortals harbored their own schemes.

Xiao clan's supreme elder paid close attention to developments on Yi Tian Mountain.

Wagering the highest stake, the rules allowed his pawn, Xiao Shan, to become the first Gu Master to ascend Yi Tian Mountain.

Xiao clan's supreme elder thus became the first Southern Border Gu Immortal to begin refining battle will in the Immortal Gu House.

# Chapter 999: Chess Piece, Chess Player

Central Continent, Heavenly Lotus Sect.

# Chapter 1001: Taking Control of Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage

Life and death blessed land.

Southern Border, Yi Tian Mountain.

# Chapter 1002: Extreme Formation, Dangerous Situation Again

Having suppressed the Great Strength True Martial immortal zombie for so many years, the Immortal Gu House Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage had formed a peculiar balance with it.

At this critical juncture, his wisdom path grandmaster attainment helped immensely, allowing him to deduce much about the Immortal Gu House from its Gu worms.

Thus, Fang Yuan's understanding of Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage grew rapidly from nothing.

At this moment, he had finally succeeded, completely taking over the Immortal Gu House Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage.

Bam.

Rank five Gu Master Sun Pang Hu approached ruthlessly, but Fang Yuan remained completely calm, feeling no nervousness.

That was, to suppress the Great Strength True Martial immortal zombie!
