"You know my name?" Fang Yuan growled, feeling something amiss.

"As an otherworldly demon, you are still useful to Shadow Sect, so I will spare your life. Don't bother with Spring Autumn Cicada—Yan Shi deduced it cannot be activated now." Confident of victory, Ying Wu Xie approached with a smile.

"What?!" Fang Yuan's entire body shook.

# Chapter 1012: Murdering Kin, Slaughtering Everyone

A hundred thousand years ago.

Southern Border, Xuan Ci Mountain.

A battle had just ended, leaving only two people on the battlefield with the victor evident.

"Hahaha!" A young man laughed toward the sky, blood-red eyes brimming with bloodthirst as he strode toward the other Gu Master.

The old man shouted: "Why! I raised you and taught you everything! Why attack the clan's higher-ups and repay our kindness with enmity? Why?!"

Facing the old man's questions, the young Gu Master lowered his gaze and smiled faintly: "Why? I haven't really thought about it. Hmm... if I must give a reason, maybe I was just annoyed."

"Annoyed?!"

"That's right... Constantly preaching that we must endure in silence, respect elders, maintain integrity, and never talk back. Saying the clan relies on me to defend its reputation, that I must think of the clansmen to become a brilliant clan leader... it's truly annoying! I felt annoyed ever since I was young. I thought I could endure it, but eventually I couldn't." The young Gu Master bared his pale white teeth.

"Enough! Enough!" The young Gu Master scowled ruthlessly, irritated by the old Gu Master's weeping.

He raised his right hand, slashing down.

With a soft sound, the old Gu Master was cleaved in two, blood and intestines spilling out as he died in grievance.

Tears flowed in deep sorrow, yet a look of utter satisfaction spread across his face.

"Even though I feel sad... is this freedom? Had I known, I would have killed them long ago. From now on, I will kill whatever annoys me!"

A hundred thousand years later.

Now completely transformed, he was a thousands-of-meters-tall monster with three heads and a thousand arms.

"So noisy, non-stop rumbling, enough is enough!" Spectral Soul roared.

A thousand arms exerted immense force as surging demonic aura coiled around the tornadoes and tore them to shreds.

Clouds dispersed and sunlight returned—Spectral Soul had resolved the myriad tribulation, wind lightning prison!

"Did we succeed?" Bo Qing and Ying Wu Xie looked back, joy showing on their faces.

But immediately, the sky turned dark again, countless grey clouds gathered above Spectral Soul's head.

The second myriad tribulation was gathering strength!

Suddenly, he raised hundreds of arms, stabbing into the dark clouds at his waist.

Formed by the ten extreme formation, the dark clouds shook intensely under Spectral Soul's assistance.

Led by Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord, Heaven Overseeing Tower turned phantom and flew past the encirclement of ghostly hands.

Re-solidifying the next moment, Heaven Overseeing Tower surged forward with a loud crash, striking Spectral Soul's right head fiercely.

Spectral Soul's head caved in under the impact, his chin slammed up into his cheekbones.

As Heaven Overseeing Tower hovered above Spectral Soul in phantom form, a hundred of his muscular dark arms withered into long, thin tendrils.

With his aid, the ten extreme formation shifted as dark clouds gathered toward the center.

At the center of the dark clouds, a spinning sphere faintly appeared, glowing with fourteen different colored lights.

Seeing this, an anxious Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord ordered: "Chop off these arms!"

Like a rocket, Heaven Overseeing Tower traced a dazzling light rainbow through the sky, cleanly severing all of Spectral Soul's arms upon contact.

"Ying Wu Xie, go and deal with Heavenly Court's Gu Immortals!" Immortal zombie Bo Qing called out.

Ying Wu Xie gritted his teeth, unwilling to leave just yet: "Give me a moment to put Fang Yuan to sleep first."

Saying so, he activated the rank eight immortal killer move — Lead Soul Into Dream.

Unable to dodge, Fang Yuan was dragged into the dream realm.

In the pavilion at the center of the lake, zither music resonated.

Fang Yuan met Star Constellation Immortal Venerable again.

Unravel dream.

Fang Yuan hurriedly activated his dream path killer move, but the dream realm held firm, producing only faint ripples across his vision.

Unravel Dream was only rank six, powerless against Ying Wu Xie's rank eight killer move.

As zither music played, Star Constellation Immortal Venerable smiled gently at Fang Yuan and sang in a soft voice.

As Heaven Overseeing Tower prepared to strike again, one of Spectral Soul's heads opened its eyes and immobilized it with a stare.

Heaven Overseeing Tower could no longer exit its phantom form!

"Fang Yuan!" Hei Lou Lan and Tai Bai Yun Sheng shouted.

But Fang Yuan was fast asleep and could not be awakened.

Just as Bo Qing moved to slaughter Hei Lou Lan and Tai Bai Yun Sheng, immense suction surged from the ground.

Caught off guard, the immortals were dragged into the earth up to their legs, powerful forces restricting their movement.

Grand tribulation — Earth Collapse!

Bo Qing and Ying Wu Xie were stunned; they had not expected a grand tribulation to ambush them while the myriad tribulation engaged Spectral Soul.

"Why aren't they restricted?!" Both were soon shocked again.

Upon hitting the ground, Hei Lou Lan and Tai Bai Yun Sheng regained their freedom and could move unhindered.

The latter grabbed the sleeping Fang Yuan and retreated rapidly.

To their joy, once the ten extreme formation produced the mysterious sphere, the spatial restriction vanished—if Fang Yuan awoke, they could escape with Fixed Immortal Travel.

Immortal zombie Bo Qing's eyes flashed with killing intent, but as he prepared to activate sword path Immortal Gu, newly formed thoughts were instantly dragged into the ground.

Earth collapse targeted not only Gu Immortals' bodies, but their thoughts, wills, and emotions as well.

# Chapter 1013: Grey Memory

Not only were the Gu Immortals trapped in the ground, their thoughts were also interrupted.

"Damn it!!" Ying Wu Xie screamed, struggling futilely as he sank deeper and deeper.

"Stop struggling and stop thinking—it will only worsen our situation, and we cannot resolve this now," immortal zombie Bo Qing said calmly beside him.

"We can only hope our main body saves us," Ying Wu Xie sighed, looking at Spectral Soul.

Spectral Soul was sinking too, half his massive legs dragged beneath the earth.

Of his six eyes, two pinned down Heaven Overseeing Tower while the other four gazed into the sky.

Thickening grey clouds gathered high above and descended slowly.

The second myriad tribulation had started.

This myriad tribulation however, was very slow.

But Spectral Soul did not move.

Even as grey clouds completely shrouded him, Spectral Soul remained motionless, controlling Heaven Overseeing Tower firmly.

They had used phantom transformation to evade Spectral Soul's attacks, but his phantom path attainment far exceeded expectations—he was certainly a great grandmaster.

The grey cloud descended, but it caused no harm.

"What is happening? A harmless myriad tribulation?!" Seeing no damage, a bewildered Ying Wu Xie felt around his body and cried out in suspicion.

"Is this grey memory?" an observant Heavenly Court Gu Immortal cried out.

"What is grey memory?"

The Heavenly Court Gu Immortal recalled: "In my youth, I inherited the legacy of a rank eight Gu Immortal who perished against the myriad tribulation grey memory, leaving his inheritance in his final moments. This myriad tribulation is harmless to the body, but it draws out the person's deepest memories. These memories were either those which had caused huge pain to the Gu Immortal's mind, or were a trauma in their life."

Myriad tribulation — Grey Memory.

Recognizing this myriad tribulation, Spectral Soul made no move.

No attack could disperse this tribulation; he had to confront all his past shame, trauma, and rage to overcome it.

The grey clouds coiling around his body suddenly flared with light and emitted sounds.

A scene from Spectral Soul Demon Venerable's childhood unfolded before the immortals.

"Kill her! Kill her! Kill her!"

A band of Gu Masters surrounded a family of three, ruthlessly shouting with bloodshot eyes.

"Father! You cannot kill mother!!" A child protected his heavily injured mother, yelling with all his energy.

"Hmph, all demonic path members must be executed! We of the righteous path uphold justice and slay demons!! Why can't we kill her? We must kill her to purge our clan's humiliation!!" The old Gu Master leading the group spoke with righteous indignation; he was the boy's grandfather and the clan leader.

With a soft sound, fresh blood spewed out.

His father stood weeping with gritted teeth, dagger plunged deep into his beloved wife's heart.

From that day onwards, he became very quiet.

The grey fog moved, as another scene appeared.

Several years had passed.

Having grown slightly, the young boy stood respectfully before his grandfather.

His grandfather, the clan leader, sipped tea and asked casually: "I had you read our clan's history. What insights did you gain? Tell grandfather."

"From history, I realized there is only one universal law in this world — to kill," the boy said calmly.

"Kill?" The old man frowned, demanding grimly: "Explain it to me."

"Yes," the boy continued. "When hungry, we kill prey. When threatened, we kill our enemies. In times of peace, rulers kill meritorious subjects to secure authority and control..."

"Though 'kill' is just a word, it holds profound meaning. How does one kill—use Gu worms personally, or hire other Gu Masters? When killing openly invites trouble, we assassinate instead. There are many ways to assassinate, for example..."

"Enough!" the old man bellowed, angrily smashing his cup onto the ground.

The old man stood up, shouting angrily: "I had you study so you would learn our clan's glorious history! I wanted you to learn courtesy and integrity, and understand the righteous path's glory! Yet all you learned was killing? What kind of twisted logic is this? You—you are confined for a month! Stay inside and reflect upon your mistake!"

"Yes, grandfather," the boy replied softly, a stubborn light in his eyes.

The grey fog moved, as the scene changed again.

Years later, the boy had become a rank one Gu Master.

Having refined hidden aura Gu, the youth sneaked into the study to surprise his grandfather.

Not long after, he heard a commotion.

Two people walked into the study room.

"That traitorous son! He dares rebel? He wants to harm his own father?!" Enraged, the old clan leader slammed the table with immense force.

"Clan leader, the evidence is conclusive. News that you obtained an eighty year lifespan Gu has spread; it is confirmed the young clan leader intends to harm you."

"Hmph! That traitorous son wants to seize my authority? Impossible!" the clan leader shouted.

His grandfather said solemnly: "Suppressing my son openly would damage our righteous reputation. Hmm... ...strike first and assassinate him. Once he is dead, the other clan elders will yield."

Behind the secret door in the hidden tunnel, the youth covered his mouth, shivering intensely.

# Chapter 1014: Food Path Inheritance

Carrying Fang Yuan, Tai Bai Yun Sheng sprinted away in escape.

"Fang Yuan, wake up!" Hei Lou Lan slapped his face, but he remained sound asleep.

Without Fang Yuan's Fixed Immortal Travel, leaving Southern Border was impossible.

Meanwhile, on Yi Tian Mountain's battlefield, the grey fog continued spreading.

But it was a completely different story for Spectral Soul Demon Venerable!

Inside the grey fog, Spectral Soul stood motionless like a mountain, like a dormant volcano.

Around him, the grey fog churned with dazzling rainbow lights, displaying various scenes after Spectral Soul had become a Gu Immortal.

Inside Earth Abyss.

"Youngster, you want my inheritance?" In the darkness, two eyes shone like lanterns.

"Yes," the Gu Immortal replied concisely. Black-robed with messy shoulder-length hair, he looked cold, light flashing occasionally in his eyes.

"Then this is your inheritance test!" With a loud roar, a strange beast emerged from the darkness.

The dragon-horned, crocodile-headed beastman Gu Immortal opened his mouth and bit at Spectral Soul's soul.

But Gu Immortal Spectral Soul did not dodge or evade.

The beastman bit, tearing apart Spectral Soul's arm.

Spectral Soul did not retreat, allowing it to continue biting.

The beastman Gu Immortal quickly devoured his other arm and both legs.

Despite intense pain, Spectral Soul remained expressionless without even frowning.

"You are different from the others." The beastman Gu Immortal stopped and appraised Spectral Soul with praise: "You feel no fear at all. As the creator of food path, I have researched eating extensively. Many who sought my inheritance looked tough outside, but inside were filled with agony and fear."

"Then, is my flesh delicious?" Spectral Soul asked.

With a claw, the beastman tore open Spectral Soul's stomach and pulled out his intestines.

Though pale, Spectral Soul remained cold, as if those intestines were not his own.

"What can I not endure?" Spectral Soul smiled coldly. "In this environment, even if only my head remains, I will regenerate and claim your inheritance. Once you lose all value, you should worry about yourself."

The beastman Gu Immortal faltered at his gaze: "What are you thinking?"

"Eating is natural in this world, but its flip side is killing. To eat meat, we must hunt. To eat vegetables, we must uproot them; that too is killing. Even consuming only wind and water still means swallowing and digesting them. In essence, eating is killing. Yet killing encompasses far more than eating—thus, your food path is inferior to my killing path."

"I have eaten many things, but never been eaten. Devouring me now is killing me. Likewise, though I have killed countless beings, I have never been slowly killed myself. Experiencing being killed is its own enjoyment. Only by being killed can I fully grasp killing. Thank you for deepening my comprehension."

The beastman Gu Immortal's eyes widened, staring at Spectral Soul as if looking at a nightmarish monster!

Soon, Gu Immortal Spectral Soul had only his head left.

Even with only his head remaining, Gu Immortal Spectral Soul was completely calm and peaceful.

But at this moment, the beastman Gu Immortal laughed wildly.

"Hahaha, you were duped! But don't feel bad—you're the two hundred and seventieth fool! Hahaha!"

Spectral Soul's gaze flashed: "Is this inheritance fake?"

"Of course it is real! When I reached rank eight, Barbarian Jiu Lie trapped me to steal my food path. I could not defeat him, but I refused to let him have his way easily. I made an agreement to pass the food path inheritance to future humans instead of him, provided they endure my eating test."

"Since then, many humans came to take the test and obtain food path knowledge. But not even Barbarian Jiu Lie understood my true abilities. By devouring dao marks endlessly, after a thousand years, I finally broke our agreement!"

"I will eat your head to nourish my recovery. Don't worry, I'll remember you—the most unique among the fools I have devoured!"

"So that is it," Spectral Soul replied plainly, remaining utterly calm.

The beastman Gu Immortal's expression froze, he grabbed his throat, shouting anxiously: "What is going on? What is going on?!"

Spectral Soul sneered: "Did you think my flesh was easy to eat? Every piece contained a fragment of my soul. You are an expert in food path, but coincidentally, I have some attainment in soul path."

"Soul path? When did such a path appear?! Splitting your soul causes pain far beyond tearing flesh!"

"I am the founder of soul path. As for that pain... experiencing it only heightens the joy of killing, doesn't it?" Spectral Soul stated. The beastman's face turned ashen as he ceased moving.

He was dead.

# Chapter 1015: Scenes of Past Events

"Spectral Soul is completely mad! Filled with demonic thoughts, he believes anything can be killed, that killing is the greatest joy, and that the Dao of heaven and earth is essentially killing!"

"The myriad tribulation grey memory cannot stop him. Though no longer a Demon Venerable and physically invincible, he remains mentally invincible!"

Just then, the clear chirping of birds echoed from the sky.

"Myriad tribulation — Grand Clear Space," a Heavenly Court Gu Immortal recognized.

Though appearing as birds, they were manifestations of space path. Wherever they flew, space was obliterated—an unstoppable, terrifying power.

Under the watchful eyes of Heavenly Court's Gu Immortals, the jade birds swooped down, encircling Spectral Soul.

Wherever the birds passed, deep lacerations opened like wounds from sharp blades.

The surrounding grey fog seemed to trap Spectral Soul deep within his memories.

Suddenly, rainbow fog expanded behind Spectral Soul's head into a vast veil, pushing away the surrounding scenes.

This was a silver-white space.

It was the location of a Thieving Heaven true inheritance.

Gu Immortal Spectral Soul barged in, muttering arrogantly: "Thieving Heaven, though you were a Demon Venerable, you are long dead. Why not leave your inheritance to me?"

However, Thieving Heaven true inheritances were left for otherworldly demons.

Not being an otherworldly demon, Gu Immortal Spectral Soul was unqualified to inherit it.

Despite exhausting every method, he only spat blood, returning empty-handed with a pale face.

Upon becoming a Demon Venerable, Spectral Soul dominated the world, slaughtering the masses.

Human history recorded that Spectral Soul once destroyed a super force, slaughtering over ten million people solely to obtain lifespan Gu.

Toying with the lifespan Gu in his hand, his expression was perplexed.

Looking over the scenery, he muttered: "Heaven, if you want to kill us, why create us?"

Another huge screen of fog appeared.

Spectral Soul Demon Venerable came to the Thieving Heaven true inheritance space he had visited in his youth.

Thieving Heaven's will formed before him: "Every venerable is extraordinary. I hope you will be magnanimous and leave this true inheritance for a fated person."

Hands behind his back, Spectral Soul Demon Venerable replied coldly: "In my youth, I coveted everything here. But now that I have attained my Dao, nothing here attracts me. I came only to ask a question."

Thieving Heaven's will smiled: "I understand. Those at our level inevitably have questions about heaven and earth. I will share my experiences for your reference."

"Okay." Spectral Soul Demon Venerable nodded.

Thieving Heaven's will continued: "You might already know, I am not from this world, I am what you would call an otherworldly demon."

"The world I came from is different from here in both its foundation and scenery. To me, I am only a traveler here, I want to go home, I have strived over my whole life for that goal."

"My real name is Ben Jie Sun. In my original world, I had a high status because I was a mecha operator."

"Mecha?" Spectral Soul Demon Venerable's eyes shone with deep interest.

"Mecha... you can think of it as a puppet or armor operated by a human inside to unleash immense battle strength," Thieving Heaven's will explained vaguely.

A moment later, another scene appeared.

Within Eighty-Eight True Yang Building.

Holding Giant Sun's true inheritance, Spectral Soul sighed: "Possessing bodies is merely a desperate measure—death remains inevitable. Lifespan Gu is still the best option. The path of a Gu Immortal is filled with tribulations—the body fails, the soul cannot exist independently, and maintaining longevity defies heaven... it is hard, hard, hard!"

"Giant Sun, oh Giant Sun, even if you created Eighty-Eight True Yang Building and attempted to plunder the lifespan Gu in Northern Plains. But heaven's will is vicious, fewer and fewer lifespan Gu are being produced, even if you obtain all of the lifespan Gu in the world, so what?"

"Heaven's will dictates lifespan Gu production. To live a long life, the crux lies with heaven's will."

At the river of time.

Spectral Soul Demon Venerable hovered mid-air, looking at a red lotus floating on the river's surface.

After exhausting all his efforts, he successfully left a ghost face on the red lotus.

"Red Lotus Demon Venerable, the most mysterious in history..." Spectral Soul Demon Venerable sighed with weary yet bright eyes. "Why did you deliberately stop and leave behind the heavily injured fate Immortal Gu?"

"Star Constellation Immortal Venerable truly made a deep scheme!"

"So only a complete otherworldly demon can thoroughly destroy fate."

"Even Thieving Heaven was only half an otherworldly demon—his soul came from another world while his body was native."

"To extend my lifespan, I must defy heaven's will. Sadly, heaven's will has no soul for me to kill. Perhaps with this Red Lotus true inheritance, I can become half an otherworldly demon..."

In a dark secret room.

Spectral Soul Demon Venerable sat on the ground before countless Gu formations.

Inside the formations lay countless corpses of men, women, young, old, and diverse variant humans.

With disheveled hair and a blood-covered body, Spectral Soul Demon Venerable was skeletal and exhausted, but his sunken eyes shone brilliantly.

He was staring at a book fixedly.

The Legends of Ren Zu.

"The Legends of Ren Zu... to think I only truly understood you today! You are an exposition of human path, the true inheritance Ren Zu left behind!"

"Using human path methods, I can create a new body and become half an otherworldly demon through soul replacement!"

"Maybe not just that, I can still..."

"What a pity—it is too late! I am fatally injured, and death approaches me."

Though invincible under heaven, Spectral Soul succumbed to injuries—perhaps inflicted while testing human path methods.

The myriad tribulation grand clear space was still continuing.

Over half of Spectral Soul's thousand arms had been severed by the jade birds. Covered in wounds, he offered no resistance.

# Chapter 1016: Over A Long Time

Inside the door of life and death.

In Obsession Death Domain.

Bodiless, Spectral Soul Demon Venerable manifested as a soul possessing three heads and a thousand arms.

Looking at his reflection in the lake, he muttered: "Very good. I created soul devouring based on food path, restoring my peak and letting me devour Gu Immortal souls for their lifelong memories and cultivation experience! Hehehe, a blessing in disguise..."

"Yet I found no souls of other Immortal or Demon Venerables. Star Constellation's absence is understandable, but Thieving Heaven is missing too—did he successfully return home?"

"It is time to return to the living world. Without Dang Hun Mountain and Luo Po Valley obstructing me, leaving the Door of Life and Death is far easier than it was for Ren Zu. Since my main body cannot depart yet, I should send split souls to pave the way."

In the following scene, seven mortals appeared instead of Spectral Soul.

"Due to Reverse Flow River's obstruction, only seven of our original ten made it out."

"Freeing our main body will take effort. If discovered, others will not sit idly by."

"To play it safe, we should separate and develop secretly across the five regions, communicating occasionally."

"In that case, why not create an organization to deceive the masses?"

"That's true. Let's call it Shadow Sect—unnoticed like shadows yet everywhere. One day, the entire world will be shrouded in our shadows!"

"Agreed. We seven are named Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Azure, Blue, and Purple. Like the seven immemorial heavens, let us never grow complacent!"

"Sword Immortal Bo Qing is actually Spectral Soul Demon Venerable's split soul!" Heavenly Court's Gu Immortals cried out.

"Azure." Inside Bo Qing's immortal zombie body, Mo Yao's remnant soul felt deeply moved upon seeing the young, handsome Azure in the image.

Around her, grey fog rumbled, showing a scene from deep within her memories.

Ruins stretched all around, with countless mangled corpses lying on the bloody ground.

"Husband! Don't die—you cannot die! If you die, how will I live without you?" Mo Yao hugged Sword Immortal Bo Qing, weeping helplessly.

Bo Qing held Mo Yao's hand weakly: "I am a split soul of Spectral Soul Demon Venerable. Loving me will only bring pain. Leave quickly, or it will be too late."

Mo Yao shook her head firmly: "No! I don't care about your identity—only that we love each other. If I cannot live with you, I will die with you!"

Six members of Shadow Sect gathered together.

"My mistake!" Green said. "Had I not sent Azure to treasure yellow heaven, he wouldn't have fallen into love's trap, betrayed us, and exposed our main body!"

"Not your fault," Purple consoled. "These are obstacles from heaven's will! As our cultivation rises, nothing goes smoothly; unintended troubles arise everywhere."

"We must resolve Azure's situation quickly, or our main body's plan will be obstructed!"

"It is possible, but risky and costly," Purple said slowly. "Yet I have a plan. If it succeeds, we might even turn Fairy Mo Yao to our side."

Purple smiled: "Spirit Affinity House used rank nine Love Gu. With his sword path incomplete, Azure couldn't resist its unstoppable might. It isn't his fault."

"With my wisdom path attainment reaching great grandmaster, I understand Azure's sword path and deduced a solution: a recipe for wisdom sword Immortal Gu."

Purple nodded: "Wisdom sword severs love threads. It only needs to cut Azure's love dao marks. We can stage an encounter so he believes he created the recipe himself."

"Once used, his love threads will be severed, restoring his reason and loyalty. Furthermore, since Mo Yao still bears love threads, we can use them to turn her to our side!"

"What?!" Seeing this, immortal zombie Bo Qing frowned deeply from the ground.

Inside the body, Mo Yao's remnant soul had believed her lover created wisdom sword Immortal Gu himself!

"Then... did Azure deceive me, or did he still love me?" Mo Yao's remnant soul shook with doubt.

Just then, another scene appeared around Spectral Soul.

Shadow Sect's seven immortals gathered.

"Once I become a venerable, I will dominate the world unrivaled," Azure said arrogantly. "Even heaven's will cannot touch me, and lifespan Gu are plentiful in this era."

Purple looked at him: "After Azure's first failure, ample preparation should prevent further mishaps... How is Fairy Mo Yao?"

Azure laughed coldly: "That foolish woman went to Eighty-Eight True Yang Building to refine calamity beckoning Immortal Gu, intending to draw the myriad tribulation onto herself during my ascension."

Purple shook his head: "Mo Yao's luck path plan will fail. Still, give her change soul Immortal Gu and that killer move. If you fail the tribulation, an intact soul preserves your foundation, letting you restart quickly."

"Mm. Thorough preparation is best." Azure nodded expressionlessly.

This scene made immortal zombie Bo Qing's body shake intensely.

Five of the immortals from Shadow Sect were gathered again.

"Blue failed," Yellow said painedly. "He fused his immortal aperture with the immemorial blue heaven fragment to research heaven's will, but fell deep into a dream realm."

After a long pause, Purple said: "Blue can be saved, but we mustn't act hastily. This is heaven's will's trap to expose us."

"Azure's second rank nine ascension attempt proved it—the tribulation was over tenfold stronger than the first! Heaven's will refuses to let us become venerables and targets us relentlessly."

"I won't hide it, I've had a bad premonition. First Azure, then Blue—I fear I am next."

"After I am gone, Gu Immortal Da Li will take over. Heaven's will is stronger than estimated, but not impossible to deceive. From now on, Shadow Sect will lie low and build strength in secret. When executing our heaven-defying act, we must strike with all our might before heaven's will can react."

# Chapter 1017: Deep Scheme

"Green, hurry!" Yellow grabbed Green's hand, pulling him away.

"No! Look at the immortal fetus Gu, it can still be saved!" Green screamed, struggling. "Let go, that's my life's work!"

"You think this explosion was an accident? Look at the remaining rank eight immortal materials!" Yellow shouted furiously.

Green shuddered in cold sweat. "These immortal materials are full of heaven's will," he said in fear. "My reason was influenced just now! Even hidden in Northern Plains' Earth Trench beneath this grand formation, I was still discovered?"

"Only a complete otherworldly demon remains fully undetected by heaven's will. Don't be discouraged—abandon this attempt and we will start over," Yellow consoled.

Green fell silent, looking at the surrounding sand, and nodded solemnly.

As the memory faded, the battle on Yi Tian Mountain continued. The myriad tribulation grand clear space finally ended.

Offering no resistance against the green birds, Spectral Soul shrank by a third.

Meanwhile, Heaven Overseeing Tower prepared to strike, close to solidifying from phantom form.

Myriad tribulation — Dark Oil Poison.

From the sky, drops of sticky poisonous oil dripped down.

Soon, the poisonous oil rained down in torrential streams.

Bathed in poisonous oil, Spectral Soul's massive body rotted visibly, rapidly shrinking.

But he did not do anything.

In the grey fog, another scene appeared.

Clutching heavenly secret Gu, Old Man Yan Shi coughed blood: "Fang Yuan has Spring Autumn Cicada! No wonder he seized Hu Immortal blessed land and destroyed Eighty-Eight True Yang Building!"

"An otherworldly demon with Spring Autumn Cicada has escaped fate—the perfect tool against heaven's will. I will conceal your tracks to block deductions."

Old Man Yan Shi coughed violently, pale and so exhausted he seemed on the verge of suffocating.

"Spending a century of lifespan with heavenly secret Gu was worth it: Spring Autumn Cicada is in poor condition."

"Fang Yuan's early arrival at Yi Tian Mountain proves he knows about the battle. Our main body must have already failed once, using that Red Lotus true inheritance to send Fang Yuan back in time to alter the future. Thankfully, Spring Autumn Cicada is only rank six—nothing terrifying."

"With the newly obtained lifespan Gu, I have twenty years left. My split soul must naturally return to the main body, but first, I will deduce the tribulations for our heaven-defying plan."

"Generations of Shadow Sect wisdom path advisors deduced before me, finally accumulating enough foundation to deduce all the tribulations!"

"How ironic. Heavenly secret Immortal Gu deduces the tribulations, yet Paradise Earth created this very Gu. He spent his life purging our main body's influence, yet in death provides us immense help."

Seeing this, Heavenly Court's Gu Immortals were stunned speechless.

Shadow Sect had deduced the tribulations all along! Spectral Soul remaining motionless within them was deeply suspicious.

As the mysterious myriad tribulation vanished, the next descended.

Vine dragon tribulation!

Countless thorny green vines erupted from sky and earth, coiling around Spectral Soul.

Soon, millions of vines surrounded Spectral Soul tightly, forming a huge ball.

They tightened relentlessly, stabbing into his body and feeding on the Demon Venerable's soul as nutrients!

"He is doing this on purpose, look at that ten extreme formation!"

Heavenly Court's Gu Immortals looked over, coming to a realization.

Having deduced the tribulations, Shadow Sect could make precise arrangements around them.

Spectral Soul offered no resistance so his soul path foundation could nourish and fuse into the formation.

"What is he refining? He used his own demonic soul as Gu refinement material!"

"Furthermore, the myriad tribulations are carving diverse dao marks onto him, destroying his soul path foundation. These dao marks could harm Spectral Soul because they rivaled his accumulated soul path foundation!"

Spectral Soul was not only refining himself, but harnessing the myriad tribulations to accomplish his goal.

The ten extreme formation reached its final juncture; amidst dark fog, the sphere of light grew brighter and rounder.

Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord's heart sank to rock bottom.

With grim determination, he said: "We must ruin Spectral Soul's scheme! Whatever he is refining, we must destroy this ten extreme formation."

"But we are in phantom form."

"We have one chance to retaliate—a secret researched by successive Heaven Overseeing Tower Lords and kept strictly confidential!" Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord said.

# Chapter 1018: Narrow Victory

Someone stepped forward: "If Shadow Sect can make sacrifices, so can Heavenly Court! I will stay behind to control Heaven Overseeing Tower!"

"Sacrificing this body to slay a Demon Venerable—why hesitate?"

Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord waved: "Those staying will help activate the tower. The rest will retreat to white heaven and retrieve the surviving Gu."

After saying this, Heavenly Court's members came to an agreement.

Heaven Overseeing Tower shot a bright light skyward, and a descending pillar of radiance enveloped the entire tower.

Startled, Spectral Soul tried to suppress Heaven Overseeing Tower, preventing it from leaving phantom form.

Yet the tower was not trying to solidify; its final attack required remaining in phantom form throughout.

Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord's voice echoed: "Spectral Soul Demon Venerable, behold Heaven Overseeing Tower's ultimate attack!"

He immediately plunged into the rank nine Immortal Gu before him!!

# Chapter 1021: Still Not Returning Here?
